2227178.title: Integration Specialist
2227178.description:
Bluedrop Training & Simulation Inc. (BTSI) develops advanced training and simulation solutions for the aerospace and defense industry. Our team designs and delivers high-performance virtual and mixed reality training systems used by front-line operators in complex and demanding environments.

As an Integration Specialist, you will play a key role in integrating, configuring, testing, and supporting advanced simulation and training systems throughout the product lifecycle. You will work closely with systems engineering, software development, and production teams to incorporate a variety of third-party hardware and software technologies into our simulation products.

This role combines hands-on technical integration work with customer-facing field support responsibilities and requires occasional travel to customer and test sites.

Qualifications
• Minimum of 2 years of relevant industry experience

• Bachelor's degree in a technical field is preferred

• Strong working knowledge of Windows operating systems, system configuration, and troubleshooting

• Familiarity with software and system concepts including operating systems, networking, and system performance metrics such as CPU usage, memory utilization, network throughput, and bottleneck analysis

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage timelines and expectations

• Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment

• Comfortable working in customer-facing environments and travelling to remote customer sites as required

## Nice to Have:

• Familiarity with networking concepts including TCP/IP, switching, routing, and network troubleshooting

• Experience with software and system testing

• Experience with scripting or software development (e.g. Python, PowerShell, C++, C#)

• IT support or systems administration experience

• Experience working with Virtual Reality (VR) or Mixed Reality (MR) hardware and tracking systems

• Experience with military simulation platforms such as VBS3/VBS4 or Arma, including mission creation, terrain modification, or basic scripting

• Experience integrating third-party hardware and software systems

Responsibilities
• Configure and integrate hardware and software components using vendor-provided documentation and internal procedures

• Develop and maintain system setup, configuration, and support documentation

• Troubleshoot system-level hardware, software, networking, and integration issues

• Perform root cause analysis and develop corrective solutions for identified problems

• Collaborate with software, systems, and production teams during integration and product development activities

• Participate in system architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical documentation activities

• Conduct feature, regression, and integration testing across simulation products

• Evaluate and recommend hardware and software technologies based on system requirements

• Work directly with third-party technology vendors to resolve integration and support issues

• Provide remote and on-site support for deployed customer systems

• Deliver customer training, field support, and product demonstrations

• Travel to customer and test sites as required

## What's in it For You?

• Work on advanced VR/MR simulation and training systems used in demanding operational environments

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams across software, systems, and production

• Exposure to cutting-edge simulation, visualization, and training technologies

• Opportunities for hands-on field support, customer interaction, and technical growth

• Competitive compensation, benefits, and career development opportunities

• Flexible work arrangements and a collaborative team environment

• Opportunity to contribute directly to products used by global aerospace and defense customers

2238301.description:
Requisition ID: 2602

Why Choose IMP Aerospace & Defence:
IMP Aerospace & Defence is not only one of the leading companies in the Aerospace field, but we are also one of the most engaging and equality advocating companies to work for. We believe that regardless of where you work at IMP Aerospace & Defence, you are a part of our ever-growing team. IMP is able to achieve success through this teamwork mindset. That is why at IMP, you are not defined by your role.

Position Overview:
Reporting to the Manager, Human Resources, the Recruiter will be responsible for executing the recruitment strategies of IMP Aerospace to attract and retain top candidates from across the globe. The Recruiter will partner with the leadership team and contribute to the success of our workforce by developing and implementing effective talent strategies and recruitment processes.

What You Will Do:
• Partner with leadership and hiring managers to identify and execute hiring strategies.

• Complete full cycle recruitment practices that create diversified and strong talent pools that ultimately lead to successful new hires.

• Lead the end-to-end recruitment process by navigating potential road blocks and ensuring the recruitment is moving efficiently.

• Provide professional advice and recommendations to leadership and HR team related to current recruitment best practices and trends.

• Act as the main point of contact for internal and external job applicants providing timely status updates.

• Design and create job postings and advertisements to attract top candidates both internal and external.

• Build relationships and a network to help identify and source qualified candidates.

• Engage with the public and represent IMP at networking functions and recruitment events.

• Maintain tracking and data related to recruitment statistics and trends.

What You Will Bring:
• Minimum 1 year of recent recruitment experience with proven ability to recruit technical and non-technical positions.

• Post-secondary education in Human Resources Management (undergraduate degree with concentration in HR or undergraduate degree with post grad HR specialization).

• Solid understanding of full cycle recruitment with demonstrated ability in behavioral interviewing and high-volume recruitment.

• Technologically savvy and previous experience working in online recruitment platforms. Familiarity with SAP Success Factors and Abode Workspace would be considered an asset.

• Working knowledge of human resources principles and practices including human rights and employment equity legislation. Familiarity with Canadian immigration process is an asset.

• Ability to travel is required as travel is anticipated to attend recruitment and networking events on behalf of IMP.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to meet tight deadlines and handle stressful situations in a fast paced, diverse environment.

• Must have a sense of urgency with strong internal client focus and the ability to influence others.

• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.

• Strong working knowledge of all required MS Office software.

• Must be eligible to meet requirements for Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP), Secret Level II Security Clearance through PSPC- Contract Security Program, and Transport Canada RAIC clearance.

What We Will Do For You:
• All IMP's benefits become effective on your first day of work, regardless of your position.

• Employees are entitled to 3 paid personal days and 12 statutory holidays per year.

• We offer a comprehensive Benefits Package, including RRSP Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Long Service Awards, Volunteer Grant Program, Scholarship Program, and more!

IMP is committed to Employment Equity and our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels. We welcome applicants from Indigenous People, Visible Minority Groups, Persons with Disabilities and Women in occupations or positions where they are under-represented. If you are a member of one of these equity groups, you are encouraged to self identify on either your cover letter or resume.

About Us
At the Department of Finance and Treasury Board, we strive to provide financial leadership, analysis and policies that strengthen Nova Scotia. As stewards of the province's financial affairs, we deliver a wide range of corporate fiscal management services – including the preparation of the provincial budget – as well as ensure government plans are coordinated and fiscally responsible. We are constantly looking for new and better ways to plan, manage, budget, and invest.

About Our Opportunity
The Director Financial Advisory Services is responsible for providing strategic direction and technical leadership in the development of fiscal management strategy to assist the province in meeting its shared services objectives.

As the Director Financial Advisory Services, you will provide guidance and direction to a team supporting client Departments and Public Service Votes.

This position reports to the Executive Director of Financial Advisory Services

Primary Accountabilities
You will be responsible for:

• Leading, coaching and mentoring budget and financial staff with respect to performance management, training and development.

• Budgeting, forecasting, year-end audit requirements, and accountability reporting.

• Managing operational budget submissions.

• Overseeing and directing third party cost sharing arrangements, ensuring they are properly reflected in budgets, forecasted, and accounted for.

• Provide leadership and support in the development of departmental policies and programs.

• Oversee the provision of briefing material.

• Ensure that expenditures are accounted for in adherence to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), Public Sector Accounting Board (PSAB) and government policies.

Provide advice, recommendations and assistance to senior management, client departments, agencies and authorities.

Qualifications and Experience
This may be the right opportunity for you if you have a university degree in business, commerce, or public administration and a professional accounting designation (CPA, CGA, CMA, CA). Several years of progressive financial management experience, preferably in a large organization, is also required.

As the successful candidate, you will possess a broad base of experience in budget development, forecasting, and financial accounting reporting. Demonstrated ability in leading and engaging a team is required. This position requires an aptitude to deal with complex issues, strong analytical skills, sound judgment and relationship-management skills, capacity for decisive action, and the ability to influence.

You are an experienced leader and excellent communicator with several years of experience engaging a variety of stakeholders.

While not required, it is considered an asset if you have knowledge and experience in government financial policies and procedures.

2239946.title: Engineering Co-Op Student
2239946.description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is growing?

## Who We Are

We are a global mining company dedicated to safely delivering nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals essential for the world's energy transition.

Our mission is to improve lives and shape a better future together.

From utensils to cellphones to satellites, our operations simplify daily life and enhance connectivity. Our metals are integral to life-saving medical equipment and the electric vehicles driving the fight against climate change – our work truly matters.

Join our diverse team of 15,000 talented individuals committed to transforming critical minerals into prosperity and sustainable development in countries like Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Japan. We invite you to use your skills with us and contribute to something meaningful and enduring.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking Engineering and Science Co-op Students to join our various Engineering Teams across our Operations in Sudbury, Ontario.

This is a 4 to 16 month fixed term position starting in January 2027 or May 2027. Please be clear in your application which start date you are looking for.

Note: Clearly state the program you are enrolled in, year of study, work location of preference, availability to start, and duration of the work term on your application.

As an Engineering or Science Coop student you will be provided with an opportunity that will allow you to gain valuable experience, knowledge and be a part of shaping our mining operations.

Additionally, in this position you will:

• Follow Vale's Safety Policies, Programs and Legislative Standards

• Develop skills and abilities related to the provision of engineering in Ontario and Manitoba

• Ensure compliance to the applicable laws, standards and guidelines

• Provide technical support to enable safe and efficient operations in an industrial plant, mine or production laboratory.

• Maintain demonstrate open and clear dialogue in all aspects of work

## About You

## Education:

We are looking for students currently enrolled and in good standing in an Engineering or Science University Co-op program, in any of the following fields:

• Chemical

• Electrical

• Mechanical

• Metallurgical

• Materials

• Environmental

• Civil

• Geotechnical

• Process

• Mining (Please apply to the Mining Engineering Co-Op posting)

## Skills:

• Demonstrate good written and oral communication skills

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 products; Teams, Word, Excel, Outlook

## What We Offer You

• Competitive compensation.

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth.

• Online training and career development opportunities.

• Opportunities to build your network and lots of fun!

• All Personal Protective Equipment is provided upon hire. Employees are given a safety boot allowance and receive a 100% reimbursement for prescription safety glasses.

## Why Sudbury

Greater Sudbury is a vibrant city in northeastern Ontario, renowned for its rich mining history and significant role in Canada's mineral production. 2227550.title: Production Supervisor
2227550.description:
Requisition ID: 2470

Why Choose IMP Aerospace & Defence:
IMP Aerospace & Defence is not only one of the leading companies in the Aerospace field, but we are also one of the most engaging and equality advocating companies to work for. We believe that regardless of where you work at IMP Aerospace & Defence, you are a part of our ever-growing team. IMP is able to achieve success through this teamwork mindset. That is why at IMP, you are not defined by your role.

Position Overview:
The Production Supervisor position is a leadership position within a "Product" structured organization of the Fixed Wing and Rotary Wing programs. Production Supervisors are members of a dedicated team of multiple disciplined supervisor's whose roles are to lead teams of core employees augmented with additional employees as production requirements dictate. In particular, the Production Supervisor is charged with the progress of the aircraft production activities within established performance objectives and maintaining the well-being and development of their assigned employees.

What You Will Do:
• Responsible for the day to day management and performance of their employees.

• They are expected to lead, manage and carry out duties in accordance with Company policies, procedures, rules, and directives, and apply the same expectations to all IMP employees.

• Oversee the execution of staged work by drawing upon the available resource skills, disciplines and authorizations in order to complete the work in the most efficient manner possible.

• Participate in the staging of work and the identification and resolution of constraints. Responsible for productivity reports and to initiate action to correct errors.

• Enforce the requirement of strict clocking accuracy in terms of Cost, WIP management and AMO compliance.

• In compliance with the employees development plans, Production Foremen are expected to progress their employees to becoming qualified and authorized in their designated disciplines at the annual development rates set forth by the VP Production.

• Perform personnel and general administrative duties including preparation of performance appraisals, probation and training reports, maintenance of vacation/overtime. Etc.

• Ensure their employees receive regular objective and progress updates in relation to production plans, and employee development goals.

• Achieve the "No Fail Tasks and Priorities" that are set each year by their Production Director.

• Exercise due diligence in Occupational Health and Safety (OH&S) related issues and promptly escalate in accordance with OHS policies and procedures.

• Other duties as required.

What You Will Bring:
• Must meet one of the following eligibility requirements: graduate of a recognized aircraft maintenance or apprenticeship program, hold a current AME license, be qualified as an Aviation or Avionics Technician with the Canadian Forces, or possess equivalent foreign military/civilian trade training.

• Preference given to candidates who have completed, or can complete within 90 days, the "Advanced Airworthiness" examination.

• Candidates must be able to demonstrate a working knowledge of Production Control and Work Breakdown Structures.

• Candidates would have completed at least 80% of their employee development plans and 100% of the TQR critical tasks or equivalent license experience.

• Ideally candidates will be able to demonstrate a working knowledge of Logical Fault finding principles and practices.

• Applicant must be able to demonstrate a working knowledge of customer documentation and log control basics.

• Applicants will be expected to discuss and demonstrate their ability to apply sound leadership principles and practices including: Communication & Interpersonal skills and Technical Reading and Writing – Such as technical manuals, drawings and Technical Data Packages (TDPs), Work Orders (WOs), Request for Engineering Services (RES) instructions and associated data.

• This position operates in a multi-shift environment and requires flexibility for irregular hours, overtime, rotating shifts, and occasional off-site work for MRP and WP activities as required.

• Mature and professional appearance and behavior is required with leadership through example expected.

• Will be expected to attend, participate in and lead progress and status meetings and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Demonstrate a personal commitment to IMP Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies, continually focusing on safety complying with all Federal Health and Safety Legislation.

• Must be eligible to meet requirements for Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP), Secret Level II Security Clearance through PSPC-Contract Security Program, and Transport Canada RAIC clearance.

What We Will Do For You:
• All IMP's benefits become effective on your first day of work, regardless of your position.

• Employees are entitled to 3 paid personal days and 12 statutory holidays per year.

• We offer a comprehensive Benefits Package, including RRSP Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Long Service Awards, Volunteer Grant Program, Scholarship Program, and more!

IMP is committed to Employment Equity and our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels. We welcome applicants from Indigenous People, Visible Minority Groups, Persons with Disabilities and Women in occupations or positions where they are under-represented. If you are a member of one of these equity groups, you are encouraged to self identify on either your cover letter or resume.

2238375.title: Senior Specialist Talent Management
2238375.description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is growing?

## Who We Are

We are a global mining company dedicated to safely delivering nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals essential for the world's energy transition.

Our mission is to improve lives and shape a better future together.

From utensils to cellphones to satellites, our operations simplify daily life and enhance connectivity. Our metals are integral to life-saving medical equipment and the electric vehicles driving the fight against climate change – our work truly matters.

Join our diverse team of 15,000 talented individuals committed to transforming critical minerals into prosperity and sustainable development in countries like Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Japan. We invite you to use your skills with us and contribute to something meaningful and enduring.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Senior Specialist Talent Management, DEI, Culture & Engagement to join our People & Culture team in Toronto, Ontario. The role is in a hybrid work environment and requires in office presence 2-3 days a week.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Talent, DEI, Culture & Employee Engagement, the incumbent will play a key role in creating and advancing enterprise people initiatives across Talent Management, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI), Culture, and Employee Engagement. The position combines program execution, data analytics, stakeholder engagement, and project management to deliver impactful employee experiences and organizational outcomes.

In this role, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of talent and culture programs while leveraging workforce data, technology, and insights to inform decision-making and drive business results. You will collaborate closely with HR teams, business leaders, and cross-functional partners to ensure programs are aligned with organizational priorities and employee needs.

## Key Responsibilities

## Talent Management

• Coordinate end-to-end talent processes, including performance management cycles, talent reviews, calibration sessions, and succession planning activities.

• Prepare talent review materials, dashboards, meeting documentation, and action plans to support leadership decision-making.

• Maintain talent and succession planning data, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality.

• Support asset teams in aligning talent initiatives with business objectives and workforce needs.

• Monitor key talent metrics and provide insights that support organizational effectiveness and workforce planning.

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)

• Support the execution of enterprise-wide DEI strategies and programs across the organization.

• Coordinate employee self-identification campaigns and DEI-related communications initiatives.

• Prepare and analyze DEI-related metrics and reporting for ESG and other organizational disclosures.

## Culture & Employee Experience

• Help translate organizational values into practical tools, resources, learning materials, and employee programs.

• Support culture-building initiatives, leadership roadshows, employee events, and engagement activities.

• Partner with Talent Acquisition and Corporate Communications teams to maintain employer branding assets and employee value proposition materials.

• Contribute to initiatives that strengthen employee connection, inclusion, and organizational culture.

## Employee Engagement

• Support the administration and execution of employee engagement surveys and pulse assessments.

• Analyze engagement data and develop reports, dashboards, heat maps, presentations, and recommendations.

• Coordinate employee recognition programs, reporting, and related communications.

## People Analytics, Reporting & Systems

• Develop and maintain HR dashboards, reports, and workforce insights that support strategic decision-making.

• Partner with HR Reporting teams to produce standard and ad hoc reports using HRIS and survey platforms.

• Ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of talent, engagement, and DEI data.

• Collaborate with HRIS and IT teams to troubleshoot system issues, validate fixes, and improve reporting capabilities.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve efficiencies through automation, AI tools, and process enhancements.

## Project Management & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build and manage project plans for talent, culture, DEI, and engagement initiatives, as required

• Develop presentations, facilitator guides, FAQs, communication materials, templates, and toolkits for key stakeholders.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, and governance requirements.

• Track budgets, vendor invoices, and project expenditures against approved plans.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance program effectiveness, scalability, and employee impact.

## About You

## Experience

• Minimum 5 to 7 years of progressive experience in Talent Management, Organizational Development, Human Resources, People Analytics, or a related Centre of Excellence environment.

• Hands-on experience supporting performance management, talent review, and succession planning processes.

• Experience working within complex, matrixed, and geographically dispersed organizations.

• Demonstrated experience supporting employee engagement, culture, and DEI initiatives.

• Proven track record of leveraging technology, automation, AI, or digital tools to improve processes and operational effectiveness.

• Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and sensitive information.

## Education

• Undergraduate Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organizational Development, Analytics, or a related discipline.

• CHRP, CPHR, or equivalent professional designation (completed or in progress) is considered an asset.

• Experience with talent assessments and leadership development tools is considered an asset.

## Skills & Competencies

• Strong knowledge of talent management practices, including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership development.

• Advanced analytical capabilities with experience working with workforce data, dashboards, and reporting tools.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUPs, and data analysis techniques.

• Experience using HRIS platforms such as SuccessFactors and employee survey tools such as Qualtrics.

• Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and compelling presentations for leaders.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

• High attention to detail and ability to manage confidential information with discretion.

• Demonstrated commitment to fostering inclusive, equitable, and engaging workplace experiences

## Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting DEI, culture, talent management, or employee engagement programs within a global organization.

• Knowledge of HR analytics, workforce reporting, and organizational effectiveness methodologies.

• Experience implementing AI-enabled solutions or digital transformation initiatives within HR functions.

• Experience partnering with cross-cultural and geographically diverse teams.

• Passion for developing inclusive workplaces and sustainable talent strategies.

## What We Offer You

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans, and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

Toronto is Canada's largest city and a global center for business, innovation, and professional services. 2240708.title: Ward Clerk
2240708.description:
ABOUT ALDERWOOD:

Alderwood cares for 70 residents across Nursing Home and Residential Care. Our home is divided into six distinct home areas; five Nursing Home (11-12 residents each) and one Residential Care (11 residents). All residents have private rooms and bathrooms to ensure their comfort and dignity, and Alderwood Home Areas are designed to create a genuine sense of belonging for our residents.

We are dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for our residents supporting their mental, physical, spiritual, emotional, and social well-being through compassionate, person-centered care. Our team of skilled, caring staff work together to create a safe, comfortable, and nurturing environment where residents feel valued and supported every day.

Purpose:

Provide scheduling for all departments under the direction of the Director of Resident Care and Director of Support Services. All tasks are to be approached in a spirit of teamwork, within and among departments, to ensure cooperation and completion in an efficient manner. As with every role, the underlying responsibility is the care and safety of each resident. Incumbents of the position are to work under the direction of the Policies and Procedures of Alderwood.

Job Summary:

Prepare work schedule for employees in all departments, full and part - time, using Staff Schedule Care (SCC) and following established criteria for scheduling. Ensure schedule is prepared as per collective agreement. Communicate with employees regarding work schedules, availability etc.

Assist with payroll records, if needed.

Provide support to all the departments.

Take specimens to lab, as required.

Maintain Kardex information on all Resident birthdates.

Prepare charts for new Resident admissions.

Replenish chart monthly.

Restock clerical supplies, forms, documentation supplies in each Household.

File all Resident discharged charts.

REQUIREMENTS:

Prior experience with computer applications and demonstrated ability to learn new applications.

Demonstrated ability to utilize complex computer software, and support colleagues with same.

Demonstrated ability to appropriately manage workload, and challenging situations.

Proven professional conduct and ability to work with all departments.

Proven confidentiality and professional conduct. In recognition of the nature of the role, and acknowledgement that this role often provides access to information not otherwise provided to staff; demonstrated confidentiality, and professional management of this information is a requirement.

Demonstrated leadership and organizational skills.

Satisfactory attendance record.

Open availability to fulfill the schedule of the part-time role, as well as additional shifts as needed to supplement schedule.

Adheres to roles and responsibilities as outlined in the position outline.

Maintain good personal physical and mental health, including physical activity to ensure willingness and capacity to meet physical demands of position, including the ability to stand for long periods, and perform a significant amount of walking/movement throughout the building.

Preferred: experience scheduling for a unionized environment

2240805.title: Head of Communications
2240805.description:
## Head of Communications
Halifax, Nova Scotia
Reference #JL-PSA-10132

PSA Halifax is Atlantic Canada's leading container terminal operator and an integral gateway for global trade. As part of the PSA International network, one of the world's largest port groups, PSA Halifax connects international supply chains through two container terminals and a corporate office in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Through strategic investments, operational excellence, and a commitment to people, PSA Halifax plays a vital role in supporting economic growth across the region and beyond.

As the organization navigates significant transformation across the shipping and logistics industry, PSA Halifax is seeking a Head of Communications to help shape and strengthen communications across the business. This newly created role will be instrumental in driving employee engagement, supporting organizational change, strengthening stakeholder relationships, and ensuring clear, consistent communication during a period of growth and evolution. As PSA Halifax continues to evolve in response to industry transformation, workforce change, technology adoption, and significant growth opportunities, the Head of Communications will play a key role in helping employees, leaders, and stakeholders navigate change with confidence.

## The Role

Reporting to the Managing Director, with a close working relationship with Human Resources and regional communications leadership, the Head of Communications will serve as PSA Halifax's principal communications resource. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role responsible for establishing and leading the organization's communications function while supporting a diverse workforce of salaried and unionized employees. This is an ideal opportunity for a communications leader who thrives in building, shaping, and executing communications strategies from the ground up. As a team of one, the successful candidate will be equally comfortable developing strategy and rolling up their sleeves to write, plan, and deliver communications across the organization.

The successful candidate will partner with senior leaders to translate business priorities, operational developments, organizational change initiatives, and industry developments into clear, engaging, and effective communications. They will play a critical role in fostering alignment, trust, transparency, and engagement across multiple employee groups while supporting the organization's reputation among key external stakeholders.

Working within a dynamic and evolving industry environment, the Head of Communications will help strengthen connections between leadership and employees, support employee and labour-relations communication initiatives, enhance employer branding efforts, and contribute to PSA Halifax's long-term culture and business objectives.

## Key Responsibilities:

## Internal Communications & Employee Engagement

• Develop and execute a comprehensive internal communications and employee engagement strategy aligned with organizational priorities.

• Translate corporate strategy, business objectives, operational updates, and transformation initiatives into meaningful communications for employees.

• Build communication programs that engage both office-based and frontline employees across multiple worksites and employee groups.

• Support organizational change, technology implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives through effective communication and engagement plans.

• Enhance employee understanding of company priorities, performance, challenges, and future opportunities.

• Lead the development of leadership communications, employee campaigns, town halls, presentations, and messaging.

• Evaluate communication effectiveness and employee feedback to continuously improve engagement outcomes.

• Support communications related to labour relations initiatives and help foster constructive dialogue, understanding, and engagement across unionized employee groups.

• Develop communication approaches that support organizational integration, cultural alignment, and employee engagement across PSA Halifax's operations and worksites.

## Strategic Communications Advising

• Act as a trusted communications advisor to the Managing Director and senior leadership team.

• Develop communication strategies and key messaging related to organizational change, workforce initiatives, operational developments, and business priorities.

• Prepare speeches, presentations, briefing notes, talking points, FAQs, and leadership communications.

• Anticipate communication risks and opportunities and recommend appropriate strategies and responses.

• Provide communications leadership and guidance related to organizational transformation, operational change, workforce initiatives, and the adoption of new technologies.

## Corporate Communications & Stakeholder Relations

• Support and protect the organization's reputation through consistent and effective communications.

• Ensure alignment of messaging across internal and external audiences.

• Build and maintain positive relationships with key stakeholders, including government officials, port partners, transportation providers, labour representatives, industry associations, and community stakeholders.

• Coordinate communications activities with regional and global PSA communications teams as required.

• Lead employer branding and talent attraction communications initiatives that strengthen PSA Halifax's reputation as an employer of choice and support long-term workforce growth and development.

## Media Relations & Crisis Communications

• Serve as a key contact for media inquiries and external communications activities.

• Draft press releases, statements, media briefings, and other public-facing communications.

• Monitor relevant industry, business, and community developments that may affect the organization.

• Develop and maintain crisis communication plans and support leadership during issues requiring coordinated communication responses.

## Qualifications & Experience:

The ideal candidate is a seasoned communications professional who combines strategic thinking with a practical, roll-up-your-sleeves approach. They are comfortable working independently, building new processes and programs, and developing credibility with diverse stakeholder groups.

Qualifications include:

• Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Human Resources, Business, or a related field.

• Minimum of 8 years of progressive corporate communications experience.

• Demonstrated success leading internal communications, employee engagement, and change communication initiatives.

• Experience managing media relations and supporting reputation management initiatives.

• Exposure to crisis communications planning and execution.

• Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

• Proven ability to influence and advise senior leaders.

• Highly organized with strong project management skills and attention to detail.

• Demonstrated discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment when handling sensitive matters.

• Experience supporting communications in a unionized, industrial, transportation, logistics, marine, or infrastructure environment will be considered a strong asset.

• Demonstrated experience supporting change management, employee engagement, and organizational transformation initiatives.

## Why Join PSA?

This is a unique opportunity to build and shape the communications function of a strategically important organization operating at the center of Atlantic Canada's supply chain network. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to influence organizational culture, strengthen employee engagement, support transformational change, and help shape the future of one of Atlantic Canada's most important transportation gateways.

PSA offers:

• Performance-based bonus program

• Defined Contribution Pension Plan with company matching contributions

• Comprehensive employer-paid health and dental benefits

• Employer-supported long-term growth and development opportunities through the global PSA network

• Paid parking

• The opportunity to contribute to high-profile projects, industry transformation initiatives, and organizational change efforts

• A collaborative leadership team committed to transparency, employee engagement, and long-term growth.

To express interest in this opportunity please apply online directly by clicking here.

If you have any questions, please contact Kate Spares, Recruitment Specialist, at kspares@kbrs.ca or Jeff Lanthier, Partner, at jlanthier@kbrs.ca. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know.

Meridia Recruitment Solutions connects leading organizations with top talent by building strong relationships and creating ideal matches with candidates because we are only successful when you are. We appreciate your interest in this opportunity.

To learn more about Meridia Recruitment Solutions, our job opportunities, and career advice we invite you to explore our site and subscribe for career alerts.

2240810.description:
## Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is growing?

## Who We Are

We are a global mining company dedicated to safely delivering nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals essential for the world's energy transition.

Our mission is to improve lives and shape a better future together.

From utensils to cellphones to satellites, our operations simplify daily life and enhance connectivity. Our metals are integral to life-saving medical equipment and the electric vehicles driving the fight against climate change – our work truly matters.

Join our diverse team of 15,000 talented individuals committed to transforming critical minerals into prosperity and sustainable development in countries like Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Japan. We invite you to use your skills with us and contribute to something meaningful and enduring.

## The Opportunity

We are seeking a Specialist Auditor

This is a permanent position with a global scope supporting Vale Base Metals operations in Canada, Brazil, and other international locations based in Toronto.

## About You

The Auditor is responsible for conducting independent and objective audit examinations to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls, risk management, and governance processes across Vale's operations in Canada and globally. The role involves performing audits in accordance with the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards, Vale's Internal Audit Policy, and the highest ethical and professional standards.

This position supports the Board of Directors, Audit Committee, Fiscal Council, Executive Leadership, and Management by providing assurance and insights regarding the effectiveness of operational, financial, compliance, environmental, and governance controls. The Auditor contributes to improving business performance while safeguarding Vale's assets, people, reputation, and environment.

## In this role, you will:

• Conduct risk-based audits of operational, financial, compliance, and governance processes across Vale's business operations.

• Lead audit engagements, when required.

• Assess the effectiveness and efficiency of internal controls, risk management practices, and governance frameworks to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Evaluate compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, procedures, contracts, and internal standards.

• Verify the integrity, reliability, and accuracy of operational and financial information used for decision-making.

• Contribute to the protection and preservation of Vale's assets, employees, and environmental resources through comprehensive audit assessments.

• Execute audit engagements in accordance with established audit programs, professional auditing standards, internal methodologies, and ethical principles.

• Prepare clear, concise, and well-supported audit reports that accurately communicate observations, risks, recommendations, and conclusions.

• Present audit findings and recommendations to management and senior leadership.

• Maintain complete and accurate audit documentation and working papers while ensuring appropriate confidentiality and information security.

• Support investigations related to allegations received through the Whistleblower and Reporting Channels, including suspected fraud, misconduct, or internal control deficiencies.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization's three lines of defense to strengthen risk management and control processes.

• Support internal audit activities related to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance testing and certification requirements.

• Participate in departmental initiatives, including the development and enhancement of audit methodologies, procedures, work programs, reporting tools, analytics, and performance indicators.

• Provide advisory and consulting services when appropriate, while maintaining the independence required of the Internal Audit function.

• Stay informed of evolving audit standards, industry best practices, regulations, and emerging risks relevant to Vale's operations.

## Experience

• Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CISA, CRMA, CFA, or equivalent are preferred.

• Fluent in Portuguese language is considered an asset.

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Advanced education such as an MBA, Postgraduate Degree, Master's Degree is considered an asset.

• Strong knowledge of internal auditing standards, internal controls, enterprise risk management, corporate governance, SOX compliance, and fraud investigations.

• Experience conducting operational, financial, compliance, and risk-based audits in complex organizations.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, report-writing, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively with diverse teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

• Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally, including remote operational sites, as required.

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans, and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare online

• Online training and career development opportunities

## Why Toronto

Toronto, Canada's largest city and financial hub, is a center of innovation, commerce, and culture. Known for its diverse economy and vibrant urban environment, Toronto offers unparalleled access to talent, technology, and global connectivity.

Our Toronto office serves as a strategic hub for corporate functions, technology development, and business operations. Here, we drive initiatives that support Vale Base Metals' global operations, leveraging advanced analytics, digital transformation, and strategic planning to ensure operational excellence across all regions.

Toronto's dynamic ecosystem enables collaboration with leading technology partners, universities, and research institutions, fostering innovation in mining and metals processing. This location is integral to shaping the future of sustainable mining and advancing our commitment to responsible resource development.

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. Vale encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all.

We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success.

We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different.

2239846.title: Metallurgist
2239846.description:
Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is transforming the future?

## Who We Are

We are Vale Base Metals – a global supplier of the critical minerals transforming the future.

With industry-leading reserves of copper and nickel in Canada, Brazil, and Indonesia, and state-of-the-art infrastructure in the U.K., Canada, and Japan, VBM delivers a secure and responsible supply of high-quality products to customers across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Global demand for critical minerals is growing exponentially. From energy to aerospace, batteries to magnets, robotics to artificial intelligence, a secure and responsible supply of critical minerals is fundamental to power modern technologies. And at Vale Base Metals, we are transforming our business to provide a secure and responsible supply of these minerals.

Join our diverse team of 13,000 talented individuals committed to providing mineral security to a world in transition. We invite you to put your skills to work, driving meaningful and enduring change while enjoying a rewarding career.

## The Opportunity

We are currently seeking a Metallurgist to join our Mill Technical Services team in Voisey's Bay, Labrador, a fly-in fly-out operation.

This is a permanent on-site position, working a two week on two week off rotation at our Voisey's Bay Mine Site.

As a Metallurgist, you will be responsible for ensuring that concentrator process equipment and operating practices deliver a performance which meets or exceeds Company targets.

Additionally, in this position you will:

• Monitor plant performance, support troubleshooting operational issues, and provide technical feedback and advice to optimize results.

• Produce daily metallurgical accounting balances, perform monthly and annual production and inventory reconciliation, generate reports, and conduct regular QA/QC checks on production accounting systems, reporting results in accordance with an established program.

• Support the definition of a metallurgical development program to optimize the process, conduct technical investigations at the bench, pilot, and plant scales to generate data, and provide technically sound recommendations for process improvements to operations and management.

• Participate in maintenance planning, ensuring process needs are considered and defects in equipment are identified for necessary repairs or modifications.

• Develop and oversee an ongoing calibration program for the on-stream analyzers, ensure that operators follow SOPs, and ensure that the required spare part inventory is maintained.

• Identify and lead process improvement projects, represent the process on capital projects, and develop relationships with internal and external off-site support groups.

## What We Offer You

• Competitive compensation including a variable annual incentive plan

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, flex health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare

• Online training and career development opportunities

• Chartered flights within Newfoundland & Labrador

• 24/7 access to a fully stocked cafeteria with balanced meals prepared by our culinary team

• Access to recreational facilities and social activities (cardio/weight room, gymnasium, music room, movie theatre, etc.)

• Accommodations are equipped with cable TV, internet, and unlimited long-distance calling

• All Personal Protective Equipment is provided upon hire. Employees are given a safety boot allowance and receive a 100% reimbursement for prescription safety glasses

## About You

## Education:

• • Bachelor of Engineering or Applied Science – Metallurgy, Mineral Processing or Chemistry.

## Experience:

• A minimum of 3 years in metallurgical or mineral processing environment

## Skills:

• Strong communication and technical writing skills.

• Ability to develop mass balances and perform statistical analysis.

• Problem-solving skills (technical, troubleshooting, etc.).

• Hands-on and proactive field engagement.

• Computer skills (MS Office Suite, PI Vision, Minitab, etc.).

## Why Newfoundland and Labrador

Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada's easternmost province, is known for its rugged coastline, rich cultural heritage, and significant natural resources. The province's economy is bolstered by a robust mining sector, where our operations play a crucial role.

At Long Harbour, we operate a state-of-the-art processing plant, which refines nickel concentrate from the Voisey's Bay mine into finished nickel, copper, and cobalt products. This plant is a cornerstone of our commitment to value-added processing in Canada. Meanwhile, the Voisey's Bay mine, located in Labrador, is one of the world's most substantial nickel deposits. It provides high-quality nickel, copper, and cobalt, essential for the 21st century economy.

## Include to Transform

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. Vale encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success. We treat each other fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different.

Vale is an equal opportunity employer seeking to increase diversity across our operations and improve equal opportunity at Vale and in the mining industry.

Vale recognizes the Impacts and Benefits Agreements with the Innu Nation and the Nunatsiavut Government in which Innu and Inuit workers have first preference for employment at the Voisey's Bay Mine Site. This is guided by an adjacency principle that first gives preference to those who live on the coast of Labrador, followed by those residing in the rest of Labrador, those residing on the island of the province, followed by the rest of Canada.

Next, priority will be given to Newfoundland and Labrador residents. We also welcome those who are willing to relocate back home and those looking to make NL their permanent home.

Accommodation is available throughout our recruitment process for applicants with disabilities.

Innu Nation members and Nunatsiavut beneficiaries can submit their application to their Vale Aboriginal Employment Coordinator.

Employees engaged by the Company must be lawfully able to work for the Company in the country where the role is located. The Company does not provide immigration, work permit, or permanent residence sponsorship or assistance.

## Pay Grade: F6T

## Apply by: Sunday, September 27th, 2026.

Competition # : 49529

About Us
The Department of Justice is responsible for the administration of justice and for promoting access to justice and the safety and security of Nova Scotians through justice-related programs, services, and initiatives.
The Public Safety and Security Division provides service based on mutual respect, consultation, and collaboration with government, stakeholders, and the diverse communities we serve. We are committed to continuous improvement and fairness in our efforts to reduce crime and its effects, while enhancing public confidence in the justice system.
Our division includes:
• Policing Strategies and Governance
• Police Modernization Unit
• Safety and Security Investigations Unit
• Public Safety Audit Function
• Provincial Firearms Program
• Security Programs Office
• Service Dog Program
For more information on the Department of Justice Public Safety and Security Division please visit the following link: https://novascotia.ca/just/public_safety

About Our Opportunity
You will be designated a firearms officer and inspector by the Chief Firearms Officer (CFO) in accordance with the Firearms Act. Under the direction of the CFO and the supervision of the Program Lead, you will be responsible to administer the Firearms Act, its regulations and Part III of the Criminal Code.
The Area Firearms Officer plays a key role in promoting public safety through the administration of Canada's firearms legislation in Nova Scotia. Working within the Provincial Firearms Program, you will conduct investigations, assess risk, and make informed decisions related to firearms licences, authorizations, and approvals.
You will engage with individuals, businesses, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders to gather information, evaluate eligibility, conduct inspections, and support compliance with legislative requirements. This position requires strong judgment, sound decision-making, and the ability to balance public safety considerations with fair and consistent service delivery
This position reports to the Provincial Firearms Office Program Lead.

Primary Accountabilities
Your main responsibilities will be:

• Conducting complex investigations to assess the risk of allowing individuals access to firearms by researching records or reports and by interviewing any person who may provide relevant information pertaining to the eligibility to hold a licence or authorization.

• Conducting thorough inspections of shooting ranges, businesses or premises, including records, to ensure compliance and enhance public safety.

• Providing advice and guidance to clients and responding to enquiries relating to regulatory compliance and adherence to the regulations.

• Build strong working relationships with the public, licensees, other compliance agencies, police agencies, and other levels of government.

Qualifications and Experience
As the successful candidate, you have a certification or bachelors' degree in a relevant field (e.g., Criminology, Social Work, Psychology, Law/Justice Studies) and 5 years of related experience. An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered.
Recent experience conducting complex investigations, eligibility assessments, background investigations, or risk assessments that required interviewing individuals, analyzing information from multiple sources, and making evidence-based decisions
You will require motivation and an ability to problem-solve while making decisions in consultation with your manager. Your sound judgement and application of common sense, with the proven ability to offer solutions to sensitive problems, is required.
Strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills are essential.
Assets for this role include:
• Successful completion of a recognized educational or training program in law enforcement or investigations.
• Bilingualism in French and English
• Proficiency in records management practices and data storage.
• Successful completion of the Canadian Firearms Safety Course and Canadian Restricted Firearms Safety Course.
• Recent experience in managing complex investigations and knowledge of diverse investigative techniques.
• Experience interpreting and applying legislation, regulations, policies, or compliance requirements.
We will assess the above qualifications and competencies using one or more of the following tools: written examination, standardized tests, oral presentations, interview(s), and reference checks.

For information on all our Benefit program offerings, click here: Benefits for government employees.

Additional Information
This role combines office-based investigative work with field inspections and stakeholder engagement throughout Nova Scotia. Regular travel is required. A valid Nova Scotia driver's license is needed.

2234585.description:
Requisition ID: 2549

Why Choose IMP Aerospace & Defence:
IMP Aerospace & Defence is not only one of the leading companies in the Aerospace field, but we are also one of the most engaging and equality advocating companies to work for. We believe that regardless of where you work at IMP Aerospace & Defence, you are a part of our ever-growing team. IMP is able to achieve success through this teamwork mindset. That is why at IMP, you are not defined by your role.

Position Overview:
The primary responsibility will be to maximize the effectiveness and efficiency of Supply Chain Services in support of the CP140 Aurora Optimized Weapons Systems Management Program using the Canadian Forces Supply System (CFSS). The position will work in conjunction with Life Cycle Asset Managers as well as company and DND Technical Authorities (TA), to provide responsive procurement and supply support to the CP140 Fleet.

What You Will Do:
• Planning and preparation of documentation associated with the procurement and contracting of forecasted requirements in support of the CP 140 Aurora OWSS.

• Maintain efficient inventory control and management of assigned CP140 PAV materials.

• Advise Asset Managers on the procurement and distribution of goods and services necessary to support the fleet.

• Work effectively with parts buyers, Asset Managers, other Supply Chain Analysts, and material support representatives (internal and external) to ensure all assigned CFSS parts bins are responsively replenished to avoid High Priority Requirements (HPRs) and stock-out situations.

• Liaise effectively with Canadian Forces (CF) base/depot supply personnel, and on-site CF representatives.

• Prepare and maintain accurate HPR status reports for Asset Managers and for OWSS program management.

• Management of assigned stock codes and changes to the Procurement Authority list.

• Maintain efficient inventory control and management of assigned materials.

• Review / action / reconcile referred demands and recommended re-order buy requirements.

• Review / action / reorder point and reorder quantity information from the CFSS and adjust as required to ensure CF depot inventory levels for CP140 PAV items are adequate to ensure a high level of mission readiness.

• Carry out investigations to determine causes for repetitive material supply problems and initiate or recommend corrective actions.

• Be responsible for initial cataloguing support, preparing reports on parts replenishment, repair and overhaul and materials disposal.

• Read, understand, comply with, and suggest improvements for all inventory-related company procedures and directives.

• Satisfy customers in a professional manner and perform other functions as required.

What You Will Bring:
• Post-secondary education in Supply Chain Management/Logistics or equivalent experience in a technical or military environment.

• Supply Chain Management Professional (SCMP) or Professional Logistics (P. Log) designation would be beneficial.

• Proficient in MS Office Suite of applications and experience with ERP systems (e.g. JD Edwards, Peoplesoft, etc.)

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational ability and an aptitude for working with numbers.

• Proficient analytical skills and the ability to work independently.

• Time management and organizational skills.

• Strong influencing skills and the ability to meet objectives working with colleagues.

• Working knowledge of the Canadian Forces Supply System (CFSS) Defence Resource Management Information System (DRMIS) is preferred.

• Familiarity with the ISO 9000 quality environments.

• Incumbents must be able to pass and maintain Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC) and Transport Canada security clearances.

• Demonstrate a personal commitment to IMP Occupational Health, Safety and Environment policies. Continually focusing on your individual safety and the safety of others who may be affected by your work and to fully comply with all Federal Health and Safety Legislation.

• Participate in Continuous Improvement, Lean & 6S activities in your area.

• All successful applicants must be eligible to meet requirements for the U.S. International Traffic In Arms Regulations (ITAR), Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and Canadian government security clearance.

What We Will Do For You:
• All IMP's benefits become effective on your first day of work, regardless of your position.

• Employees are entitled to 3 paid personal days and 12 statutory holidays per year.

• We offer a comprehensive Benefits Package, including RRSP Program, Tuition Reimbursement Program, Long Service Awards, Volunteer Grant Program, Scholarship Program, and more!

IMP is committed to Employment Equity and our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels. We welcome applicants from Indigenous People, Visible Minority Groups, Persons with Disabilities and Women in occupations or positions where they are under-represented. If you are a member of one of these equity groups, you are encouraged to self identify on either your cover letter or resume.

2234587.title: Accountant
2234587.description:
Requisition ID: 2548

Why Choose IMP Aerospace & Defence:
IMP Aerospace & Defence is not only one of the leading companies in the Aerospace field, but we are also one of the most engaging and equality advocating companies to work for. We believe that regardless of where you work at IMP Aerospace & Defence, you are a part of our ever-growing team. IMP is able to achieve success through this teamwork mindset. That is why at IMP, you are not defined by your role.

Position Overview:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical accountant who enjoys digging into data, understanding how operations drive results, and explaining why variances occur—not just reporting them.
Based in our Halifax office, this role will support two manufacturing locations in Hammonds Plains and Amherst, with occasional on-site visits to build understanding of operations and processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to move beyond traditional accounting into operational finance, with a focus on work-in-progress (WIP), costing, and variance analysis.
A professional designation is not required. We are focused on experience, mindset, and analytical ability.

What You Will Do:
• Own and maintain WIP continuity and month-end reconciliation

• Support month-end close, financial reporting, account reconciliations, journal entries, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

• Investigate and explain production and cost variances

• Support two manufacturing operations by analyzing cost drivers and operational activity

• Reconcile and analyze data across ERP systems, Excel, and operational inputs

• Identify discrepancies and ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data

• Work closely with plant personnel and operations teams to understand results

• Travel periodically to both locations (Hammonds Plains and Amherst) to support understanding and continuous improvement

• Recommend and implement improvements to processes, tracking, and reporting

What You Will Bring:
• 3–7+ years in accounting, finance, or a related role

• Strong experience with reconciliations, analysis, and financial data

• Exposure to any of the following is an asset:

• WIP or project accounting

• Inventory or job costing

• Manufacturing or construction environments

• Variance analysis

• Strong Excel skills (ability to analyze and manipulate data is essential)

• Experience with ERP systems (e.g., JD Edwards, SAP, Oracle) is an asset

• Highly detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership

• Naturally curious—wants to understand why results occur

• Comfortable working with large, imperfect, or complex data sets

• Willing to engage with operations and challenge assumptions

• Must be eligible to meet requirements for Canadian Controlled Goods Program (CGP), Secret Level II Security Clearance through PSPC- Contract Security Program, and Transport Canada RAIC clearance.

What We Will Do For You:
• All of IMP's benefits become effective on your first day of work, regardless of your position.

• We offer a comprehensive Benefits Package, including RSP Program, Holiday Incentive program (3 additional days off over Christmas), Tuition Reimbursement Program, Long Service Awards, Volunteer Grant Program, Scholarship Program, and more!

IMP is committed to Employment Equity and our goal is to be a diverse workforce that is representative at all job levels. We welcome applicants from Indigenous People, Visible Minority Groups, Persons with Disabilities and Women in occupations or positions where they are under-represented. If you are a member of one of these equity groups, you are encouraged to self identify on either your cover letter or resume.

Eastlink is seeking a Retail Sales Representative to join our team within our store at Halifax Shopping Centre. We are looking for a passionate individual who will help deliver great customer service and sales.

## What does the day-to-day look like?

• Everyday there are opportunities to learn more about our products, services and promotions allowing you to excel in technical expertise

• In addition, every customer interaction is an opportunity to build customer loyalty by using your expertise and product knowledge

• Our teams thrive on the chance to drive in-store sales! Hitting personal targets is fun and we will help you get there!

## What will you bring?

## What we offer?

Your earning potential (salary plus commission, incentive & growth share) could be $36,000 to $45,000 per year*! Or even more!

About Eastlink

Eastlink is proudly family-owned and headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. After more than 50 years, we’ve grown from a small-town startup into one of Canada’s Best Managed companies without losing our entrepreneurial edge. We move fast. We try new things. We care about doing right by our customers, and we’re not afraid to take a different approach to make that happen.

Why Work With Us

We could say we’re not your typical telecom, but what makes us different is how we operate day to day. At Eastlink, we’re a tight-knit team all working toward common goals. We’re big enough to do meaningful work, but small enough that you can actually make your mark. You won’t get stuck waiting for layers of approval or years of tenure to make an impact! We believe in getting involved, speaking up, and figuring things out together. We’re always listening, learning, and adapting because our customers (and our people) expect us to. And just like we invest in our network, we invest in you, with intention and for the long run.

We’re committed to building a workplace where everyone feels they belong. We embrace diversity, inclusion, equity, and accessibility throughout all levels of the organization and encourage members of equity groups to self-identify during the application process.

*Total compensation varies based on individual performance in a full-time role.

2240147.title: Senior Analyst, Procurement
2240147.description:
## Ready to build a rewarding career in an industry that is growing?

## Who We Are

We are a global mining company dedicated to safely delivering nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group metals essential for the world's energy transition.

Our mission is to improve lives and shape a better future together.

From utensils to cellphones to satellites, our operations simplify daily life and enhance connectivity. Our metals are integral to life-saving medical equipment and the electric vehicles driving the fight against climate change – our work truly matters.

Join our diverse team of 15,000 talented individuals committed to transforming critical minerals into prosperity and sustainable development in countries like Canada, Brazil, Indonesia, the United Kingdom, and Japan. We invite you to use your skills with us and contribute to something meaningful and enduring.

## The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Procurement (Heavy Mobile Mining Equipment & Parts & Services) to join our Global Procurement team.

This is a permanent position with a global scope supporting Vale Base Metals operations in Canada, Brazil, and other international locations based in Toronto

Reporting to the Manager, Strategic Procurement, the Senior Analyst will be responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies for heavy mobile mining equipment . This includes supporting procurement activities for off-road haul trucks, articulated trucks, excavators, loaders, drill rigs, infrastructure equipment, and associated parts, components, maintenance programs and related services.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in maximizing value across some of the organization's largest spend categories, establishing strategic supplier partnerships, managing contract performance, and ensuring cost-effective, sustainable procurement solutions that support operational excellence across the business.

## About You

You are a strategic procurement professional with strong commercial acumen and experience managing large capital equipment categories. You possess exceptional negotiation and relationship management skills and thrive in a global, cross-functional environment where collaboration and value creation are critical to success.

You have a proven ability to manage complex supplier relationships, develop effective sourcing strategies, and deliver measurable financial and operational results while maintaining a strong focus on safety, sustainability, and business performance.

## In this role, you will:

• Lead the development and execution of global sourcing and category strategies for Heavy Mobile Mining Equipment across Vale Base Metals operations.

• Manage strategic procurement activities for high-value categories including off-road haul trucks, articulated trucks, excavators, loaders, drill rigs, infrastructure equipment, and associated parts and services.

• Conduct market and supplier analysis to identify opportunities for cost optimization, operational efficiencies, innovation, and risk mitigation.

• Develop and execute negotiation strategies while leading commercial discussions with key suppliers to secure optimal pricing, terms, and service agreements.

• Build and maintain strategic supplier partnerships that support long-term business objectives and enhance supply reliability.

• Manage the full contract lifecycle, including commercial administration, performance monitoring, and governance of multi-site and multi-user agreements.

• Analyze Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models and equipment lifecycle costs to support data-driven sourcing decisions.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, Maintenance, Reliability, Engineering, and Supply Chain stakeholders to align procurement strategies with business requirements.

• Support sustainability, responsible sourcing, and supplier performance initiatives while ensuring compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.

• Drive value creation initiatives across assigned categories while managing procurement spend exceeding USD $250M annually.

• Work collaboratively with regional and global procurement teams to leverage best practices, supplier intelligence, and category synergies across Vale Base Metals operations.

• Identify and mitigate supply chain risks while ensuring the availability of critical equipment and services that support mining operations globally.

## Experience

• Minimum 8+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, or Category Management.

• Experience managing heavy mobile mining equipment, OTR tires, industrial capital equipment, or related categories.

• Proven experience leading complex negotiations and supplier management activities.

• Experience developing and executing category strategies within a global or multi-site environment.

• Experience managing large commercial contracts and strategic supplier relationships.

## Education

• Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Engineering, Commerce, Finance, or a related discipline.

• Professional procurement designation (SCMP, CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent) is considered an asset.

## Skills & Competencies

• Strong strategic sourcing and category management capabilities.

• Advanced contract negotiation and commercial management skills.

• Strong understanding of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles.

• Knowledge of equipment acquisition, lifecycle costing, freight, logistics, duties, and taxation considerations.

• Strong analytical and financial evaluation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across diverse geographic regions.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management abilities.

• Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Strong business acumen with a results-driven mindset.

• Advanced English proficiency required. Portuguese and/or French considered an asset.

## What We Offer You

• Competitive compensation including a variable annual incentive plan

• Participation in a competitive Defined Contribution Pension package

• Comprehensive benefits package (company paid core coverage, health and dental coverage, flex accounts, disability plans, and optional insurances)

• Leave for all of life's reasons (vacation, personal, sick, parental)

• Work culture dedicated to safety, diversity & inclusion, and career growth

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Virtual Healthcare online

• Online training and career development opportunities

## Why Toronto

Toronto, Canada's largest city and financial hub, is a center of innovation, commerce, and culture. Known for its diverse economy and vibrant urban environment, Toronto offers unparalleled access to talent, technology, and global connectivity.

Our Toronto office serves as a strategic hub for corporate functions, technology development, and business operations. Here, we drive initiatives that support Vale Base Metals' global operations, leveraging advanced analytics, digital transformation, and strategic planning to ensure operational excellence across all regions.

Toronto's dynamic ecosystem enables collaboration with leading technology partners, universities, and research institutions, fostering innovation in mining and metals processing. This location is integral to shaping the future of sustainable mining and advancing our commitment to responsible resource development.

## Include to Transform

At Vale Base Metals, we are committed to ensuring an inclusive work environment where people feel comfortable to be themselves. Vale encourages everyone to express their ideas and opinions and values the plurality of individual profiles. We want our people to feel that all.

We want our people to feel that all voices are heard, all cultures respected and that a variety of perspectives are not only welcome – they are critical to our success. We treat each other

fairly and with dignity regardless of race, gender, nationality, ethnic origin, religion, age, sexual orientation, or any other personal consideration that makes us different.

Vale is an equal opportunity employer seeking to increase diversity across our operations and improve equal opportunity at Vale and in the mining industry.

Accommodation is available throughout our recruitment process for applicants with disabilities.

Vale uses artificial intelligence to screen, assess, and/or select applicants for this position.

Pay Grade: F6T

## Minimum Starting Salary: $83,224

Apply by: Friday, Sep 28, 2026

## #ValeBaseMetals
