2209006.title: Senior Accountant
2209006.description:
## About Us

Tidal CFO helps growing organizations gain financial clarity, confidence, and control. We are a modern, remote-first finance firm providing fractional CFO, controller, and bookkeeping services to Canadian startups, nonprofits, and SMEs, with roots in Atlantic Canada.

Our CPA-led team blends hands-on accounting support with strategic financial leadership. We act as trusted advisors, building strong internal systems, leveraging modern cloud-based tools, and creating efficient, scalable processes that support our clients' growth.

At the same time, we are building a collaborative, high-performing team that values accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

We are looking to expand our team with a highly organized, self-motivated Senior Accountant who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is motivated by continuous learning and career growth.

## The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Accountant to support our client engagements by delivering accurate financial reporting and maintaining strong accounting foundations. This role reports directly to management and plays a critical part in executing month-end close, reconciliations, and day-to-day accounting operations across multiple clients.

As a Senior Accountant, you will be hands-on in the preparation and review of financial information while collaborating closely with management. While Tidal CFO operates as a remote first firm, this role requires a willingness to spend time onsite at client offices or places of work when appropriate to support relationship-building, onboarding, and key deliverables. You will help ensure data integrity, support system improvements, and contribute to a consistent, high-quality client experience.

This role is ideal for an experienced accountant who enjoys ownership of their work, thrives in a fast-paced, client-facing environment, and wants exposure to advisory-focused accounting within a fast-growing, dynamic firm with a clear path to advancement into a Manager role.

If you're a strategic thinker with deep technical expertise and a passion for client delivery, we want to hear from you!

## Key Responsibilities

• Deliver High-Quality Financial Outcomes
• Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) for assigned clients

• Complete bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations

• Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, and adjustments

• Support payroll accounting, HST filings, and intercompany transactions

• Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial data prior to Manager review

• Support Month-End Close & Reporting
• Execute month-end close tasks in alignment with internal timelines and client expectations

• Maintain clear, organized, and audit-ready working papers

• Assist Managers with financial reporting packages and supporting schedules

• Flag unusual variances, discrepancies, or risks and proactively communicate findings

• Maintain Systems & Process Integrity
• Ensure client adherence to established accounting systems and workflows (QBO, Xero, Dext and related tools)

• Support data clean-up projects, system implementations, and new client onboarding

• Follow documented processes while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across tools, templates, and workflows

• Collaborate with Managers & Internal Teams
• Work closely with Managers to meet deadlines and deliver consistent client outcomes

• Communicate clearly and professionally with internal team members and clients as needed

• Support internal quality control processes by preparing accurate documentation and anticipating review needs

• Act as a coach and mentor to junior and intermediate accountants by providing guidance, reviewing work, sharing best practices, and supporting their professional development

• Contribute to building a strong, collaborative team culture grounded in learning and accountability

## What We're Looking For

• Accounting Experience: 3+ years of full-cycle accounting experience

• Professional Credentials: CPA designation (completed or in progress) considered an asset

• Bilingual (English/French): Strongly preferred and considered a significant asset

• Client Service Mindset: Experience working in a client-facing or professional services environment

• Highly Organized: Strong ability to manage multiple clients and priorities simultaneously

• Detail-Oriented: Commitment to accuracy, documentation, and high-quality execution

• Tech-Savvy: Experience with cloud-based accounting tools such as Xero, QuickBooks Online, Dext, Syft, and Plooto

• Leadership Potential: Comfortable coaching and mentoring junior and intermediate team members and interested in growing into a future Manager role

• Growth-Oriented: Motivated by continuous improvement, professional development, and long-term career progression

• Problem Solver: Comfortable identifying issues, asking questions, and proposing solutions

## What We Offer

• Competitive compensation aligned with experience and value brought to the role

• Willingness to pay a premium for candidates who strongly meet our technical, leadership, and cultural criteria

• Primarily remote work, with flexible scheduling. Occasional in-person client delivery work required.

• Collaborative and supportive team culture within a fast-growing, dynamic firm

• Clear career progression path with opportunity to grow into a Manager role

• Exposure to controller- and CFO-level work across a diverse client portfolio

• Professional development support, including CPA dues reimbursement

• Paid vacation

• A comprehensive health benefits package to support your well-being

## Join Our Team

At Tidal CFO, we are redefining how growing businesses access financial expertise. We combine strategic advisory services with strong accounting foundations and modern systems to help our clients succeed.

If you are an experienced accountant who values accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement and wants to grow within a forward-thinking advisory firm, we want you to be part of our team.

## To Apply

Please submit your resume detailing your experience and why you are the ideal fit for Tidal CFO.

This position is based in New Brunswick. Preference will be given to candidates currently located in New Brunswick. Exceptional candidates from other parts of Canada may also be considered.

Reporting to the Manager of Clinical Engineering, the successful candidate will be responsible to repair, calibrate, and maintain all types of basic clinical/medical equipment technologies, devices, instruments, and systems under relatively close supervision or guidance of the CE Manager, CE Supervisor, and/or Topic Expert. This position is also responsible for installing and providing inspection and preventive maintenance (IPM) of general clinical/medical equipment.

Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Repair, install, maintain, troubleshoot, calibrate, and inspect a diverse range of therapeutic and diagnostic clinical/medical instruments and equipment

• Perform IPM and electrical safety tests on clinical/medical equipment, devices and systems

• Diagnose and correct system and equipment malfunctions

• Maintain documentation of incoming and current equipment, including inspections, repairs, and failures

• Provide technical assistance and instruction on equipment operation and maintenance to clinical users

• Maintain good personal relationships with fellow workers, clients, vendors, manufacturers and the general public

## ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS:

## CET-1:

• Graduation from an Electronic Engineering Technology program accredited by NBSCETT (New Brunswick Society of Certified Engineering Technicians and Technologists) or graduate from an accredited 3-year clinical engineering technology program. Must be eligible for certification by NBSCETT.

• Knowledge and experience working with Microsoft Office Suite software (Word, Excel, Outlook).

• Written and spoken competence in English is required.

## CET-2:

• Graduation from an Electronic Engineering Technology program accredited by NBSCETT (New Brunswick Society of Certified Engineering Technicians and Technologists) or graduate from an accredited 3-year clinical engineering technology program. Must be eligible for certification by NBSCETT.

• At least two years of medical equipment technology experience.

• Knowledge and experience working with Microsoft Office Suite software (Word, Excel, Outlook).

• Written and spoken competence in English is required.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please state your language capability on your application and ensure that preferred language for assessment is clearly identified.

ASSET QUALIFICATIONS: Preference may be given to candidates who demonstrate they have training or experience in one or more of the following areas:

• electronic theory, technology, and test equipment

• color coding conventions used in component and wiring marking

• analysis, repair and testing of electronic and electromechanical equipment

• networking and computer troubleshooting

• performing mechanical repairs and IPM

• running diagnostic programs

• maintaining accurate records of repairs, calibrations, and tests

Subject to the response to this competition, candidates may be required to demonstrate on their application one or more of the asset qualifications in addition to the essential qualifications in order to be given further consideration.

## OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Travel throughout the province may be required, including work off site at customer locations as scheduled. Candidates must possess a valid driver`s license and passport.

• Must be able to provide periodic off-hour on-call support.

• Candidates will be required to undergo a Criminal History Clearance prior to appointment.

2233226.title: Senior Securities Analyst
2233226.description:
The Financial and Consumer Services Commission (Commission) is a leader in integrated financial and consumer services regulation. The Commission's mandate is to protect consumers and enhance public confidence in the financial and consumer marketplace through the provision of regulatory and educational services. With offices in both Fredericton and Saint John, it is responsible for the administration and enforcement of provincial legislation regulating mortgage brokers, payday lenders, real estate, securities, insurance, pensions, credit unions, trust and loan companies, cooperatives, unclaimed property, and a wide range of consumer legislation. The Commission is a self funded Crown corporation responsible for the administration and enforcement of financial consumer services legislation.

We offer opportunities for dedicated professionals to play a vital role in carrying out our mandate.

## Senior Securities Analyst - Securities Division (Saint John Office)

We are currently seeking a highly skilled and experienced accounting professional to join our team as a Senior Securities Analyst within the Securities Division.

In this unique accounting role, you will serve as a subject matter expert in corporate finance, leading in-depth reviews and analysis of prospectus and continuous disclosure filings from New Brunswick reporting issuers. Your work will help ensure filings meet the standard of full, true, and plain disclosure, supporting the Commission's regulatory mandate. An equally important part of the role involves participating on policy development projects and representing the Commission on various national corporate finance committees, helping shape securities regulation across jurisdictions.

In addition, you will also act as a key accounting resource for the Division and the Commission, providing expertise through the review of financial information and supporting budgeting and financial planning activities.

## Your Focus

## • National policy and regulatory leadership

Participate on different Canadian Securities Administrators committees to support the development and interpretation of corporate finance policies and rules, and represent the Commission's position at the national level.

## • Prospectus and disclosure review

Lead high-quality reviews of prospectus, continuous disclosure, and exempt market filings to ensure compliance with accounting standards and full, true, and plain disclosure, and recommend corrective actions where needed.

## • Team support and oversight

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Advanced Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Advanced Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Advanced Care Paramedic positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Advanced Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Advanced Care Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Must be willing to participate and contribute to future pilot projects, related research initiatives and focus groups

• Must be willing to participate in community Paramedicine duties

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your ACP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2233374.title: Senior Municipal Engineer
2233374.employer: GEMTEC Consulting Engineers and Scientists Limited
2233374.description:
Are you an experienced Senior Municipal Engineer looking to progress your career? We're looking for a senior level Civil/Municipal Engineer to join our growing team. This role can be hybrid (part time remote from home and part time in the office) in our Saint John, NB office. We also have openings in our Fredericton and Moncton offices.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm—not too big, not too small. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

A typical day on the job might look like:

• Leading and managing civil engineering projects from concept through completion, ensuring delivery on time, on budget, and within scope
• municipal and transportation infrastructure,

• commercial and residential subdivision land development,

• site grading and mass detailed site earthworks for underground services

• Preparation of stamped engineering drawings, quality assurance/control specifications and quantity estimates issued for tender and construction project administration.

• Storm water modelling and management civil design.

• Organizing/carrying out construction quantity surveying / field inspections.

• Developing and maintaining strong client relationships

• Preparing proposals and supporting business development initiatives

• Participating in the implementation and adaptation of existing Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) Policies, Procedures, Standards, and Guidelines in the execution of all project work.

• Acting in support of other GEMTEC offices when needed to complete projects.

The good stuff you get:

• Full-time (37.5 hours per week)

• Complete health & dental coverage including vision, paramedical services, and Teladoc

• Retirement planning made easier with a 5% employer match on your contributions

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days) plus Employee & Family Assistance Program when you need it

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year)

Your background and what you bring:

• 12+ years of experience in civil engineering practice with a preference for municipal engineering experience

• Currently registered as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with APEGNB

• Bachelor's degree in civil engineering from an accredited university

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with a commitment to quality

• Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D 2018 (or newer version)

• Experience with ArchGIS and/or QGIS software platforms would be considered an asset, as would experience with hydraulic modeling software suites

• Well-developed interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

• Valid driver's license and have access to a personal vehicle for work related travel

Interested individuals, click here to apply: https://gemtec.bamboohr.com/careers/333

Thank you for taking the time to consider GEMTEC. Only candidates proceeding to the next phase of the application process will be contacted at this time. We encourage you to connect with us on LinkedIn, even if this opportunity isn't for you, the next one might be!

Should you be selected for an interview and require accommodation of any kind, please kindly help us understand how we can help. Email HR@GEMTEC.ca

2240814.description:
## BUSINESS CONSULTANT

## ABOUT MONTANA CONSULTING GROUP

Montana Consulting Group is a human resources consulting firm with a difference. We have in-depth understanding of complex issues in employment, human rights, and labour relations, and we value passing on clear, practical solutions for our clients. Besides consulting, we have developed a reputation for high quality customized and standard management development programs that make a tangible difference in workplaces across Canada.

We are looking for someone to grow with us!

## YOU AND MONTANA

Although your credentials are important, personal and career credibility and the ability to establish quick trusting relationships with clients are just as critical to your success. Our approach is practical and down to earth, and your style will need to reflect that. Our thorough, reasoned approach to conducting workplace assessments and harassment investigations is in high demand and we will need your help there, too. We're looking for an analytical thinker who can articulate complex concepts in a simple, logical manner. And because report writing is an essential part of these assignments and in consulting in general, you must also be able to write clearly and well in both official languages.

Finally, we are looking for someone interested in becoming a captivating instructor and developer of practical, engaging leadership development courses in both French and English. Montana offers many programs for managers and employees across a wide spectrum of subjects, including leadership, communications, change management, human rights and respect in the workplace, labour relations, conflict resolution, negotiation, mediation, and other topics. A genuine interest in labour relations, human rights, and general employment law will be a great asset. Even if you are not deeply experienced in these areas today, this is an opportunity for someone who wants to learn from industry experts.

Ideally, you would be based at our office in Moncton, but you will be required to travel regularly within and occasionally outside New-Brunswick. Our clients' needs dictate our schedule, so we are able to accommodate some flexibility in scheduling. We work seriously without taking ourselves seriously. We love what we do and we get along well. We respect one another and like to laugh, and we are looking for someone who will really add to the team.

Please send us your résumé by email with a letter demonstrating your abilities to meet the requirements as described in this posting. If you can convince us, we will be in touch!

Maxime Labbé
Managing Director
Montana Consulting Group
58 Mountain Rd.
Moncton NB E1A 7Y5
labbem@montanahr.com

## CONSULTANT-E EN AFFAIRES

## À PROPOS DE MONTANA CONSULTING GROUP

Le Groupe conseil Montana est un cabinet de consultation en ressources humaines et relations industrielles qui se distingue par sa compréhension approfondie des enjeux complexes liés à l'emploi, aux droits de la personne et aux relations de travail. Nous accordons une grande importance à la transmission de solutions claires et pratiques à nos clients. En plus de nos services de consultation, nous avons développé une solide réputation pour nos programmes de développement professionnel en leadership et en gestion. Nos formations ont un impact concret dans les milieux de travail partout au Canada.

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui veux faire carrière dans le domaine de la consultation et qui souhaite évoluer avec nous.

## TRAVAILLER AVEC LE GROUPE CONSEIL MONTANA

Bien que vos qualifications soient importantes, votre crédibilité personnelle et professionnelle ainsi que votre capacité à établir rapidement des relations de confiance avec les clients sont tout aussi essentielles à votre réussite. Notre approche est pratique et terre-à-terre, et votre style devra refléter cette philosophie.

Notre méthodologie rigoureuse et réfléchie pour réaliser des évaluations de milieu de travail et des enquêtes en matière de harcèlement est très en demande, et nous aurons besoin de votre contribution dans ce domaine. Nous recherchons une personne analytique capable d'expliquer des concepts complexes de manière simple et logique. Comme la rédaction de rapports constitue une partie essentielle de ces mandats, et du travail de consultation en général, vous devez aussi être en mesure d'écrire clairement et efficacement autant en anglais qu'en français.

Enfin, la personne idéale a également un intérêt à devenir une formatrice captivante et une conceptrice de cours de leadership pratiques et engageants, en français comme en anglais. Montana offre de nombreux programmes destinés aux gestionnaires et aux employés sur un vaste éventail de sujets, notamment le leadership, les communications, la gestion du changement, les droits de la personne et le respect en milieu de travail, les relations de travail, la résolution de conflits, la négociation, la gestion de l'absentéisme et des accommodements, et bien d'autres.

Un intérêt réel pour les relations de travail, les droits de la personne et le droit de l'emploi en général est un atout important. Même si vous n'êtes pas encore très expérimenté dans ces domaines, ce poste représente une occasion d'apprendre auprès d'experts reconnus.

Idéalement, vous serez basé à notre bureau de Moncton, mais vous devrez vous déplacer régulièrement à l'intérieur du Nouveau-Brunswick et parfois à l'extérieur de la province. Les besoins de nos clients dictent notre horaire, ce qui nous permet d'offrir une certaine flexibilité dans l'organisation du travail.

Nous travaillons sérieusement sans nous prendre trop au sérieux. Nous aimons ce que nous faisons et nous nous entendons bien. Nous nous respectons mutuellement et apprécions l'humour, et nous cherchons quelqu'un qui saura réellement enrichir notre équipe.

Veuillez nous faire parvenir votre curriculum vitæ par courriel, accompagné d'une lettre démontrant que vous rencontrez les exigences décrites dans cette offre. Si vous réussissez à nous convaincre, nous communiquerons avec vous.

Maxime Labbé
Directeur général

Moncton, N.-B.

## Department of Transportation and Infrastructure

## Operations Worker I

## Seasonal Position

## Open

## Glaslsville/Holmesville Division

## Fredericton District

## Who we are

The work we do has a positive impact on our communities and helps improve the everyday lives of New Brunswickers. Together, we are over 45,000 New Brunswickers who are passionate problem-solvers, who make a difference and are proud to call New Brunswick home.

The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure has a broad mandate and is committed to maintaining and improving New Brunswick's public infrastructure. The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure's mission is to contribute to New Brunswick's economy and quality of life by providing and supporting sustainable infrastructure that allows for the safe and efficient movement of people, goods and government services to the public. Not only is the department responsible for managing over 18,000 kilometers of provincial highways, it also manages the planning, design and construction of hospitals, schools and other government buildings.

## What you will do

Reporting to the Highway Supervisor, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following responsibilities:

• performing various highway maintenance and construction work;

• operating and maintaining light construction equipment, including a tandem service truck when required by the Department of Transportation and Infrastructure;

• performing normal maintenance and minor repairs on assigned equipment, preparing, and maintaining work records on the operation of the assigned equipment;

• operating a one-person plow in winter operations and performing other related maintenance tasks;

• ensuring roads are safe for public use through plowing and placing sand and salt on roads.

## Work environment:

• Office location: Glassville Division during the summer operations and Holmesville during winter operations.

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we're building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That's why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you're inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what's possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

On the Bell Business Markets team, you'll be a vital part of making innovation happen for enterprise-scale customers. You'll deliver advanced solutions in areas such as IoT, Mobility/5G, Cloud, Cyber Security, Voice, Collaboration & Contact Centre and Internet & Private Networks.

At Bell, your skills and expertise will help set us apart as we continue to be the leading provider of digital connections and next generation services to businesses and governments.

Summary
The Contract Security Coordinator will be the key point contact in supporting and guiding the deal and project teams on security requirements for all federal government contracts. Their expertise in all security pillars of the Government of Canada Contract Security Program (CSP) will drive their guidance in support, and in the development of the BBM CSP department, including its framework and processes. • Strong leadership skills in navigating complexity and influencing internal and external stakeholders, via workshops and information gathering sessions.

2241072.title: Director, Public Transit
2241072.description:
Job Title: Director, Public Transit
Location: Moncton, New Brunswick
TP - CMC - 10143

Meridia Recruitment Solutions is proud to partner with the City of Moncton in the search for a Director, Public Transit to lead Codiac Transpo through an exciting period of growth, modernization, and regional collaboration.

Serving the communities of Moncton, Dieppe, and Riverview, Codiac Transpo is a vital public service that connects residents to employment, education, healthcare, recreation, and community life. As one of Atlantic Canada's leading transit systems, Codiac Transpo is focused on delivering safe, reliable, accessible, and customer-focused transportation services while advancing a Council-approved Transit Growth Strategy that will shape the future of mobility across the region.

This is a unique leadership opportunity to guide a growing transit organization through significant operational, technological, and infrastructure investments, including service expansion, fleet modernization, and the development of future transit facilities.

Role Description
The Director of Public Transit provides strategic and operational leadership for Codiac Transpo. You will oversee all aspects of transit operations including service delivery, fleet and infrastructure management, financial planning, administration, customer service, safety, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Leading a team of approximately 120 employees, including five direct-report managers, you will be responsible for ensuring the delivery of high-quality transit services while fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and service excellence. This role requires a leader who can balance long-term strategic priorities with day-to-day operational demands while building strong relationships with municipal leaders, elected officials, employees, union representatives, and community stakeholders.

## Your responsibilities will include:

• Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for Codiac Transpo and its people, services, assets, and budgets.

• Lead the implementation of the Transit Growth Strategy, including route expansion, service enhancements, and operational improvements.

• Oversee all transit functions including operations, finance, fleet management, infrastructure, technology, administration, and customer service.

• Manage operating and capital budgets while ensuring effective stewardship of public resources.

• Lead major capital projects, including fleet expansion and replacement initiatives, transit technology investments, and future transit facility development.

• Develop, mentor, and support a high-performing leadership team while fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture.

• Promote strong labour-management relationships and provide leadership within a unionized working environment.

• Monitor operational performance, safety, customer experience, and service reliability while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

• Collaborate with municipal partners in Moncton, Dieppe, and Riverview on service planning, governance matters, cost-sharing discussions, and regional transit initiatives.

• Provide recommendations and presentations to senior leadership, municipal councils, and the Public Transit Governance Committee.

• Build strong relationships with community partners, elected officials, regulators, and industry stakeholders.

• Support the adoption of innovative technologies, systems, and best practices to improve operational effectiveness and customer service.

## Your Qualifications:

The ideal candidate is a collaborative and forward-thinking leader who is passionate about public service and committed to delivering safe, reliable, and sustainable transit solutions. You have demonstrated success leading complex operations while motivating teams through growth and change.

## Your qualifications will include:

• A post-secondary degree in business administration, public administration, transportation, engineering, planning, or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.

• 10+ years of progressive leadership experience within public transit, transportation, municipal operations, or a similarly complex service environment.

• Direct experience within public transit operations, transit planning, or transportation services.

• Experience managing large teams and developing high-performing leaders.

• Demonstrated success operating within a unionized environment.

• Strong financial acumen with experience overseeing operating and capital budgets.

• Experience leading organizational change, service improvements, and strategic initiatives.

• Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.

• Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making abilities.

• The ability to balance competing priorities while maintaining a focus on customer service, safety, and operational excellence.

• Valid driver's licence.

## Assets include:

• Senior leadership experience within a municipal transit organization.

• Experience implementing transit growth strategies or major service expansion initiatives.

• Experience overseeing fleet modernization, fleet replacement, or transit infrastructure projects.

• Knowledge of emerging transit technologies and industry best practices.

• Bilingualism (English and French) is an asset.

This is an exceptional opportunity to lead a critical public service during a transformative period of growth and investment. You will play a key role in shaping the future of public transportation across Greater Moncton while working alongside dedicated employees, municipal leaders, and community partners committed to building a more connected region.

Emergency Response Team Responder - In Training (Fire/Emergency Response Team)
Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station, New Brunswick, Canada
Competition # E22123- 2025

At NB Power we are a team committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for new members to join us.

NB Power's Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station is seeking candidates for its Fire Protection Program - Emergency Response Team (ERT). As a qualified ERT Responder, individuals will be provided with advanced training and be prepared to respond to various types of emergency situations including fire, medical and hazmat. Other duties or maintenance activities based on station operational requirements, as requested.

• High School diploma or equivalent (GED)

• Valid Class 3 Driver's License with Airbrakes Endorsement accompanied by an acceptable driving record with submission of Driver's Abstract

• National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) = 1001 Level I Fire Fighter certificate OR International Fire Service Accreditation Congress (IFSAC) Level I Fire Fighter certificate

• National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) = 1001 Level II Fire Fighter certificate OR International Fire Service Accreditation Congress (IFSAC) Level II Fire Fighter certificate

• Medical First Responder with Advanced CPR & AED

• NFPA 472 Awareness and Operations

• Two years of experience as a volunteer or full-time Industrial or Municipal Fire Fighter

• Two years of experience working in an industrial environment

• NFPA 1002: Standard for Fire Apparatus Driver/Operator Professional Qualifications

• Rope/technical rescue certificate

## Candidates must also meet the following qualifications and requirements:

• Successfully pass Fitness Testing

• Complete a competency-based interview

• Complete medical screening

• Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission requirements for a criminal background check, personal credit check and Canadian Security Intelligence Service Site Access security clearance

Please note physical and medical testing must be conducted in person at the designated location in New Brunswick.

## Our ideal candidate will also have:

• The ability to work shift work on a rotating schedule that involves working nights, weekends, and holidays as per shift schedule.

• A strong team orientation, while also able to work independently without direct supervision, when required.

• Basic computer skills with Microsoft applications such as Outlook and Word.

An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

## Conditions of Employment:

• Security Clearance: Due to security requirements at Canadian Nuclear facilities, the successful candidates will be required to obtain a Site Access Security Clearance. This process includes verification of background information, credit check, references, a Criminal Record Name Check, and a Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) security recommendation. Maintaining this clearance is a mandatory requirement for the position.

• Medical Clearance: Must be medically cleared as "fit for duty" by NB Power's contracted physician and maintain this status.

• Annual Physical Testing: Must successfully pass and maintain annual physical testing.

• Emergency Response Team Training: Must successfully complete and maintain training in the on-site Emergency Response Team program, which spans 20-24 weeks.

• Drills and Certifications: Must complete and maintain qualifying drills in Fire, Medical, and HAZMAT.

• Radiation Protection Training: Must successfully pass and maintain Radiation Protection Training Yellow Badge certification.

An Eligibility List generated from this competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level within a period of up to 12 months.

• Health Spending Account, allowing for further flexibility

• New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan, offering retirement financial security

• Wellness options, including our Employee Family Assistance Program

• Benefits that allow for financial protection in the event it is needed

• Various options for paid or unpaid leaves

• Representation of the IBEW Local 37 Union

• Career development and growth throughout the organization

• Competitive wages

## Could you be our next team member? Apply today!

Please ensure a resume and a copy of your degree/diploma/certificate are attached to your online application.

NB Power will accept foreign credentials if they are considered acceptable by a recognized Canadian educational institution. Candidates with foreign education credentials are required to provide proof of Canadian equivalency. Any applicable fees are the responsibility of the candidate. For more information, you may refer to the Canadian Information Centre of International Credentials .

To be considered for this employment opportunity you must be eligible to work in Canada.

For questions concerning this job opening please contact Nicole Ferguson at careers@nbpower.com .

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

## Job Posting Information

Nuclear Response Team - In Training (Security)
Current and future Term and Regular positions
Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station, New Brunswick, Canada
Competition # E21722-2025

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for new members to join us.

NB Power's Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station is seeking candidates for its Nuclear Response Team (NRT). The Nuclear Response Team is responsible for the security of personnel and assets at the Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station, ensuring compliance of the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission (CNSC) Nuclear Security Regulations, and all applicable NB Power Security procedures and processes. Nuclear Response Team Officers provide armed, tactical response capabilities, on a shift basis, in addition to conducting general security and security-related administrative activities.

## Key functions include, but are not limited to:

• Carrying out foot and vehicle patrols of buildings, grounds, and fence lines. Responding to alarms on site and operate conventional and armored patrol vehicles.
• Be prepared to provide armed, tactical response to a Station security threat.
• Conducting searches of persons, packages, and vehicles entering and leaving the facility, using physical and technological methods to ensure no weapons, explosives or other prohibited items enter the facility and to prevent the unauthorized removal of nuclear material.
• Monitoring and recording all vehicle traffic and personnel entering the site in accordance with approved procedures and operating policies.
• Operating and monitoring surveillance video and intrusion detection equipment located within the Central Alarm Station.
• Investigating incidents and preparing condition reports involving breaches of security regulations or other incidents discovered during security patrols or as requested by the Nuclear Response Team Sergeant.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Post secondary certificate, diploma, degree or on track to graduate in June 2025, in one of the following: Police Foundations, Police Science, Law and Security, Criminal Justice, Corrections, Criminology, or a course deemed an equivalent level of education

OR

• Canadian Armed Forces Military Service* of either:

• Regular Force with minimum three years of continuous service

• Military Reserve with minimum three years as a Full Time Reservist

• Military Reserve with minimum five years as a Part-Time Reservist

*Submission of Members Personnel Record Resume is required for proof of Canadian Armed Forces Service

An equivalent combination of training and experience will be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

## Candidates must also meet the following qualifications and requirements:

• Valid Class 5 Driver's Licence
• Complete and pass Aptitude & Psychological Testing
• Complete a competency-based interview
• Complete medical screening including hearing, vision and bloodwork
• Must hold at time of application, a valid Firearms Possession and Acquisition Licence (PAL) for both RESTRICTED and NON-RESTRICTED weapons
• Complete and pass Fitness Testing consisting of the Ontario Police Fitness Award PIN Program https://pfpo.org/ontario-police-fitness-pin-award-program/

Please note physical and medical testing MUST be conducted in person at the designated location in New Brunswick.

## Our ideal candidate will also have:

• Strong attention to detail
• Strong oral and written communication skills
• Experience carrying a firearm in the line of duty and the ability to deal with stressful situations
• Team orientated, but also able to work independently without direct supervision, when required
• Possess basic computer skills with word, excel, outlook and/or access control applications such as OpenText
• Physical ability to carry approximately 45 pounds of equipment periodically throughout a 12-hour shift on a rotating schedule that involves working nights, weekends, and holidays as per shift schedule

## Conditions of Employment

• Security Clearance: Due to security requirements at Canadian Nuclear facilities, the successful candidate will require a Site Access Security Clearance to Level II SECRET. This process includes verification of background information, credit check, references, a Criminal Record Name Check, and a Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) security recommendation. Maintaining this clearance is a mandatory requirement for the position.

• Medical Clearance: Must be medically cleared as "fit for duty" by NB Power's contracted physician and maintain this status.

• Annual Physical Testing: Must successfully pass and maintain annual physical testing.

• Nuclear Response Team Training: Must successfully pass the on-site Basic Tactical Officer Course (BTOC).

• Certifications: Must be able to obtain and maintain Nuclear Security Officer status and Public Agent Status through the approval of the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission.

• Alcohol and Drug Testing: Nuclear Response Team members are subject to alcohol and drug testing in the following circumstances: pre-placement, random, post-incident, for cause, and return-to-duty/follow-up, as outlined in REGDOC-2.2.4, Managing Alcohol and Drug Use by the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission. Passing pre-placement test is mandatory for continued employment.

## Could you be our next team member? Apply today!

Your resume and required documentation such as the valid restricted and non-restricted PAL, Valid Driver's Licence, proof of education and (if applicable) Members Personnel Record Resume MUST be attached to your online application. In order to be considered for this job opportunity, applicants must provide proof of Canadian citizenship.

NB Power will accept foreign credentials if they are considered acceptable by a recognized Canadian educational institution. Candidates with foreign education credentials are required to provide proof of Canadian equivalency. Any applicable fees are the responsibility of the candidate. For more information, you may refer to the Canadian Information Centre of International Credentials .

Please note that only applications submitted through the NB Power website will be considered, as the showing of our postings on various websites may not have been requested or approved.

An Eligibility List generated from this competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level within a period of up to 12 months.

## We care for our team, and as a member you will have access to:

• Health & Dental plans that provide flexible options to meet your needs
• Health Spending Account, allowing for further flexibility
• New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan, offering retirement financial security
• Wellness options, including our Employee Family Assistance Program
• Benefits that allow for financial protection in the event it is needed
• Various options for paid or unpaid leaves
• Representation of the IBEW Local 37 Union
• Career development and growth throughout the organization
• Competitive wages

For questions concerning this job opening please contact Nicole Ferguson at careers@nbpower.com .

The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure has a broad mandate and is committed to maintaining and improving New Brunswick's public infrastructure. The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure's mission is to contribute to New Brunswick's economy and quality of life by providing and supporting sustainable infrastructure that allows for the safe and efficient movement of people, goods and government services to the public. Not only is the department responsible for managing over 18,000 kilometers of provincial highways, it also manages the planning, design and construction of hospitals, schools and other government buildings.

## What you will do

The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure is seeking individuals to create an inventory for existing and future casual snowfighter opportunities in the Highway Maintenance crews within the Moncton District during winter operations. The Moncton District includes divisions in Petitcodiac, Hillsborough, Indian Mountain/Salisbury, Cap-Pelé, Sackville/Port Elgin, Shediac, Moncton, Harcourt/Acadieville, Kouchibouguac, Rexton, Bouctouche/St-Marie, Cocagne.

Reporting to the Highway Supervisor, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

• performing skilled duties in the construction and maintenance of highways.

• managing safe and efficient operation of a variety of heavy equipment, including a one-person plow during winter operations as requested, per the procedures set by the Department of Transportation and Infrastructure.

• performing normal maintenance and minor repairs on assigned equipment, preparing and maintaining work records on the operation of the assigned equipment.

2241246.description:
NEW BRUNSWICK HOUSING CORPORATIONEXPRESSION OF INTEREST:Pay Band 4/5Open Competition - Temporary Opportunity Federal-Provincial-Territorial Secretariat Opportunity

Housing New Brunswick (HNB) is seeking expressions of interest from Pay Band 4 and 5 employees for roles in contributing to the development of an FPT Secretariat. Over the next few years, HNB will be preparing to assume a stronger leadership role in FPT housing collaboration, requiring strong coordination, policy analysis, strategic advice, and relationship management across many levels of government. This initiative aims to identify employees for temporary assignments, projects, development opportunities, or future roles within the evolving Secretariat.

## About the Opportunity:

The FPT Secretariat will help advance New Brunswick`s housing priorities through effective intergovernmental coordination, clear advice to senior leaders, and timely support for national and regional housing discussions. The Secretariat will work closely with HNB teams, partners across the Government of New Brunswick, federal departments and other provinces and territories.

This is an opportunity to gain exposure to high-priority intergovernmental work, strengthen briefing and policy skills, and contribute directly to Housing New Brunswick`s readiness for future FPT leadership responsibilities while helping to shape a team that will become increasingly important to the organization over the coming years.

## Key Areas of Work:

Employees selected through this process may support a range of activities, including but not limited to:

• Support preparation for FPT, Provinces and Territories (PT), Assistant Deputy Minister (ADM), Deputy Minister and Minister-level meetings, including briefing notes, speaking notes, agendas, decision materials, and follow-up summaries.

• Leadership and collaboration on national working groups, including organizing facilitating and driving the agenda for multi-jurisdictional meetings to align strategic housing initiatives across regions.

• Development and delivery of high impact presentations for senior executives, intergovernmental partners, and stakeholder forums. Presentations must effectively communicate key insights, progress metrics, and strategic opportunities, and should reflect a high standard of analytical and visual clarity.

• Track federal, provincial and territorial housing developments, commitments, risks and opportunities relevant to New Brunswick.

• Coordinate input from HNB divisions and other departments to support clear and consistent provincial positions.

• Assist with federal agreement management, action plans, reporting, claims, performance tracking and related governance materials.

• Cross-jurisdictional analysis and reporting: includes performing in-depth jurisdictional analysis of housing policies, funding allocations, and performance outcomes and will involve synthesizing complex data sets to provide evidence-based insights and recommendations to senior leadership and working groups.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.

## Need to have:

• A bachelor`s degree in business, sociology, or a related field and four (4) or five (5) years of related work experience. An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience may be considered.

Written and spoken competence in English and French is required. Some positions only require English. Please state your language capability.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please ensure that preferred language for assessment is identified on your resume.

Behavioral Competencies: The successful candidate will possess the following leadership competencies:

• Strategic Thinking

• Effective Interactive Communication

• Relationship / Network Building

• Analytical Thinking/Judgment

• Organizational Awareness

Technical Competencies: The successful candidate will possess the following technical competencies:

• Policy and Research Analysis

• Planning and Organizing Skills

• Written Communication

• Consulting Skills

• Project Management

## Who Should Apply

This opportunity may be a good fit for employees who are curious, organized, collaborative and interested in housing policy, federal funding programs and intergovernmental work, even if they do not have direct FPT experience. Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing competing deadlines, synthesizing information, and preparing clear written materials for senior decision-makers.

## Ideal candidates will bring some combination of the following:

• Strong writing, research and analytical skills with good judgment, discretion and attention to detail.

• Experience preparing briefing notes, decision documents, meeting materials or policy advice.

• Ability to work across teams and build effective relationships.

• Intergovernmental relations or corporate coordination.

• Ability to organize information, track commitments and support follow-up on complex files.

• Comfort working with ambiguity and helping build new processes as the Secretariat develops.

Employees are encouraged to discuss their interest with their manager before applying.

Submitting an expression of interest does not ensure placement but may identify employees for future opportunities based on organizational needs and feasibility.

Interested employees are asked to submit a brief expression of interest outlining:

• Why you are interested in supporting the FPT Secretariat.

• Relevant experience, skills or strengths you would bring to the work.

• Any areas of development you are hoping to strengthen through this opportunity.

2239540.title: Nurse Practitioner
2239540.description:
Nurse Practitioner - 2 positions
Dieppe, New Brunswick

## Help Shape the Future of Primary Care

At Clinique Médicale Accès, we believe the future of primary care is not about asking healthcare professionals to work harder-it is about building smarter systems that allow every member of the team to practise at the highest level of their training.

Our collaborative physician-nurse model has demonstrated that innovation, prevention, and efficient team-based care can dramatically increase access to primary care while preserving the quality of the patient experience. We continue to invest in new ways of delivering care, empowering healthcare professionals, and improving the lives of our patients.

As our clinic continues to grow, we are excited to welcome two bilingual Nurse Practitioners to join our team.

We intentionally hope to recruit two Nurse Practitioners together, believing that beginning this journey alongside another NP creates opportunities for collaboration, mentorship, professional support, and long-term job satisfaction.

If you are passionate about preventive medicine, collaborative practice, and helping redefine how primary care is delivered, we would love to meet you.

The Opportunity These positions offer the opportunity to develop a rewarding practice focused primarily on preventive medicine while working alongside an experienced collaborative care team.

Your practice will primarily focus on:

• Well-baby care

• Preventive health assessments

• Cancer screening appointments

• Adult preventive care

• Immunizations and vaccination programs

• Health promotion and patient education

You will also collaborate with physicians and nurses in providing comprehensive primary care while practising to the full scope of your Nurse Practitioner licence.

One of the unique aspects of our clinic is our commitment to supporting the professional interests of our providers. As our organization continues to grow, there will be opportunities to further develop areas of practice aligned with your expertise and career goals.

## Key Responsibilities

• Perform comprehensive health assessments

• Diagnose and manage acute and chronic medical conditions

• Prescribe medications and therapies within scope of practice

• Order and interpret laboratory investigations and diagnostic imaging

• Provide preventive health screening and counselling

• Provide well-baby care and routine childhood follow-ups for children from 2 weeks to 5 years of age. Approximately two days per week are dedicated to these appointments.

• Administer and oversee vaccination programs

• Educate patients regarding disease prevention and healthy lifestyles

• Maintain accurate EMR documentation

• Review laboratory results, diagnostic reports, electronic consultations and incoming correspondence

• Collaborate closely with physicians, nurses and administrative staff

• Maintain current evidence-based practice standards

## Qualifications

Applicants must:

• Hold a Bachelor's Degree in Nursing

• Hold a Master's Degree in Nursing (Nurse Practitioner)

• Have successfully completed the Canadian Nurse Practitioner Examination (CNPE)

• Be registered and in good standing with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick (NANB)

• Be fluent in both English and French

## What Makes Our Clinic Different

Our clinic was intentionally designed to maximize provider satisfaction while improving patient access.

We believe healthcare professionals should spend their time caring for patients-not navigating unnecessary administrative burden.

Our collaborative workflows, highly trained nursing team and efficient clinical processes allow providers to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care.

## Schedule

Hours may be negotiated based on the successful candidate's preferences.

Our physicians and nursing team currently work Monday through Thursday and benefit from paid Fridays off through our efficiency-based compensation model.

• No evenings

• No weekends

• No statutory holidays

• No after-hours coverage

## Benefits

Joining Clinique Médicale Accès means becoming part of a supportive, innovative team committed to both professional excellence and work-life balance.

Benefits include:

• Medical insurance

• Two weeks of paid vacation

• Clinic closed for two weeks over Christmas

• Clinic closed for two weeks during March Break

• Flexible summer schedule (employees may choose to work or access Employment Insurance, where applicable)

• Additional unpaid leave may be negotiated

• Collaborative multidisciplinary team

• No overhead or administrative costs

• Free on-site parking

• Efficiency-based bonus structure

## Compensation

We offer a competitive compensation package starting at $150 000 annually.

In addition to the annual salary, successful candidates will participate in our efficiency-based bonus program, recognizing providers who contribute to improving patient access while maintaining excellence in care.

## Supporting Your Success

At Clinique Médicale Accès, we believe that Nurse Practitioners should spend the majority of their time applying their clinical expertise-assessing patients, making diagnoses, developing treatment plans, and solving complex medical problems.

As our clinic continues to grow, we are committed to continually optimizing our collaborative care model. To help Nurse Practitioners maximize both job satisfaction and eligibility for our efficiency-based bonus program, we are open to discussing dedicated Registered Nurse support. By allowing Registered Nurses to perform appropriate clinical tasks within their scope of practice, Nurse Practitioners can focus more of their time on clinical decision-making and delivering high-quality patient care.

We believe every healthcare professional should be empowered to practise at the highest level of their training.

Start Date: Between September 15 and October 15, 2026, at the successful candidate's discretion.
Application Deadline : September 30 2026

2241228.title: Senior Environmental Professional (Biologist or Environmental Scientist)
2241228.employer: GEMTEC Consulting Engineers and Scientists Limited
2241228.description:
Do your friends stop talking to you on hikes because you keep identifying every plant and bird? If so, we may have the perfect role for you! We currently have an opening for a permanent full-time Senior Environmental Professional based in any of the following NB offices: Fredericton, Moncton or Saint John.

About Us

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm with offices across Atlantic Canada and Ontario. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team. Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers, without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

About the Role

The position provides the opportunity to primarily support the growing team in New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland and Labrador, and across Canada. You will work with a team of engineers, and environmental scientists on a variety of environmental projects in support of infrastructure and land development, renewable energy development and mine development. Some of the key responsibilities are:

• Planning, development and execution of environmental deliverables including Environmental Impact Assessments, Environmental Monitoring Reports, Permit Applications, etc. for proposed development projects in various industry sectors under provincial and/or federal processes.

• Planning, execution, and management of field programs/surveys relevant to the assessment of terrestrial and/or aquatic biology including avifauna, wildlife, vegetation (including rare plants), aquatics, wetlands, species at risk, etc.

• Involved in coordinating, preparing, and reviewing provincial and federal environmental permitting applications.

• Provide oversight of field and office staff including review of health and safety plans, survey methodology, QA/QC practices, etc.

• Preparation and review of proposals, work plans and budgets as well as contributing or leading the management of projects.

• Collaboration with other GEMTEC staff and offices on environmental permitting and related environmental projects of various sizes.

• Involved in coordinating and completing environmental and socioeconomic studies, Aboriginal, stakeholder, and public consultation programs.

Qualifications

• Completion of an undergraduate degree in related field such as Biology, Environmental Engineering or Environmental Science.

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in a related environmental professional role.

• A demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast paced, multidisciplinary environment.

• Knowledge and understanding of applicable municipal, provincial, and federal policies, guidelines and legislation for environmental assessments.

• Excellent project management skills with the ability to develop scope of works, execution strategies, and experience with overseeing management of environmental related work.

• Certified wetland delineator would be considered an asset

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Prior work experience in environmental consulting will be considered an asset

• Must have a valid driver's license

## EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Position Title: Trimble Cityworks & Esri ArcGIS Online Administrator
Report To: Geomatics Program Manager
Location: 47 Church Road, Natoaganeg, New Brunswick, E1V 4E6
Anticipated Start Date: September 25, 2026 (Negotiable)
Application Deadline: September 11, 2026
Term: One-year contract with a three-month probationary period

NSMTC Member Communities:
The North Shore Mi'kmaq Tribal Council (NSMTC) is comprised of and provides services to seven member Mi'kmaq First Nation communities: Ugpi'ganjig (Eel River Bar), Oinpegitjoig (Pabineau), Natoaganeg (Eel Ground), Metepenagiag (Red Bank), L'nui Menikuk (Indian Island), Tjipogtotjg (Buctouche), and Amlamgog (Fort Folly).

Position Overview:
The Trimble Cityworks and ESRI ArcGIS Online Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of the organization's GIS-centric infrastructure asset management and maintenance management systems. The position ensures the integrity, availability, and effective use of spatial asset data to support work order management, service requests, inspections, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle management of First Nations infrastructure. Working closely with the NSMTC Technical Services' Geomatics Program, the Administrator supports system integration, optimizes business processes, develops reporting and dashboards, and provides technical expertise to improve operational efficiency, asset performance, and data-driven decision-making.

Program Location and Travel:
The Trimble Cityworks & Esri ArcGIS Online Administrator will be based at the Natoaganeg Band Office in Natoaganeg (Eel Ground) First Nation, New Brunswick. Regular travel to participating NSMTC First Nations is required, along with occasional travel throughout Atlantic Canada. The successful candidate must hold a valid driver's license and have access to reliable transportation.

## Key Responsibilities:

• Administer, configure, and maintain Trimble Cityworks and Esri ArcGIS Online, ensuring reliable system performance, data integrity, security, and user support.

• Manage GIS-based infrastructure asset data and maintenance workflows, including work orders, service requests, inspections, preventive maintenance, asset inventory, and mobile field operations.

• Develop, maintain, and promote data governance standards, documentation, user training, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure consistent, accurate, and effective use of asset management and GIS systems across the organization.

• Other duties as required to meet organizational objectives.

## Duties and Responsibilities:

• Administer, configure, maintain, and support the Trimble Cityworks Asset Management System (AMS) and Esri ArcGIS Online environment to ensure reliable system performance, security, and availability.

• Configure and maintain work order, service request, inspection, and preventive maintenance workflows to support infrastructure maintenance and operational requirements.

• Maintain the integrity, accuracy, and quality of GIS-based infrastructure asset data, ensuring assets are current, complete, and aligned with organizational standards.

• Manage user accounts, security roles, permissions, licensing, and system access in accordance with organizational policies and best practices.

• Develop, configure, and maintain web maps, hosted feature layers, dashboards, mobile applications, and reporting tools to support operational and management decision-making.

• Collaborate with NSMTC Technical Services' programs, other NSMTC departments, NSMTC Member Nations, and other business units to identify business requirements and implement system enhancements and process improvements.

• Monitor system performance, troubleshoot technical issues, coordinate software upgrades and patches, and work with vendors to resolve application and integration issues.

• Administer and maintain infrastructure asset inventories, asset hierarchies, condition assessments, and lifecycle information to support effective asset management, maintenance planning, capital renewal, and long-term infrastructure investment decisions.

• Develop and maintain documentation, system standards, operating procedures, and data governance practices to ensure consistent and effective system administration.

• Provide technical support, training, and guidance to end users, promoting the effective use of GIS, asset management, and maintenance management applications.

• Produce and analyze reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to support asset lifecycle management, maintenance planning, regulatory reporting, and organizational performance monitoring.

• Research emerging technologies, industry best practices, and software enhancements, and recommend continuous improvements to infrastructure asset management, maintenance management, and GIS business processes.

• Other duties as required to meet organizational objectives.

## Qualifications and Skills:

• Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience administering and supporting Esri ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, and/or enterprise GIS solutions.

• Minimum of three (3) years of experience administering Trimble Cityworks or a comparable Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) or Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

• Demonstrated experience in infrastructure asset management, maintenance management, and GIS-based asset inventory management within a municipal, utility, or public sector environment.

• Strong knowledge of work order management, service requests, inspections, preventive maintenance, and asset lifecycle management principles and practices.

• Experience with GIS data management, spatial databases, data quality assurance, and maintaining accurate, reliable, and authoritative asset information.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues, support users, manage multiple priorities, and implement continuous system and business process improvements.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• Experience designing and delivering training programs or workshops.

• Strong communication skills, including technical presentation delivery and report or proposal writing.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

• Experience liaising with First Nations, government, industry, and project partners.

• Demonstrated understanding of Indigenous people, traditions and socio-economic conditions is essential.

• Spoken and written English is essential; proficiency in Mi'kmaq will be considered an asset.

## What We Offer:

• A work culture that supports employee wellbeing, diversity, engagement, and a sense of belonging.

• Competitive salary and access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program.

• Collaboration with a team of passionate professionals working towards contributing to the growth and success of First Nations communities.

## Conditions of Employment:

• Successful criminal record check.

• Proven ability to maintain confidentiality.

• Valid driver's license and access to reliable transportation.

## Compensation and Benefits:

• Competitive salary

• Travel expenses

Additional Information:
If you are passionate about directly supporting First Nations communities and are motivated, collaborative, innovative, and possess excellent communication skills, we encourage you to apply for this position.

The NSMTC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all interested parties. However, if there are applicants of equal education, skills, and experience, preference may be given to members of our seven member communities.

Application Deadline:
Please submit your resume and cover letter to Tammy Scott, Human Resources Manager at careers@nsmtc.ca by September 11, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.

We thank those who apply, but only individuals selected for further consideration will be contacted. Applicants are responsible for the timely submission of applications.
