Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2240747.title: Health, Safety and Wellness Specialist
2240747.description:
## Work Remotely Anywhere in the Province of New Brunswick

WorkSafeNB is seeking to fill an approximately 18-month term contract of Health, Safety, and Wellness Specialist. Reporting to the Director, Health and Wellness, the Health, Safety, and Wellness Specialist is responsible for supporting the development and implementation of health, safety, and wellness programs within the organization. The primary focus will be on promoting a safe and healthy work environment, employee well-being, and monitoring compliance with relevant regulations.

## Salary and Hours of Work:

• Hours of work are those required to perform the assigned tasks but shall not be less than 35 hours per week.

• Pay Scale: $82,971.90 to $97,614.00 annually.

## Responsibilities

• Occupational Health and Safety/Psychological Health & Safety Program - Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of the Occupational Health and Safety/Psychological Health and Safety Program to prioritize employees' well-being and effectively manage and mitigate the risks associated with work-related injuries and illnesses.

• Training and Development - Support training and development of mandatory health and safety programs, directives, and third-party health and safety training to ensure regulatory compliance and internal compliance to WorkSafeNB directives.

• Wellness - Support the development and implementation of corporate wellness initiatives that support the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees.

• Statistical Analysis - Gather and analyze Health, Safety, and Wellness data from multiple sources to extract trends and organizational insights.

• Incident/Hazard Management - Support the Incident Management process to promptly capture, document, and investigate workplace incidents to prevent recurrence.

## Qualifications

• University degree in Science, Business Administration, Occupational Health, and Safety, other relevant discipline.

• Minimum 3 years of work experience in administration of occupational health and safety programs.

• Experience in the interpretation and application of relevant provincial/federal health and safety legislation, standards, statistical information, and guidelines.

• Occupational Health and Safety Knowledge

• Knowledge of regulations pertaining to Health and Safety and related compliance requirements with strong attention to detail.

• Knowledge of policies, guidelines, standards of the NB Occupational Health and Safety Act and Regulation.

• Knowledge of the understanding of the Workers Compensation Act.

• Professional designation in Occupational Health and Safety (e.g., Canadian Registered Safety Professional) is considered an asset.

• Knowledge of health and safety; specific knowledge in ergonomics and/or physical safety hazards or organizational health and employee wellbeing is an asset.

## Competencies:

• Adaptability

• Enabling Communication

• Client-focused Service

• Teamwork and Collaboration

• Ensuring Accountability

• Impact and Influence

• Emotional Intelligence / Self-awareness

• Problem Solving

• Ensuring Health and Safety

• Occupational Health and Safety Management

## Written and spoken competence in English is required.

WorkSafeNB offers a competitive annual salary with excellent benefits, including:

• Health and Dental Coverage

• Basic Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance

• Optional Dependent Life Insurance

• New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan

• Competitive vacation and leave entitlements.

• Online Doctors

• Personal Wellness Account

Your primary workspace will be from your in-home office, with the occasional expectation of in person meetings, primarily at the head office in Saint John, New Brunswick, for that reason, working from outside the province or country is not permissible.

If you are interested in pursuing this opportunity with WorkSafeNB, please apply online at www.worksafenb.ca by October 5, 2026.

We thank all those who apply however only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

For more information about WorkSafeNB, or this and other employment opportunities, please visit our website at worksafenb.ca.

## About Us

The team at WorkSafeNB is passionate about promoting health and safety in New Brunswick workplaces. We strive to make New Brunswick the safest place to work. However, injuries do occur, and when they do, we are committed to providing caring recovery and return to work services, benefits, and compensation to injured workers and their families. Culture is the heartbeat of the organization. The stronger it is, the further we go! Selected by our employees, our WorkSafeNB values shape our culture. We put our values of Accountability, Collaboration and Trust into ACTion. We demonstrate accountability by taking pride in and ownership of our work so we can take care of our clients and other New Brunswickers. Through collaboration, we build strong partnerships and innovate to achieve better outcomes. Trust guides our organization; we lead and listen with empathy and embrace diversity, inclusion and belonging. These ACTions shape us.

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for new members to join us.

The Mactaquac Generating Station began generating electricity in 1968. Since the 1980s, concrete portions of the hydro station have been affected by a chemical reaction called alkali-aggregate reaction (AAR). The reaction causes the concrete to swell and crack and has required substantial annual maintenance and repairs. NB Power is proposing a project to ensure the station can operate to its intended 100-year lifespan with a modified approach to maintenance and adjusting and replacing equipment and concrete overtime.

As part of the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project, the Engineer V will lead a team of engineers responsible for all aspects of design and construction of project work. This includes ensuring NB Power is prepared to complete the preliminary designs required and overseeing and coordinating all design and construction work performed by external consultants to ensure safety, environment, quality, efficiency, and compliance with organizational standards.

## Mechanical Engineering key functions include:

• Lead a team of discipline-specific engineers while engaging stakeholders across all project phases, ensuring technical expertise is applied from planning through close-out.

• Review designs, and oversee installation and commissioning of turbines, hydraulic gates, cranes, and mechanical systems, while weighing alternatives and approving consultant-provided design solutions on behalf of NB Power.

• Provide field support during construction by managing Request for Information (RFIs), monitoring contractor quality, adapting to changed conditions, and delivering recommendations on multidisciplinary technical issues to senior project leadership for resolution.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Registered Professional Engineer licensed in New Brunswick or eligible for immediate transfer

• Eight years of experience with any of large hydraulic gate design and installation, large cranes, turbines, balance of plant mechanical systems (fire protection, drainage, piping, pumps, HVAC) as well as mechanical/instrumentation construction oversight

• Participation in design teams during planning, detailed design, execution, and close-out phases of mega-projects

• Providing technical guidance during construction, including responding to RFIs, managing contractor quality programs, handling changed conditions and knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and industry best practices

• Demonstrated experience leading a team of discipline specific engineers

## Civil Engineering key functions include:

• Lead a team of discipline-specific engineers while engaging stakeholders across all project phases, ensuring technical expertise is applied from planning through close-out.

• Review designs and oversee the design and construction of reinforced concrete, structural steel, earthworks, and dam-related activities, applying geotechnical insights and mitigation strategies for AAR concrete effects, while weighing alternatives and approving consultant-provided solutions on behalf of NB Power.

• Provide field support during construction by managing RFIs, monitoring contractor quality, adapting to changed conditions, and delivering recommendations on multidisciplinary technical issues to senior project leadership for resolution.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Civil Engineering

• Providing technical guidance during construction, including responding to RFIs, managing contractor quality programs, handling changed conditions and knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and industry best practices

• Demonstrated experience leading a team of discipline specific engineers

## Electrical Engineering key functions include:

• Lead a team of discipline-specific engineers while engaging stakeholders across all project phases, ensuring technical expertise is applied from planning through close-out.

• Review designs and lead the implementation and commissioning of electrical distribution and control systems, balance of plant equipment, SCADA, generator protection, and communications, while weighing alternatives and approving consultant-provided solutions on behalf of NB Power.

• Contribute to hydroelectric equipment integration, ensuring safe and efficient operation from design through commissioning.

• Provide field support during construction by managing RFIs, monitoring contractor quality, adapting to changed conditions, and delivering recommendations on multidisciplinary technical issues to senior project leadership for resolution.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering

• Registered Professional Engineer licensed in New Brunswick or eligible for immediate transfer

• Eight years of experience in AC and DC electrical distribution, communications systems (fire protection, access control, SCADA), generator protection and control systems as well as electrical/instrumentation construction oversight

• Participation in design teams during planning, detailed design, execution, and close-out phases of mega-projects

• Providing technical guidance during construction, including responding to RFIs, managing contractor quality programs, handling changed conditions and knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and industry best practices

## The following are considered assets:

• Earthworks and embankment dam design and construction

• Experience with hydroelectric generation equipment (e.g., generators)

Please note that during the initial phase of the project, positions will be based at Head Office. As the project advances, the primary work location will transition to the Mactaquac Generating Station.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

To holistically coordinate the care of each patient, incorporating the nursing profession's values of knowledge, theory and practice. To assess, plan, implement and evaluate the needs of patients and significant others in the delivery of care and collaborate with all members of the interdisciplinary team in this approach.

The EMP Enhanced Care Coordination in Schools (CCS) program will provide support to Education and Early Childhood Development (EECD) and integrated care teams in all regions throughout the province. This includes the care coordination required to implement each student's school-based medical care plan while continuing to evaluate the needs of students/families and care providers (including school personnel) in the delivery of care. The EMP Coordinator works to facilitate and coordinate activities required for the enhancement of care for students with complex medical care needs.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Work with students, families, teachers, educational assistants, other professional staff to ensure an integrated person-centered approach to meet the student's care needs in a time efficient manner.

• Support the school-based care team to ensure the student identified as having complex medical care needs has a Care Plan developed in collaboration with the student/family and integrated care team that is reviewed regularly.

• Complete documentation as required, ensure student records contain all relevant medical information and collect data as needed.

• Provide comprehensive assessment, intervention and evaluation of outcomes and work with the inter-professional team in the provision of safe, evidence-based quality care.

• Daily planning, organizing, delegating, coordinating and evaluating optimal nursing care along with troubleshooting day-to-day obstacles within the service.

• Provide clinical care to students through the effective application of clinical judgement, computer-based decision support software, appropriate evidence-based clinical guidelines, and other relevant information databases/resources.

• Using in-depth clinical knowledge, apply process to identify student needs, risk and safety issues, educational opportunities, alternate services required and ensure appropriate care pathway.

• Lead and participate in student care conferences to help coordinate care and services and share information to ensure continuity of care.

• Support EECD, and family to ensure the appropriate education is provided and or available to the student's school-based circle of care.

• Build credible and therapeutic relationships with the student/parents, school personnel, Regional Health Authorities, physicians and nurse practitioners, Social Development, other partner organizations and community agencies involved in the circle of care as an ambassador of the program.

• Communicate effectively and demonstrate cultural competence.

• Assure leadership, direction and supervision of LPN's clinical work.

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor's degree in Nursing;

• Actively registered or ability to register with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick;

• Three (3) years' experience of specialized registered nursing experience in acute care setting with consideration given to those with nursing lead experience in specialty clinics;

• Canadian Nursing Association certification in a specialty area related to community health is an asset;

• A good driving record with a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License;

• Have a current CPR Level C certification or be prepared to obtain within 3 months;

• Ability to work independently and effectively with an inter-disciplinary team and possess leadership and coaching skills, strong interpersonal skills, good judgment and decision making skills;

• Well organized with the ability to prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment and comfortable working to a schedule with demanding turn-around times;

• Possess sound analytical skills and clinical judgement with the ability to work in a remote work environment;

• Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office;

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Salary: As per collective agreement.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Emergency Medical Technicians are based on the current Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements for Emergency Medical Technician as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our emergency medical technicians provide transportation and patient care for non-urgent low acuity patients and are expected to maintain and operate ambulances and related equipment in accordance with patient needs and public safety.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in emergency medical technology or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• High school graduation plus an Emergency Medical Technician program/course

• Must meet all legislated requirements for Emergency Medical Technician in New Brunswick

• Must be registered, active Emergency Medical Technician with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Written & Spoken competency in one of the two official languages (English or French) is required and spoken competency in the other official language is preferred.

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your EMT certificate from a recognized institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as an Emergency Medical Technician within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR Level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Please note: Related and allied duties may be assigned from time to time as may become necessary to the operation of Ambulance NB. Also other competencies related to changes in PANB Scope of Practice guidelines and approved by the Provincial Medical Director may also be added to the duties and responsibilities of this classification.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

As valuable member of the Extramural Program's interdisciplinary team, the Patient Care Attendant - 2 (PCA-2) reports to the Unit Manager and provides personal support and assistance with activities of daily living and other services to patients of all ages in the community.

Using a person-centered approach, the PCA-2 works in partnership with the patient and their health care team by holistically supporting the patient's physical, psychological, social, cognitive, cultural, and spiritual needs.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provides holistic and individualized care across the lifespan.

• Provides food and meal assistance.

• Assists with mobilization.

• Assists with personal hygiene.

• Supports patient care activities by observing and reporting concerns, changes, or relevant information to the appropriate health care team members.

• Provides assistance with Activities of Daily Living (ADL) and Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADL).

• Provides palliative, end-of-life (EOL), and postmortem care.

• Recognize and report changes in the patient's status to the primary provider.

• Assists with restricted activities/controlled acts, as delegated by a Regulated Health Professional

• Participates as a member of the healthcare team.

• Documents patient information, care and progress as per EMP documentation standards.

• Maintains patient safety.

• Reports suspected situations of abuse and/or neglect.

• Maintains personal and team members' safety.

• Applies infection prevention and control practices.

• Maintain a clean and safe work area.

• Provides inclusive care.

•

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS

• High school graduation plus an additional patient care program/course of up to six months or equivalent.

• Experience working with adult patients would be an asset;

• A good driving record with a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License;

• Have a current CPR Level C certification that has been issued in the last 12 months;

• Ability to work efficiently as a member of the team, possess strong interpersonal and communication skill;

• Able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record;

• A high regard for confidentiality Good computer knowledge and skills (MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Submit a valid and clean criminal record check;

All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

2240262.title: Medical Office Administrator - Plastic Surgery Practice
2240262.description:
Dr. Andrew Mulherin, MD, MSc, FRCSC
Saint John Regional Hospital
400 University Ave, Suite 4DN
Saint John, NB E2L 4L2

## JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Medical Office Administrator - Plastic Surgery Practice
Reports to: Dr. Andrew Mulherin, physician
Date: Effective September 15, 2026

## JOB PURPOSE

Dr. Andrew Mulherin is a Reconstructive and Cosmetic Plastic Surgeon practicing in Saint John, NB. He has a primary focus in the treatment of skin cancer, head and neck reconstruction, and aesthetic surgery.

Dr. Mulherin is seeking a full-time Medical Office Administrator (MOA) to join their team. The MOA is often the first point of contact for patients, and equally plays an important role in connecting with other health service providers.

This opportunity is tailored for an individual who has experience working as an office administrator within a healthcare setting, ideally with exposure to surgical or specialized cosmetic clinics. Dr. Mulherin is looking for a strong communicator who is organized, compassionate, highly professional, and an innovative person who is comfortable taking initiative.

## RESPONSIBILITIES

• Patient Coordination: Coordinate patient care through the clinic by checking in patients, prepping charts, escorting individuals to exam/consultation rooms, and preparing rooms for subsequent appointments.

• Clinic Maintenance: Ensure consultation and procedure rooms are stocked appropriately with necessary medical and cosmetic supplies.

• Communication Management: Answer inquiries by phone, email, and in person in a helpful, respectful, and efficient manner, acting as the welcoming face of the practice.

• Scheduling: Manage and maintain the complex appointment schedule, including consultations, follow-ups, and booking surgeries and minor in-office/clinic procedures.

• Documentation & EMR: Manage incoming/outgoing communications and maintain electronic medical records accurately via EMR software.

• Administrative Tasks: Process faxes electronically, prepare/process clinic mail, and perform all other related administrative or special tasks.

• Financial Procedures: Perform billing procedures and handle private payments for cosmetic services where applicable.

• Inventory Control: Order and receive office, medical, and specialized surgical supplies.

• Confidentiality: Ensure absolute patient confidentiality and privacy in alignment with healthcare regulations and the sensitive nature of plastic surgery.

## CONFIDENTIALITY AND DISCRETION

In accordance with the clinic's confidentiality and discretion policy, the incumbent must maintain the confidentiality of all company and patient information and must not discuss such matters outside of the clinical setting. Tact and discretion must be used in all dealings with all patients and potential patients.

## WORKING CONDITIONS & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• This is a full-time position, 40 hours/ week, Monday to Friday.

• The office is located within the Saint John Regional Hospital (400 University Ave, Saint John, NB). The position is expected to maintain regular hours in the office, 8am to 4pm, with occasional variability.

• Some overtime may be required. Similarly, some weeks may require fewer working hours.

## QUALIFICATIONS

• Proficiency with computers, including internet use, electronic medical record (EMR) systems, and MS Office software.

• Excellent documentation skills and a high level of attention to detail.

• Strong communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills.

• Deep compassion, patience, and absolute discretion.

• High regard for confidentiality and strong advocacy for patient care.

• Ability to multi-task and maintain composure in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in English is required; proficiency in French is considered a strong asset.

## EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

• Minimum of two years of experience as a medical office administrator within a medical environment (specialty or surgical clinic experience is a strong asset).

• Medical Office Administrator diploma (or equivalent) is preferred.

• Familiarity with medical terminology, particularly related to surgery and anatomy.

• General knowledge of the New Brunswick medical system is an asset.

## COMPENSATION

Compensation will vary based on the candidate's experience, beginning at $55,000 annually. A performance review will be conducted annually with potential for yearly increase and/ or bonus. Vacation time will be (at least) four weeks each year, assuming flexibility with Dr. Mulherin's schedule.

APPLICATION DEADLINE: September 26, 2026. Applications will be reviewed throughout and the job advertisement will close early if a successful candidate is found. Please do not call the office and leave voicemails as this line is reserved for patients and other physician offices.

2214050.title: Internal Medicine Physician
2214050.description:
Imagine a playground in Atlantic Canada surrounded by fresh waterways on one side and the ocean on the other. Come live and belong to a community where families can raise their children in a safe, close-knit environment with a reasonable cost of living.

Horizon Health Network is seeking Internal Medicine Physicians to join our collaborative teams in beautiful New Brunswick, Canada!

## Why you should work here

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

New Brunswick offers a safe, welcoming community and a relaxed lifestyle enriched by its Indigenous, Anglophone, and Francophone heritage. Whether by the ocean, a river, or a lake, you'll find an ideal place to call home—complete with short commutes, plenty of recreation, and space to enjoy with family and pets. At Horizon, you'll build a meaningful career that makes a difference while embracing the desirable East Coast lifestyle.

## Incentives & Remuneration

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban recruitment incentive of $50,000.00 with a return of service or Rural recruitment incentive of $100,000 with a return of service

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

Remuneration will be determined in accordance with the specific role and practice location. Additional details will be shared as the recruitment process progresses.

## What you will do

The Internal Medicine Physician will join a well-established team of internists at one of our facilities. This full-time position offers an opportunity to provide high-quality, comprehensive medical care, with opportunities to participate in subspecialty activities catering to the applicant's interest. Opportunities and responsibilities may include:

• Provision of an outpatient service for assessment and management of new and follow-up patients.

• Participation in an inpatient internal medicine service.

• Participate in an equally shared on-call rotation.

• Participation in a consultation service for inpatients, emergency room, and the local community.

• Opportunities to participate in diagnostic testing and interpretation.

• Opportunities for teaching of residents and medical students.

• Opportunities for research

## Who you are

• You have a MD (Medical Doctor) degree or a DO (Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine) from a recognized medical school and postgraduate studies (residency).

• ACLS (Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support) certification is required.

• Candidates must be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick.

• Proficiency in English is required. Bilingual skills would be considered an asset.

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

## Interested? Apply Today!

If you have questions and/or to apply, please email physiciancareers@horizonnb.ca with the subject "Application for Internal Medicine"

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2240863.description:
## WHO WE ARE

Mariner innovates always and everywhere, turning novel ideas into practical solutions. From products and services to venture creation, we build better futures powered by people. Our purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company for those who make an impact - elevating people, data, and technology in the best way to solve hard problems. We partner with people embracing change, leveraging data, cybersecurity, cloud, and change management to drive successful business outcomes that matter to our customers.

Mariners build for change. Like SHIFT Energy, our energy management and decarbonization company. Or East Valley Ventures, created to scale social economic impact in our communities through investment and mentorship of emerging change-makers and their companies.

Mariner s purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company and the core values that guide us every day are:

## OUR VALUES

• We care for our team.

• We care about the impact we have on our community.

• We serve by solving complex problems.

• We grow because growth fuels opportunities.

• We innovate always and everywhere.

• We build a business that lasts.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE: We are seeking a Senior OT Control Systems Engineer to join a critical industrial operations environment in Saint John, New Brunswick. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, support, optimization, and security of Operational Technology (OT) and industrial automation systems that enable safe and reliable operations. The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in process control, industrial networking, distributed control systems, and automation technologies within complex industrial settings such as refining, manufacturing, utilities, or other process-driven environments.
This is an on-site position in Saint John, NB.

## WHAT YOU LL BE DOING IN THE ROLE:

• Lead the design, implementation, and enhancement of OT and industrial control system solutions to support operational and business objectives.

• Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot automation systems, including DCS, PLC, HMI, SIS, and asset monitoring platforms.

• Develop and maintain control strategies, system configurations, and automation standards to improve performance, reliability, and safety.

• Design and support industrial networks, ensuring high availability, cybersecurity compliance, and secure system integration.

• Plan and execute system upgrades, patching, lifecycle management activities, and technology modernization initiatives.

• Monitor system health, investigate operational issues, and provide advanced troubleshooting support for critical automation infrastructure.

• Lead commissioning, startup, testing, and validation activities for new and modified control systems.

• Collaborate with operations, engineering, maintenance, cybersecurity, and external vendors to deliver reliable and secure automation solutions.

• Support process safety initiatives, risk assessments, and change management activities while maintaining technical documentation and procedures.

## WHAT SKILLS / QUALIFICATIONS YOU LL NEED TO DO THE JOB:

## Required Experience

• 15+ years of experience supporting Operational Technology (OT), industrial automation, or process control environments, including significant experience in heavy industrial operations.

• Strong expertise with industrial control technologies, including DCS, PLC, SCADA, HMI, Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and industrial networking platforms.

• Hands-on experience with OT infrastructure, cybersecurity practices, network architecture, and system lifecycle management.

• Proven experience troubleshooting, maintaining, and optimizing complex automation and control environments.

• Previous experience in refining, petrochemical, energy, utilities, manufacturing, or other process-intensive industries is highly desirable.

## Technical Expertise

• Honeywell Experion PKS, TPS/TDC, Safety Manager, and HMI Web.

• Rockwell Automation platforms, including Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk View.

• Industrial Ethernet, Cisco networking, firewalls, and OT cybersecurity solutions.

• Active Directory, Windows Server environments, VMware, and related OT infrastructure technologies.

• Asset monitoring and reliability systems such as Emerson AMS, Bently Nevada, CCC, and Prognost.

## Education & Certifications

• Degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Technology, Industrial Automation, Instrumentation & Controls, or a related field.

• Professional engineering designation, engineering technologist certification, or relevant industry certifications are considered assets.

• Certifications in Honeywell technologies, Cisco networking, OT/ICS cybersecurity, instrumentation, or electrical disciplines are highly regarded

Core Competencies & Skills
• Demonstrated ability to excel in a dynamic, operationally driven environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to effectively prioritize competing demands.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, supported by strong analytical capabilities and sound technical judgment.

• Adaptable and responsive, with the ability to quickly adjust priorities based on operational requirements and business needs.

• Self-motivated professional who can work independently while contributing effectively within cross-functional and collaborative teams.

• Proven problem-solving, troubleshooting, and critical-thinking abilities in complex technical environments.

• Strong hands-on technical expertise in industrial networking, network infrastructure, control systems hardware, panel design, installation, maintenance, and repair.

• Commitment to operational excellence, continuous improvement, and the delivery of reliable, secure, and high-performing automation solutions.

## WHY MARINER?

We believe in making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work! Not only are we passionate about nurturing a thriving technology sector here in Atlantic Canada, but we are also committed to solving technology challenges that will make an impact worldwide. Technology is everlasting, and we take pride in connecting world class talent to world class projects and business solutions.

If you are an IT Professional, Software Professional, or Management Consultant, that is passionate about career development, data, and problem solving, we want to hear from you! If this sounds like someone you know, share this with them so they do not miss the opportunity to experience Mariner!

To achieve this, we know we need to be all in on training and development of our team so we can continue to move the needle in the technology sector together. Of course, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to our team, but our competitive edge is the development and training that our team experiences every day.

Be part of our vibrant community that values diversity and embraces inclusion at every level. We are committed to fostering a culture where individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life feel empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. Our collaborative environment celebrates the richness of ideas and experiences, and we believe that by embracing diversity, we can achieve greater innovation and excellence together. Come and help us create a workplace that reflects the beautiful tapestry of our global community.

## Join our growing team!

2229184.title: Project Manager
2229184.description:
## Project Manager
Saint John, New Brunswick
AM - GOL - 9707

Meridia Recruitment Solutions has partnered with Gulf Operators in search of a Project Manager to join their growing team in Saint John, New Brunswick.

Gulf Operators, a division of J.D. Irving (JDI), Limited, is a leading civil construction company with over 40 years of experience delivering complex infrastructure projects across the Maritimes. With expertise spanning renewable energy, road and rail construction, marine infrastructure, and industrial development, Gulf Operators is known for tackling challenging projects with a strong commitment to safety, environmental responsibility, and quality execution. Their success is built on a highly skilled workforce, a modern fleet of equipment, and a hands-on, solutions-driven approach to project delivery.

## Role Description:

Reporting to the Area Manager, the Project Manager will take full ownership of civil construction projects from initiation through completion. Gulf Operators operates with a lean and collaborative structure, and this is a hands-on role where you will lead project execution, manage budgets and schedules, and work closely with internal teams, subcontractors, and clients to ensure successful delivery. Projects typically include mass excavation and backfill, underground services, road and rail construction, and other technically demanding civil work.

This role offers the opportunity to take full responsibility for meaningful, large-scale civil construction projects that will shape communities and infrastructure in the Atlantic Region. By joining JDI, you will open the door to a wealth of leadership pathways and opportunities for advancement across various divisions of the company.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Develop and manage detailed construction schedules, ensuring projects are executed safely and efficiently from start to finish.

• Prepare and monitor project budgets, perform ongoing cost analysis and forecasting, and ensure financial targets are achieved.

• Lead contract administration efforts, managing relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, and stakeholders.

• Coordinate and participate in client meetings, addressing design changes, resolving issues, and maintaining alignment with project objectives.

• Oversee construction activities to ensure compliance with design specifications, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Identify and resolve construction challenges in real-time, minimizing impacts to schedule and budget.

• Generate and manage progress claims and invoicing in a timely and accurate manner.

• Collaborate closely with field teams, including Superintendents, Project Coordinators, and Field Engineers, to drive project success.

• Mentor and develop team members, contributing to a high-performing and growth-oriented work environment.

• Utilize software tools, such as Microsoft Project, to support planning, scheduling and reporting requirements.

Your Qualifications:
As the ideal candidate, you are a results-oriented construction professional who thrives in a hands-on environment and takes pride in owning project execution from start to finish. You bring strong leadership capabilities, sound technical knowledge, and the ability to adapt to the challenges of complex civil construction work.

Your qualifications should include:

• 3-5+ years of experience managing or supporting large-scale civil construction projects.

• Educational background in Civil Engineering or Civil Engineering Technology is preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.

• Strong understanding of civil construction practices, particularly in areas such as excavation, underground services, road building, and site development.

• Demonstrated experience with project budgeting, cost tracking, and forecasting.

• Proficiency with scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project (Primavera experience is considered an asset).

• Experience working in a hands-on project environment with direct accountability for outcomes.

• Strong leadership and team development abilities, with a willingness to mentor junior staff.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex and unpredictable site conditions.

• Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with clients, subcontractors, and internal teams.

• Professional certifications such as PMP or P.Tech are considered assets.

• Full professional proficiency in English is required.

To express interest in this opportunity please apply online by clicking "Apply Now" below.

For more information, please contact Austin McLennan, Partner, at 902-424-1103 and amclennan@kbrs.ca, or Abdul Dalloul, Recruitment Specialist at 902-334-7488 and adalloul@kbrs.ca, or please apply online by clicking the "Apply Now" button below. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let Austin or Abdul know.

Meridia Recruitment Solutions connects leading organizations with top talent by building strong relationships and creating ideal matches with candidates because we are only successful when you are. We appreciate your interest in this opportunity.

To learn more about Meridia Recruitment Solutions, our job opportunities, and career advice, we invite you to explore our site and subscribe for career alerts.

## Join the Ability NB team!

Manager, Peer Mentorship program
(full-time, possibility of remote work)

• Are you a "people person" who gets satisfaction from supporting others' success through problem solving?

• Are you looking for a job that allows you to apply creative approaches to empower someone to become more independent?

• Are you interested in a role that allows you to work with an award-winning organization who offers a gold star compensation package?

If you answered yes to any of the above questions, then please keep reading!

Ability NB offers our staff a gold standard health and dental package, 3 weeks paid vacation, time off over the December holiday season, and a matching RRSP contribution plan for up to 3% of your salary.

Ability NB is seeking a passionate, highly motivated and results-oriented Manager for our Peer Mentorship program. The successful candidate is a knowledge leader in peer mentorship programs for persons with a mobility disability and effective program design, delivery and evaluation. The program aims to increase access to early intervention mental health services by helping people with a mobility disability and their families adjust, adapt and thrive as they deal with a new injury or with the ongoing challenges of living and aging with a mobility disability. The Manager provides oversight to the program by leading the development and implementation of 1) a formal, provincial, bilingual peer mentorship program; 2) a formal curriculum and peer mentorship training program; and 3) a social media hub for peer mentorship connections.

## The successful applicant must demonstrate the following qualifications:

• Minimum of a post-secondary degree or diploma in a social service related field.

• Minimum of one year of experience in employee management, leadership and coaching

• Highly motivated, results-driven, innovative and resourceful

• Minimum of one-year experience in program development

• Excellent planning, organizational, time-management, communication, facilitation, relationship-building, numeracy and writing skills

• Proven ability to network and work collaboratively with employees, volunteers, diverse stakeholders and populations

• Knowledge of peer mentorship program practices

• High level of proficiency with computers and in Microsoft Office

• Knowledge of privacy legislation and demonstrated ability to maintain a high degree of confidentiality

• Previous experience in peer mentorship programs will be considered an asset

• Persons with a mobility disability are strongly encouraged to apply.

• Bilingual ability in English and French is an asset.

Salary: $55,000 to $65,000 + benefit package. Valid driver's license, travel throughout the province and use of own vehicle is required. 2239573.description:
CUSTOMER CARE REPRESENTATIVE

About Uresta:

Uresta is a rapidly growing women's health brand focused on pelvic health. Our mission at Uresta is to provide life-changing products for women that displace outdated solutions for common female taboos. Our flagship product, the Uresta Bladder Support, is an innovative solution for stress urinary incontinence (described as bladder leaks when coughing, sneezing, jumping, etc.), a condition that impacts 1 in 3 women. We are proud to be a Canadian, female-owned and led business. To learn more about Uresta, visit our website www.uresta.com.

Job Details:

Type: Full-time
Hours: MON 9am - 5pm ET / TUE 9am - 5pm ET / WED 9am - 5pm ET / THU Off / FRI Off / SAT 9am - 5pm ET / SUN 9am - 5pm ET
Location: Remote
Language: English + Conversational French
Compensation: To be discussed
Benefits: Health, Dental, Life Insurance, AD&D and Critical Illness
Target start: October 19, 2026

Job Description:

The Customer Care Representative ("CCR") will be responsible for assisting both prospective and current customers with general questions and inquiries about the Company's products. The CCR will be responsible for managing communications from multiple channels, including 1) email, 2) telephone and 3) social media. The CCR will have access to an extensive database of frequently asked questions and approved responses to address inquiries. In instances where approved responses are not available, the CCR will receive support from the Company's COO to prepare appropriate responses.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

• Answering questions: Responding to frequently asked questions from current and prospective customers leveraging approved responses.

• Troubleshooting: Assisting customers with issues they may be experiencing.

• Handling complaints: Resolving customer complaints with professionalism and empathy.

• Gathering feedback: Recording complaints and feedback to help improve products and service.

• Assisting with orders: Helping customers with order processing, shipment tracking, additional size requests, and refunds.

• Data tracking: Log relevant data in specified spreadsheets for business analytics purposes.

Required Skills:

• Communication: Strong communication skills and the ability to use positive language

• Empathy: Being able to show empathy for customer concerns

• Adaptability: Being able to adjust to and handle various personalities

• Product knowledge: Developing in-depth product knowledge

• Time management: Having the ability to manage various tasks throughout the day

• Independence: Ability to work independently and problem solve as needed

• Organization: Being well organized to keep track of multiple tasks

Qualifications:

• Work Experience:
• >5 years work experience

• Previous experience in customer support / sales roles
• Preference for some level of experience with social media

Business Tools:

• Proficiency with basic Microsoft products (e.g. Outlook, Word, Excel)

• Experience with social media preferred

Education:

• High school diploma required

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

2239375.description:
We're looking for a Hydrogeologist to join our growing team in Fredericton, NB. This role is also open to our other New Brunswick offices in Moncton, Saint John, Bathurst or Grand Falls.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're a perfect sized employee-owned, 400-person multi-disciplinary consulting firm that is large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

A typical day on the job might look like:

• Provide technical support to a wide variety of physical hydrogeology projects and prepare proposals and reports.

• Design field investigations such as drilling, coring and test pitting logging; soil and bedrock description and characterization; monitoring well and groundwater/surface water instrumentation installation; single- and multi-well pumping tests; soil, groundwater, sediment and surface water sampling; infiltration rate testing; and private well monitoring.

• Prepare technical proposals and reports, including hydrogeological characterization assessments; impact assessments, groundwater supply and source water protection studies and approvals; quarry, mine pit and construction dewatering assessments and permitting; water balance assessments; and groundwater and surface water interaction and monitoring programs.

• Develop and maintain relationships with clients.

The good stuff you get:

• Fair pay plus extra: competitive salary with year-end profit-sharing bonus.

• Complete health & dental coverage including vision, paramedical services, and Teladoc.

• Retirement planning made easier with a 5% employer match on your contributions.

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days) plus Employee & Family Assistance Program when you need it.

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year).

Your background and what you bring:

• Bachelor's degree in earth science, environmental science or geological/geotechnical/civil engineering with an emphasis in water resources or hydrogeology.

• Professional license in NB (i.e. P.Geo. or P.Eng.)

• 5 to 10 years of relevant professional related experience (preferably in consulting).

• Knowledge and understanding of provincial and federal regulatory frameworks for groundwater withdrawal/use, drinking water supply, contaminated sites assessment and management, and environmental assessment is required.

• Familiarity with infrastructure, pit and quarry dewatering as well as exploration and development of community water supplies is required, with specific experience in the mining industry considered an asset.

• Groundwater flow and transport modeling experience is considered an asset.

• Valid NB driver's license.

Interested individuals, click here to apply: https://gemtec.bamboohr.com/careers/352

New Brunswick offers a safe and welcoming community with a relaxed lifestyle and a true work-life balance, enriched by its diverse Indigenous, Anglophone, and Francophone heritage.

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban recruitment incentive of $50,000.00 with a 2-year return of service.

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

Responsibilities include inpatient and outpatient care, non-invasive diagnostics, and equal participation in echocardiography, ECG/Holter reporting, stress testing, CICU coverage, and on-call rotation. Outpatient volume beyond follow-up care is flexible. Leadership and professional development opportunities may be available. All cardiologists are part of the Division of Clinical Cardiology within the Departments of Cardiac Sciences and Medicine.

• Provide comprehensive inpatient and outpatient diagnostic services (e.g., echocardiography, ECG, Holter monitoring, stress tests, and other imaging modalities as qualified).

• Participate in CICU rotations, daily inpatient rounds on the cardiac stepdown unit, and provide inpatient consultations and care.

• Offer outpatient consultations and follow-up after inpatient/emergency care, as well as elective specialty consultations for the regional medical community (volume/scope customizable).

• Ensure coverage of your outpatient practice during absences; report all absences (planned/unforeseen) in writing to the Division Head.

• Participate in the cardiology on-call schedule, including weekdays, evenings, weekends, and holidays.

• Negotiate service gaps in advance to maintain coverage.

• Practice in alignment with Horizon Health's mission and values, in collaboration with interdisciplinary teams.

• Engage in teaching, quality improvement initiatives, and research supporting Horizon's clinical mandate.

(Note: These responsibilities are the basic and prime duties associated with this position; other related and allied duties may be assigned from time to time as may be necessary to the operation of Horizon Health Network.)

## Who you are

• Medical degree and Royal College certification in Cardiology.

• Licensed to practice in New Brunswick; in good standing with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of NB and the NB Medical Society.

• CMPA malpractice coverage appropriate to scope of practice.

• Proficient in inpatient and outpatient cardiology, including:
• Clinical cardiology consultation and longitudinal care

• CICU procedures (arterial/venous access, Swan-Ganz, IABP, temporary pacing, hemodynamic therapies)

• ECG, Holter, ABPM interpretation; comprehensive echocardiography (TTE, TEE, stress, 3D, contrast/bubble, strain)

• Strong communication, teamwork, and interpersonal skills.

• Excellent attendance record and physical ability to perform duties.

• Proficiency in medical-level spoken and written English.

Preferred Assets:

• Experience with pacemaker/device interrogation and programming.

• Bilingualism (English/French) is a strong asset.

• Leadership experience in planning, strategy, and quality improvement.

• Experience in teaching and skill development for clinical teams.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Provide pre?hospital clinical care prior to the arrival of a transporting ambulance when required. This work involves assessment, triage and managing patient care independently and collaboratively with ambulance crews when required.

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics, Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Paramedics are also expected to maintain and operate ambulances or clinical support unit (CSU) and related equipment in accordance with patient needs and public safety. Assesses, triages, and manages patient care until the arrival of an ambulance. Assist and collaborate with ambulance personnel with the provision of medical treatment, when necessary.

Labour Relations Lawyer - Association of University of New Brunswick Teachers (AUNBT)

The Association of University of New Brunswick Teachers (AUNBT) invites applications for the position of Labour Relations Lawyer.

AUNBT (a union under the NB Industrial Relations Act) represents approximately 600 full-time and 350 contract academic staff located primarily on UNB's Fredericton and Saint John campuses.

## Key Responsibilities

Subject to the direction of the President and Executive Committee, the Professional OfficerLabour Relations Lawyer will perform the following representative duties:

• Provide substantial professional support to the Grievance Committee in all aspects of the grievance process, including case management, grievance hearings and arbitrations, and research.

• Assist the President and various AUNBT committees.

• Support negotiation teams in the collective bargaining process.

• Be involved in communicating with and offering support services to AUNBT members.

• Promote good working relations with various levels of UNB's administration and with other UNB employee groups. The successful candidate may have a role in relations with other local, provincial and national associations with similar interests.

• Undertake other strategic, legal, or policy initiatives as requested to support the objectives of AUNBT and its membership.

## Qualifications

Applicants will have a law degree and preferably postgraduate training in a labour-related area. The successful candidate will have experience working in academic and/or unionized environments. Experience with interpreting collective agreements, the grievance and arbitration processes, and facility with legal/contract drafting is essential. The successful candidate must possess strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills. They must be flexible and able to work collegially. They will work from UNB's Fredericton campus and must be able to travel to the Saint John (and, occasionally, Moncton) campus as needed.

AUNBT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to principles of equity and diversity in the workplace. The applications of Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority.

## Salary Range

$105,540 - $167,243 (Effective July 1, 2026). Compensation is governed by AUNBT's established salary grid, with starting placement on the grid calculated strictly by years of directly relevant experience (0 to 27 years).

## Deadline

Review of applications will continue until the position is filled. Please submit a letter of application and a detailed résumé to Adam Wilson, President, AUNBT at aunbt@aunbt.ca.

Are you an experienced Bridge Engineer looking to progress your career? We're looking for an Intermediate or Senior Bridge Engineer to join our growing team. We are open to filling this position in any of our locations across the Atlantic provinces.

Reporting to the Structural Bridge Lead, you will play a key role in the technical delivery and management of bridge projects—from conceptual design and analysis to construction review and inspection. The successful candidate will have the opportunity of designing various structural systems out of steel, concrete, and timber, including the design of prestressed concrete, GFRP reinforced concrete, composite steel/concrete sections, and composite precast/cast-in-place sections.

You will have excellent opportunities to grow and develop your engineering skills with the company, as well as mentor Engineers-in-Training and junior Engineers.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm—not too big, not too small. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

You're an ideal candidate if you have:

• Initiative to lead projects and drive tasks to completion.

• A collaborative mindset and enjoy working across multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality work.

• A commitment to mentoring others.

• A proactive approach to client communication and problem solving.

A typical day on the job might look like:

• Lead or support the design and analysis of bridge structures in steel, concrete, and timber, including prestressed and composite systems.

• Prepare and review contract documents, technical reports, and construction estimates.

• Conduct and oversee bridge condition assessments, inspections, and load ratings (including above and below water).

• Provide construction support services, including review of shop drawings, responses to RFIs, and on-site problem resolution.

• Coordinate and collaborate with multi-disciplinary project teams to ensure successful project delivery.

• Manage project schedules, budgets, and deliverables, ensuring compliance with client expectations and quality standards.

• Assist in business development activities, including preparation of proposals and participation in client meetings.

• Mentor and support junior and intermediate engineers, fostering technical growth within the team.

• Adhering to all company policies.

The good stuff you get:

• Retirement planning made easier with a 5% employer match on your contributions

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days) plus Employee & Family Assistance Program when you need it

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year)

Your background and what you bring:

• Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited University.

• Registered, or eligible for registration, as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with the Association of Professional Engineers & Geoscientists of New Brunswick (APEGNB).

• 8+ years of progressive experience in bridge structural design, inspection, and construction support. Any other heavy civil experience such as with marine or dam structures will be viewed as an additional asset.

• Demonstrated experience with prestressed concrete, steel and composite structures, and timber systems.

• Working knowledge of relevant design codes and standards (CHBDC, CSA).

• Proficiency with structural analysis and design software such as SAFI, StructurePoint, WoodWorks, Microsoft Office is an asset.
