Job Title: Long Haul Driver

Job Type: Full time

Location: Moncton, NB

Shifts: Monday to Friday, start time at 8am, weekends as needed

Wage: $27.00/hour

## Job Overview

The role requires compliance with Canadian and U.S. Hours of Service (HOS) regulations, border crossing procedures, customs documentation, and all federal and provincial/state transportation laws. Drivers must maintain a professional attitude when interacting with customers, border officials, and regulatory agencies, while prioritizing safety, cargo security, and on-time delivery.

## Key Responsibilities

• Safely operate a Class 1 commercial vehicle to transport medical waste across international (Canada-U.S.) routes, primarily to Curtis Bay- South Baltimore, Maryland.

• Complete 2-3 trips per week, including overnight stays in the tractor sleeper cab.

• Perform thorough pre-trip and post-trip inspections to identify mechanical or safety issues and report defects to the Transportation Supervisor.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date electronic driver logbooks (HOS) using a mobile application.

• Verify all materials are properly packaged and match the packaging slip prior to departure.

• Accurately complete and maintain manifests and shipping documentation, ensuring compliance with applicable Transportation of Dangerous Goods (TDG) regulations.

• Ensure proper handling and securement of regulated medical waste in accordance with company and regulatory standards.

• Communicate effectively with dispatch and supervisors regarding trip status, delays, or issues.

• Adhere to all environmental, health, and safety policies and procedures.

• Report any incidents, defects, or safety concerns promptly.

## Qualifications

• Valid Class 1 (AZ) Driver's License.

• Valid Transportation of Dangerous Goods (TDG) Training Certificate.

• Valid FAST Card.

• Minimum 2+ years of commercial driving experience.

• Clean driver's abstract and strong safety record.

• Experience with cross-border transportation (preferred).

• Knowledge of TDG regulations and hazardous materials handling (asset).

• Ability to complete electronic logs and documentation accurately.

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

## Working Conditions

• Frequent long-haul travel between Canada and the United States.

• Overnight stays required in sleeper cab.

WorkSafeNB is seeking to fill a 2-year term contract position of Business System Owner - Finance.

Reporting to the Director, Accounting Operations and Benefit Payments, the Business System Owner (BSO) is the single point of business accountability for the value, performance, and long?term effectiveness of Finance-related business systems, which includes Finance, Procurement, and Payroll systems. The BSO ensures that systems continue to support organizational strategy, operational needs, policy and regulatory requirements, and desired business outcomes throughout their lifecycle.

The BSO represents the voice and authority of the business and makes decisions about priorities, trade?offs, risks, and value while partnering closely with IT Product Owners, Solution Delivery teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to enable effective delivery and ongoing operations.

The BSO provides strategic and operational leadership for Finance-related system capabilities within the organization. They ensure system functionality is aligned with business processes, organizational priorities, compliance requirements, and user needs, while supporting system integrity, operational effectiveness, and a consistent user experience.

The BSO serves as the primary business owner for Finance-related systems and partners closely with IT Product Owners, Solution Delivery teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to support system optimization, enhancements, release planning, and ongoing operations. They ensure business processes and requirements are effectively translated into system functionality that enables efficient, sustainable, and people-centered outcomes.

## Salary and Hours of Work:

Hours of work are those required to perform the assigned tasks but shall not be less than 35 hours per week.

## Pay Scale: $92,248.80 to $108,528.00 annually.

## Responsibilities

• Business Ownership, System Vision and Outcomes - Own and maintain the business system vision, success measures, and value realization for Finance-related systems, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and priorities.
• Business Demand, Prioritization and Decision-Making - Prioritize business demand and make decisions regarding scope, timing, and trade-offs to ensure optimal value and alignment.
• Stakeholder Alignment, Vendor Accountability and System Performance - Ensure alignment across stakeholders, hold vendors accountable for delivering against business needs, and monitor system performance to drive continuous improvement and sustained business value.
• Adoption, Change and Business Readiness - Ensure the organization is equipped to effectively use the system and realize intended value.
• Business Requirements, Policy and Risk Management - Ensure business needs, policies, and regulatory requirements are clearly defined and reflected in system design and delivery.

## Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Public Administration, or Information Systems. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered, such as a 2-year diploma in a relevant field plus an additional 2 years of relevant experience.
• 5 to 7 years of combined experience in Finance-related business operations and enterprise systems (e.g., ERP and other core operational systems), with accountability for business outcomes, prioritization, decision-making, business requirements definition, outcome validation, and successful system adoption.
• Demonstrated understanding of full-cycle accounting principles, including general knowledge of procurement and payroll processes, and a solid understanding of core finance functions (e.g., General Ledger, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Payroll, and Procurement) and how they translate into system configuration and business processes.
• Demonstrated critical thinking skills, with the ability to analyze complex situations, assess competing priorities, evaluate risks, and make sound, well-reasoned decisions.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align diverse stakeholders, and facilitate decision-making on priorities, trade-offs, and outcomes.
• Solid understanding of how technology enables business processes and outcomes, with the ability to partner effectively with IT teams and vendors.
• Experience supporting organizational change, adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives is an asset.

The Family Practice Nurse Practitioner will work in close collaboration with physicians and other interdisciplinary health professionals in a community-based collaborative care clinic. As a vital member of the team, the Nurse Practitioner is responsible for delivering high-quality comprehensive primary care to patients with a focus on the assessment and management across the full spectrum of primary care presentations in all populations, as well as health education, disease prevention, and chronic disease management.

## About Us

The clinic is a new collaborative care practice established to provide primary care to the community. The clinic will work collaboratively with health authorities and community partners to enhance local patient care and improve professional satisfaction for all health care team members. At the clinic, we will strive to create a welcoming space for staff and patients. We will maintain a culture of improvement, with all team members contributing to better health care systems. We believe primary care should be accessible to all New Brunswickers and will work hard to provide continuity and access to our patients.

## Why work with us?

• Competitive salary.

• Career development - opportunities for operating at top of scope of practice, continuous education/advancement encouraged.

• Comprehensive benefits package available. Additional pay in lieu of benefits negotiable.

• Cross-coverage of your practice while you are absent.

• Heavily clinical- and patient-focused role as part of an innovative team!

## Key Responsibilities

• Manage a family practice roster of 500 patients independently in year 1 o Expectation to increase roster to 800 patients total during year 2

• Cross-coverage of parallel practices while other providers are absent.

• Focused engagement in quality improvement initiatives and performance tracking that aim to improve delivery of care.

• In collaboration with other providers:
• Create and maintain up-to-date patient charts.

• Review incoming investigations.

• Primary care acute/urgent issues assessment and management.

• Chronic disease management and surveillance.

• Opportunities for engagement on patient panels of interest, including (but not limited to) acute care, sexual health, mental health, perinatal health, pediatric medicine, etc.

The NP position requires availability to work in the clinic during regular working hours from Monday to Friday. Cross-coverage expectations, after-hours clinics, virtual care/work from home clinics, and/or occasional meeting attendance outside of office hours are negotiable.

• Minimum of 3-5 years' experience providing patient care to patients of all ages in a comprehensive Family Practice or relevant Ambulatory care setting.

• Medical expert with in-depth knowledge of patient care.

• Exemplary interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

• Demonstrated organizational, leadership, and collaborative teamwork skills.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and efficiently, while maintaining accuracy, critical thinking, and proper judgement.

• Adherence to professional ethical principles.

• Previous experience with an electronic medical record (EMR) program is an asset.

• Knowledge of the NB primary health care system is an asset.

• Bilingualism is an asset.

2228966.title: Business Architect
2228966.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

Cooke is strengthening enterprise decision-making through disciplined Business Architecture, strong governance, and clear alignment between business structure, strategy, and technology enablement. Business Architecture provides a shared understanding of what the business does, how it delivers value, and what must change to support strategic priorities.

As a Business Architect, you own and apply Business Architecture practices that enable clear, consistent, and informed decisions across strategic decision-making, investment planning, and delivery execution.

## The Role

As a Business Architect, you are responsible for owning and evolving the enterprise Business Architecture, aligned to industry standards such as BIZBOK and/or TOGAF Business Architecture. You act as the steward of the Business Capability Model and related architectural views, ensuring they are clear, consistent, and actively used. You partner closely with Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Portfolio, and Delivery teams to provide capability-based insights that inform planning, prioritization, and change decisions. You provide the architectural foundation that enables consistent planning and execution of change through a shared, enterprise-level understanding of business capabilities, value streams, and impacts.

## Key Responsibilities

• Own and maintain the enterprise Business Capability Model as the authoritative, governed view of the business

• Define and maintain business value streams, outcomes, and capability relationships to describe how value is delivered

• Apply and uphold Business Architecture standards and practices aligned to BIZBOK and/or TOGAF Business Architecture

• Provide business capability insights and impact analysis used to support enterprise investment and governance decisions

• Define capability target states, evolution, and transition views, identifying dependencies, sequencing logic, and organizational readiness

• Conduct capability maturity and gap assessments to identify improvement opportunities, structural risks, and cross-domain dependencies

• Identify business capability redundancies and fragmentation, providing business-driven insight to inform application and technology consolidation and optimization decisions

• Facilitate cross-functional workshops focused on capability impact, structural alignment, and transformation feasibility

• Support architecture and portfolio governance by ensuring initiatives demonstrate alignment with agreed business capabilities and target states

• Collaborate with Enterprise, solution, and technology architects to ensure ongoing alignment between business architecture and technology design

• Coach and guide team members in Business Architecture concepts, standards, and best practices

## What Success Looks Like

2241025.title: Miramichi Registered Nurse Class D (RNCD) - Nurse Practitioner PCN 1757481
2241025.description:
## JOB PURPOSE

The Nurse Practitioner (NP) provides primary health care services, illness/injury prevention, chronic disease management and community development services, using a population health approach in an interdisciplinary team of providers. In keeping with the Horizon Health Network strategic plan, the provincial CHC framework, and the Community Health Program standards, the service model is based on the principles of primary health care with a primary goal of supporting communities in meeting their health care needs. The NP is a registered nurse with advanced educational preparation in nursing. As a member of the interdisciplinary team, the NP provides direct care to scheduled and unscheduled patients across the lifespan with a variety of health conditions. The NP evaluates patient outcomes, provides consultation to, and consults with other team members. The NP also utilizes research, leadership and educator knowledge and skills to support/provide health promotion, illness and injury prevention, and community development initiatives.

## QUALIFICATIONS

• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing, Master's degree in Nursing preferred.

• Registration with the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB) as a Nurse Practitioner.

• Current BCLS.

• Comprehensive knowledge in caring for clients across the health continuum and throughout the client's lifespan.

• Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

• Demonstrated organizational and leadership skills.

• Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with other members of a team toward common goals.

• Demonstrated ability to function independently in the role with recognized decision-making and problem-solving skills.

• Demonstrated ability to critically analyze theory and research literature and apply to practice.

• Good work and attendance record.

• Physically able to perform assigned duties.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

## Health Assessment and Diagnosis:

• Completes a comprehensive health assessment including, but not limited to, physical, psychological, cultural, spiritual and social needs of the patient/client.

• Orders, obtains, performs and interprets diagnostic and laboratory screening tests in accordance to schedules "A" and "B" of the NANB Rules Respecting Nurse Practitioners.

• Establishes a diagnosis.

• Initiates appropriate treatment plan in cooperation with the patient/client and other team members as indicated.

## Health Management of Acute and Chronic Conditions:

• Demonstrates knowledge of current best-practice guidelines for the delivery of care

• Prescribes, adjusts and renews medications in accordance to Schedule "C" of the NANB rules respecting Nurse Practitioners.

• Monitors, evaluates and alters therapies and/or treatments when appropriate.

• Initiates timely referral or collaboration with other team members, as indicated.

## Health Promotion and Disease Prevention:

• Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of health promotion services and facilitates primary, secondary and tertiary prevention strategies for all patients/clients

• Incorporates risk reduction and disease and injury prevention strategies for all patients/clients

• As part of the interdisciplinary team, participates in the development and implementation of community/population health interventions

## Professional Role and Responsibilities:

• Maintains the competencies as outlined in the Competency and Standards of Practice for Nurse Practitioners in Primary Health Care.

• Actively participates as a team member to provide comprehensive care to all patients/clients.

• Exemplifies and promotes excellence in advance practice nursing care.

• Utilizes nursing and other research to support clinical knowledge and evidence-based practice

• Assumes responsibility for self-directed professional development

• Establishes a network of referral sources to accommodate the provision of care to patients/clients. Referral sources are internal and external to the organization.

• Functions as a resource person, preceptor and mentor to Nurse Practitioner students, peers and other health professional

• Participates in the development of the Nurse Practitioner advanced practice.

• Participates in the professional education activities at the clinic.

NOTE: The above are basic and prime responsibilities; related and allied duties may be assigned from time to time as may become necessary to the operation of the Health Authority.

## COMPETENCIES

• Professional Responsibility and Accountability

• Health Assessment and Diagnosis

• Therapeutic Management

• Health Promotion and Prevention of Illness and Injury

• Patient/Client Focus

If a candidate's primary language of communication is not English, an English Language Proficiency Evaluation is required for all postings (Reading, Writing and Oral).

## Interested? Apply Today!

Horizon Health Network (Horizon) only accepts on-line applications.

## About Horizon's Recruitment Process

We thank all applicant who apply; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted. All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Horizon's recruitment screening process may include language proficiency testing, clerical testing and/or behavioral assessment. If you are selected for testing, you will be contacted via the email address provided on your application. The official results will be shared with the candidate, Human Resources and the requesting manager electronically and language results will be placed on the personnel file for Horizon's hiring purposes.

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

2240149.title: Chief Information Security Officer
2240149.description:
The Financial and Consumer Services Commission (Commission) is a leader in integrated financial and consumer services regulation. The Commission's mandate is to protect consumers and enhance public confidence in the financial and consumer marketplace through the provision of regulatory and educational services. With offices in both Fredericton and Saint John, it is responsible for the administration and enforcement of provincial legislation regulating mortgage brokers, payday lenders, real estate, securities, insurance, pensions, credit unions, trust and loan companies, cooperatives, unclaimed property, and a wide range of consumer legislation. The Commission is a self-funded Crown corporation responsible for the administration and enforcement of financial consumer services legislation.

We offer opportunities for dedicated professionals to play a vital role in carrying out our mandate.

Chief Information Security Officer - Information Technology and Strategic Performance Division (Saint John or Fredericton office)

The Commission is seeking an experienced cybersecurity and technology leader to serve as its Chief Information Security Officer (CISO).

Reporting to the Director of Information Technology Services, the CISO is responsible for leading the Commission's cybersecurity program and strengthening its overall cybersecurity posture. The position provides strategic leadership for cybersecurity governance, risk management, incident response and security operations, along with operational leadership for the Commission's technology infrastructure and supporting services. The CISO leads cybersecurity and infrastructure teams and provides strategic advice to leadership on cybersecurity and technology risks.

## Your Focus:

• Lead the development and execution of the Commission's cybersecurity strategy, governance framework and risk management program.

• Assess and communicate cybersecurity and technology risks and provide strategic advice, recommendations and cybersecurity posture updates to leadership.

• Lead cybersecurity operations, including monitoring, threat and vulnerability management, incident response, recovery preparedness, disaster recovery and security awareness.

• Provide leadership during significant cybersecurity incidents, including response coordination, recovery prioritization and post-incident review.

• Establish and oversee security assurance and review activities for technologies, applications, vendors and service providers, including cybersecurity audits, assessments and remediation activities.

• Oversee security governance for identity, authentication, authorization and privileged access management.

• Provide operational leadership for Microsoft 365, Azure cloud services, network infrastructure, endpoint management and core technology services.

• Manage and develop cybersecurity and infrastructure staff while overseeing technology vendors, contracts, procurement activities and operational budget.

## What You Bring

• A university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• A minimum of eight (8) years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, infrastructure operations and cloud technologies.

• A minimum of five (5) years of people management experience, including staff supervision, coaching, performance management, and professional development.

• Demonstrated experience in cybersecurity governance, risk management, security operations, compliance programs, and technology infrastructure.

• Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001 and Zero Trust principles.

• Demonstrated experience leading secure cloud, infrastructure, endpoint, network and identity services in a complex technology environment.

• Experience managing technology vendors, contracts, procurement activities, and service providers.

• Experience developing and maintaining technology policies, standards, and operational procedures.

• Demonstrated ability to influence organizational decision-making, build consensus, and lead initiatives across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Strong analytical, leadership and relationship-building skills, with the ability to communicate complex cybersecurity and technology risks clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.

## Additional Strengths

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent certifications would be considered an asset.

The Financial and Consumer Services Commission offers a competitive salary and benefits package as well as excellent opportunities for personal growth and challenge. Salary will be commensurate with experience. If you are interested in being a key part of this team, please forward your resume and cover letter.

Salary Range: $91,850 - $126,294 (annual compensation)

As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to undergo a pre-employment background check in accordance with the Commission's Pre-Employment Background Checks Directive. This may include criminal record checks, credential verification, and reference checks.

For more information about this position, please visit our website at www.fcnb.ca or call the Talent Acquisition Specialist at (506) 643-7790.

Please note that only candidates selected for further evaluation will be contacted.

Join our team - Primary Health Care Nurse Practitioner
Miramichi, NB

Dr. Paula Keating and Dr. Evan Slaney's patient centered family practice is seeking two (2) Nurse Practitioners to join their growing team!

We are an innovative primary care clinic committed to delivering continuous, high-quality care to patients in our community. We pride ourselves on fostering a professional and welcoming environment where team members work together to achieve clinical excellence and improve patient outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity for Nurse Practitioners who are passionate about primary care and who value collaboration, innovation, and meaningful patient relationships.

## The opportunity

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide high-quality, patient-centered care to an assigned panel of patients while also supporting same-day access appointments. You will play a key role in delivering accessible, coordinated care within a collaborative clinical environment.

At our clinic, you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced physicians and a dedicated healthcare team while making a significant impact on the health and well-being of individuals and families.

Our clinic is committed to supporting professional growth and is open to tailoring a portion of the Nurse Practitioner's practice to align with their clinical interests, expertise, and professional goals. If you are a motivated healthcare professional who is passionate about providing exceptional care and making a meaningful impact in patients' lives, we would love to hear from you!

## Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct comprehensive health assessments, establish diagnoses, and develop appropriate treatment plans, including prescribing medications and recommending follow-up care for chronic diseases and mental health, as required.

• Support shared participation in urgent care services.

• Participate in screening and vaccination programs.

• Educate, counsel, and empower patients regarding preventive healthcare, health initiatives, and disease management strategies.

• Order, interpret, and communicate diagnostic tests and laboratory results.

• Maintain accurate and confidential patient records, encounter documentation, and clinical data using EMR software in accordance with regulatory and privacy standards.

• Respond to patient inquiries in a professional, respectful, and timely manner.

• Review, process, and manage incoming electronic communications, including faxes and test results.

• Collaborate effectively with other healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated, patient-centered care.

• Remain current with clinical best practices, emerging medical research, and regulatory requirements to maintain high standards of care.

• Perform other related clinical, administrative, and special projects as required to support clinic operations.

## Experience/Education:

Applicants must meet the following qualifications:

• Successfully completed a bachelor's degree in nursing.

• Hold a master's degree in practical nursing.

• Successfully completed the Canadian Nurse Practitioner Examination (CNPE).

• Be currently registered and in good standing with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick (NANB).

## Qualifications:

• Advanced clinical knowledge with strong critical thinking skills.

• A high level of professionalism, including strict adherence to confidentiality and patient advocacy standards.

• Self-motivation with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• Proficiency with computers, including internet use, electronic medical record (EMR) systems, and other relevant software applications.

• A commitment to fostering a culture of problem-solving, collaboration, and excellence.

• Strong documentation skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

• Compassion, patience, and a patient-centered approach to care.

• The ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced clinical environment.

• Fluency in both English and French is considered an asset , but not a requirement.

## Working Conditions & Location:

• The Nurse Practitioner's weekly hours are flexible, with the option of part-time or full-time hours based on the successful candidate's preference. The successful candidate will enjoy a high degree of autonomy in determining their schedule, with the addition of working remotely on certain days of the week.

• The clinic operates Monday through Friday and remains closed on weekends and statutory holidays.

• The clinic is located at 295 Pleasant St, Miramichi, NB

## Join our team!

Our clinic invites you to apply for this exciting opportunity to become part of a positive, team-oriented environment where you will benefit from:

• A professional, supportive, and inclusive workplace that promotes wellness and work-life balance.

• Orientation and clinical onboarding will be provided, including review of clinic workflows, EMR use, and collaborative practice processes to support a smooth onboarding.

• The opportunity to collaborate within a multidisciplinary team.

• Flexible vacation, no pre-determined schedule.

• Paid sick/personal days.

• Additional paid time off between Christmas and New Years.

• A flexible schedule with no evening, weekend, statutory holiday, or on-call responsibilities.

• Free on-site parking.

• Annual performance review with potential for yearly increase or bonus.

## Compensation:

Hourly rate within a range of $63.31- $71.24, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Final compensation will be discussed and confirmed with the successful candidate.

Start Date: To be determined in collaboration with the successful candidate.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

2238502.description:
Leisure Days RV Centre Moncton is hiring! Our team has active career opportunity for a full-time, experienced RV Technician.

We offer:

• A collegial work environment

• Competitive Compensation $30 - 33/hr., depending on experience + vacation pay

• Group Benefits, RRSP Plan with employer match

• Training in support of your role

## Overview:

As an RV Technician you will be performing pre-delivery inspections, accurately diagnosing, and repairing a variety of technical issues, inspecting, and adjusting, or overhaul recreational vehicles and travel trailers. RV Technicians know a little bit about everything such as electrical, plumbing, carpentry, flooring, etc.

You will be responsible for maintaining a clean work environment, participating in training, assisting co-workers, completing jobs with efficiency and other tasks as required.

Reports to: Service Manager

## Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

• Examine/troubleshoot and diagnose units needing repair and maintenance.

• Discuss repairs and communicate additional requests with the service manager.

• Provide plan work procedures and labor time estimates to the RV service manager.

• Install/repair and maintain interior and exterior components on motorhomes, travel trailers, and fifth wheel trailers such as roof, siding, windows, doors, awnings, vents, floor cabinets, counters, plumbing systems, electrical systems, propane gas systems, batteries and charging systems, body, and structural components.

• Install accessories, perform pre-delivery inspections, troubleshoot, repair and conduct maintenance on propane gas and electric appliances - furnace, refrigerator, water heaters, and A/C units.

• Install hitches - including fifth wheel and wiring of tow vehicles.

• Use testing equipment / troubleshooting techniques / manufacturers specs and internet websites.

• Monitor repair time and update RV service advisor regularly.

• Maintain strict adherence to dealership policies on RV care and operation.

• Complete story and/or documentation for client repairs.

• Assist in mentoring mobile RV technician trainees (if required).

• Attend company and factory training and keep current with factory technical bulletins.

• Understand and follow federal, provincial, and local regulations (such as disposal of hazardous waste).

## Essential Skills:

• Good manual dexterity and balance while working off the ground.

• Work well with others in a fast-paced environment.

• Like working with your hands and enjoy learning new skills and knowledge.

• Pride in workmanship and desire to attain a superior level of service.

• Mechanical aptitude and ability to follow procedures.

• Motivated team player, energetic and enthusiastic.

• Ability to periodically lift more than 25 kilograms.

• Mechanical and electrical aptitude - problem solving capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and as a team member.

• Attention to detail, neat and orderly, general good health, and physical ability.

## Qualifications:

• Previous RV technician experience required (5 or more years preferred).

• ARVDA Propane Certificate required.

• Red Seal is an asset.

• Valid driver's license required.

• Forklift license an asset.

Leisure Days RV Group is Canada's largest RV dealership network, proudly operating over 25 dealerships across Ontario, Nova Scotia, and New Brunswick, with plans for sustainable growth. Our scale and superior purchasing power enable us to provide customers with unmatched access to RV sales, rentals, parts, and services. As a dynamic and innovative company, we emphasize performance, continuous improvement, and cultivating growth from within. We are committed to providing motivated professionals with opportunities for development and advancement as part of our exciting journey.

2240713.description:
Greater Moncton Wastewater Commission Job Description

Title: Finance Manager - Accounting & Special Projects

## Organizational Context

TransAqua provides reliable, cost-efficient, and environmentally responsible wastewater services for Dieppe, Moncton, and Riverview. The organization supports regional planning, regulatory compliance, and community quality of life through effective operations and sound financial management.

## Overall Purpose of the Role

Reporting to the Senior Finance Manager, the Finance Manager - Accounting & Special Projects is responsible for supporting and leading finance-related special projects, financial analysis, accounting activities, capital planning, budgeting, forecasting, and process improvement initiatives.

The Finance Manager - Accounting & Special Projects plays a critical role in ensuring financial systems operate efficiently and support accurate financial reporting and operational decision-making. The role also supports the finance team in month-end and annual close activities, ensuring deadlines are met and financial data is accurate and complete.

As a member of the management team, the Finance Manager - Accounting & Special Projects, as with all TransAqua positions, carries responsibility to actively promote and uphold the organization's safety program and culture, contributing to a respectful and positive work environment.

## Key Accountabilities

## Accounting and Financial Reporting

• Support month-end and annual close activities, including journal entries, reconciliations, supporting schedules, and account analysis.

• Assist with the preparation of financial statements, management reports, and variance analysis.

• Research and assist with the accounting treatment of complex, unusual, or non-routine transactions.

• Ensure financial information is accurate, complete, and recorded in accordance with applicable accounting standards and internal policies.

• Provide accounting support to the finance team and other departments as required.

## Capital and Asset Management

• Support the preparation and ongoing monitoring of the capital budget and long-term capital plan.

• Monitor capital project expenditures, commitments, and forecasts against approved budgets.

• Assist with the appropriate accounting and classification of capital expenditures.

• Support asset management initiatives, project close-outs, and financial reporting related to capital assets.

• Provide financial analysis to support capital investment decisions and project prioritization.

## Budgeting and Forecasting

• Assist with the preparation of annual operating and capital budgets.

• Prepare forecasts, financial projections, and supporting analysis throughout the year.

• Work with departments to understand budget assumptions, operational requirements, and financial impacts.

• Prepare scenario and sensitivity analyses to support long-term financial planning and analysis.

• Monitor actual results against budget and forecast and assist with identifying and explaining significant variances.

## Process Improvement and Systems

• Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, workflows, and internal controls.

• Participate in financial system implementations, upgrades, enhancements, testing, and related initiatives.

• Support automation and reporting improvements to increase efficiency and improve the quality of financial information.

• Develop and maintain procedures, workflows, user guides, and process documentation.

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across financial, operational, and administrative processes.

## Special Projects and Financial Analysis

• Lead and support finance-related special projects and organizational initiatives as assigned.

• Prepare financial models, business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and scenario or sensitivity analyses to support decision-making.

• Provide financial analysis and support for major capital, operational, and strategic initiatives.

• Coordinate financial aspects of cross-functional projects and work with internal and external stakeholders as required.

2234659.employer: GEMTEC Consulting Engineers and Scientists Limited
2234659.description:
We are seeking a full-time Senior Geotechnical Engineer in our Fredericton, New Brunswick office. The successful candidate will work with multidisciplinary teams on unique and challenging projects across Atlantic Canada. This role offers continued professional development in the technical and management fields.

About Us

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm—not too big, not too small. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

Key Responsibilities:

• Work on a myriad of projects spanning roads, bridges, mining, tunnelling and dams, etc.

• Work collaboratively with other GEMTEC offices, particularly for larger and multi-disciplinary assignments.

• Coordinate and manage geotechnical programs, including field investigations, geotechnical analysis and design, and report preparation for highways, roads, bridges, buildings, marine and municipal infrastructure, land development, geotechnical instrumentation, mines and dams.

• Complete geotechnical design for shallow and deep foundations, retaining structures, embankment dams, roadway embankments, railways, excavation support systems, tunnels, trenchless construction, staged embankment construction, and ground improvement methods.

• Perform project management functions, including proposal preparation, budget estimation, scheduling, scope management, project summary report preparation, maintaining quality throughout the project, and implementing improvements.

• Mentor junior staff.

• Adhere to health and safety protocols, promoting a safe working environment.

• Manage projects across Atlantic Provinces

• Manage contractors and subcontractors

• Other duties as required (communicate with clients, contractors and internal teams, implement quality control procedures, identify and manage risks).

The good stuff you get:

• Full time permanent salaried position

• Employee-owned company with future potential to become a shareholder

• Year-end profit-sharing bonus

• Health and dental benefits

• Matching RRSP program with employer contributions up to 5%

• Paid time off (vacation starting at 3 weeks per year and 2 weeks of sick time)

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and New Years)

• Work/life balance including a 37.5 hour work week and flexible working arrangements including hybrid options.

• Growth and development opportunities as we work on a large variety of projects so you can build your skills and experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Geotechnical Engineering (Civil or Geological Engineering programs may also be suitable) from a recognized university. A Master's or Doctorate degree is considered an asset.

• Minimum of 12 years of post-graduate experience in civil, geological, mining engineering, with a focus on geotechnical engineering.

• Demonstrate excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills in English, strong organizational abilities, and the capacity to manage and prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously, ensuring the delivery of quality work on time and within budget.

• Have experience in geotechnical design for roads, bridges, dams, buildings, tunneling, etc.

• Be proficient in geotechnical software applications such as Slope/W, Seep/W, Sigma/W, Settle3D, FLAC, PLAXIS or similar.

• Be a licensed Professional Engineer in Canada and be (or eligible to become) a Registered Professional Engineer with APEGNB.

• Be motivated to provide excellent client service and enjoy working in a multi-disciplinary team environment.

• Have experience with and the ability to make informed decisions regarding intrusive and non-intrusive field investigations, basic and advanced laboratory testing, and material characterization.

• Be experienced in field investigation techniques such as CPT, SPT, and their application in static and seismic design.

• Valid driver's license and have access to a personal vehicle for work related travel.

## COMPETITION NUMBER

## 202600318

Primary Care Paramedic

## LOCATION

Miramichi, NB

NB Union – Specialized Health Care Professionals

## STATUS

Part time permanent

Rotating days and nights, weekends, and statutory holidays. Subject to change due to operational requirements.

As soon as possible

Not applicable

As per collective agreement

Written and spoken competency in one of the two official languages (English or French) is required and spoken competency in the other official language is required.

## CLOSING DATE

This competition will remain open until filled.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2238827.title: Practice Facilitator
2238827.description:
## Practice Facilitator

Salary Range: $78,289 to $105,921, plus a comprehensive benefits package, including a defined benefit pension plan

Location: Work from home within the health zones of the Vitalité Health Network (i.e. Edmundston, Campbellton, Bathurst and Acadian Peninsula or Moncton) or based at the NBMS office in Fredericton, NB, subject to operational requirements. This position will focus primarily on supporting physician clinics within the Vitalité Health Network zones. Regular travel throughout the province is required.

## Build Better Health Care in New Brunswick

The New Brunswick Medical Society (NBMS) is the provincial voice of physicians, providing leadership, advocacy, and support to strengthen health care across New Brunswick. Representing practicing, future, and retired physicians, the NBMS works to advance fair and sustainable compensation, improve physician health and wellness, and influence health policy and system design to achieve better outcomes for patients.

Through its Practice Support programs, NBMS partners with physicians, nurse practitioners, and clinic teams to strengthen primary and specialty care, improve practice operations, and advance team-based models of care that enhance patient access, experience, and outcomes.

## Why You'll Love Working Here

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on health care delivery across New Brunswick while enjoying the flexibility of a remote work environment and the support of a collaborative, mission-driven organization.

As a Practice Facilitator, you will:

• work directly with physicians and clinic teams to support meaningful improvements in patient care and clinic operations

• lead meaningful quality improvement and practice transformation initiatives across NB

• collaborate with healthcare leaders and partners to support innovation in physician clinics

• work from your home community within New Brunswick while supporting clinics across the province

• receive ongoing professional development and learning opportunities

• participate in a competitive compensation program that includes a defined benefit pension plan, comprehensive health and dental coverage, paid vacation, and wellness benefits

• be part of a team dedicated to strengthening the health care system for physicians and patients alike

## Position Overview

The Practice Facilitator works directly with physicians, nurse practitioners, and clinic teams across New Brunswick to support practice improvement initiatives that enhance patient care, team effectiveness, clinic operations, and access to care. This dynamic role combines facilitation, coaching, quality improvement, change management, and stakeholder engagement to help clinics identify opportunities, implement sustainable improvements, and strengthen team-based care delivery.

As a trusted advisor and facilitator, you will help physicians and clinic teams identify opportunities for improvement, implement meaningful change, and build sustainable practices that support better outcomes for patients and providers.

## Who Would be Successful in This Role?

We are looking for someone who is passionate about improving health care and enjoys working collaboratively with physicians and clinic teams. You may be a great fit if you:

• enjoy building relationships and working collaboratively with physicians, healthcare professionals, and diverse stakeholders

• are passionate about improving health care delivery and supporting positive change

• have strong facilitation, coaching, and communication skills

• are comfortable leading discussions, workshops, and improvement initiatives

• enjoy solving problems, analyzing processes, and helping teams identify practical solutions

• can build trust, influence without authority, and support teams through change

• are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects and priorities

• thrive in a dynamic environment that combines relationship management, continuous improvement, and healthcare innovation

## Key Responsibilities

## Practice Facilitation and Improvement

• support physician practices in identifying and implementing quality improvement opportunities

• facilitate workflow reviews, assessments, and improvement planning

• assist clinics in strengthening team-based care and operational effectiveness

• support implementation of evidence-informed tools, processes, and best practices

## Coaching and Change Management

• provide coaching and facilitation to clinic teams

• support clinics in implementing sustainable change initiatives

• connect teams with provincial resources and improvement opportunities

• support teams in measuring outcomes and evaluating improvement efforts

## Health Partner Collaboration

• work with physicians, healthcare partners, government, and internal stakeholders

• support provincial practice support projects and initiatives

• contribute to provincial initiatives that strengthen access, quality, and continuity of care

## Qualifications

Relevant experience may come from a variety of educational and professional backgrounds. Candidates who do not meet every listed qualification are still encouraged to apply if they believe their experience would support success in this role.

## Education

• post-secondary degree or diploma in healthcare administration, business administration, health sciences, nursing, education, public administration, social sciences, or a related field

• equivalent combinations of education, training, certifications, and experience may be considered

## Experience

• experience working within healthcare, primary care, or a related sector

• experience in quality improvement, facilitation, coaching, project management, or change management

• experience supporting organizational improvement initiatives and stakeholder engagement activities

• experience leading workshops, meetings, or group facilitation activities

• experience working with physicians, healthcare teams, or healthcare organizations is considered an asset

## Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• understanding of quality improvement methodologies and change management principles

• knowledge of primary care environments, team-based care models, and healthcare operations

• strong communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills

• ability to support diverse stakeholders and build consensus

• strong organizational, planning, and time management skills

• ability to analyze information and develop practical recommendations

• ability to work independently and collaboratively

• proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and workplace technology

• strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities

## Language Requirements:

• Written and spoken competence in English and French is required. Language proficiency will be assessed during the recruitment process.

## Position Location and Travel

This position may be based remotely within New Brunswick in one of the Vitalité Health Network Health Regionals or from the NBMS office in Fredericton, subject to operational requirements. The role provides the opportunity to work directly with physician practices and healthcare teams across the province, supporting meaningful improvements in primary care delivery. Regular travel throughout New Brunswick is required, with a focus on Vitalité Health Network zones. Candidates must possess a valid driver's licence and have access to reliable transportation. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required to accommodate physician schedules, clinic meetings, workshops, and program requirements.

## Commitment to Equity, Diversity and Inclusion

The New Brunswick Medical Society is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where all employees feel valued and respected. We encourage applications from individuals from equity-deserving groups and are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process.

## How to Apply

Qualified candidates are encouraged to submit a cover letter and resume outlining how their education, experience, and skills align with the requirements of the position. Applications should be submitted to:

Sandra Hunter, Director Finance and Operations: shunter@nbms.nb.ca

Applications will be accepted until September 30th, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ADT, and all candidates will be reviewed as received.

Thank you for you interest in the New Brunswick Medical Society.

At NB Power we are a team committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for new members to join us.

NB Power's Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station is seeking candidates for its Nuclear Response Team (NRT). The Nuclear Response Team is responsible for the security of personnel and assets at the Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station, ensuring compliance of the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission (CNSC) Nuclear Security Regulations, and all applicable NB Power Security procedures and processes. Nuclear Response Team Officers provide armed, tactical response capabilities, on a shift basis, in addition to conducting general security and security-related administrative activities.

## Key functions include, but are not limited to:

• Carrying out foot and vehicle patrols of buildings, grounds, and fence lines. Responding to alarms on site and operate conventional and armored patrol vehicles.

• Be prepared to provide armed, tactical response to a Station security threat.

• Conducting searches of persons, packages, and vehicles entering and leaving the facility, using physical and technological methods to ensure no weapons, explosives or other prohibited items enter the facility and to prevent the unauthorized removal of nuclear material.

• Monitoring and recording all vehicle traffic and personnel entering the site in accordance with approved procedures and operating policies.

• Operating and monitoring surveillance video and intrusion detection equipment located within the Central Alarm Station.

• Investigating incidents and preparing condition reports involving breaches of security regulations or other incidents discovered during security patrols or as requested by the Nuclear Response Team Sergeant.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Post secondary certificate, diploma, degree or on track to graduate in June 2025, in one of the following: Police Foundations, Police Science, Law and Security, Criminal Justice, Corrections, Criminology, or a course deemed an equivalent level of education

## OR

• Canadian Armed Forces Military Service of either:
• Regular Force with minimum three years of continuous service

• Military Reserve with minimum three years as a Full Time Reservist

• Military Reserve with minimum five years as a Part-Time Reservist

• Submission of Members Personnel Record Resume is required for proof of Canadian Armed Forces Service

## Candidates must also meet the following qualifications and requirements:

• Valid Class 5 Driver's Licence

• Must complete and pass Aptitude & Psychological Testing

• Complete a competency-based interview

• Complete medical screening including hearing, vision and bloodwork

• Must hold at time of application, a valid Firearms Possession and Acquisition Licence (PAL) for both RESTRICTED and NON-RESTRICTED weapons

• Successfully pass Fitness Testing consisting of the Ontario Police Fitness Award PIN Program https://pfpo.org/ontario-police-fitness-pin-award-program/

Please note physical and medical testing MUST be conducted in person at the designated location in New Brunswick.

## Our ideal candidate will also have:

• Strong attention to detail

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Experience carrying a firearm in the line of duty and the ability to deal with stressful situations

• Team orientated, but also able to work independently without direct supervision, when required

• Possess basic computer skills with word, excel, outlook and/or access control applications such as OpenText

• Physical ability to carry approximately 45 pounds of equipment periodically throughout a 12-hour shift on a rotating schedule that involves working nights, weekends, and holidays as per shift schedule

An equivalent combination of training and experience will be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

## Conditions of Employment:

• Security Clearance: Due to security requirements at Canadian Nuclear facilities, the successful candidate will require a Site Access Security Clearance to Level II SECRET. This process includes verification of background information, credit check, references, a Criminal Record Name Check, and a Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) security recommendation. Maintaining this clearance is a mandatory requirement for the position.

• Medical Clearance: Must be medically cleared as "fit for duty" by NB Power's contracted physician and maintain this status.

• Annual Physical Testing: Must successfully pass and maintain annual physical testing.

• Nuclear Response Team Training: Must successfully pass the on-site Basic Tactical Officer Course (BTOC).

• Certifications: Must be able to obtain and maintain Nuclear Security Officer status and Public Agent Status through the approval of the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission.

• Alcohol and drug testing: Nuclear Response Team members are subject to alcohol and drug testing in the following circumstances: pre-placement, random, post-incident, for cause, and return-to-duty/follow-up, as outlined in REGDOC-2.2.4, Managing Alcohol and Drug Use by the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission. Passing pre-placement test is mandatory for continued employment.

As an Instructional Designer (ID), you will be responsible for the analysis, design and development of face-to-face and online training. Working closely with Project Managers, Instructional Designers, Subject Matter Experts and Developers, you will design creative instructional strategies.

Qualifications
Candidates must possess the following qualifications:

• Must have a college diploma or degree in any field.

• Must have a minimum of five (5) years' experience within the last ten (10) years in instructional design.

• Must have a minimum of three (3) years' experience within the last ten (10) years in the instructional design of eLearning products.

• Must be able to obtain Government of Canada Secret security clearance

• Must be proficient in English.

Responsibilities
• Use process and standards, storyboard EL/DL products as prioritized by leadership in terms of content, media, learner profiles, instructional methods and levels of knowledge.

• Liaise with courseware project Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and Offices of Primary Interest (OPIs) for content acquisition, clarification, and overall alignment of EL/DL content to the desired performance objectives (POs) in accordance with the mandated Training Plan (TP).

• Advise and liaise with the production and quality assurance teams during product design, development, release and evaluation phases, including but not limited to contributing to learner assessment products, QC checks complete with verifications, and peer review.

• Assist in conducting QC reviews if required.

• Synthesize content into creative, sound instructional design that is cognitively engaging.

• Write assessment questions appropriate to the level of learning, matching the learning objectives.

• Work cooperatively with multi-disciplinary project teams consisting of DND civilian and military personnel, interns and other contractors.

• Participate in appropriate planning processes, meeting and working groups dealing primarily with the overall project, the project team and matters pertaining to general courseware production and the content review and revision cycles.

• Ensure consistency and maintain documentation for specific style guidelines (i.e., project specific or school specific style guides).

• Prepare courseware text documents to be sent to translation.

• Support development of the project plan and schedule.

• Assist in the design of the learning solution and prepare both high level and detailed design documents.

• Assist in the design and support the development of prototypes and beta test products and ensure compliance with specifications and standards.

• Liaise with development staff as needed prior to and during production (ie. to refine media specifications, to clarify storyboards and to share updates or changes).

• Identify potential obstacles, scope changes or impact on deliverables.

• Other duties as required.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

2240127.description:
Director Organizational Change and Transformation
One Regular position
Non-Unionized
Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada
$133,489 - $183,365 annually based on 40 hours per week
Competition # E22653-2026

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for a new member to join us.

As a key member of the Customer and Strategy team and reporting to the Vice President, Customer and Strategy, the Director of Organizational Change and Transformation leads enterprise-wide change initiatives that address complex business challenges and drive transformational improvements across the organization. Leveraging established change management methodologies, organizational effectiveness frameworks, and diagnostic tools, the Director assesses organizational performance, identifies both root and contributing causes of business challenges, and develops strategic solutions that enhance effectiveness and support the achievement of corporate objectives. Working collaboratively with business leaders and the People and Culture team, this role designs and implements sustainable improvement strategies that strengthen organizational capability, improve performance, and enable successful transformation.

## Key functions include:

• Leverage organizational change management methodologies, organizational effectiveness assessment tools, and performance data to identify the root cause of performance challenges and barriers to achieving strategic objectives. Analyze findings to provide actionable insights and recommendations that enhance organizational effectiveness, improve performance, and support the successful delivery of business goals.

• Collaborate with key stakeholders across the organization, including People and Culture, Business Innovation, and Digital Technology, to identify performance gaps and develop strategic initiatives that enhance organizational effectiveness and eliminate barriers to high performance.

• Provide expert guidance, coaching, and strategic support to senior leaders and executives in assessing and enhancing organizational effectiveness. Lead and influence enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, serving as a project lead where appropriate, to drive alignment across functions, build organizational capability, and achieve strategic business objectives.

• Collaborate with leaders and cross-functional teams to ensure NB Power's Vision, Mission, and Values are embedded in strategic decision-making, operational processes, and day-to-day behaviors. Proactively identify and address barriers to successful execution, driving alignment, accountability, and organizational performance. Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders by providing strategic guidance, influence, and coaching in areas such as performance, leadership effectiveness and team development.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• University degree or master's degree in Business Administration or Management, or a related discipline

• Eight years of experience in performance improvement or a related field, including the management of large scale organizational, construction, or technology projects

• Five years demonstrated leadership experience

• Demonstrated experience in performance improvement, capability management, change management, systems thinking, organizational/self-assessments, leadership and team effectiveness

• Strong understanding of business strategy, performance management, organizational effectiveness, project management, and change management principles

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

• Proven ability to collaborate and communicate effectively with diverse teams and all levels within an organization

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

• One or more of the following would be considered an asset: training in Lean Six Sigma methodology, a Project Management Professional (PMP) designation, or project management training in areas such as risk management or contract management

An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

An Eligibility List generated from this competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level within a period of up to 12 months.

## We care for our team, and as a member you will have access to:

• Health & Dental plans that provide flexible options to meet your needs

• Health Spending Account, allowing for further flexibility

• New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan, offering retirement financial security

• Wellness options, including our Employee Family Assistance Program

• Benefits that allow for financial protection in the event it is needed

• Various options for paid or unpaid leaves

• Career development and growth throughout the organization

• Competitive wages

## Could you be our next team member? Apply today!

Please ensure a resume and a copy of your degree/diploma/certificate are attached to your online application.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.
