Service New Brunswick (SNB) is seeking an individual with Scrum Master expertise to join the Technology Services Division in the Digital Solution Services unit. The Scrum Master will join a new Agile team being established to support a strategic approach based on a common framework for portable, verifiable, and user-controlled credentials.

Reporting to a Product Owner (PO), the Scrum Master acts as a servant leader and coach who helps the Agile team adhere to SAFe practices, eliminate impediments, and maintain a high-performing environment. They work closely with the Product Owner and the rest of the Agile Release Train (ART) to ensure smooth value delivery.

Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Supports PI Planning: Assists the Agile team in calculating capacity, mapping dependencies, and identifying risks during quarterly Planning Interval (PI) Planning events. Helps draft the Agile team's PI objectives.

• Attends Scrum of Scrums/ART Sync: Represents their Agile team at regular Agile Release Train (ART) sync meetings. They use this forum to coordinate dependencies and escalate unresolved risks to the Release Train Engineer (RTE).

• Participates in Inspect and Adapt: Guides the Agile team through this ART-wide event to evaluate the large-scale solution progress. They help the Agile team identify systemic process improvements across the entire ART.

• Team Coaching: Educates the Agile team on SAFe principles, Scrum, Kanban, and built-In quality practices. Empowers the Agile team to self-organize and take ownership of their commitments.

• Removes Impediments: Actively identifies and clears internal and external blockers that slow down the Agile team's progress. Escalates issues outside the Agile team's control to management or the RTE.

• Protects Team Focus: Shields the team from outside distractions, disruptive context-switching, and uncontrolled scope changes. This allows developers to maintain a steady and productive workflow.

• Optimizes Flow: Uses visual management tools like Kanban boards to analyze work-in-progress (WIP) limits and bottlenecks. Utilizes SAFe metrics to improve the Agile team's delivery velocity and predictability.

• Partners with the PO: Helps the PO maintain a healthy and prioritized team backlog that meets the Definition of Ready (DoR) to ensure work is not pulled before it is actionable Ensures the team maintains a balance between user value and technical enablers.

• Ensures Built-In Quality: Coaches the Agile team to uphold architectural runway standards and technical excellence. Reinforces adherence to the shared Definition of Done (DoD) for all deliverables.

• Facilitates Cross-Team Coordination: Proactively collaborates with other Scrum Masters on the ART to resolve overlapping dependencies. This keeps the entire ART moving toward delivery goals with minimal friction.

• Promotes SAFe Core Values: Champions alignment, transparency, respect for people, and relentless improvement within their sphere of influence. Cultivates an environment where failure is treated as a learning opportunity.

• Experience within the public sector

• Experience with Enterprise Agile frameworks, including the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)

• Possession of a Scaled Agile Framework Scrum Master (SAFe SSM) certification. Note that incumbents without this certification must secure and maintain it as a condition of continued employment.

• Possession of a PMI Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (ACP), or PRINCE2 Practitioner certification. Alternately, certification from one of the recognized leaders in Scrum and Agile education is acceptable.

• Possession of a change management certification from one of the recognized leaders in change management.

• Experience presenting to senior management groups

• Experience facilitating groups

• Experience supporting transformation of organizations from traditional project-centric (i.e., waterfall) approaches to product-centric Agile and/or DevOps approaches.

• Experience with Azure DevOps Services

• Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS) platforms, such as PingOne

• Experience with decentralized identity solutions and approaches utilizing Verifiable Credentials (VCs)

• Experience with SaaS applications

• Experience with Cloud applications

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS: A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline and a minimum of seven (7) years of related experience including five (5) as a Scrum Master or Senior Project Manager. The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure is seeking an individual to join the Property Services Branch as a Property Manager, Valuation and Administration.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the Department's real property disposal program by leading the appraisal and valuation function for surplus provincial properties. The position will be responsible for developing, implementing and continuously improving appraisal processes and standards to support informed decision-making and ensure consistency across the Property Management and Sales Unit.

Reporting to the Acting Assistant Director, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

• managing the appraisal process for surplus provincial properties, including determining valuation requirements, completing and coordinating appraisal assignments, and monitoring timelines to support property disposal initiatives;

• developing, implementing and maintaining appraisal policies, procedures and best practices to ensure consistency, efficiency and compliance with the Canadian Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (CUSPAP);

• reviewing and analyzing appraisal reports prepared by third-party consultants to ensure accuracy, completeness, reasonableness and compliance with CUSPAP and departmental requirements;

• providing professional advice and recommendations on real estate valuation matters to senior management, internal stakeholders and other government departments to support strategic decision-making;

• preparing valuation analyses, briefing materials, proposals, and recommendations related to the disposal of provincial real property;

• managing Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and purchase and sale contracts for the development of properties, including evaluating proposals and ensuring contractual obligations are met;

• conducting market research and analysis to identify real estate trends and provide expert advice on property values and disposal strategies;

• ensuring a high degree of confidentiality while working within applicable legislation, government policies and local government requirements;

• identifying opportunities to improve appraisal processes, business practices and service delivery within the Property Management and Sales unit.

Senior Technicians
Two (2) Regular positions (1 Civil, 1 Electrical)
Mactaquac, New Brunswick, Canada
Salary range: $37.64 to $48.10 hourly based on 40 hours per week
Competition # E22651-2026

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for a new member to join us.

The Mactaquac Generating Station began generating electricity in 1968. Since the 1980s, concrete portions of the hydro station have been affected by a chemical reaction called alkali-aggregate reaction. The reaction causes the concrete to swell and crack and has required substantial annual maintenance and repairs. NB Power is proposing a project to ensure the station can operate to its intended 100-year lifespan with a modified approach to maintenance and adjusting and replacing equipment and concrete over time.

As part of the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project, both the Senior Electrical and Instrumentation & Controls and Civil Technicians are responsible for overseeing and coordinating all on-site construction activities, ensuring they align with contract documents, drawings, and specifications. This position plays a critical role in ensuring that the project is executed safely, on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

## Civil key functions include:

• Oversee day-to-day construction activities, ensure alignment with project scope, schedule, safety, and quality standards, and coordinate site logistics and stakeholder interfaces.

• Track progress, maintain daily reporting, manage scope changes, support claims negotiations, and ensure accurate documentation and project controls.

• Guide contractors and internal teams, develop direct reports, foster a high-performance culture, and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Diploma in Civil Engineering Technology

• Six years of experience in construction projects in hydro generation or heavy industrial. This includes surveying with strong knowledge of construction contracts, drawings, codes, and specifications

• Skilled in planning, scheduling, look-ahead coordination, and progress reporting

• Proficient in managing field activities, contractor coordination, project controls, and change management

• Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership abilities, with experience mentoring or managing teams

• Proficient with construction scheduling tools and Microsoft Office suite (Project, Excel, Word, Outlook)

• Design experience and PMP or equivalent project management certification are considered assets

## Electrical key functions include:

• Oversee day-to-day Electrical and Instrumentation & Controls construction and commissioning activities, ensuring alignment with project scope, schedule, safety requirements, and quality standards, while coordinating site electrical work, system integration, and stakeholder interfaces.

• Track progress of electrical and instrumentation installations, maintain daily reporting, manage scope changes, support contract and claims processes, and ensure accurate documentation, testing records, and project controls for EI&C systems.

• Provide technical guidance to electrical contractors and multidisciplinary teams, support development of direct reports, promote a high-performance and safety-focused culture, and collaborate effectively across engineering, operations, and commissioning teams.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

One of the following:

• Diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology

• Industrial Control Technology Diploma

• Instrumentation/Control Technology Diploma

And

• Six years of experience in construction projects in hydro generation, EI&C systems, or heavy industrial environments, with strong knowledge of electrical and instrumentation installation practices, construction contracts, drawings, codes, and technical specifications

• Skilled in planning, scheduling, look-ahead coordination, and progress reporting

• Proficient in managing field activities, contractor coordination, project controls, and change management

• Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution skills

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership abilities, with experience mentoring or managing teams

• Proficient with construction scheduling tools and Microsoft Office suite (Project, Excel, Word, Outlook)

• Design experience and PMP or equivalent project management certification are considered assets

An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

An Eligibility List generated from this competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level within a period of up to 12 months.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. BARGAINING UNIT NBNU
UNIT LOCATION Fredericton

HOURS OF WORK Starting 0800hr to 1600hr Monday-Friday. Subject to change due to operational requirements.

As per collective agreement
LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT Written and spoken competence in English and French is required.
CLOSING DATE Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

NB Health Link (NBHL) leverages technological solutions and innovative clinical delivery models to provide access to care for New Brunswickers who don't have a family doctor or nurse practitioner. The program provides patients who are registered with the program access to a network of family doctors and nurse practitioners throughout the province - offering in-person, telephone and online appointments in both official languages.

As part of NBHL, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

The Nurse Practitioner (NP) is a generalist who offers quality and relevant care across the health continuum and throughout the patient's lifespan, including health promotion, disease and injury, prevention, curative, supportive, rehabilitative, and palliative care within an interdisciplinary team of health providers.

The service model is based on the principles of primary health care with the goal of supporting communities in meeting their health care needs.

As a key member of the NB Health Link team, the NP is responsible and accountable for their practice and professional conduct while working in collaboration with physicians to ensure quality and relevant care.

As an EM/ANB employee, the NPs are accountable to our patients and families and co-workers by participating in and supporting safety related initiatives as well as acting in a manner that fosters a culture of learning. Safety for patients, caregivers, and workplace are kept the priority.

## ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Integrates a broad knowledge base and critical appraisal in determining and communicating the diagnosis and the patient's needs.

• Applies advanced assessment techniques, critical thinking and clinical decision-making skills when assessing patients.

• Systematically collects documents and critically analyzes health data by performing a holistic health assessment using multiple tools and sources of data.

• Completes a prescription accurately and completely according to relevant legislation, standards, and policies.

• Orders diagnostic imaging tests, laboratory and other tests when clinically indicated and in accordance with the Nurse Practitioner Schedules and program guidelines for Ordering.

• Promotes health and reduces the risk of complications, illness, and injury for patients.

• Ensures that diagnostic tests are interpreted, and results are acted upon in an appropriate and timely manner.

• Monitor the ongoing therapy of patients with chronic stable illnesses.

• Screen for the presence of chronic illnesses and works in collaboration with physicians who identified presence of chronic illness in patients.

• Monitors the effectiveness of interventions.

• Facilitates the patient's transition within and between health care settings, e.g., admitting,

• transferring, and discharging patients.

• Ability to work independently and as part of the interdisciplinary team including making appropriate referrals.

• Documents clinical data, assessment findings, diagnosis, plan of care, therapeutic intervention (including consent), patients' response and clinical rationale in a timely and accurate manner in the patient health record.

• Maintain a positive working relationship with the interdisciplinary team.

• Help build protocols and templates in prevention medicine for the program.

• Responsibilities to support the core provincial program will be the primary task.

• Other responsibilities may be assigned to support the program.

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor's Degree in Nursing and successful completion of a postgraduate Nurse Practitioner program in Primary Health Care.

• Registered as a Nurse Practitioner with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick

• Current Basic Life Saving certificate and maintain certification.

• A least 2 years' experience in primary health care setting in Community Health Centre or Collaborative Practice.;

• Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills;

• Demonstrated organizational and leadership skills;

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with other members of a team toward common goals;

• Demonstrated ability to function independently in the role with recognized decision-making and problem-solving skills;

• Demonstrated ability to critically analyze theory and research literature and apply to practice;

• Demonstrated ability to integrate a determinants of health approach into care delivery;

• Actively participates as a team member to provide comprehensive care to all patients;

• Must be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record;

• Adherence to professional ethical principles.

• Skillful use of computer tools and Microsoft Office Programs.

All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

NBHL is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

The Attorney General is the law officer of the Executive Council and is responsible to see that the administration of public affairs is in accordance with the law and to ensure protection of the public interest. The Legal Services Branch provides civil and constitutional legal advice and representation to all provincial government departments and related agencies.

The Office of the Attorney General is seeking an individual to join the Legal Services Branch as Lawyer 2 within the Litigation Group.

2239374.employer: GEMTEC Consulting Engineers and Scientists Limited
2239374.description:
We're looking for a Hydrogeologist to join our growing team in Fredericton, NB. This role is also open to our other New Brunswick offices in Moncton, Saint John, Bathurst or Grand Falls.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're a perfect sized employee-owned, 400-person multi-disciplinary consulting firm that is large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers—without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

A typical day on the job might look like:

• Provide technical support to a wide variety of physical hydrogeology projects and prepare proposals and reports.

• Design field investigations such as drilling, coring and test pitting logging; soil and bedrock description and characterization; monitoring well and groundwater/surface water instrumentation installation; single- and multi-well pumping tests; soil, groundwater, sediment and surface water sampling; infiltration rate testing; and private well monitoring.

• Prepare technical proposals and reports, including hydrogeological characterization assessments; impact assessments, groundwater supply and source water protection studies and approvals; quarry, mine pit and construction dewatering assessments and permitting; water balance assessments; and groundwater and surface water interaction and monitoring programs.

• Develop and maintain relationships with clients.

The good stuff you get:

• Fair pay plus extra: competitive salary with year-end profit-sharing bonus.

• Complete health & dental coverage including vision, paramedical services, and Teladoc.

• Retirement planning made easier with a 5% employer match on your contributions.

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days) plus Employee & Family Assistance Program when you need it.

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and the New Year).

Your background and what you bring:

• Bachelor's degree in earth science, environmental science or geological/geotechnical/civil engineering with an emphasis in water resources or hydrogeology.

• Professional license in NB (i.e. P.Geo. or P.Eng.)

• 5 to 10 years of relevant professional related experience (preferably in consulting).

• Knowledge and understanding of provincial and federal regulatory frameworks for groundwater withdrawal/use, drinking water supply, contaminated sites assessment and management, and environmental assessment is required.

• Familiarity with infrastructure, pit and quarry dewatering as well as exploration and development of community water supplies is required, with specific experience in the mining industry considered an asset.

• Groundwater flow and transport modeling experience is considered an asset.

• Valid NB driver's license.

Interested individuals, click here to apply: https://gemtec.bamboohr.com/careers/351

Thank you for taking the time to consider GEMTEC. Only candidates proceeding to the next phase of the application process will be contacted at this time. We encourage you to connect with us on LinkedIn, even if this opportunity isn't for you, the next one might be!

Should you be selected for an interview and require accommodation of any kind, please kindly help us understand how we can help.

Horizon Health Network is seeking a Geriatric Psychiatrist to join our collegial and collaborative team in beautiful Saint John, New Brunswick, Canada.

Reporting to the Department Head of Psychiatry, the Geriatric Psychiatry Specialist will play a central role in assessing, diagnosing, and managing complex mental health conditions in older adults. This position offers a dynamic and meaningful opportunity for a clinician dedicated to enhancing outcomes for seniors through evidence?based practice, innovation, and compassionate care. You will provide specialized expertise to both inpatient and outpatient populations, working collaboratively within a supportive, multidisciplinary team committed to delivering high?quality geriatric mental health services.

## Why you should work here

New Brunswick offers a safe and welcoming community with a relaxed lifestyle and a true work-life balance, enriched by its diverse Indigenous, Anglophone, and Francophone heritage.

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

Located on the beautiful bay of Fundy, Saint John offers coastal living, vibrant arts and culinary scenes, and quick access to wilderness—all without the big-city grind. You'll also enjoy a lower cost of living and a close-knit, welcoming community.

## Incentives & Remuneration

The salary range is $385,258 – $425,835, plus fee-for-service billing opportunities, paid time off (including vacation and education leave), health and travel insurance benefits, sick benefits, and employer-paid contributions to our pension plan.

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban recruitment incentive of $50,000.00 with a 2-year return of service.

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

## What you will do

Our ideal candidate will collaborate with other Physicians, Nursing and other Allied medical staff in the following areas:

• Geriatric psychiatry inpatient and outpatient care

• Close collaboration with our outstanding Medicine colleagues including consultations to in-patient units

• ECT Service

All members of our department are expected to provide:

• After-hours and weekend on-call coverage (paid stipend and fee-for-service billing)

• ECT Service

• Clinical supervision of medical students and residents

(Note: These responsibilities are the basic and prime duties associated with this position; other related and allied duties may be assigned from time to time as may be necessary to the operation of Horizon Health Network.)

## Who you are

• You have a Medical Degree from a recognized medical school and postgraduate studies (residency) in the field of Geriatric Psychiatry.

• You have experience in collaborative multidisciplinary Addiction and Mental Health care.

• You have Certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, and a valid license through New Brunswick College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick (CPSNB) and become a member of the NB Medical Society.

• You practice medicine in a manner compatible with the Health Authority's mission, values, and strategic directions. https://horizonnb.ca/about-us/our-promise.

The physician must also meet continuing education requirements, adhere to departmental and health authority policies, comply with relevant legislation, and follow professional ethical standards set by regulatory bodies.

## Interested? Apply Today!

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

Job Posting Information
Civil Engineering Construction Lead (Engineer V)
One Regular position
Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada
Salary range: $52.23 - $65.32 hourly based on 40 hours per week
Competition # E22441-2026

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for a new member to join us.

The Mactaquac Generating Station began generating electricity in 1968. Since the 1980s, concrete portions of the hydro station have been affected by a chemical reaction called alkali-aggregate reaction (AAR). The reaction causes the concrete to swell and crack and has required substantial annual maintenance and repairs. NB Power is proposing a project to ensure the station can operate to its intended 100-year lifespan with a modified approach to maintenance and adjusting and replacing equipment and concrete overtime.

As part of the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project, the Engineer V (Civil Engineering Construction Lead) is responsible for enhancing the effectiveness of project delivery through strong project management practices, including standardization, quality control, structure, and discipline, for the Fish Passage project.

## Key functions include:

• Lead the management of a Tier 3 or 4, multidisciplinary project, ensuring alignment with scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.

• Support the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project through both planning and execution phases, while effectively integrating project deliverables with broader organizational objectives and initiatives.

• Lead environmental and efficiency studies in support of the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project and liaise with Department of Fisheries and Oceans and First Nations groups.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Service New Brunswick (SNB) is seeking an individual with Product Owner expertise to join the Technology Services Division in the Digital Solution Services (DSS) unit. The Product Owner will lead a new Agile team being established to support a strategic approach based on a common framework for portable, verifiable, and user-controlled credentials.

Working at Service New Brunswick is more than just a job — it's an opportunity to build a meaningful career. Guided by our vision of "Elevating Service Excellence", our teams provide high-quality, innovative public services for customers with a focus on value for all New Brunswickers.

Known for our people-oriented workplace culture, we foster an environment where innovation, inclusivity, and teamwork are celebrated. We are proud to be recognized as one of Atlantic Canada's Top Employers for 2026!

## What We Offer

At SNB, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are:

• Human-Centered: We prioritize well-being and flexibility for our employees.

• Driven by Growth: We invest in your professional development and career advancement.

• Celebrating Excellence: We recognize and reward outstanding contributions.

• United by Purpose: Every project you work on makes a real difference for New Brunswickers.

## SNB also offers a comprehensive employee benefits package.

Reporting to the Director of DSS, the Product Owner serves as the lead for defining user stories and prioritizing the Agile team's backlog to streamline the execution of priorities. They act as a proxy for the business and customers within the Agile team and work closely with Product Management to extend business intent down to the execution level within the Agile Release Train (ART).

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Lead Agile Delivery: Drive iteration and quarterly Planning Interval (PI) planning, maintain and prioritize the product backlog, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality, tested solutions.

• Define and Communicate Product Vision: Translate business needs into actionable features and/or capabilities aligned with organizational goals and communicate the product roadmap to stakeholders.

• Backlog Management: Create and maintain the Agile team's backlog, ensuring items are well-formed and prioritized based on user value, risk, and dependencies.

• User Story Creation: Define user stories with clear acceptance criteria in concert with the Senior Business Analyst. Serve as a point of contact for clarification on requirements to the development team.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact for clients and the development team; foster strong relationships to understand needs and manage expectations.

• Resource & Financial Management: Oversee budgets, contracts, and resource planning to ensure efficient and cost-effective service delivery.

• Risk & Portfolio Management: Monitor product performance, manage risks using the ROAM approach, and ensure lifecycle sustainability.

• Incident Response & Continuity: Provide leadership during critical incidents, coordinate resolution teams, and ensure continuity of services for public-facing platforms.

• Quality Assurance: Validate that user stories meet acceptance criteria and ensure technical stability and compliance with standards.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Scrum Masters, Platform Strategists, and Shared Services teams to align development objectives with business goals.

• Continuous Improvement: Promote adoption of enterprise-standard tools and practices, and lead efforts to regularly improve approaches, behaviours, and processes to increase delivery efficiency and effectiveness.

• Strategic Leadership: Contribute to ART-level planning, performance monitoring, and emergency response coordination as part of the senior management team.

• Team Management: Manage a team of senior information technology professionals utilizing the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) operating model to deliver products and services to a diverse customer base. Management also includes supporting the team's collective performance and maturation along with the performance and maturation of individuals within the team.

• Experience within the public sector

• Experience applying risk management and compliance in a public sector or large organizational context

• Experience with Enterprise Agile frameworks, including the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)

• Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices

• Possession of a Scaled Agile Framework Product Owner/Product Manager (SAFe POPM) certification. Note that incumbents without this certification must secure and maintain it as a condition of continued employment.

• Possession of active Business Analyst certifications, such as IIBA-CBAP, PMI-PBA, and IQBBA

• Experience with Azure DevOps Services

• Experience with the BrowserStack platform

• Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS) platforms, such as PingOne

• Experience with decentralized identity solutions and approaches utilizing Verifiable Credentials (VCs)

• Experience with SaaS applications

• Experience with Cloud applications

• Experience with UI/UX design systems

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS: A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline, along with seven (7) years of related experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst in an Agile delivery environment. Subject to the response to this competition, an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

2236012.title: Enterprise Architect
2236012.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

Cooke is strengthening its Enterprise Architecture capability to improve how complex business and technology decisions are shaped across the organization. The practice brings together business needs, applications, data, integrations, security, and technology so that major initiatives can move forward with clear direction and fewer avoidable gaps.

As an Enterprise Architect, you shape initiatives before and during delivery by defining the architecture approach, assessing options, identifying affected areas, and setting practical guardrails. This role will focus primarily on Finance initiatives while supporting other business priorities where required.

## The Role

You work with business leaders, delivery teams, and technology specialists to turn business needs into clear architecture direction. You look beyond an individual system or project to understand wider impacts, dependencies, and longer-term implications. You provide architecture leadership for significant initiatives, from early problem framing and option assessment through solution design and key delivery decisions. You do not replace the teams accountable for delivery; you make sure they have the direction, constraints, and decisions needed to deliver their part. You also contribute to the standards, roadmaps, patterns, and architecture views used to guide consistent decisions across Cooke.

## Key Responsibilities

• Lead architecture work for complex business and technology initiatives, establishing the scope, approach, affected areas, and key decisions

• Work with business stakeholders to understand the problem, desired outcomes, operating constraints, and capability needs

• Develop current-state, target-state, and transition views that give delivery teams a clear and practical direction

• Assess solution and vendor options, explaining the trade-offs across business value, cost, risk, complexity, supportability, and strategic fit

• Identify impacts and dependencies across processes, applications, data, integrations, security, infrastructure, operations, and affected companies

• Define architecture guardrails and decision criteria, and remain engaged through delivery when material design choices or exceptions arise

• Review proposed designs and recommendations to identify gaps, duplication, unsupported assumptions, and decisions requiring escalation

• Support Architecture Review Board and portfolio governance with clear, evidence-based architecture assessments

• Develop and maintain relevant roadmaps, principles, standards, reference models, and reusable solution patterns

• Identify opportunities to simplify the application landscape, improve reuse, reduce fragmentation, and strengthen shared capabilities

• Support acquisition and integration assessments where business or technology decisions have wider enterprise implications

• Work across Data, Integration, Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Delivery teams to maintain end-to-end alignment

## What Success Looks Like

• Business and technology leaders have clear options and understand the implications of major decisions

• Initiatives move into delivery with an agreed architecture approach, visible dependencies, and practical guardrails

• Material risks, gaps, and cross-team impacts are identified early enough to influence the outcome

• Delivery teams understand the architecture guardrails that apply and know when material design changes require further architecture review.

• Roadmaps and target-state views are grounded in business priorities and used to guide investment and sequencing

• Architecture governance improves decision quality without taking ownership away from accountable delivery teams

• Opportunities for simplification, reuse, and consolidation are translated into actionable decisions

## Core Skills & Competencies

• Broad architecture experience spanning business capabilities, applications, data, integrations, security, and technology

• Ability to frame complex problems and translate business needs into clear architecture direction

• Experience leading architecture across significant initiatives with multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders

• Strong option assessment and decision-support skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs plainly

• Experience developing roadmaps, target states, transition plans, principles, standards, and reusable patterns

• Ability to identify cross-functional impacts, dependencies, ownership gaps, and delivery constraints

• Working knowledge of enterprise applications, cloud platforms, data, integration, security, and operational support models

• Clear written, visual, and verbal communication with senior business, technology, and delivery stakeholders

## Behaviors That Drive Success

• Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility for clear architecture direction, sound analysis, and visible decisions

• Enterprise Perspective - Considers wider business and technology impacts without losing sight of the immediate delivery need

• Practical Judgment - Applies standards with context and focuses effort where architecture can materially improve the outcome

• Collaboration & Influence - Builds alignment across teams without relying on direct authority

• Clarity - Makes complex issues understandable and separates facts, assumptions, risks, and decisions

• Delivery Awareness - Stays close enough to implementation to address material changes while respecting delivery ownership

## Experience & Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or related discipline, or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, technology strategy, or complex transformation roles

• Demonstrated experience providing architecture leadership across business and technology initiatives

• Experience assessing commercial platforms, vendor proposals, custom solutions, integrations, and technology investments

• Experience working across business, application, data, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational concerns

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and support decisions in environments with competing priorities

• Experience in a complex, multi-company, acquisition-driven, or federated organization is an asset

• Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture frameworks and repository tools is an asset

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. • Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

2240873.description:
Are you passionate about storytelling, creating engaging content, and building meaningful connections through social media? Are you energized by identifying compelling stories, growing online communities, and helping shape how an organization is seen and experienced online?

New Brunswick Community College (NBCC) is seeking a creative and strategic Social Media Specialist to join our Marketing and Communications team. In this exciting role, you'll help strengthen NBCC's online presence by creating compelling content, fostering meaningful engagement, and showcasing the impact of our students, staff, alumni, and communities across New Brunswick

This is a Regular employment opportunity located at any of NBCC's campus locations.

Qualifications

## Education:

• Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, or a related discipline.

• Minimum three (3) to five (5) years of relevant experience.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills.

## Technical Skills:

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office.

• Demonstrated experience creating social media content, including photography, video, and short-form content using mobile devices and content creation tools for multiple audiences and platforms.

• Experience using enterprise social media management and scheduling platforms.

• Strong understanding of social media platforms, analytics, audience engagement, and content optimization.

• Demonstrated track record in prioritizing and time management with the ability to work on multiple projects with tight deadlines and competing priorities.

## Professional Skills:

• Ability to work proactively, independently, and collaboratively in a team environment.

• A highly collaborative attitude focused on providing the best products and solutions for the team.

• Ability to make sound recommendations, adapt quickly, and respond effectively to changing priorities.

Candidates must clearly demonstrate how they meet these qualifications in their resume and portfolio.

Other combinations of education and experience may be considered as equivalent. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be raised.

Responsibilities

## What does this role look like?

Reporting to the Manager, Strategic Communications & Creative, the Social Media Specialist supports the Marketing and Communications department in helping NBCC pursue its mission, vision and commitments.

## What will you be doing?

• Lead the development and execution of NBCC's social media strategy, ensuring alignment with institutional priorities, brand standards, enrolment objectives, and strategic communications goals.

• Create, capture, curate, and publish engaging content across NBCC's official social media channels, including written content, photography, mobile video, stories, reels, contests, and emerging content formats. Travel throughout New Brunswick to campuses, events, and community activities to identify compelling stories and create social-first content.

• Manage the social media content calendar, coordinating the planning, review, approval, and publishing of content across official social media channels.

• Foster engagement through community management and social listening, responding to inquiries, monitoring conversations, escalating issues as appropriate, and supporting issues management activities when required.

• Analyze performance data, audience insights, and digital trends to optimize content, improve results, and inform strategic decision-making.

• Serve as the College's subject matter expert on social media, providing guidance, best practices, and strategic recommendations to departments and initiatives across NBCC.

• Build relationships with students, staff, alumni, and community partners to identify and amplify authentic stories that support NBCC's brand and strategic priorities.

• A culture that is focused on nurturing a sense of belonging for all employees.

• A salary range of $53,742 to $75,114 annually.

• Become a member of the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan.

• Opportunities for professional development and training.

• NBCC supports the wellbeing of its employees. We provide free access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP).

• Paid sick and vacation leave.

• Volunteer leave.

• Tuition Reimbursement Programs (Employee: Tuition Reimbursement Program AND Family: Tuition Reduction Benefit - Spouse and Children).

All applicants must be eligible to work in Canada at the time of application. This competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level.

## JOB SUMMARY

Under the supervision of the manager, the Resource Nurse provides clinical guidance and support to EMP clinical staff in the planning and delivery of care to EMP patients and their families/support persons. They will act as a clinical leader, role model and change agent. The Resource Nurse will be responsible for clinical training and orientating of clinical staff at the local and regional levels.

They will collaborate in the development and updating of policies, procedures and protocols and the implementation of best practices and act as a resource person to clinical staff for managing clinical cases.

## Roles and Responsibilities

## Clinical Leadership and Patient Care

• Collaborates in the implementation of home care best practices.

• Maintains open lines of communication between members of the interdisciplinary team.

• Provides leadership and supports clinical staff with complex clinical situations in accordance with EMP Unit policies and procedures. Supports the team in the EMP Approval/Denial process where appropriate.

• Consults in developing and revising the policies, procedures, protocols and any other clinical documentation related to EMP.

• Promotes interdisciplinary patient centered care approach.

• Provides direct care to patients as needed based on unit requirements.

• Supports clinical staff to maintain ongoing collaborative relationship with the patient's primary provider (physician or Nurse Practitioner) and other healthcare professionals.

• Supports manager with Approval/Denial as requested.

• Communicates with Clinical manager and Clinical Nurse Specialist.

• Attends discipline specific meetings as appropriate

## Staff Orientation and Development

• Prepares, coordinates and delivers orientation and continuing education programs focused on skills specific to homecare practices and works in conjunction with other resource nurses across the EMP.

• Ensures the orientation material and training content are up to date.

• Promotes principals of home care practice with EMP clinical staff and supports nurses in developing skills needed to be competent.

• Acts as a mentor with new EMP clinical staff.

• Ongoing and monitoring professional competencies and certifications- conduct "skills lab"- linked to EMP Education manager and Clinical Nurse Specialist positions

• Assists the clinical manager with the monitoring and assessment of clinical activities and nursing competencies needed to meet home care standards.

• Assists the clinical manager with identification of educational needs, training needs and opportunities.

• Offers sessions to clinical staff in order to maintain required certifications (advanced skills, etc.).

• Trains the staff on using new pieces of equipment and techniques relevant to specific practice.

• Collaborates with the development of patient's educational tools and resources required for patients and families' teaching.

• Supports clinical staff in the acquisition of community problem solving / critical thinking skills in an effort to support informed decision-making.

• Participates in caseload review with the manager in an effort to support efficiency and consistency in caseload management as well as meeting home care best practice and EMP clinical practice leadership guidelines.

• Collaborates in the implementation of appropriate home care indicators and ensure that EMP staff is aware of the indicators and follow the provincial EMP Clinical Practice leadership Practice documents for home care.

• Supports EMP accountability framework to contribute to efficient performance

## Quality Improvement and Risk Management

• Collaborates in quality improvement initiatives as required.

• Responds to Wound Care consults generated through PIXalere (works in conjunction with EMP Skin & Wound Care Network)

## Research

• Assists in finding potential patients for researchers through the promotion of approved projects.

• Participates in research projects as required.

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor Degree in Nursing;

• Must be registered (active) or ability to register with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick;

• Minimum of five (5) years of experience with EMP acquired over the past eight (8) years;

• Demonstrated ability to provide education programs using exceptional interpersonal, leadership, and teaching skills;

• Demonstrated knowledge of current health trends, principles of home health care, community care, senior, acute, supportive and palliative care;

• Knowledge of the target population of EMP and available community resources;

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License and good driving record (proof required);

• Must demonstrate capacity to work independently

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

2176290.description:
Horizon Health Network is seeking Anesthesiologists to join our collegial and collaborative teams in beautiful New Brunswick.

We currently have opportunities available for anesthesiologists across our network.

## Why you should work here

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

New Brunswick offers an exceptional work?life balance with short commutes, affordable housing, and a relaxed lifestyle surrounded by beaches, forests, and the scenic Bay of Fundy. Physicians benefit from practicing in collaborative, close?knit medical communities supported by the province's two regional health authorities, Horizon and Vitalité.

Consistently ranked as having one of the best qualities of life in Canada, New Brunswick blends vibrant culture with abundant outdoor recreation — making it an ideal place to build both a rewarding medical career and a fulfilling personal life.

## Incentives & Remuneration

Remuneration will be determined in accordance with the specific role and practice location. Additional details will be shared as the recruitment process progresses.

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban or rural recruitment incentive with a return of service.

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

## What you will do

Reporting to the Anesthesiology Department Head and the Medical Director for the area, the Anesthesiologist collaborates with other Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, Registered, Nurses, and other Allied Medical Staff to provide:

• Anesthesiology services in the operating room as required.

• Ambulatory care in a clinic setting.

• Inpatient care including rounds on patients.

• Consultations to hospital-based patients as requested by attending staff.

• Participate in on-call responsibilities as defined by your department.

• Participate in the use of departmental and corporate evidence-based rules of practice to ensure that expected standards of care are achieved.

• Maintain all patient records in the office and the hospital current and in accordance with the Horizon Health Network bylaws, medical staff rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.

• Participate in medical practice that is compatible with the Health Authority's mission, values, and strategic directions.

• Other duties that may arise by circumstance and may be assigned by the Department of Anesthesiology.

## Who you are

• A medical degree is required.

• Certification with the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada in Anesthesiology

• Candidates must be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick.

• Candidates must be eligible for an academic appointment from Dalhousie University.

• Proficiency in English is required. Bilingual skills would be considered an asset.

• In accordance with immigration requirements, preference will be given to Canadian citizens and Permanent Residents of Canada.

## Interested? Apply Today!

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care

CENTRE FOR LEARNING FUTURES
The Centre for Learning Futures at UNB is the university's hub for lifelong learning, supporting community engagement and revenue growth through innovative programming. The Strategic Marketing, Sales & Communication unit drives recruitment, sales, marketing, and retention across a broad portfolio.

## WHAT WE OFFER

## Full-time | 1-year Term | Fredericton | On-Campus

Standard Work Hours: Mon - Fri | 8:15 am - 4:30 pm | 36.25 hours per week

Salary Range: $46,251 - $57,812 per annum

## YOUR FOCUS

Reporting to Assistant Director, Strategic Marketing, Sales & Communication, the Content Marketing Specialist is responsible for planning, creating, and managing high-quality content across digital and print platforms to support marketing campaigns, strengthen brand presence, and meet contractual marketing deliverables for corporate and partner programs. This role guarantees content accuracy, consistency, and engagement while collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders.

• Develop and edit compelling content for a variety of platforms, including advertisements, blogs, social media posts, press releases, and website pages.

• Maintain a consistent brand voice and tone while tailoring messaging to diverse audiences.

• Ensure all content aligns with CLF's strategic marketing objectives, engages readers, and drives conversions.

• Create authentic and engaging narratives that showcase CLF's impact.

• Conduct interviews with learners, partners, and stakeholders to gather testimonials and success stories.

• Support video content development by contributing to storyboards and scripts that bring CLF's programs to life.

• Ensure accuracy and currency of CLF's web presence by reviewing existing content and identifying areas that require updates or improvements.

• Escalate required changes through the appropriate workflow channels.

• Monitor for outdated information, broken links, or inconsistencies and provide clear recommendations to maintain a dynamic, informative, and user-friendly website.

• Plan and manage content calendars to ensure timely delivery of marketing materials for campaigns and initiatives.

• Coordinate with sales and marketing teams to align content with enrollment cycles, promotional events, and strategic priorities.

• Collaborate with graphic designers, digital specialists, and external partners to manage co-branded marketing initiatives.

• Work with corporate clients, partners and internal teams to fulfill contractual marketing deliverables.

• Ensure accuracy and professionalism of all marketing materials through meticulous proofreading and editing.

• Review proposals, campaign content, and translated documents for clarity, grammar, and adherence to brand guidelines.

• Check for consistency across platforms and ensure compliance with accessibility and institutional standards.

• Assist with content audits, review partner materials, and provide input on improvements to content workflows.

• Additional related duties as required to support departmental goals and priorities.

## WHAT YOU BRING

• College diploma in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

• Minimum 3 years in content creation, digital marketing, or related roles.

• An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

## Additional Strengths

• Exceptional writing and editing skills.

• Familiarity with Content Management Systems (CMS) for coordinating website updates.

• Proficiency in social media platforms.

• Strong understanding of SEO and digital marketing best practices.

• Ability to collaborate across teams and manage multiple projects.

• Attention to detail and quality control.

2239686.title: Senior Manager, Marketing & Communications
2239686.description:
The Chalmers Foundation is seeking an experienced marketing and communications professional to lead the Foundation's marketing and communications function as Senior Manager, Marketing & Communications.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, the Senior Manager plays an important leadership role in strengthening the Foundation's reputation, community presence, donor engagement and fundraising success.

This is a broad marketing and communications leadership role. It requires someone who can understand organizational objectives, audiences, and community context; determine how the Foundation should communicate; and translate that strategy into relevant and effective content and campaigns.

The successful candidate will lead the Foundation's marketing and communications strategy, including brand, digital and social media, content, media relations, marketing analytics, and campaign communications. They will work closely with philanthropy and program teams, provide leadership to the Marketing Coordinator, and direct the Foundation's relationship with its external creative agency.

## The opportunity

At the Chalmers Foundation, marketing and communications are closely integrated with philanthropy.

Our work involves telling the stories of donors, healthcare professionals, patients, programs, and healthcare needs across our region. It requires understanding what our audiences need and want to hear, identifying the right stories and channels, and communicating the impact of philanthropy in ways that are credible, relevant, and engaging.

We are therefore looking for someone who brings strategic marketing judgment as well as strong execution capability.

The successful candidate will be expected to challenge assumptions when appropriate, make informed recommendations, use data to improve decisions, and help determine where the Foundation should focus its marketing resources.

## Key responsibilities

The Senior Manager will:

• Develop and lead the Foundation's integrated marketing and communications strategy, annual plan, priorities, budget and KPIs.

• Lead content and audience strategy across social media, digital channels, email, web, print, media and Foundation events.

• Guide the Foundation's social media and digital presence, ensuring content remains relevant to audiences and responsive to changing trends.

• Provide stewardship of the Chalmers Foundation brand and ensure consistency across public and donor communications.

• Work closely with philanthropy and program teams to develop marketing strategies supporting fundraising, stewardship, programs and community engagement.

• Use marketing, digital, social media, website and campaign data to identify insights and recommend changes.

• Lead media relations, news releases and significant public communications.

• Maintain effective communications relationships with Horizon Health Network and other healthcare and community stakeholders.

• Provide leadership, coaching and direction to the Marketing Coordinator.

• Direct the Foundation's relationship with its external creative agency and other marketing partners.

• Develop clear strategic briefs and provide informed direction and feedback on creative work.

• Support executive communications, including presentations, speaking notes and key messages as required.

• Represent the Foundation at appropriate donor, healthcare, community and networking activities.

• Manage marketing expenditures and ensure resources are aligned with organizational priorities.

## The person we are looking for

You will ideally have seven or more years of progressively responsible marketing, communications, or public relations experience.

More important than the number of years is the breadth of your experience.

We want someone who has owned strategy, understood audiences, made marketing decisions, interpreted data, and influenced outcomes. Strong project management is important, but this role requires more than coordinating projects and deliverables.

You should demonstrate:

• Strong strategic marketing and communications judgement

• Excellent writing, presentation and verbal communication skills

• Strong knowledge of digital marketing, social media, content and evolving audience behaviour

• Ability to understand different audiences and translate insights into communications strategy

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn performance data into decisions

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build productive working relationships

• Ability to present recommendations, influence constructively and work through different perspectives

• Adaptability when priorities or circumstances change

• Ability to work effectively within a small, highly collaborative team

• Experience leading or developing employees

• Ability to provide clear direction to agencies, designers and other creative partners

• Professional judgement when dealing with donors, media, healthcare partners and community stakeholders

Experience in healthcare, philanthropy, nonprofit, higher education, public sector, or another stakeholder-intensive environment would be considered an asset.

Experience with CRM platforms, email marketing, digital analytics, and marketing automation tools would also be considered an asset.

## Working at the Chalmers Foundation

The position primarily operates in a professional office environment and requires regular collaboration with Foundation teams and interaction with donors, healthcare partners, the media, community organizations, and other stakeholders.

As part of the Foundation's relationship-building and community engagement activities, the Senior Manager will be expected to attend selected Foundation events, donor activities, networking opportunities, and community engagements outside regular business hours.

The role requires flexibility to respond to changing organizational priorities, emerging communications needs, and time-sensitive opportunities.

## Compensation and Benefits

Salary Band 3: $71,500 to $94,500 annually, with placement within the band determined by qualifications and experience.

The Chalmers Foundation offers a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and wellness benefits, as well as employer-supported retirement benefits.

## Please submit the resume and cover letter in one document.
