2241247.description:
GEOSPATIAL SPECIALIST
OPEN COMPETITION
DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH
PERMANENT
FREDERICTON
(An alternate work location in New Brunswick may be considered)

The Department of Health is seeking an individual to join the Shared Analytics Branch as a Geospatial Specialist in Fredericton.

Reporting to the Manager of Analytics Response Management, the successful candidate will be responsible for designing, testing, and conducting geo-analysis of complex health system issues and identification of population health insights to assist in the planning of current and future Departmental projects. The successful candidate will also be responsible for communicating results and insights to various stakeholders and decision-makers as well as represent the Department on various federal/provincial/territorial, interdepartmental, intradepartmental and multi-stakeholder committees.

As a Geospatial Specialist, you will be responsible for:

• Developing and conducting spatial health analysis using GIS/mapping software;

• Applying statistical, epidemiological, and algorithmic techniques to spatial analysis;

• Providing interpretation of complex data and results;

• Discovering patterns and trends through spatial mapping of data;

• Designing digital maps with geographic data and other data sources;

• Producing reports and presentations of geographic data utilizing data visualizations;

• Preparing large and varied administrative datasets for analysis;

• Manipulating data sets using various statistical and data management software;

• Developing and promoting the Geospatial program and GIS Governance within the health system;

• Participating on GIS working groups and work with data source stakeholders/partners.

Who you are:

• You are comfortable and effective working with executives, external stakeholders, clients and all levels of the organization.

• You are at your best when you are challenged and thrive on getting results.

• You are recognized for your attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to prioritize deliverables.

• You have well-developed writing skills to prepare material where interpretation, analysis, assessment and creativity, requiring the knowledgeable use of terminology and precise articulation of ideas or opinions, is necessary to effectively communicate.

Essential Qualifications:

• Bachelor`s degree in Data Science, Geography, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or Engineering, or a related area;

• A minimum of five (5) years of related work experience to include two (2) years working with large administrative data sets;

• Experience with data manipulation software such as SPSS, SAS, Stata, R, and/or Python and experience with ESRI`s GIS & Mapping tools;

• An equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

• Written and spoken competence in English is required. Please state your language capability on your application.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please ensue that preferred language for assessment is identified on your resume.

In the event that this competition poses difficulties in recruiting a qualified candidate, a covering off appointment at a lower level may be made. In that case, candidates with less than the required related years of experience may also be considered.

Asset Qualifications: Preference may be given to candidates that possess the following asset qualification:

• Experience with Microsoft Power BI

Candidates may be required to demonstrate on their application the asset qualification, in addition to the essential qualifications, in order to be given further consideration.

Behavioural Competencies: The successful candidate will possess the following behavioural competencies:

• Analytical Thinking/Judgment

• Effective Interactive Communication

• Results Orientation

Technical Competencies: The successful candidate will possess the following technical competencies:

• Specialized Subject Matter Expertise and Knowledge

• Knowledge of research methodologies, principles and practices

• Written Communication

Résumés should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

• Free access to Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and services.

• Career growth, development and continuous learning opportunities.

The geriatrician will also contribute to academic and teaching components of our service with opportunities for collaborative research. 2240376.description:
## JOB PURPOSE

The successful candidate will be responsible for promoting, facilitating, and exemplifying the provision of high-quality care as a Primary Health Care NP within their legislated scope of practice as outlined in the provincial Nurses Act, College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB) Entry-Level Competencies for Nurse Practitioners, and the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB) Standards for the Practice of Primary Health Care Nurse Practitioners.

As a member of the interdisciplinary team, the NP provides direct care to scheduled and unscheduled patients across the lifespan with a variety of health conditions. The NP evaluates patient outcomes, provides consultation to, and consults with other team members. The NP also utilizes research, leadership and educator knowledge and skills to support/provide health promotion, illness and injury prevention, and community development initiatives.

## QUALIFICATIONS

• Active registration as a nurse practitioner with the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB).

• Current BCLS.

• Minimum of 1 year of clinical practice experience as a NP within the last 5 years.

• Ability to work independently and in teams; to lead and drive change.

• Demonstrated organizational and leadership skills.

• Demonstrated understanding of privacy and confidentiality, evidence-based nursing practice and mentoring cultures.

• Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.

• Good work and attendance record.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintains an awareness of current trends, issues, and concepts within provincial and national health care, and the NP profession.

• Contributes to process change involving NP practice, for the purpose of increasing efficiency and effectiveness of health services.

• Participates in the development, monitoring, and evaluation of evidence-based protocols/guidelines/standards of care for geriatric patient populations, in collaboration with team members.

• Acts as a consultant to registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, and personal care attendants (resident attendants) as it relates to diagnosing, ordering of tests, and prescribing medications as outlined by the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB).

## Health Assessment and Diagnosis

• Completes a comprehensive health assessment

• Orders, obtains, performs and interprets diagnostic and laboratory screening tests in accordance with the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB) Standards for PHC NPs and within legislation.

• Establishes a diagnosis.

• Initiates appropriate treatment plan in collaboration with the patient/client/family or substitute decision maker and other team members as indicated.

## Therapeutic Management of Acute and Chronic Conditions

• Demonstrates knowledge of current best-practice guidelines for the delivery of care.

• Prescribes, adjusts and renews medications in accordance with legislation, College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB) and employer policy.

• Monitors, evaluates, and alters therapies and/or treatments as appropriate.

• Initiates timely referral or collaboration with other team members, as indicated.

## Health Promotion and Prevention of Illness and Injury

• Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of health promotion services and facilitates primary, secondary and tertiary prevention strategies.

• Incorporates risk reduction and disease and injury prevention strategies.

• As part of the interdisciplinary team, participates in the development and implementation of community/population health interventions as required.

## Professional Responsibility and Accountability

• Maintains the competencies as outlined in the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB) Standards of Practice for Primary Health Care Nurse Practitioners.

• Actively participates as a team member to provide comprehensive care to all patients.

• Exemplifies and promotes excellence in advance practice nursing care.

• Utilizes nursing and other research to support clinical knowledge and evidence-based practice.

• Establishes a network of referral sources to accommodate the provision of care to patients. Referral sources are internal and external to the organization.

• Functions as a resource, preceptor and mentor to Nurse Practitioner students and other health professionals.

• Assumes responsibility for self-directed professional development and participates in professional education activities.

• Participates in the development, monitoring, and evaluation of evidence-based protocols/guidelines/standards of care in collaboration with team members.

• Participates in regular Drug Reviews, Professional Advisory Meetings, Ethics Meetings and Multidisciplinary Care Conferences, or other committees as required.

## COMPETENCIES

• Communication

• Leadership

• Planning and Prioritizing Work

• Teaching/Mentoring

• Teamwork and Collaboration

• Patient/Client Focus

• Nurse Practitioner Competencies as outlined by the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB)

2240517.description:
Job Title: Executive Officer

Location: Moncton, NB

Shift: Mondays to Fridays, 8am-5pm

Wage: $100,000-$120,000 annually

## Position Summary:

The Executive Officer is the chief administrative leader of the Association, responsible for implementing the strategic direction established by the Board of Directors while overseeing all aspects of the Association's operations. Reporting directly to the Board, the Executive Officer provides leadership in governance, financial management, membership engagement, advocacy, communications, events, and organizational development to ensure the Association delivers exceptional value to its members and advances the residential construction industry. This role is a 6month contract with the possibility of permanent hire.

## Key Responsibilities:

• Provide strategic and operational leadership to achieve the Association's mission, goals, and strategic priorities.

• Serve as the primary liaison between the Board of Directors, members, committees, government, industry partners, sponsors, and stakeholders.

• Lead governance activities by supporting Board and committee meetings, implementing Board decisions, maintaining corporate records, and ensuring compliance with applicable legislation, bylaws, and policies.

• Oversee the Association's financial operations, including budgeting, financial reporting, cash flow management, audits, and sound financial controls.

• Develop and implement strategies to recruit, retain, and engage members while delivering high-quality member services and support.

• Lead government relations and advocacy initiatives by monitoring industry issues, building relationships with elected officials, and representing the Association on matters affecting the residential construction sector.

• Direct all communications, marketing, public relations, website content, social media, newsletters, and member communications to strengthen the Association's profile and engagement.

• Provide leadership and oversight for Association events, sponsorships, programs, and the successful delivery of the annual Home Show and other signature initiatives.

• Recruit, mentor, supervise, and develop staff and contractors while fostering a collaborative, high-performing workplace culture.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with industry partners, community organizations, sponsors, and affiliated associations.

• Support long-term organizational sustainability through strategic planning, policy development, performance measurement, operational improvements, and succession planning.

• Prepare reports, presentations, recommendations, and correspondence while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and member service.

## Qualifications:

The ideal candidate is a collaborative and strategic leader with experience in association management, business administration, nonprofit leadership, or a related field. They possess strong financial acumen, governance knowledge, relationship-building skills, and exceptional communication abilities. Experience working with Boards of Directors, government stakeholders, and member-based organizations is considered an asset.

## Core Competencies

• Executive leadership and organizational management

• Bilingual in French and English

• Governance and Board relations

• Financial planning and fiscal stewardship

• Strategic planning and execution

• Membership engagement and stakeholder relations

• Government relations and advocacy

• Communications, marketing, and public relations

• Event and program management

• Human resource leadership

• Strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills

This is a dynamic leadership opportunity for an experienced professional who is passionate about serving members, building industry partnerships, and leading a respected organization that supports and advocates for the residential construction industry. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational management and requires a collaborative, results-oriented approach.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centers around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's License (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

## Job Posting Information

Engineer I-IV
Current and Future Regular positions
Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada
Competition # E22278-2026

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for new members to join us.

The Mactaquac Generating Station began generating electricity in 1968. Since the 1980s, concrete portions of the hydro station have been affected by a chemical reaction called alkali-aggregate reaction (AAR). The reaction causes the concrete to swell and crack and has required substantial annual maintenance and repairs. NB Power is proposing a project to ensure the station can operate to its intended 100-year lifespan with a modified approach to maintenance and adjusting and replacing equipment and concrete overtime.

As part of the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project, the Engineer I-IV will be responsible for supporting all aspects of design and construction of project work. This includes ensuring NB Power is prepared to complete the preliminary designs required and overseeing and coordinating all design and construction work performed by external consultants to ensure safety, environment, quality, efficiency, and compliance with organizational standards.

## Mechanical Engineering key functions include:

• Review design and oversee installation and commissioning of turbines, hydraulic gates, large cranes, and mechanical systems such as HVAC, fire protection, and drainage.

• Provide field support during construction, managing Request for Information (RFIs), contractor quality, and adapting to changed conditions.

• Collaborate across project phases with all stakeholders (internal and external), contributing technical expertise from planning through close-out.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechanical Engineering

• Registered Professional Engineer licensed in New Brunswick or eligible for immediate transfer

• Six years of experience with any of large hydraulic gate design and installation, large cranes, turbines, Balance of Plant mechanical systems (fire protection, drainage, piping, pumps, HVAC) as well as mechanical/instrumentation construction oversight

• Participation in design teams during planning, detailed design, execution, and close-out phases of mega-projects

• Providing technical guidance during construction, including responding to RFIs, coordinating contractor quality programs, handling changed conditions and knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and industry best practices

## Civil Engineering key functions include:

• Review design and oversee construction of reinforced concrete and structural steel components, ensuring integrity and compliance.

• Review design and oversee construction of earthworks and dam-related activities, applying geotechnical insights and mitigation strategies for AAR concrete effects.

• Support construction execution, resolving RFIs and maintaining quality standards throughout the project lifecycle.

• Collaborate across project phases with all stakeholders (internal and external), contributing technical expertise from planning through close-out.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Civil Engineering

• Registered Professional Engineer licensed in New Brunswick or eligible for immediate transfer

• Six years of experience with reinforced concrete and structural steel design and construction along with civil construction oversight

• Participation in design teams during planning, detailed design, execution, and close-out phases of mega-projects

• Providing technical guidance during construction, including responding to RFIs, coordinating contractor quality programs, handling changed conditions and knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and industry best practices

## Electrical Engineering key functions include:

• Review designs and oversee implementation and commissioning of electrical distribution and control systems, general Balance of Plant equipment, and SCADA, generator protection, and communications.

• Guide electrical construction activities, addressing RFIs, overseeing quality programs, and managing field changes.

• Contribute to hydroelectric equipment integration, ensuring safe and efficient operation from design to commissioning.

• Collaborate across project phases with all stakeholders (internal and external), contributing technical expertise from planning through close-out.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering

• Registered Professional Engineer licensed in New Brunswick or eligible for immediate transfer

• Six years of experience in AC and DC electrical distribution, communications systems (fire protection, access control, SCADA), generator protection and control systems as well as electrical/instrumentation construction oversight

• Participation in design teams during planning, detailed design, execution, and close-out phases of mega-projects

• Providing technical guidance during construction, including responding to RFIs, coordinating contractor quality programs, handling changed conditions and knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, and industry best practices

## The following are considered assets:

• Hydro project experience

• Experience with turbine design and installation

• Penstock or large diameter piping and welding programs

• Earthworks and embankment dam design and construction

• Experience with hydroelectric generation equipment (e.g., generators)

• Experience with AAR concrete effects on mechanical, civil, or electrical equipment

• Brownfield or overhaul project experience

Note: If no candidates are identified who meet all of the above requirements, applicants with fewer years of experience may be considered.

Please note that during the initial phase of the project, positions will be based at Head Office. As the project advances, the primary work location will transition to the Mactaquac Generating Station.

An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

An Eligibility List generated from this competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level within a period of up to 12 months.

## We care for our team, and as a member you will have access to:

• Health & Dental plans that provide flexible options to meet your needs

• Health Spending Account, allowing for further flexibility

• New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan, offering retirement financial security

• Wellness options, including our Employee Family Assistance Program

Candidates with foreign education credentials are required to provide proof of Canadian equivalency. Any applicable fees are the responsibility of the candidate. For more information, you may refer to the Canadian Information Centre of International Credentials

To be considered for this employment opportunity you must be eligible to work in Canada.

For questions concerning this job opening please contact Holly Tissington at careers@nbpower.com .

The Department of Post-Secondary Education, Training and Labour is seeking an individual to join the Policy, Research and Labour Market Analysis Branch, as a Senior Researcher in Fredericton.

The Policy, Research and Labour Market Analysis Branch is responsible for advancing the Department's strategic policy direction, while ensuring consistency with Government priorities and activities. The Branch is responsible for leading policy development related to industrial relations and employment standards, accessibility, employment development, population growth, adult learning, student financial assistance, and post-secondary education issues; and for providing labour market information, leading research projects and program monitoring and evaluation activities.

The Policy, Research and Labour Market Analysis Branch is also responsible for planning, monitoring, and developing all Departmental Memoranda to the Executive Council, including legislative and regulatory activities, appointments to Agencies, Boards, and Commissions, and holds responsibility for the Accessibility Office.

## ROLE

The successful candidate will play a vital role in fulfilling the responsibilities of the Branch with regards to research and evaluation of programs across the department. The successful candidate will be responsible to plan and lead key monitoring and evaluation projects which provide accountability measures and key indicators for the Department.

## RESPONSIBILITIES

Working collaboratively, the Senior Researcher supports evidence-informed decision making and accountability across the department in two key ways.

• Executing program evaluation and general research and analysis, including,

• Development and maintenance of evaluation plans aligned to departmental and program needs.

• Planning and managing projects, including those with external consultants.

• Developing recruitment and sampling plans.

• Developing or validating various research instruments for use, including surveys and research protocols.

• Conducting internal data analysis and reporting.

2) Providing advice, guidance and support across the department and government. This includes:

• Developing evaluation frameworks and plans for programs and services across the department.

• Advising on appropriate KPIs and measurement methodologies, ensuring relevance and utility.

• Representing the department on committees and evaluation working groups related to agreements (e.g. Workforce Development Agreement, Provincial Nominee Program Agreement), and assisting with external evaluations mandated under Federal government agreements.

• Advising on research methods and approaches.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS: A bachelor`s degree in business/public administration, education, social sciences or other related discipline and a minimum of five (5) years of related experience in research and evaluation. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and the Microsoft Office environment.

OR

a master`s degree in public administration, business administration, education, social sciences or a related field and a minimum of (3) three years of related experience in research and evaluation. Strong proficiency in MS Excel and the Microsoft Office environment.

An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Candidates with an appropriate mix of skills and qualifications may be considered for underfilling the position.

Written and spoken competence in English is required. Please state your language capability.

ASSET QUALIFICATIONS: Preference may be given to candidates who have:

• Experience leading and conducting multi-faceted evaluation research or general research projects.

• Attained a Credentialed Evaluator or equivalent designation.

• A strong foundation in quantitative, qualitative, and mixed methods research.

• Familiarity with research software, such as SPSS, R, Limesurvey, or NVivo.

2240424.title: Quality Assurance Assistant
2240424.description:
Company: Shediac Lobster Shop Ltd.
Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control
Reports To: Quality Assurance Manager
Industry: Seafood / Lobster Processing

The Quality Assurance Assistant position is responsible for overseeing the monitoring of product and production activities to ensure lobster products meet established food safety, quality, regulatory and customer requirements. Assist the Quality Assurance Manager with reviews, audits, verification and trend analysis, CAPA preparation, coordinating implementation and verification activities associated with implemented CAPA plans.

The QA employee performs verification on routine inspections, checks, monitoring and documentation throughout production and identifies product or process issues requiring attention, correction or escalation. QA Assistant also works closely with QC technicians and leads to ensure accuracy and compliance. The position works closely with all departments, reports quality or food safety concerns to the Quality Assurance Manager and assists in the resolution of those concerns.

## Key Responsibilities

## Production & Product Monitoring

• Conduct routine verifications of quality checks throughout production.

• Inspect raw materials, work-in-process and finished products for compliance with established specifications.

• Monitor product quality, condition, appearance and other required product characteristics.

• Verify that products meet applicable customer and company specifications.

• Review defects, deviations or unacceptable product for compliance corrective actions.

• Communicate quality concerns immediately to Production and/or the QA Manager.

• Assist in preventing non-conforming product from being released.

## Food Safety & Process Controls

• Review and verify food safety and process monitoring activities.

• Temperatures and other established process controls.

• Verify that required production and food safety checks are completed at the required frequency against records and recording activities.

• Observe employee compliance with GMPs, hygiene and food-handling requirements.

• Report food safety concerns or deviations immediately.

• Assist and oversee verification of sanitation processes and results.

## Product Specifications & Label Verification

• Verify product against applicable specifications.

• Ensure labels and packaging for accuracy.

• Identify incorrect or non-compliant labels or packaging before product is released.

• Correct and report specification or labeling discrepancies to the QA Manager.

## Non-Conforming Product

• Assist in controls of non-conforming products and equipment.

• Place or assist in placing affected product on HOLD according to company procedures.

• Clearly identify and segregate held or non-conforming products.

• Control deviations and notify the QA Manager and Production.

• Assist with product evaluation, reinspection and corrective actions as directed.

• Verify corrections when assigned before affected production continues or product is released.

## Records & Documentation

• Accurately complete assigned QC monitoring forms and records.

• Record inspection results, temperatures, product checks and deviations.

• Ensure records are completed at the time monitoring occurs.

• Document corrective actions taken when required.

• Maintain clear, accurate and legible records.

• Submit completed records to the QA Manager according to established procedures.

• Review, organize and when required verify documents and records.

## Traceability & Product Control

• Assist with traceability activities and product identification.

• Support product hold, release and recall activities when required.

• Assist the QA Manager with traceability exercises and product investigations.

## Communication

• Communicate quality and food safety concerns promptly and professionally.

• Work cooperatively with all departments in addressing, and implementing corrective and preventative actions.

• Escalate significant or repeated deviations to the QA Manager.

• Provide factual information regarding quality findings and production observations.

## Authority

Quality Assurance Assistant personnel have authority and responsibility to:

• Identify and report food safety or quality concerns.

• Request correction of identified product or process deviations.

• Place or recommend product be placed on HOLD when requirements are not met.

• Escalate unresolved or significant issues to the QA Manager.

• Stop or request the stopping of an affected process when there is an immediate food safety or serious product compliance concern.

Final disposition of significant non-conforming product and decisions involving regulatory compliance, program changes or customer requirements remain under the authority of the QA Manager and/or designated management.

## Skills & Qualifications

The QA Assistant employee should demonstrate:

• Strong attention to detail.

• Ability to follow written procedures and product specifications.

• Ability to accurately complete records and documentation.

• Good communication and organizational skills.

• Ability to identify, report and correct product defects or deviations.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced seafood production environment.

• Understanding of GMPs, food safety and quality requirements.

• Ability to work independently while escalating issues appropriately.

• Competent in Microsoft Word and Excel.

• Understanding of food safety fundamentals, HACCP and GFSI standards.

Training will be provided on applicable company food safety programs, product specifications, monitoring procedures, documentation requirements and responsibilities.

English Language Requirement: Strong written and verbal English skills are required, with the ability to read and write clearly accurately.

## Overall Responsibility

The primary responsibility of QA Assistant is to oversee inspection and monitoring activities, identify and document product and process deviations so that problems are addressed before non-conforming product is released. The QA Manager manages the quality system; QA Assistant verifies the continual day to day implementation of the program along with the QC technicians to ensure continuing compliance.

EDDY GROUP LIMITED "Maritime Owned and Operated"

Eddy Group Limited is a Maritime-based wholesale distributor and proud member of "Canada's Best Managed Companies". Eddy Group Limited has been a trusted partner in the construction industry for over a century. As a family business now in its fifth generation, we are all about providing top-notch products, personalized solutions, and great service to our industrial, commercial, and residential customers.

As part of our Head Office Sales team, the New Brunswick IAC Sales Representative will be responsible for developing and supporting Eddy Group Limited's Industrial Automation and Controls (IAC) business throughout New Brunswick and Prince Edward Island. This position serves as a resource for Eddy Group's branch sales teams and customers, providing product expertise, solution support, opportunity development and technical guidance.

Working collaboratively with the Branch sales teams, the IAC Specialist will help identify IAC opportunities, develop customer relationships, support quotations and product selections, and assist in converting opportunities into profitable sales.

The successful candidate will build strong relationships with customers, suppliers and Eddy Group employees while developing a strong understanding of the IAC product portfolio and the applications in which those products are used.

## What you'll do:

• Develop and grow IAC sales throughout New Brunswick and Prince Edward Island in alignment with Eddy Group's sales and business objectives.

• Identify, qualify and pursue new IAC business opportunities with existing and prospective customers.

• Develop and maintain strong, profitable customer relationships.

• Work with customers to understand their applications, challenges and requirements and recommend appropriate IAC products and solutions.

• Conduct customer visits, site visits and sales calls throughout New Brunswick and Prince Edward Island as required.

• Maintain regular contact with key IAC customers and identify opportunities for additional products and services.

• Prepare for and conduct customer presentations, product demonstrations and meetings.

• Develop opportunities from initial inquiry through quotation, follow-up and successful sale.

• Work with suppliers and manufacturers to identify products, pricing, technical information and solutions for customer requirements.

• Assist branch salespeople with IAC product selection, applications, specifications and customer requirements.

• Assist with complex IAC quotations, product recommendations and solution development.

• Participate in customer calls with branch salespeople where specialized IAC knowledge would add value.

• Provide guidance to branch employees without taking ownership of the customer relationship away from the branch salesperson.

• Help branch sales teams become more knowledgeable and confident in selling IAC products.

## Qualifications and key competencies:

• Post-secondary education in business, sales, engineering technology, electrical, automation, controls or a related field is considered an asset.

• Minimum five years of experience in wholesale distribution, electrical, automation, controls, industrial or related industries.

• Strong knowledge of IAC products, applications and solutions.

• Previous experience in a sales, technical sales, applications or customer-support capacity.

• Experience working with industrial customers and understanding their operational requirements.

• Strong ability to develop and maintain customer relationships.

• Demonstrated ability to identify sales opportunities and convert them into profitable business.

• Strong product knowledge combined with the ability to understand and communicate technical information.

• Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work effectively with both customers and internal sales teams.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently while remaining highly collaborative.

• Strong business acumen, including an understanding of pricing, gross profit and customer profitability.

• Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

## Why join the Eddy Group?

• Health, drug, dental, life insurance, dependent life insurance, AD&D, EFAP and LTD Benefits.

• Vehicle allowance and gas cards for business purposes.

• Defined Contribution Pension Plan (4% Employee and 2% Employer Match).

• Earn quarterly and annual commissions for your hard work.

• Join a dynamic, results-driven team where collaboration is key, and success is the norm.

• Experience a winning culture that makes you proud.

• Eddy Group has family values and treats its employees that way.

This is a full-time position that may be located anywhere in New Brunswick with preference for individuals located near Eddy Group Ltd locations. Regular business hours are from 7:00 am to 5:00 pm, Monday to Friday, however, occasional work outside these hours should be expected.

Annual base salary will be commensurate with your experience.

Eddy Group Limited

2200 Vanier Blvd.
Bathurst, NB E2A 4A1
Attention: Pat King, Human Resources Manager
e-mail: pat.king@eddygroup.com

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

Hours of work: 4 to 12 hours per week

Closing date: October 5, 2026

## Position description

The Access and Events Assistant works closely with the full-time staff of the Owens Art Gallery and plays a vital role supporting access initiatives and public events at the Gallery. This position encompasses four, interrelated, public-focused areas of work: the Owens' Visitor Services; event set-up and support; facilitating Play Atelier, a pop-up space for open-ended sensory and creative play linked to Make Something Sunday workshops; and maintaining access resources at the Gallery, such as Art Kits and sensory supports (e.g., ear defenders, fidgets, sensory kits, etc.). This is a part-time, casual position with one, regular, four-hour weekday shift per week, plus additional hours up to a maximum of twelve per week, primarily on evenings and weekends. The term of the position runs from 15 August to 15 May.

## Responsibilities

• Work one four-hour shift per week at the Owens' Welcome Desk, which includes greeting visitors, providing information on current exhibitions, answering and transferring phone calls, and monitoring gallery security

• Set up and take down tables, chairs and audio-visual equipment for events, including external bookings

• Work at the Welcome Desk during select after-hours events

• Be "on call" for Welcome Desk shifts during the week and on weekends

• Set up, host, and put away Play Atelier for Make Something Sunday, a monthly program of informal hands-on workshops for kids twelve and under and their adults

• Attend planning meetings and assist with material prep ahead of Make Something Sunday programs

• Disinfect and maintain access resources, such as fidgets and sensory kits

• Assist with the Sweetest Little Thing annual fundraiser

• Assist with Owens events and external bookings as needed

## Qualifications/skills

• An undergraduate degree in Art History, Fine Arts, or Museum and Curatorial Studies or equivalent relevant experience

• A minimum of two years' experience providing educational programs to children and working with the public

• Knowledge of contemporary art and artistic practices

• Strong communications skills in English, with working French considered an asset

• Comfortable working in a dynamic environment and confident responding to the varying needs of art gallery visitors

• Comfortable maintaining a positive and welcoming atmosphere for visitor experience while also preserving the safety of works of art

• Punctuality, reliability, attention to detail, and demonstrated organizational skills

• Comfortable with moderate physical activity required for the setup and takedown of events

• Previous experience working with audio-visual equipment is considered an asset

2237362.title: Project Manager - ITSM
2237362.description:
WHO WE ARE
Mariner innovates always and everywhere, turning novel ideas into practical solutions. From products and services to venture creation, we build better futures powered by people. Our purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company for those who make an impact - elevating people, data, and technology in the best way to solve hard problems. We partner with people embracing change, leveraging data, cybersecurity, cloud, and change management to drive successful business outcomes that matter to our customers.

Mariners build for change. Like SHIFT Energy, our energy management and decarbonization company. Or East Valley created to scale social economic impact in our communities through investment and mentorship of emerging change-makers and their companies.

Mariner s purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company and the core values that guide us every day are:

## OUR VALUES

• We care for our team.

• We care about the impact we have on our community.

• We serve by solving complex problems.

• We grow because growth fuels opportunities.

• We innovate always and everywhere.

• We build a business that lasts.

## OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager or Business Analyst with strong IT Service Management (ITSM) experience to support the implementation and improvement of ITSM capabilities within a client environment. The role will work across business, IT, security, and technical teams to define requirements, improve service management processes, and support implementation, with a focus on security request handling, workflow automation, and efficient service delivery.

## WHAT YOU LL BE DOING IN THE ROLE

• Support the planning, implementation, and enhancement of ITSM processes, capabilities, and supporting technology

• Assess current-state service management processes and identify gaps, opportunities, and areas for improvement

• Work with business, IT, security, and technical stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements

• Define future-state processes, workflows, roles, responsibilities, and service management requirements

• Support ITSM processes such as incident, service request, change, problem, and related service management practices

• Define and improve security request handling, including request intake, routing, approvals, escalation, tracking, and fulfillment

• Identify opportunities to automate service requests, security requests, approvals, notifications, routing, and other repeatable workflows

• Facilitate stakeholder workshops and working sessions to align on requirements, processes, priorities, and implementation decisions

• Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and technology-enabled workflows

• Coordinate implementation activities across business, technical, security, and vendor teams

• Support project planning, scope and schedule management, risk and issue management, status reporting, and stakeholder communications

• Support testing, validation, deployment, documentation, change readiness, and adoption of new ITSM processes

## WHAT SKILLS / QUALIFICATIONS YOU LL NEED TO DO THE JOB

• 5+ years of experience in Project Management, Business Analysis, IT Service Management, with demonstrated experience supporting ITSM implementations or process improvement initiatives.

• Demonstrated experience supporting or leading ITSM implementations, transformations, or process improvement initiatives

• Strong understanding of ITSM principles and processes, including incident, request, change, and problem management

• Strong background in assessing current-state processes, gathering requirements, facilitating stakeholder workshops, and designing practical future-state workflows

• Proven ability to plan and coordinate technology implementations, including scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and issues

• Hands-on experience designing service request workflows, including approvals, escalations, fulfillment, and security-related processes within an ITSM environment

• Ability to identify and implement opportunities for workflow automation and process improvement

• Experience supporting initiatives through requirements, design, testing, deployment, change readiness, and adoption

• Ability to work effectively across business, IT, security, technical, and vendor teams

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC Helix, Freshservice, or similar is considered an asset

• ITIL, PMP, PRINCE2, CBAP, CCBA, or related certifications are considered assets

• Experience with cybersecurity or information security processes, workflow automation, or client-facing consulting environments is considered an asset.

## AND YOU ARE...

• Always improving your skills and knowledge: you want to be the best at what you do

• Curious and creative; comfortable taking on new problems and challenges

• A self-starter with the ability to recommend priorities to the project leader

• Comfortable working through problems and figuring things out with minimal supervision

• Great problem-solving skills: thorough and reliable

• Able to work in a team: share knowledge and assist other team members

• A good communicator: able to explain your ideas and recommendations

• Well organized and dependable under pressure: you manage your time effectively

• Energized by our company values!

## MARINER OFFERS YOU:

• A values-driven workplace where people really matter

• Hybrid work environment.

• Competitive salary, retirement savings program, and rewards program

• Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans and access to e-health care

• Paid vacation, maternity/parental leave, paid sick leave and paid Mariner MyLife days

• Unlimited training

## WHY MARINER?

We believe in making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work! Not only are we passionate about nurturing a thriving technology sector here in Atlantic Canada, but we are also committed to solving technology challenges that will make an impact worldwide. Technology is everlasting, and we take pride in connecting world class talent to world class projects and business solutions.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2239474.title: Travel Consultant
2239474.description:
## Travel Consultant

On Site Training | Work From Home Opportunities | Starting at $21/hour + bonus potential

## Helping People Through the Moments That Matter

Travel doesn't always go according to plan.

Flights get cancelled. Weather disrupts plans. Connections are missed. Things don't always go as expected.

When that happens, our customers need more than someone to answer the call. They need someone who can listen, understand what matters most, and confidently guide them towards a solution.

As a Travel Consultant, you'll help our customers book, manage and modify their travel arrangements while delivering the exceptional service they expect. Whether you're helping a customer rebook a flight, adjust hotel reservations, navigate a travel disruption, or maximize the benefits available to them, you'll play an important role in turning stressful situations into positive experiences.

This isn't just about booking travel. It's about building trust, solving problems, and making customers feel genuinely supported when they need it most.

If you're someone who loves helping people, communicates naturally, and can stay focused when things get busy, we'd love to meet you!

## Why You'll Love Working Here

At Cloud5, we believe great customer experiences start with great people.

We'll provide the training, coaching, and support you need to succeed, even if you've never worked in travel before. You'll develop valuable customer service, communication, consulting, and problem-solving skills while working alongside a team that genuinely supports one another.

No two days are exactly the same. You'll tackle new challenges, connect with different customers, and continuously build skills that will benefit you throughout your career.

## No travel experience? No problem!

If you have strong customer service skills, enjoy helping people, and are passionate about creating positive customer experiences, we'll provide the training to help you succeed.

## Why Join Us?

· $21/hour starting wage with quarterly bonus potential

· Shift premiums across various hours/days

· Work from home opportunities following successful completion of training

· Employee referral bonus of up to $500 per successful candidate

· Medical & Vision benefits after 3 months

· Dental coverage after 6 months

· RRSP and TFSA options

· Company RRSP match up to 3 percent after 1 year

· Paid training and ongoing coaching to help you succeed

· Career growth opportunities within a growing organization

· Access to various travel perks and discounts

## What You'll Do

· Help customers book, manage, modify and troubleshoot travel arrangements

· Resolve travel-related issues and provide solutions during disruptions and unexpected situations

· Communicate with customers by phone to understand their needs and provide personalized support

· Demonstrate the value and benefits available to the customer

· Consult with customers to identify the best available options based on their unique circumstances

· Coordinate with travel suppliers and partners to secure travel arrangements and resolve issues

· Research solutions, troubleshoot challenges, and think creatively when standard options aren't available

· Maintain a calm, professional, and empathetic approach during complex or high-pressure situations

· Deliver a consistently exceptional customer experience while meeting service expectations

## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Success in this role isn't measured by how much you know about travel on day one. It's measured by how well you listen, solve problems, and create positive experiences for customers.

## You may be a great fit if you:

· Connect naturally with people and build rapport easily

· Are an active listener who takes the time to understand customer needs

· Lead conversations with empathy, professionalism, and confidence

· Enjoy troubleshooting and finding solutions to complex problems

· Can balance customer needs with program guidelines and available options

· Stay calm and resourceful when handling challenging situations

· Are highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks at once

· Communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing

· Are comfortable using technology and navigating multiple systems simultaneously

· Have a positive attitude, growth mindset and genuine desire to help others

Experience in customer service, hospitality, travel, contact center, or other service-focused environments is considered an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates who demonstrate strong communication skills, curiosity, and a customer first mindset.

Cloud5 Communications is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. We will never request a fee or payment from candidates. Please do not provide any personal or financial information to anyone you suspect of recruitment fraud.

## How to Identify Recruitment Fraud:

• You receive a message on WhatsApp or another online messaging platform

• You are asked to provide a fee or payment (we will NEVER request payment from candidates)

• Our email communication will only ever come from a @Cloud5.com domain or @msg.paycomonline.com domain. We will never contact you through Gmail or any other free online mail service

• Cross reference the recruiter's name and contact information on LinkedIn or by contacting corphr@cloud5.com

• If you are still unsure call 1 (877) 241-2516

2201260.title: Horizon Communications Team General Application
2201260.description:
## Join Horizon Health Network's Communications and Marketing Team

Are you a storyteller at heart with a passion for strategic communications and/or marketing? Are you looking for meaningful work that allows you to make a real difference in the lives of New Brunswickers?

Horizon's Communications and Marketing portfolio is looking for talented and enthusiastic professionals to join our growing and fast-paced team!

If you're a communications and/or marketing professional who is energized by collaboration, motivated by purpose, and thrive on bringing clarity to complex issues, this is the opportunity you've been waiting for.

## About Us

The Communications team is responsible for internal and external strategic communications, digital channels, and media relations.

The Marketing team is responsible for brand management, campaigns, social media, creative services (design and videography), and translation services.

Together, we tell the stories of how Horizon staff, physicians, volunteers and patients, clients and family members are working to improve health care in our province and help ensure New Brunswickers have the information they need about their health care services.

Our team members have meaningful influence with health care leaders within Horizon, helping guide the organization through complex and challenging situations involving various internal and external stakeholders.

## About Our Opportunities

We're looking to meet with experienced communications and marketing professionals with a passion for sharing positive stories on numerous platforms with engaged and diverse audiences.

We have opportunities that will allow you to gain experience and expertise in a multitude of communications and marketing channels and work with health care providers, leadership and support personnel from across our organization.

Our work is fast-paced and rewarding, and every day on the job is different!

Working at Horizon provides you with a compensation package that is more than a base salary. You will be part of the public service, which provides access to health and dental, government pension, sick time, and vacation time, starting at three (3) weeks. Living outside the province? We offer a relocation allowance of up to $5,000.

## What You'll Do:

As a member of our collaborative team, you'll:

• Contribute to the planning and delivery of strategic communications and marketing projects that support Horizon's goals.

• Develop content and assets across multiple channels and formats, aligned with audience needs and Horizon's goals and brand standards.

• Collaborate with colleagues, leaders, and partners to deliver innovative, people-centred communication and marketing strategies.

• Manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.

• Help bring Horizon's stories to life – stories of innovation, care, research and the people behind them.

## What We're Looking For:

We're not looking for a perfect fit – we're looking for the right fit. If you bring some of the following skills and experience, we want to hear from you:

• Strategic thinker with at least 1 year of experience in communications, marketing, creative services, digital channels or a related field.

• Strong storytelling and content development skills, which may include writing, visual, digital, or multimedia formats, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.

• Ability to juggle competing priorities and meet tight deadlines with professionalism and creativity.

• Experience using a wide range of tools, platforms, and channels, including digital, social media.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills – a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment.

• Self-starter who takes initiative, follows through, and gets things done.

## Nice-to-haves

• Experience in health care, public sector, or a complex organization.

• Exposure to issues management, crisis response, or high-profile, time-sensitive work.

• Familiarity with analytics, performance measurement, and reporting related to communications, marketing or digital channels.

## Why Join Horizon?

Because what we do matters. As one of the largest health care organizations in Atlantic Canada, our communications team plays a critical role in informing, engaging and inspiring our communities, patients, staff and partners.

You'll join a highly supportive team that values creativity, collaboration and compassion, all while contributing to something bigger than yourself.

Ready to Apply?
Even if you're not sure you check every box – apply anyway. We want to hear from you.

Let's start a conversation.

Apply today and help shape the future of health care communications in New Brunswick.

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

2239944.description:
Competition number: 26-093

Salary: $56,082.00 - $61,655.00/Year Job Type: Permanent Full Time Closing Date: September 26, 2026 Position Overview:
Do you like working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment? Do you enjoy a job where you get to interact with everyone, and no two days are ever the same?

Join us as a Customer Experience Representative!

You are someone who likes to help people. You are cheerful, well-organized, empathetic, and calm. Maybe you would like to broaden and vary your experience in office administration and work somewhere where you will both serve the public and make connections with lots of different colleagues who do a wide variety of work.

You could make an ideal Customer Experience Representative! And we are actively seeking a CSR to join our team!

Here's the job:

•As CSR you will be the face and voice of the City of Saint John - the very first stop for in-person visitors to City Hall, and to Saint Johners (citizens and organizations) calling on the phone with questions.

•You need to be quick, efficient, effective, creative, and always pleasant, as you locate and share the information or refer to the department that the visitor or caller needs.

•In between serving these clients, you will coordinate mail distribution and do a variety of admin tasks.

•Above all, you will foster positive relationships with your City colleagues and between the City and citizens/other organizations, by providing high-quality front-line communications.

Here's what we offer you:

•Competitive salary.

•Training opportunities.

•A chance to make many connections, use your creativity, and increase your professional value.

Here's what we need from you:

•A diploma in Office Administration from community college or a Business Certificate from university.

•At least one year of experience in a customer service-focused role.

•Proficiency in Microsoft Office Systems.

•Bilingualism is a requirement.

If this sounds like you, get in touch. We ask for only one year of experience, but perhaps you have five years' experience - or 20! - and you want a new challenge.

## Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we live and which we serve. We encourage and support applications from Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and members of visible minority groups. Candidates who belong to such groups, who are qualified, will be given preference at the time of selection.

Applications will be accepted through our online system only. Qualified applicants should submit their cover letters and resumes to:

City of Saint John

Attn: Hiring Committee

www.saintjohn.ca (careers)

Only those applicants being considered further will be contacted.

2233495.description:
## Job Title: Bilingual Director of Operations

## Location: Flexible location within New Brunswick

## TP-JDS-9845

Meridia Recruitment is working with J.D. Irving, Limited (JDI) to recruit a Bilingual Director of Operations to support a broad portfolio of industrial operations across its Woodlands and Sawmill network. This is a senior leadership opportunity designed to strengthen operational capability, drive performance across complex production systems, and build long-term leadership depth within the organization.

## Role Description

The Director of Operations will be responsible for leading and influencing large-scale, multi-site industrial operations, with accountability for safety, productivity, cost performance, and continuous improvement. This role operates across interconnected manufacturing and resource-based systems, ensuring alignment between upstream supply, operational execution, and downstream production outcomes. This is a highly data-driven and performance-oriented role, requiring strong analytical capability and the ability to translate operational metrics into clear actions on the ground. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across multiple facilities, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving consistency in execution across diverse operating environments.

The structure of the role is intentionally flexible and may vary depending on the background of the successful candidate. It may suit individuals coming from manufacturing, forestry, heavy industry, or other large-scale production environments with experience leading multi-site operations.

## Your Qualifications

• Bilingual proficiency in French and English (spoken and written) is required

• 10+ years of leadership experience in industrial, manufacturing, forestry, or other complex production environments

• Proven experience managing multi-site or large-scale operations

• Strong background in operations management, production systems, or engineering-led environments

• Experience leading supervisors, managers, and cross-functional operational teams

• Demonstrated ability to drive KPI performance, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement

• Strong financial and business acumen, including budgeting and forecasting experience

• High level of analytical capability with a data-driven approach to decision-making

• Strong leadership presence with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization

• Experience in safety-critical, high-output operational environments

• Engineering or technical background considered an asset

• Willingness to travel regularly across operational sites

This is a high-impact leadership role within J.D. Irving, Limited's operations network, offering exposure to some of the most complex integrated industrial systems in Atlantic Canada. The successful candidate will play a key role in strengthening operational performance, developing leadership capability, and supporting the long-term growth of the organization's operations leadership pipeline.

To express interest in this opportunity please apply online by clicking "Apply Now" below.

For more information contact Thomas Pugh, Partner, at 902-818-4506 and tpugh@kbrs.ca or Heather Simmons, Consultant at 902-421-2335 and hsimmons@kbrs.ca. If you require accommodation to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know.

Meridia Recruitment Solutions connects leading organizations with top talent by building strong relationships and creating ideal matches with candidates because we are only successful when you are. We appreciate your interest in this opportunity.

To learn more about Meridia Recruitment Solutions, our job opportunities, and career advice we invite you to explore our site and subscribe for career alerts.
