Strategic Project AdvisorDepartment of Environment and Local Government Pay Band 6 Open CompetitionFredericton

Interested in making a difference in our province? We encourage you to Choose GNB!

## Who we are?

The work we do has a positive impact on our communities and helps improve the everyday lives of New Brunswickers. Together, we are over 45,000 New Brunswickers who are passionate problem-solvers, who make a difference and are proud to call New Brunswick home.

The Corporate Services and Strategic Investments Division supports the department by providing financial, human resources, strategic planning, project support, and information management services. This division also administers several funding programs that support local, regional, environmental and climate priorities. The division is responsible for the development and tracking of the Climate Change Action Plan and management of the Climate Change Fund and the Output Based Pricing System.

The Department of Environment and Local Government provides leadership in environmental management and addressing climate change while supporting strong local governance and vibrant communities throughout New Brunswick.

Our vision: Working together for a healthy environment and vibrant communities.

Our mission statement: We are dedicated to safeguarding and enhancing the environment while fostering vibrant, sustainable and resilient communities through environmental stewardship, evidence-based approaches and supporting effective local governance.

For more information, please go to our website: Department of Environment and Local Government - gnb.ca

## What will you do?

Reporting to the Director of Strategy, Performance Excellence and Engagement Branch, the Strategic Project Advisor is responsible for identifying, enhancing and sustaining improved business processes, organizational performance and services. They will help drive a culture of continuous improvement through leading and facilitating initiatives using a combination of approaches including project management, innovation and human centered-design, agile and Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC/DMADV) methodology. The successful candidate will work collaboratively and support business owners and executive champions to define problems, clarify objectives and develop practical approaches in the delivery of

prioritized projects that may include complex, cross-departmental and large-scale department projects.

As a project professional, the role involves building capacity in the organization through training and coaching, project management, tracking and reporting on progress, facilitating and presenting, as well as assisting with the identification of improvement opportunities across the organization.

## Who you are?

You are agile, open to new challenges, solution-oriented with a strong sense of initiative and able to work within a team. You enjoy being part of a collaborative team working towards common goals and results. You are concerned for the safety and wellbeing of New Brunswickers.

Your attitude, skills and interests are just as important as your area of study. We are looking for diverse backgrounds that bring a combination of the following:

## Essential qualifications

Bachelor`s Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Social Sciences or other related discipline. A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible work experience including two (2) years of project management experience and/or leading or facilitating teams.

An equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Written and spoken competence in English is required. Please state your language capability.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please ensure that preferred language for assessment is identified on your resume.

## Asset Qualifications

Preference may be given to candidates that demonstrate one or more of the following asset qualifications:

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification

• Certificate in Project Management

• Certificate in Change Management

• Experience with project management tools and methodologies, problem solving and change management practices

• Quality/process improvement experience

• Experience in data analysis

• Presentation and group facilitation skills

• Experience using human-centered design, innovation, or design-thinking methods.

## Operational Requirements

Travel throughout the province is required. A valid Class 5 driver`s license as issued by the Province of New Brunswick is required.

## Behavioural competencies

• Client Service Orientation;

• Effective Interactive Communication;

• Analytical Thinking/Judgment;

• Change Leadership;

• Impact and Influence;

• Relationship / Network Building;

• Results Orientation;

## Technical Competencies

• Project Management

• Knowledge of Group Facilitation Techniques

• Presentation Skills

Résumés should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

## Wage

Pay Band 6: $3,021.00 to $4,019.00 bi-weekly, based on 36.25 hours per week

## Work environment

• Office location: 20 McGloin (Marysville Place), Fredericton.

• Standard hours of work: Monday - Friday, 8:15-4:30 (office schedule)

• Possibility of hybrid work within one of our 6 Regional Offices.

• We promote a scent-reduced environment.

## What can GNB offer you?

• Comprehensive benefits package which includes paid vacation, Health and Dental Plan, Life Insurance, Long-Term Disability, and the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan.

• Opportunities for career growth, professional development, and training.

• Free access to Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and services.

• Free Parking, secure bicycle storage and recreational trails access. (at Marysville Place)

• 1 paid Volunteer Day per year to give back to your community.

• An active departmental social committee; and

• A fitness facility (at Marysville Place) for employees at low cost.

Providing a safe workplace for all. Your health & safety are important to us. GNB has implemented preventative measures across the organization to ensure your health & safety.

## How to apply

We encourage applicants to apply online at www.ere.gnb.ca, or by email at HR-RH.ELG-EGL@gnb.ca by October 5, 2026, indicating competition number 80-26-004. This competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

"First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

2239796.description:
At CBCL Limited, we are a successful, dynamic, and growing engineering and environmental consulting firm. We have an exciting opportunity for a Group Lead, Electrical Buildings – NB to join our team in New Brunswick. There is a possibility to operate out of Moncton, Saint John, or Fredericton.

Bring your technical expertise, people-focused leadership, and collaborative mindset to a team that delivers excellence in electrical design and consulting for buildings projects across New Brunswick and beyond. In this role, you will guide and support a talented group of engineers and technologists, contribute to project delivery and client relationships, and help shape the continued growth and success of our Electrical Buildings practice.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and Support the Team: Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentorship to electrical engineers and technologists, supporting workload planning, technical development, collaboration, and overall team performance.

• Oversee Electrical Buildings Design: Guide the design, analysis, and coordination of electrical building systems, including power distribution, lighting, lighting controls, life safety, communications, security, and access control systems for commercial, institutional, industrial, infrastructure, and residential projects.

• Support Business Development and Client Relationships: Contribute to business development efforts by maintaining strong client relationships, identifying opportunities, supporting proposals, and representing CBCL's Electrical Buildings group with professionalism and technical credibility.

• Manage and Coordinate Project Delivery: Work closely with project managers and multidisciplinary teams to support successful project planning and delivery, helping to ensure quality, budget, schedule, and client expectations are met.

• Foster Innovation and Collaboration: Promote innovative problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement while supporting a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

• Ensure Quality and Technical Excellence: Apply sound engineering judgment, complete technical reviews, and support quality management practices to ensure design solutions comply with electrical codes, safety standards, building requirements, and industry best practices.

• Support Construction and Field Services: Lead or support site reviews, respond to RFIs, review shop drawings, resolve field issues, and ensure construction activities align with design intent and project requirements.

• Contribute to Group Planning and Growth: Support resource planning, staff development, technical standards, and strategic initiatives that strengthen the Electrical Buildings group and contribute to CBCL's continued growth in New Brunswick.

Your Capabilities and Credentials:

• A Degree in Electrical Engineering or diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology

• Registration or eligibility for registration with provincial Engineering or technical association;

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant electrical buildings design experience, including demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, or team coordination;

• Strong experience in electrical building systems design, including power distribution, lighting, fire alarm, communications, security, and controls, with in-depth knowledge of applicable building, energy, and electrical codes and standards;

• Experience leading multidisciplinary project coordination, technical reviews, proposal support, and client-focused project delivery in a consulting environment;

• Proficiency with electrical design and coordination tools such as AutoCAD and Revit, with the ability to guide others in producing coordinated, high-quality deliverables;

• Strong communication, organization, and leadership skills, with the ability to support team members, build trusted client relationships, and deliver quality work on time and within budget.

You are encouraged to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements.

The following would be considered assets:

• Experience working in a consulting engineering environment, particularly within electrical buildings design, is preferred;

• Previous experience in a group lead, discipline lead, or formal people leadership role would be considered an asset;

• Experience using Agi32 lighting analysis software and SKM Power Tools; and

• The ability to communicate in both English and French would be an asset.

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• CAAT Defined Benefit Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Flexible hours to support work/life balance;

• Opportunity to earn paid overtime or bank time-in-lieu for future use;

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise;

• Exposure to a variety of projects;

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests;

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise;

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development;

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa; and

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills.

About Us

At CBCL our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and our planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

CBCL Limited strives to provide a diverse workplace that is inclusive, accessible and celebrates individuals and what makes us unique. We are proud to be an employer partner with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and Pride at Work.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment or interview process, or while working with us, please email hr@cbcl.ca. We will work with you to meet your needs in a respectful and timely manner.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

1856318.title: Freshwater Aquaculture Technician
1856318.description:
Kelly Cove Salmon Ltd., a division of Cooke Aquaculture Inc., a dynamic and growing east coast family company, with Platinum Member status in the Canada's Best Managed Companies Program, is offering a unique opportunity for highly motivated individuals to join the Company's team as a Freshwater Aquaculture Technician for our hatcheries in Eastern Charlotte County, NB.

Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, and South America. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly-skilled and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

Primary duties include:

• Monitoring feed and oxygen

• Completing water quality tests

• Data collection and input

• Daily farm routines

• Clean and maintain equipment

• Assist other aquaculture technicians in the operation of fish hatcheries.

• Brood stock production and handling spawning, egg and fry production.

• Feed aquaculture stocks, vaccinate stocks, and perform culling.

• Operate, maintain, and clean pumps, filters, tanks and other aquaculture equipment.

• Keep daily records of water chemistry and oxygen.

• Grade and weigh aquaculture stocks.

• Handles chemicals with necessary PPE. Includes mandatory FIT testing (respirators).

The ideal candidate must be:

• Attention to details

• Ability to lift and carry brood fish

• Computer literate

• Ability to answer alarms

• Willing to work varied or irregular shift including weekends.

The ideal candidate will have completed aquaculture training from a recognized educational institute. This requirement may be substituted with sufficient hands-on experience in spawning, egg incubation and early rearing of salmon fry. Previous experience with water quality testing would be considered an asset.

*As per company policy, a criminal background check is required.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Wellness: Wellness programs.

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

## The Opportunity

The role description is just one part of the story. This is an opportunity to grow, to work within the parameters of the role but to reach your fullest potential. We are a team that is driven to succeed. We count performance, we reward contribution and we recognize talent. It is about being at the center of a growing, global leader in seafood and knowing you are part of that growth. The ability to bring your passion for learning, desire for growth and energy for moving your career forward is what we offer.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

## JOB PURPOSE

Working collaboration with hospital teams, community services and other system partners, the Dietitian is responsible for managing the nutritional care of patients or clients. This is professional dietetics practice in either clinical nutrition, community nutrition needs or food service operations towards the attainment, maintenance, and promotion of the health of individuals, groups, and the community

## QUALIFICATIONS

• Must be registered and a member in good standing with the New Brunswick Association of Dietitians.

• Ability to travel for client appointments and community meeting using own transportation for those working in Public Health.

• Ability to attend work on a regular basis.

• Ability to perform the duties of the position.

• Good work record.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Dietitian is responsible for:

• Review patient medical history, symptoms, medications, laboratory tests, anthropometric data (BMI, height, ideal or standard body weight).

• Establish a nutrition care plan, coordinate care and provide behaviour modification and counselling techniques.

• Document assessments, interventions, treatment plans and communication with care team.

• Participating in interdisciplinary care planning or community assessments

• Preparing and presenting information and education sessions

• Providing mentoring and support for students

• Participating in developing, maintaining and evaluating policies and procedures

• Flexibility

• Mentoring and Coaching

• Patient/Client Focus

2240192.title: Marketing Coordinator
2240192.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

True North Seafood is Cooke's consumer brand with a premium positioning in North America, in both retail and foodservice. True North Seafood is the go-to brand for trusted seafood - our main priority is to bring our consumers closer to the source.

## The Role

As a result of our robust growth, we are looking for a Marketing Coordinator with a passion for marketing to join our team in our Saint John, NB office. This role is the organizational hub of the marketing team - supporting the execution and coordination of initiatives across both Retail and Foodservice channels, leading day-to-day management of social media content and customer-facing collateral, and helping projects move efficiently from concept to completion while maintaining brand consistency and operational excellence.

This position offers an excellent opportunity for an ambitious marketing professional who is eager to expand their skills, take ownership of projects, and grow within a dynamic marketing team. Success in this role will require energy, enthusiasm, and a positive, entrepreneurial attitude, along with strong communication, time management, and collaboration skills at all levels of the organization.

## What You'll Do:

## Marketing Promotion Coordination

• Support the design, development and delivery of marketing collateral, including sell sheets, brochures, website content and presentations.

• Conduct quality assurance reviews of marketing materials to ensure accuracy, grammar, formatting and brand compliance.

• Lead the ongoing management and oversight of promotional content.

• Facilitate successful customer interactions and tours, including coordination of meetings, customer cuttings/tastings and overall experience management (POS, gift planning, etc.).

• Maintain marketing project trackers, timelines and status updates.

## Digital Channels & Content Management

• Maintain organized digital asset libraries and SharePoint folders, ensuring materials are current, accessible and properly archived.

• Manage version control and distribution of marketing resources.

• Support the development of the digital strategy internally and with external partners.

## Administration, Data, Insights & Optimization

• Manage administrative functions for the marketing team, including PO creation, budget tracking and POS sourcing.

• Manage merchandise and apparel programs, including inventory tracking and brand/budget alignment.

• Support the coordination of domestic and international shipments, including samples, POS and tradeshow collateral.

• Assist in the management and execution of internal and external events.

• Conduct market research and deliver recommendations to optimize marketing activities.

• Lead the development and delivery of a monthly internal newsletter sharing market information and insights.

## Project Management

• Provide marketing support across various sub-brands and lead special projects as assigned.

• Lead initiatives that support operational excellence for the Marketing team, including continuous improvement, process development and documentation.

## What You Bring:

• Post-secondary certificate or degree in marketing, communications, commerce or a related field.

• Event planning, food industry and project management experience are considered an asset.

• Advanced knowledge of digital platforms, social media (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram) and MS Office/MS Suite.

• Excellent written communication and proof-reading skills.

• Excellent organizational skills - detail-oriented, self-starter and highly organized.

• A solutions-focused, analytical and data-driven approach to problem-solving.

• Ability to thrive in a complex, fast-paced environment while remaining flexible and adaptable to change.

• A team player who is energetic, resourceful, reliable and timely - comfortable working independently and collaboratively to drive results across multiple projects.

## What a Role at Cooke Will Offer You:

• The opportunity to contribute to complex projects in meaningful ways within an exciting, fast-growing environment.

• Real-life experience across the Consumer-Packaged Goods space - retail, foodservice, tradeshows, digital and social media, new product development, packaging development and analytics.

• Collaboration with diverse teams locally and globally.

• The opportunity to develop your presentation and speaking skills.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

2219566.title: Horizon Licensed Practical Nurse (LPNA) Application
2219566.description:
Horizon Health Network in beautiful New Brunswick is looking for LICENSED PRACTICAL NURSES to join our team!

## This is the life-changing opportunity you've been looking for!

Horizon Health Network (Horizon) is actively recruiting Licensed Practical Nurses interested in pursing their careers in New Brunswick.

As a Licenced Practical Nurse, you will be critical in Horizon's ability to provide exceptional care. You will contribute to the overall wellbeing and quality of life of individual patients as well as our communities in New Brunswick.

Positions are available in Saint John, Fredericton, Miramichi, Moncton, Waterville, Sussex, Sackville, Perth Andover and St. Stephen

## Our Offer

Our offer comes with competitive salary starting at $35.14 to $39.63 per hour combined with a network of opportunities in over 100 facilities with careers in acute and community settings. There are flexible options with full-time, part-time, and casual opportunities.

## Who we are

Horizon is one of Atlantic Canada's Top Employers of Choice, and the second largest health authority in Atlantic Canada, servicing over a half a million people.

## Why you should work here

Working for Horizon gives you flexibility in your career, an east coast lifestyle and the chance to make a big difference in the lives of New Brunswickers.

Horizon is an equal opportunity employer that values and recognizes your contributions, is dedicated to patient safety and satisfaction, has competitive pay and benefits, and offers many opportunities for professional growth.

As a Horizon employee, you will benefit from engagement programs like Years of Service and our Bravo! recognition programs. You will also see a commitment to your well-being through our safe and respectful workplace programs that include safety initiatives, workplace violence prevention, and employee wellness services.

## Where we are

At Horizon, a rewarding opportunity is as close as the ocean!

New Brunswick is located on Canada's beautiful east coast. It is known for its welcoming people, billion-year-old coastlines, and rich heritage of Indigenous, Anglophone and Francophone communities which have been ranked among the best places in the world to live.

## Who you are

You have a current registration with the Association of New Brunswick Licensed Practical Nurses (ANBLPN) or able to obtain upon hire. You have written and spoken competence in English.

## We want to hear from you!

Our dedicated Talent Acquisition Specialist will work closely with you to discuss your career goals and areas of interest and specialization to find the best fit within our team.

Email nursingcareers@horizonnb.ca and we will be happy to schedule a time to chat about the nursing opportunities or click "Apply" below to provide your information and we'll get back to you.

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

2177469.title: Primary Care Paramedic - 2025620
2177469.description:
## COMPETITION NUMBER

## 2025620

## POSITION TITLE

Primary Care Paramedic

## LOCATION

Ford's Mills, NB

## BARGAINING UNIT

NB Union – Specialized Health Care Professionals

## STATUS

Part time permanent

## HOURS OF WORK

Rotating days and nights, weekends, and statutory holidays. Subject to change due to operational requirements.

## ANTICIPATED START DATE

As soon as possible

## ANTICIPATED END DATE

Not applicable

## SALARY RANGE

As per collective agreement

## LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT

Written and spoken competency in one of the two official languages (English or French) is required and spoken competency in the other official language is required.

## CLOSING DATE

This competition will remain open until filled.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2185201.title: Highway Supervisor I-II
2185201.employer: Department of Transportation / Ministère des Transports
2185201.description:
## Department of Transportation and Infrastructure

## Highway Supervisor I-II

## Seasonal Position

## Open

## Bathurst District

## Robinsonville Division

## Who we are

The work we do has a positive impact on our communities and helps improve the everyday lives of New Brunswickers. Together, we are over 45,000 New Brunswickers who are passionate problem-solvers, who make a difference and are proud to call New Brunswick home.

The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure has a broad mandate and is committed to maintaining and improving New Brunswick's public infrastructure. The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure's mission is to contribute to New Brunswick's economy and quality of life by providing and supporting sustainable infrastructure that allows for the safe and efficient movement of people, goods and government services to the public. Not only is the department responsible for managing over 18,000 kilometers of provincial highways, it also manages the planning, design and construction of hospitals, schools and other government buildings.

## What you will do

Reporting to the Transportation Maintenance Superintendent, the successful candidate will be responsible for:

• providing leadership, guidance, and support to employees, while ensuring effective teamwork and performance;

• maintaining public relations with the community;

• overseeing operation and maintenance of equipment;

• providing effective winter maintenance of highways in accordance with the Department of Transportation and Infrastructure's policies and guidelines.

## Work environment:

• Office location: Tide Head

• Work holidays, weekends, shift and/or variable hours

• May work in adverse road and weather conditions

• We promote a scent-reduced environment.

## Who you are

## Key behavioural competencies:

• Concern for Order

• Developing Others

• Effective Interactive Communication

• Flexibility

• Results Orientation

## Essential Qualifications:

## Highway Supervisor II:

• Diploma from a recognized two (2) year Civil Engineering Technology program in a related field.

• Three (3) years of winter maintenance or winter and summer maintenance work experience which includes one (1) year of supervisory experience.

• OR high school graduation or GED and six (6) years of winter maintenance or winter and summer maintenance work which includes one (1) year of supervisory experience.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

• Valid Class 5 driver's license as issued by the Province of New Brunswick.

If there are no applicants with the above essential qualifications, we may consider applicants with the following qualifications and appoint at a lower classification.

## Highway Supervisor I:

• Diploma from a recognized two (2) year Civil Engineering Technology program in a related field

• One (1) year of related work experience which includes one (1) year of supervisory experience.

• OR high school graduation or GED and four (4) years of winter maintenance work or winter and summer maintenance work experience which includes one (1) year of supervisory experience.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

• Valid Class 5 driver's license as issued by the Province of New Brunswick.

An equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Written and spoken competence in English and French is required. Please state your language capability.

• Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration.

• Résumés should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

• Please ensure that your preferred language of assessment is identified in your résumé.

## Please attach a copy of your driver's license with your application.

## Asset Qualifications:

Preference may be given to candidates that demonstrate the following asset:

• recent road construction and/or road maintenance experience.

Subject to the response to this competition, candidates may be required to demonstrate on their application one or more of the asset qualifications in addition to the essential qualifications in order to be given further consideration.

## The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure offers:

• Meaningful work and the opportunity to support New Brunswickers in times of need.

• Opportunities for career growth, professional development and training.

• Comprehensive benefits package which includes paid vacation, Health and Dental Plan, Life Insurance, Long-Term Disability and the Public Service Shared Risk Pension Plan.

• Free access to Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and services.

## SALARY:

Highway Supervisor I: $2,135.00 to $2,686.00 bi-weekly, based on 40 hours per week.

Highway Supervisor II: $2,346.00 to $2,947.00 bi-weekly, based on 40 hours per week.

Providing a safe workplace for all. Your health and safety are important to us. GNB has implemented preventative measures across the organization to ensure your health and safety.

## How to apply

We encourage applicants to apply on-line indicating competition number (15000)2025-D01-19. This competition will be open until filled and may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level.

We thank all those who apply, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

As per the?Civil Service Act, veterans, who demonstrate they are among the most qualified, shall be given preference at the time of appointment.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Program contributing to the creation of a more balanced workforce that reflects the diversity of the province by removing barriers to employment and providing individualized supports to designated equity group members.

The New Brunswick Public Service: Improving the lives of New Brunswickers every day!

Subscribe to our newsletter

2240469.title: Network Solution Architect
2240469.description:
## WHO WE ARE

Mariner innovates always and everywhere, turning novel ideas into practical solutions. From products and services to venture creation, we build better futures powered by people. Our purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company for those who make an impact - elevating people, data, and technology in the best way to solve hard problems. We partner with people embracing change, leveraging data, cybersecurity, cloud, and change management to drive successful business outcomes that matter to our customers.

Mariners build for change. Like SHIFT Energy, our energy management and decarbonization company. Or East Valley Ventures, created to scale social economic impact in our communities through investment and mentorship of emerging change-makers and their companies.

Mariner s purpose has always been to be a great, everlasting technology company and the core values that guide us every day are:

## OUR VALUES

• We care for our team.

• We care about the impact we have on our community.

• We serve by solving complex problems.

• We grow because growth fuels opportunities.

• We innovate always and everywhere.

• We build a business that lasts.

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE:
We are seeking an experienced Network Solution Architect to join our client's high-performing enterprise architecture and infrastructure team. This role is ideal for a senior networking professional who combines deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and has a proven track record of designing and delivering scalable, resilient, and secure enterprise network solutions

## WHAT YOU LL BE DOING IN THE ROLE:

• Design and deliver enterprise-scale network solutions across LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, cloud, and security domains.

• Develop and maintain network architecture standards, roadmaps, and reference architectures.

• Lead network modernization, transformation, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.

• Design highly available and resilient network infrastructures, including disaster recovery solutions.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations aligned with business objectives.

• Ensure network solutions meet security, compliance, and risk management requirements.

• Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders throughout project lifecycles.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects, designers, and engineering teams.

• Develop and maintain architecture documentation, network diagrams, and technical standards.

• Work closely with vendors and service providers to support strategic initiatives.

## WHAT SKILLS / QUALIFICATIONS YOU LL NEED TO DO THE JOB:

• 5+ years of experience in Network Architecture, Solution Architecture, or Infrastructure Design roles.

• Strong expertise in enterprise networking technologies and protocols, including:
• TCP/IP

• BGP

• MPLS

• QoS

• IPv4/IPv6

• OSPF

• VPN technologies

• Experience designing enterprise LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking solutions.

• Strong understanding of network security principles, firewalls, segmentation, and secure connectivity.

• Experience with high-availability, redundancy, and disaster recovery architectures.

• Familiarity with network design, modeling, and documentation tools.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• One or more industry-recognized networking certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIS/JNCIP, Fortinet NSE, Palo Alto PCNSE, or equivalent.

• Cloud networking certifications such as Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Advanced Networking Specialty, or Google Professional Cloud Network Engineer are considered strong assets.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with cloud networking in Azure, AWS, and/or GCP.

• Experience with SDN technologies, SASE, Zero Trust, and network modernization initiatives.

• Knowledge of network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.

• Hands-on experience with Python, Ansible, Terraform, or Bicep.

• Experience working within Agile and DevOps environments.

• TOGAF certification is considered an asset.

• Experience supporting large-scale enterprise network transformation programs.

## AND YOU ARE...

• Always improving your skills and knowledge: you want to be the best at what you do

• Curious and creative; comfortable taking on new problems and challenges

• A self-starter with the ability to recommend priorities to the project leader

• Comfortable working through problems and figuring things out with minimal supervision

• Great problem-solving skills: thorough and reliable

• Able to work in a team: share knowledge and assist other team members

• A good communicator: able to explain your ideas and recommendations

• Well organized and dependable under pressure: you manage your time effectively

• Energized by our company values!

## MARINER OFFERS YOU:

• A values-driven workplace where people really matter

• Hybrid/ Remote work environment.

• Competitive salary, retirement savings program, and rewards program

• Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans and access to e-health care

• Paid vacation, maternity/parental leave, paid sick leave and paid Mariner MyLife days

• Unlimited training

## WHY MARINER?

We believe in making a positive impact in the communities where we live and work! Not only are we passionate about nurturing a thriving technology sector here in Atlantic Canada, but we are also committed to solving technology challenges that will make an impact worldwide. Technology is everlasting, and we take pride in connecting world class talent to world class projects and business solutions.

If you are an IT Professional, Software Professional, or Management Consultant, that is passionate about career development, data, and problem solving, we want to hear from you! If this sounds like someone you know, share this with them so they do not miss the opportunity to experience Mariner!

To achieve this, we know we need to be all in on training and development of our team so we can continue to move the needle in the technology sector together. Of course, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to our team, but our competitive edge is the development and training that our team experiences every day.

Be part of our vibrant community that values diversity and embraces inclusion at every level. We are committed to fostering a culture where individuals from all backgrounds and walks of life feel empowered to contribute their unique perspectives. Our collaborative environment celebrates the richness of ideas and experiences, and we believe that by embracing diversity, we can achieve greater innovation and excellence together. Come and help us create a workplace that reflects the beautiful tapestry of our global community.

## Join our growing team!

2239795.title: Group Lead, Electrical Buildings - NB
2239795.description:
At CBCL Limited, we are a successful, dynamic, and growing engineering and environmental consulting firm. We have an exciting opportunity for a Group Lead, Electrical Buildings – NB to join our team in New Brunswick. There is a possibility to operate out of Moncton, Saint John, or Fredericton.

Bring your technical expertise, people-focused leadership, and collaborative mindset to a team that delivers excellence in electrical design and consulting for buildings projects across New Brunswick and beyond. In this role, you will guide and support a talented group of engineers and technologists, contribute to project delivery and client relationships, and help shape the continued growth and success of our Electrical Buildings practice.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and Support the Team: Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentorship to electrical engineers and technologists, supporting workload planning, technical development, collaboration, and overall team performance.

• Oversee Electrical Buildings Design: Guide the design, analysis, and coordination of electrical building systems, including power distribution, lighting, lighting controls, life safety, communications, security, and access control systems for commercial, institutional, industrial, infrastructure, and residential projects.

• Support Business Development and Client Relationships: Contribute to business development efforts by maintaining strong client relationships, identifying opportunities, supporting proposals, and representing CBCL's Electrical Buildings group with professionalism and technical credibility.

• Manage and Coordinate Project Delivery: Work closely with project managers and multidisciplinary teams to support successful project planning and delivery, helping to ensure quality, budget, schedule, and client expectations are met.

• Foster Innovation and Collaboration: Promote innovative problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement while supporting a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

• Ensure Quality and Technical Excellence: Apply sound engineering judgment, complete technical reviews, and support quality management practices to ensure design solutions comply with electrical codes, safety standards, building requirements, and industry best practices.

• Support Construction and Field Services: Lead or support site reviews, respond to RFIs, review shop drawings, resolve field issues, and ensure construction activities align with design intent and project requirements.

• Contribute to Group Planning and Growth: Support resource planning, staff development, technical standards, and strategic initiatives that strengthen the Electrical Buildings group and contribute to CBCL's continued growth in New Brunswick.

Your Capabilities and Credentials:

• A Degree in Electrical Engineering or diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology

• Registration or eligibility for registration with provincial Engineering or technical association;

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant electrical buildings design experience, including demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, or team coordination;

• Strong experience in electrical building systems design, including power distribution, lighting, fire alarm, communications, security, and controls, with in-depth knowledge of applicable building, energy, and electrical codes and standards;

• Experience leading multidisciplinary project coordination, technical reviews, proposal support, and client-focused project delivery in a consulting environment;

• Proficiency with electrical design and coordination tools such as AutoCAD and Revit, with the ability to guide others in producing coordinated, high-quality deliverables;

• Strong communication, organization, and leadership skills, with the ability to support team members, build trusted client relationships, and deliver quality work on time and within budget.

You are encouraged to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements.

The following would be considered assets:

• Experience working in a consulting engineering environment, particularly within electrical buildings design, is preferred;

• Previous experience in a group lead, discipline lead, or formal people leadership role would be considered an asset;

• Experience using Agi32 lighting analysis software and SKM Power Tools; and

• The ability to communicate in both English and French would be an asset.

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• CAAT Defined Benefit Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Flexible hours to support work/life balance;

• Opportunity to earn paid overtime or bank time-in-lieu for future use;

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise;

• Exposure to a variety of projects;

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests;

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise;

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development;

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa; and

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills.

About Us

At CBCL our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and our planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

CBCL Limited strives to provide a diverse workplace that is inclusive, accessible and celebrates individuals and what makes us unique. We are proud to be an employer partner with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and Pride at Work.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment or interview process, or while working with us, please email hr@cbcl.ca. We will work with you to meet your needs in a respectful and timely manner.

Our goal is to ensure every candidate has a fair opportunity to demonstrate their abilities. We value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to removing barriers that may prevent individuals from thriving in their roles.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those applicants who are selected to interview will be contacted.

2239836.title: Property Administrator
2239836.description:
Property Administrator Atlantic Commercial Properties (ACP) is Moncton's largest provider of commercial warehouse space, owning and managing more than 45 commercial properties across the Maritimes.

We are seeking a Property Administrator to join our team in Moncton. This is an important, multi-faceted role that combines property administration, tenant service, maintenance coordination, and accounts payable.

The successful candidate will be a key point of contact for our tenants, contractors, and suppliers and will help coordinate the day-to-day operations of our commercial property portfolio. This position is well suited to someone who is organized, dependable, personable, and comfortable managing a variety of responsibilities. Training will be provided.

## Key Responsibilities

## Tenant & Property Administration

• Serve as a primary point of contact for tenants, contractors, and suppliers

• Respond to phone calls, emails, service requests, and general inquiries

• Maintain tenant contact information, emergency contacts, service records, contracts, leases, and other property documentation

• Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems

• Assist with internal reporting, data entry, and document preparation

## Maintenance & Service Coordination

• Schedule and coordinate in-house maintenance staff for service calls, repairs, renovations, and emergencies

• Arrange outside contractors for electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other specialized work

• Track service calls and follow up to ensure work is completed in a timely manner

• Coordinate and maintain schedules for preventative maintenance and required inspections, including HVAC, sprinkler, fire alarm, and backflow systems

## Contractor & Supplier Management

• Maintain strong working relationships with contractors and suppliers

• Request and review quotes for repairs, maintenance, and property improvement projects

• Assist with negotiating annual service contracts, including landscaping and snow clearing

• Identify opportunities for cost savings and negotiate pricing with suppliers when appropriate

## Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel

• Strong organizational and communication skills

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks

• Professional and customer-service-oriented approach when dealing with tenants, contractors, and suppliers

## The Following Are Considered Assets

• College diploma in business, office administration, or a related field

• Previous experience in property management, administration

• Experience with QuickBooks

• Experience coordinating contractors, maintenance, or service work

• Bilingual (English & French)

## Why Join ACP?

ACP is a family-owned and operated business with a small, close-knit team. We value people who are willing to take ownership of their responsibilities while also pitching in wherever needed.

We offer:

• Competitive compensation

• Benefits package

• Paid vacation

• Training and support

• A stable, long-term position with an established local company

• A collaborative, small-team working environment

If you are organized, proactive, enjoy working with people, and are looking for a varied role, we would like to hear from you.

2173914.title: Manager of Fish Performance and Remote Operations
2173914.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

Kelly Cove Salmon Ltd., a Division of Cooke Aquaculture Inc., a dynamic and growing east coast family company, with Platinum Member status in the Canada's Best Managed Companies Program, is offering a unique opportunity for the right individual to join the team as Manager of Fish Performance and Remote Operations.

## The Role

This pivotal role is responsible for driving feed optimization strategies using AI and automation, ensuring sustainable growth, and leading a high-performing team within our Operations Centre. If you are passionate about aquaculture innovation, performance analytics, and remote technology, this is a unique opportunity to make a significant impact.

## Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Feed Management

• Develop and oversee AI-driven feeding strategies to maximize fish growth and minimize Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR).

• Ensure feeding practices meet environmental standards and avoid benthic impact.

Team Leadership & Support

• Lead and mentor Operations Centre Team Leaders and Feed Analysts.

• Serve as the primary escalation point for feeding operations.

Innovation & Program Leadership

• Drive strategic initiatives including:

• Project Foundation - Continuous improvement in FCR and growth.

• Co-Pilot - Expansion of automated feeding through Observe technology.

Performance Reporting

• Deliver bi-weekly performance reports to senior leadership, including KPIs such as feed output, mortality biomass, and net bio-gain vs forecast.

Forecasting & Accuracy

• Contribute to monthly feed forecasting and ensure actuals align within ±3% of projections.

Infrastructure Planning

• Design and maintain optimal feed infrastructure plans to support fish flow and operational flexibility.

Remote Operations Expertise

• Act as the subject matter expert on remote operations technologies, including wireless networks and remote control of generators and compressors.

• Collaborate with Centralized Feed Technicians to ensure seamless onsite support.

## Qualifications:

• Degree in Aquaculture, Marine Biology, Animal Science, or related field.

• 3+ years of experience in aquaculture operations, feed strategy, or related field.

• Proven leadership experience with cross-functional teams.

• Strong analytical skills and experience with performance reporting and forecasting.

• Familiarity with AI and automation technologies in aquaculture.

• Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

• Knowledge of environmental compliance and sustainability practices.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

NOTE: The recruiter is reviewing and interviewing eligible applicants for this position as they are received. If you are interested in this posting, you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

2235223.title: Senior Marine Structural Engineer
2235223.employer: GEMTEC Consulting Engineers and Scientists Limited
2235223.description:
Are you an experienced Marine Structural Engineer looking to progress your career? We're looking for a Senior Marine Structural Engineer to join our growing team. We are open to filling this position in any of our Atlantic Canada offices including Fredericton, Moncton, Saint John, Grand Falls, Bathurst, Halifax or St. John's.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm—not too big, not too small. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team.

• Minimum of 12 years of experience in civil engineering including specific expertise in marine structures.

2240166.title: Director of Municipal Performance
2240166.description:
## SUMMARY

Reporting to the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, Organizational Services, the incumbent plays a corporate, cross-functional role aimed at developing and strengthening the City of Dieppe's capacity to improve its practices, deliver corporate projects, measure its performance and achieve its strategic priorities.

The Director of Municipal Performance establishes and leads an integrated department encompassing organizational transformation, corporate project management, change management, process optimization, continuous improvement-particularly through the "Amélioration Dieppe" program-as well as performance measurement and accountability mechanisms.

Working with the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer, departments and managers, the incumbent serves as a strategic and operational partner. The incumbent translates strategic directions into concrete action, supports their implementation and helps embed a structured, engaging and results-oriented organizational culture.

## RESPONSIBILITIES

## Organizational performance and decision-making support

• Design, implement and continuously improve an integrated municipal performance management system

• Develop performance management methodologies and monitoring tools, as well as indicators for measuring results

• Analyze organizational data, interpret results and prepare strategic reports to support decision-making

• Make recommendations to improve performance and organizational efficiency and achieve strategic objectives

• Monitor organizational performance, assess progress and recommend required adjustments

• Embed an organizational culture focused on results, accountability, continuous improvement and evidence-based decision-making

## Strategic planning

• Support senior management in implementing, monitoring and continuously developing strategic planning

• Coordinate the strategic planning cycle, including annual planning, periodic reviews and accountability mechanisms

• Ensure organizational initiatives are aligned with the City's strategic directions and objectives

• Advise departments to ensure their action plans, projects and priorities are aligned with the City's strategic plan

• Identify gaps, interdependencies, risks and capacity issues, and recommend required adjustments

• Prepare strategic reports, when required, for senior management, City Council and the public, including progress reports issued twice a year

## Organizational transformation, corporate projects and organizational change

• Lead the delivery of corporate and cross-functional projects, ensuring their planning, coordination and monitoring, the application of their governance mechanisms and the achievement of expected results

• Define and clarify the objectives, deliverables, timelines, roles, responsibilities, risks, interdependencies and expected benefits of corporate projects

• Implement and continuously improve project management approaches suited to the municipal context

• Assess the human, organizational, operational and technological impacts of transformation projects, as well as organizational capacity issues

• Anticipate resistance and risks related to buy-in, and recommend the measures required to secure that buy-in

• Develop and implement integrated change management, communication, training and support strategies

• Support departments and managers in fulfilling their roles as change leaders in order to foster smooth and sustainable transitions

• Ensure the sustained adoption of new practices, processes and ways of working

## Continuous improvement

• Provide advisory expertise to senior management, departments and managers to support the integration of a continuous improvement culture

• Work with departments to identify and prioritize opportunities for improvement, assess needs and guide interventions based on organizational issues

• Analyze issues experienced by work teams, conduct the required assessments and make recommendations to improve processes, organizational efficiency and the City's overall performance

• Facilitate the resolution of cross-departmental issues that could hinder progress on improvement initiatives

• Conduct or coordinate performance, efficiency and cost-effectiveness audits and prepare appropriate reports and recommendations

• Ensure the continued development, governance and sustainability of the "Amélioration Dieppe" program, based on the Lean Six Sigma approach, by updating its framework, objectives, service offerings and monitoring mechanisms

• Monitor trends, emerging practices and best practices in continuous improvement and change management, and recommend their adoption

## Human, financial and administrative resources

• Provide strategic management of team members, including workforce planning, skills development, performance management, occupational health and safety, and maintaining a healthy work environment, in collaboration with the Human Resources Department

• Lead, engage and support team members to foster accountability, commitment and achievement of the department's objectives

• Plan, manage and monitor the department's financial resources, including operating and capital budgets, in accordance with the City's directions and policies

• Ensure a rigorous, transparent and compliant management of administrative resources, contracts, procurement processes, agreements and funding requests

• Oversee the preparation of funding and grant applications, as well as the related reporting requirements

• Ensure optimal use of the department's human, financial and material resources, and recommend the necessary adjustments to ensure the department's performance, efficiency and sustainability

## Other

• Perform any other related duties, including but not limited to those assigned by the Deputy Chief Administrative Officer

## MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

## Education and certifications

• Bachelor's degree in public administration, business administration, organizational development or another relevant discipline

• An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

• Recognized project management certification - for example, PMP, PRINCE2 or another equivalent certification or training

• Recognized Lean facilitation certification, such as a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Lean Master certification or equivalent (considered an asset)

• Change management certification, such as PROSCI, Lean, Agile or another relevant recognized certification or training (considered an asset)

## Experience

• Seven (7) years of relevant experience, including significant experience in management, leadership or strategic advisory roles

• Experience in strategic planning, organizational performance management, continuous improvement, process optimization, problem-solving, and corporate or cross-functional project management

• Experience in organizational transformation, change management and supporting managers (considered an asset)

• Experience in a municipal, quasi-public or public-sector organization (considered an asset)

## Knowledge

• Proficiency in spoken and written French and English

• Very good knowledge of Microsoft 365, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint

• In-depth knowledge of project management and change management principles, methods and tools

• Good knowledge of continuous improvement approaches, including Lean Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S, as well as process optimization and problem-solving methods

• Good knowledge of the principles and practices of strategic planning, organizational performance management, indicator development, dashboards, and monitoring and accountability mechanisms

## Skills

• Engaging leadership and the ability to exert positive strategic influence with a variety of stakeholders, with or without direct line authority

• Strong ability to coordinate, manage projects and change, and ensure strategic alignment

• Strong analytical, synthesis and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and formulate strategic recommendations

• Excellent communication, collaboration and negotiation skills, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences, including decision-making bodies

• Ability to quickly become familiar with ongoing files and projects, structure their progress and mobilize the parties involved toward achieving results

• Ability to manage multiple files simultaneously, set priorities and work effectively in contexts of ambiguity, change or limited resources

• Ability to support managers and teams through organizational transformation and evolving practices

• Initiative, rigour, judgment, autonomy and results orientation

## General requirements

• Adherence to organizational values and demonstration of a professional attitude aligned with the interests of the City of Dieppe and the community

• Compliance with confidentiality and information management rules and policies

• Demonstrate punctuality and regular attendance

• Ability to perform the duties inherent to the position (physical requirements, where applicable)

• Ability to maintain satisfactory job performance

## WORK SCHEDULE

• Thirty-five (35) hours per week

• Work outside regular office hours, including evenings and weekends, as required

## COMPENSATION

• In accordance with the salary scale in effect for non-unionized employees

• The incumbent also receives vacation, employer-paid benefits and a pension plan (employer/employee contributions).

## CLOSING DATE

• The deadline to submit an application is October 13th, 2026 at 23:59.

Disclaimer: The statements above describe the principal characteristics of the position and are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They should not be considered an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, abilities and occupational requirements inherent in the position.

Note: The municipality officially declared itself a francophone city offering bilingual services in 2000 (Municipal Administration Language Policy A-9). As French is the language of work, all employees must be able to communicate orally and in writing in both French and English.

Working for Horizon gives you flexibility in your career, an east coast lifestyle and the chance to make a big difference in the lives of New Brunswickers. At Horizon, a rewarding opportunity is as close as the ocean!
