With short commutes, the warmest ocean waters in Canada, and a rich and colourful cultural experience, New Brunswick is truly Canada's hidden gem. Situated on the Atlantic coast, the province boasts stunning landscapes ranging from pristine beaches to dense forests, providing endless opportunities for outdoor recreation such as hiking, camping, fishing, skiing and more.

New Brunswick communities offer affordable housing, a low cost of living, vibrant culture, and a rich east coast lifestyle that is never far from the city. Our people are the heart of our organization. We have more than 14,000 dedicated employees working with over 1,000 physicians, and play a major role in research, education, innovation and health and wellness.

2239076.title: Learning Design Consultant, Online Course Development
2239076.description:
Are you passionate about designing engaging, high-quality online learning experiences? Are you also curious about how AI can responsibly support and improve the way online courses are developed?

We're looking for a Learning Design Consultant, Online Course Development to join our team for a one-year term and help design and develop new online courses across UFred's certificate, diploma, undergraduate, and graduate programs.

Working closely with subject matter experts (SMEs) and internal academic partners, you'll help take courses from their initial academic framework and assessment design through to developed, SME-approved content that is ready for digital production and implementation.

This role is a great fit for someone who brings strong learning design fundamentals, enjoys collaborating with faculty and SMEs, and is excited to work within a modern, streamlined course development environment-including the responsible use of AI-supported development tools.

Qualifications

## What you'll bring

• A bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Learning Design, Educational Technology, Curriculum Studies or a related field.

• At least two years of recent experience designing and developing online courses within a post-secondary environment or closely comparable adult-learning setting.

• Experience collaborating with faculty or SMEs to take a course from initial outcomes and assessment design through to developed online learning materials.

• Working knowledge of course and program outcome alignment, including CLO-to-PLO or equivalent mapping and assessment alignment.

• Experience working within an enterprise Learning Management System (LMS).

• Knowledge of adult learning, online pedagogy, assessment design, accessibility and Universal Design for Learning.

• Strong writing and editing skills, with an ability to turn complex academic content into clear and effective online learning materials.

• Strong communication, collaboration and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple course development deliverables and timelines.

• A proactive and open approach to using AI tools responsibly to support course development, review, documentation and quality assurance.

## Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with digital course authoring tools.

• Experience developing undergraduate, graduate, certificate, diploma or continuing education courses.

• Experience working within a Canadian university or college, particularly in online or distance education.

• Experience applying accessibility practices and coordinating multimedia or interactive learning assets.

• Experience working with established digital course development templates and structured development workflows.

Responsibilities

## Course framework and curriculum design

• Collaborate in structured course design conversations with SMEs to define the course description, syllabus, course learning outcomes, CLO-to-PLO mapping, weekly topics and subtopics, assessment plan, and assessment-to-CLO mapping.

• Support the translation of program expectations, academic standards, and level requirements into coherent course frameworks and learning pathways.

• Review sequencing, scope, workload, learning progression, and academic integrity considerations, and recommend practical adjustments for assigned courses.

• Use approved course development templates, checklists, and design standards when preparing course frameworks for review and approval.

## Responsible AI-supported development and academic quality support

• Use approved AI tools, structured workflows, and prompt patterns to support the drafting and refinement of learning content, examples, activities, case studies, feedback, knowledge checks, and assessment items.

• Work closely with SMEs to verify content accuracy, currency, breadth, depth, and appropriateness for the intended academic level.

• Edit, organize, and refine draft content into learning materials that are clear, instructionally effective, learner centered, and aligned to course outcomes.

• Apply institutional expectations for responsible AI use, copyright, privacy, bias mitigation, and academic quality control.

• Maintain clear documentation, SME decisions, review notes, approvals, and content changes throughout course development.

## Online course development and production support

• Develop and prepare SME approved content using structured course development workflows, institutional templates, standards, and supported development tools.

• Apply evidence informed online learning practices, accessibility requirements, and Universal Design for Learning principles in the development and presentation of content, activities, interactions, and assessments.

• Identify and coordinate requirements for multimedia elements, interactions, knowledge checks, and other course assets to support engagement and academic rigour.

• Prepare organized, approved course content and supporting assets for downstream digital production, LMS implementation, testing, and launch readiness.

• As assigned, support course configuration or development using approved digital authoring tools and templates based on project and operational needs.

## Quality review, documentation, and workflow improvement

• Conduct course level design, alignment, accessibility, and readiness checks using defined rubrics, mapping checks, and institutional quality criteria.

• Incorporate feedback from SMEs and internal stakeholders throughout development to strengthen course quality, alignment, usability, and readiness.

• Maintain accurate records of design decisions, mappings, review comments, approvals, version history, and course assets throughout the online course development lifecycle.

• Contribute practical observations and recommendations to improve course development templates, workflows, standards, documentation, and scalable new course development practices.

• Collaborate with the manager, project team, and relevant internal partners to identify and resolve development issues that may affect quality, timelines, or course readiness.

• Other duties as assigned.

In addition to your base compensation, joining the UFred team means becoming part of a growing organization with a mission to provide quality and affordable education globally. UFred values its employees and supports them with opportunities for Wellness and Balance, as well as Professional Development.

Wellness and Balance
UFred employees enjoy subsidized Health and Vision Care, an RRSP Match program, and a minimum of three weeks of vacation to start. All staff also receive additional paid time off between Christmas and New Year's. Flexible work arrangements and an Active Living Benefit support overall well-being.

Professional Development
UFred supports ongoing learning and development through internal and external opportunities and resources to support your growth.

Hours of Work
This is a a one year full-time position (35 hours per week) under regular business hours. The position is based in Fredericton, NB, with the option to work remotely from anywhere in New Brunswick and attend in-person meetings as required.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
The University of Fredericton is passionately committed to ensuring a positive and professional working environment in which all people are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion and aim to provide a fair and consistent method for filling job openings in support of equality of opportunity and cultural diversity within the organization. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, Black, Indigenous, and People of Colour (BIPOC), and individuals from LGBTQ2SIA+ and other equity-seeking communities.

This position is currently vacant, and the job posting will remain open until October 3, 2026. We appreciate all applications received.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. 1896150.title: Regional Quality Assurance Specialist
1896150.description:
True North Salmon , a division of Cooke Aquaculture Inc., a dynamic and growing east coast family company, with Platinum Member status in the Canada's Best Managed Companies Program has an opportunity for a highly motivated individual to join the Company's Quality Assurance Team based out of our facility located in Blacks Harbour, NB.

Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly-skilled and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

The successful candidate will be a practical quality professional with strong knowledge of seafood or food manufacturing, Canadian and U.S. regulatory requirements, and GFSI-based food-safety systems. This position works closely with QA, Operations, Production, Sanitation, Procurement, Sales, Marketing, Product Development, Logistics, suppliers, customers, and third-party auditors. This position is based out of Blacks Harbour, NB.

Specific responsibilities for this position will include but are not limited to:

• Maintain raw material, packaging-material, finished-product, and customer-specific product specifications and technical documentation.

• Review and approve packaging artwork, labels, cartons, retail and food-service packaging, product claims, and customer-specific packaging before printing, purchasing, production, or market release.

• Verify product identity, species declarations, ingredient statements, allergen declarations, Nutrition Facts information, net contents, bilingual Canadian labeling, U.S. labeling, storage instructions, date coding, lot coding, barcodes, and traceability information.

• Maintain controlled records of specifications, label and packaging approvals, supplier declarations, food-contact documentation, customer documents, and obsolete-material controls.

• Investigate customer complaints, product defects, packaging and labeling issues, food-safety deviations, and non-conformation documentation.

• Lead or support root-cause analysis using 5 Why Analysis, Fishbone Diagrams, Pareto analysis, trend reviews, and other structured problem-solving tools.

• Prepare KPI scorecards, trend analyses, risk assessments, complaint summaries, corrective-action reports, and technical reports for QA and operational leadership.

• Provide technical support and training to QA and operational teams on specifications, packaging, labeling, food safety, regulatory requirements, inspection standards, and documentation practices.

A successful candidate will possess the following qualifications:

• Post-secondary education in Food Science, Food Safety, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Biology, Nutrition, Fisheries, Aquaculture, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education, experience, and training will be considered.

• A recognized Regulatory Affairs Certificate, food-labeling certificate, or equivalent formal training in food regulatory affairs.

• Experience in food quality assurance, food safety, seafood processing, aquaculture, regulatory affairs, product specifications, labeling, or packaging approval.

• Working knowledge of HACCP, GMPs, traceability, sanitation, corrective actions, complaint investigation, root-cause analysis, food-safety audits, and GFSI-recognized standards such as BRCGS or SQF.

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. food regulations, including CFIA/SFCR requirements, FDA seafood HACCP, food labeling, allergen declarations, nutrition labeling, and packaging requirements.

• Strong organizational, analytical, technical-writing, communication, and project-management skills.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and electronic document-control, quality-management, specification-management, or ERP systems.

• Valid driver's license and ability to travel approximately 20%.

*Cooke offers full-time year round employment, competitive rates and a competitive benefits package which includes health and dental as well as a company matched pension.

## Benefits Package

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Wellness: Wellness programs.

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

## The Opportunity

The role description is just one part of the story. This is an opportunity to grow, to stretch, to work within the parameters of the role but stretch to your fullest potential. We are a team that counts performance, we reward contribution, and we recognize talent. It is about being at the center of the fastest growing company in Atlantic Canada and knowing you are part of that growth. The ability to bring your passion for learning, desire for growth, and energy for moving your career forward is what we offer.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2162993.description:
## This is the life-changing opportunity you've been looking for.

Imagine a playground in Atlantic Canada

surrounded by fresh waterways on one side and the ocean on the other.

Horizon Health Network is currently seeking Geriatricians to join the Division of Geriatric Medicine
in beautiful Fredericton, New Brunswick.

## Why you should work here

New Brunswick offers a safe and welcoming community with a relaxed lifestyle and a true work-life balance, enriched by its diverse Indigenous, Anglophone, and Francophone heritage.

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

Horizon's Dr. Everett Chalmers Regional Hospital (DECRH) is located in Fredericton, the capital city of New Brunswick. The DECRH is partnered with Dalhousie University and is a teaching site for Family Medicine residents, as well as medical students in an innovative longitudinal clerkship program. The Geriatric Medicine outpatient clinic is based at the nearby Woodbridge Centre facility. You'd be joining a dynamic team of three internist Geriatricians in a collegial environment which supports your flexibility to pursue clinical, educational, quality improvement and administrative interests.

## Incentives & Remuneration:

This is a salaried position with a base range of $273,962 - $302,796. Participation in the General Internal Medicine on-call service is optional and is remunerated additionally in a fee-for-service model.

Salaried physicians enjoy vacation and medical education leave, paid overhead expenses including administrative support, extended health benefits, and unparalleled work-life balance.

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban recruitment incentive of $50,000.00 with a 2-year return of service.

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

## Who you are

• Geriatric Medicine specialist (Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or equivalent).

• Must hold a valid license to practice medicine in the Province of New Brunswick.

• A member in good standing with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick and the Atlantic Registry.

• Must have current malpractice insurance from the Canadian Medical Protective Association (CMPA) appropriate to the category of practice.

• Bilingualism (French/English) would be considered an asset.

## What you will do

As a Geriatrician, you will establish a full-time practice offering both inpatient and outpatient services:

• Provide assessment and management of both new and follow-up outpatients through the Geriatric Medicine Clinic at the Woodbridge Centre in Fredericton.

• Provide inpatient consultations upon request in Fredericton and Oromocto hospitals.

• Provide consultations to local nursing home residents at the request of the primary care provider.

• Provide consultations at home, if desired.

• Collaborate in the care of older adults admitted to the inpatient rehabilitation unit at the DECRH, including attending weekly interdisciplinary team meetings.

• Engage in clinical teaching for resident physicians and medical students. Didactic and small-group teaching opportunities are also available.

• There are numerous opportunities to participate in administrative roles for those who wish.

## Interested? Apply Today!

To learn more, visit https://myhorizoncareer.ca/

If you have questions, please email physiciancareers@horizonnb.ca.

Fredericton Region - Horizon Health Network

2222682.employer: City of Moncton / Ville de Moncton
2222682.description:
UTILITY 6 - ARBORIST

Parks - Job # P1441

JOB SUMMARY:
The Utility 6-Arborist will carry out comprehensive arboricultural duties throughout the City of Moncton's urban tree population. Daily climbing of all types of trees under all types of conditions is the primary job function.

The position reports to the Supervisor of Parks.

EDUCATION:

• Graduation from Grade 12 or equivalent .

• Must have one of the following:
• Post-secondary education from a recognized institution in a relevant college or university degree program.

• Designated as a Utility Arborist Journeyperson with the Province of New Brunswick

• Designated as an Arborist Journeyperson with the Province of New Brunswick

• The following certificates and training are required for this position. The successful candidate must have and maintain these qualifications as required for periodic renewal: ISA Certified Arborist Certification, Chainsaw Safety Training, Standard First Aid and CPR, Arboricultural Electrical Safety, Construction Signing & Traffic Control, Bucket Evacuation Safety.

• Must be willing to attend training as required.

EXPERIENCE:

• Must have a minimum of (3) three years of aerial work with a combination of climbing and bucket truck operation.

• Must be knowledgeable and have proven experience with materials and methods required for rigging and removal of mature trees in an urban setting. This includes but is not limited to the use of ropes, cranes, slings, friction brakes and other arboricultural equipment.

LANGUAGE:

• English essential.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

• Must be able to work safely and efficiently in and around obstacles such as houses, energized conductors, communication lines, pedestrian traffic, and other forms of urban infrastructure.

• Must have and maintain a level of physical fitness to be able to carry out all aspects of this position.

• Must be knowledgeable and capable of performing aerial rescue operations from a tree climbing and aerial lift scenario.

• Must possess the ability to prepare daily work reports and I.S.A. hazardous tree evaluation forms.

• Must be knowledgeable and abide by the New Brunswick Occupational Health and Safety Act.

• Must have a good working knowledge of IPM and its principles as they apply to urban forestry.

• Good working knowledge of Tree Risk Assessment, IPM and PHC as it relates to Urban Forestry and knowledge of Tree Soil Relations.

• Good working knowledge of plants indigenous and introduced to Zone 5b.

• Good working knowledge of acceptable nursery stock as per CNLA specifications (most current edition).

• Good working knowledge of construction practices as they relate to tree care.

• Must be knowledgeable of the New Brunswick Occupational Safety Act.

• Basic computer knowledge of Microsoft Office, Word, Excel, etc.

• Ability to work safely and efficiently in an aerial working environment both with climbing techniques and with the use of aerial lift devices.

• Must have demonstrated skills and abilities to work around energized power conductors.

• Must have proven technical abilities in rigging and removal in an urban setting.

• Must have good pruning skills as per current ANSI 300 Pruning Standards Best Management Practices for Tree Pruning.

• Basic operation and maintenance of arboricultural and grounds maintenance equipment including but not limited to bucket trucks, chippers, stumpers, saws, tree spades, tractors, Zambonis, 1 ton plow trucks etc.

OTHER:

• Must possess and maintain a valid Class 3E driver's license

CONTACT:

• Must be able to communicate precisely, positively and professionally when responding to inquiries from the public, other municipal departments, government inspectors, contractors, material suppliers and fellow employees.

• Work requires an individual with a positive attitude that reflects the best interests of the Corporation and the community at large.

SUPERVISION:

• Supervision and development of small crews and contractors may be required.

CONDITIONS OF WORK:

• Work will be carried out in all types of weather conditions while constantly under the eye of the public in municipal parks, city buildings and street side locations.

• This work requires considerable physical effort to work in extreme hot, extreme cold and all types of stormy, humid and wet weather conditions.

• Salary and hours of work as specified in the Collective Agreement between the City of Moncton and CUPE Local 51.

## Sales Representative

Location: Moncton, NB

## Position Summary

Maritime Paper Products LP is a dynamic, team-oriented company and is honored to be one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. We believe that hiring the best people is a key part of our success. Providing excellence in both our packaging solutions and the relationships we build with our clients, we offer superior capabilities, including in-house graphic and structural design, platemaking, and manufacturing for retail-ready display. We support our customers through operations located in NS, NB, NL, and PE.

We're looking for a Sales Representative to grow existing customer relationships while actively developing new business in the New Brunswick territory. You'll manage your own customer portfolio and work closely with an assigned Customer Service Representative and our internal teams to develop solutions and drive profitable growth. You will report to the Director, Sales & Marketing.

## Duties & Responsibilities

· Manage and grow an existing portfolio of customer accounts

· Build relationships with key contacts and decision-makers

· Identify opportunities to expand business within existing accounts

· Prospect, qualify and secure new customers

· Develop and maintain an active sales pipeline

· Manage pricing and commercial opportunities with a focus on profitable growth

· Work with Design and other internal teams to develop customer solutions

· Monitor market and competitive activity and maintain accurate sales forecasts

## Qualifications & Experience

## Required Qualifications

· B2B sales or account management experience

· A proven ability to build strong customer relationships while identifying opportunities to grow new business within existing accounts

· Strong communication, negotiation and commercial skills

· A proactive approach to developing existing accounts, winning new business, and achieving sales objectives

· Strong organization, planning and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage customer activities and sales opportunities effectively

· Proficiency in standard business software and CRM systems, with the ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies

· Bilingual English/French required for Moncton-based positions.

## Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in packaging, manufacturing or related industry

This role is a great fit for a motivated and customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building strong relationships, identifying opportunities, and delivering solutions that create value for customers and the business.

Maritime Paper Products promotes and encourages career advancement within our Scotia Investments Family of Companies.

Maritime Paper Products is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

Although we gratefully accept all applications, only those candidates being considered for an interview will be contacted. No telephone calls please.

## An Equal Opportunity Employer

2240380.description:
## JOB PURPOSE

The successful candidate will be responsible for promoting, facilitating, and exemplifying the provision of high-quality care as a Primary Health Care NP within their legislated scope of practice as outlined in the provincial Nurses Act, NANB Entry-Level Competencies Nurse Practitioners, the NANB Standards for the Practice of Primary Health Care Nurse Practitioners.

## QUALIFICATIONS

• Active registration as a nurse practitioner with the Nurses Association of New Brunswick.

• Minimum of 1 year of clinical practice experience as a NP within the last 5 years.

• Ability to work independently and in teams; to lead and drive change.

• Demonstrated understanding of privacy and confidentiality, evidence-based nursing practice and mentoring cultures.

• Exemplary written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Demonstrated ability to attend work on a regular basis.

## RESPONSIBILITIES

• Maintains an awareness of current trends, issues, and concepts within provincial and national health care, and the NP profession.

• Contributes to process change involving NP practice, for the purpose of increasing efficiency and effectiveness of health services.

• Participates in the development, monitoring, and evaluation of evidence-based protocols/guidelines/standards of care for geriatric patient populations, in collaboration with team members.

• Acts as a consultant to the registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, and personal care attendants (resident attendants) as it relates to diagnosing, ordering of tests, and prescribing medications as outlined by the NANB.

## Health Assessment and Diagnosis

• Completes a comprehensive health assessment

• Orders, obtains, performs and interprets diagnostic and laboratory screening tests in accordance with the NANB Standards for PHC NPs and within legislation.

• Establishes a diagnosis.

• Initiates appropriate treatment plan in collaboration with the patient/client/family or substitute decision maker and other team members as indicated.

## Therapeutic Management of Acute and Chronic Conditions

• Demonstrates knowledge of current best-practice guidelines for the delivery of care.

• Prescribes, adjusts and renews medications in accordance with legislation, NANB and employer policy.

• Monitors, evaluates, and alters therapies and/or treatments as appropriate.

• Initiates timely referral or collaboration with other team members, as indicated.

## Health Promotion and Prevention of Illness and Injury

• Demonstrates knowledge and understanding of health promotion services and facilitates primary, secondary and tertiary prevention strategies.

• Incorporates risk reduction and disease and injury prevention strategies.

• As part of the interdisciplinary team, participates in the development and implementation of community/population health interventions as required.

## Professional Responsibility and Accountability

• Maintains the competencies as outlined in the NANB Standards of Practice for Primary Health Care Nurse Practitioners.

• Actively participates as a team member to provide comprehensive care to all residents.

• Exemplifies and promotes excellence in advance practice nursing care.

• Utilizes nursing and other research to support clinical knowledge and evidence-based practice.

• Establishes a network of referral sources to accommodate the provision of care to residents. Referral sources are internal and external to the organization.

• Functions as a resource, preceptor and mentor to Nurse Practitioner students and other health professionals.

• Assumes responsibility for self-directed professional development and participates in professional education activities.

• Participates in the development, monitoring, and evaluation of evidence-based protocols/guidelines/standards of care in collaboration with team members.

• Participates in regular Drug Reviews, Professional Advisory Meetings, Ethics Meetings and Multidisciplinary Care Conferences, or other committees as required.

## COMPETENCIES

• Communication

• Leadership

• Planning and Prioritizing Work

• Teaching/Mentoring

• Teamwork and Collaboration

• Nurse Practitioner Competencies as outlined by the NANB

If a candidate's primary language of communication is not English, an English Language Proficiency Evaluation is required for all postings (Reading, Writing and Oral).

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

As valuable member of the Extramural Program's interdisciplinary team, the Patient Care Attendant - 2 (PCA-2) reports to the Unit Manager and provides personal support and assistance with activities of daily living and other services to patients of all ages in the community.

Using a person-centered approach, the PCA-2 works in partnership with the patient and their health care team by holistically supporting the patient's physical, psychological, social, cognitive, cultural, and spiritual needs.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provides holistic and individualized care across the lifespan.

• Provides food and meal assistance.

• Assists with mobilization.

• Assists with personal hygiene.

• Supports patient care activities by observing and reporting concerns, changes, or relevant information to the appropriate health care team members.

• Provides assistance with Activities of Daily Living (ADL) and Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADL).

• Provides palliative, end-of-life (EOL), and postmortem care.

• Recognize and report changes in the patient's status to the primary provider.

• Assists with restricted activities/controlled acts, as delegated by a Regulated Health Professional

• Participates as a member of the healthcare team.

• Documents patient information, care and progress as per EMP documentation standards.

• Maintains patient safety.

• Reports suspected situations of abuse and/or neglect.

• Maintains personal and team members' safety.

• Applies infection prevention and control practices.

• Maintain a clean and safe work area.

• Provides inclusive care.

•

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS

• High school graduation plus an additional patient care program/course of up to six months or equivalent.

• Experience working with adult patients would be an asset;

• A good driving record with a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License;

• Have a current CPR Level C certification that has been issued in the last 12 months;

• Ability to work efficiently as a member of the team, possess strong interpersonal and communication skill;

• Able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record;

• A high regard for confidentiality Good computer knowledge and skills (MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Submit a valid and clean criminal record check;

All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Note: For any positions in the St. Stephen EMP unit, a valid Canadian passport or Nexus card will be required.

If you are interested in working with a dynamic team of professionals and possess the necessary qualifications, please click the 'Apply Now' button to submit your resume.

1856200.title: Saltwater Aquaculture Worker - Grand Manan
1856200.description:
Kelly Cove Salmon Ltd., a division of Cooke Aquaculture Inc., a dynamic and growing east coast family company, with Platinum Member status in the Canada's Best Managed Companies Program, is offering a unique opportunity for highly motivated individuals to join the Company's Saltwater Team on Grand Manan, NB.

Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, and South America. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly-skilled and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

As a result of our robust growth, we are hiring Saltwater Aquaculture Workers to join our team. The ideal candidates will be self-motivated team players willing to work flexible hours and schedules.

The primary duties include, but are not limited to:

• Monitoring and operating the feeding systems.

• Report any observed irregularities in stocks.

• Grid installation and inspection/repair.

• Marine cage and net installation and removal.

• Operate, maintain, and clean aquaculture equipment and enclosures.

• General site maintenance including net washing.

• Operation of boats for aquaculture operations.

• Grade and weigh aquaculture stock.

• Harvest assistance as required.

*Applicants must hold or be willing to obtain a Marine Emergency Duties (MED) certificate .

This is a labour-intensive position, requires standing for long periods of time; applicants must be comfortable working in outside weather conditions on both aquaculture sites and aboard maintenance vessels.

Experience within the aquaculture field would be considered an asset but not required as on the job training is provided.

Hourly wage, is based on experience/education, and begins at $20.66 plus $2 an hour premium for any hours worked on Grand Manan; complimented by a competitive health and dental benefit package.

* We offer flexible work rotations for those who do not wish to relocate but are interested in working a rotating schedule (week on/week off). This includes company housing while on shift, Coastal Transportation fare, and competitive rates.

## The Opportunity

The role description is just one part of the story. This is an opportunity to grow, to work within the parameters of the role but to reach your fullest potential. We are a team that is driven to succeed. We count performance, we reward contribution, and we recognize talent. It is about being at the center of a growing, global leader in seafood and knowing you are part of that growth. The ability to bring your passion for learning, desire for growth and energy for moving your career forward is what we offer.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

* As per company policy, a criminal background check is required.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2241253.title: Learning Specialist for the Centre of Excellence for Skilled Trades and Manufacturing
2241253.employer: Department of Education and Early Childhood Development
2241253.description:
Learning Specialist for the Centre of Excellence for Skilled Trades and Manufacturing Department of Education and Early Childhood DevelopmentContract OpenFredericton

At the Department of Education and Early Childhood Development (EECD),we are dedicated to fulfilling New Brunswick's educational mission.

Interested in making a difference in our province? We encourage you to Choose GNB!

## Who we are:

The work we do has a positive impact on our communities and helps improve the everyday lives of New Brunswickers. Together, we are over 45,000 New Brunswickers who are passionate problem-solvers, who make a difference and are proud to call New Brunswick home.

The Centre of Excellence for Skilled Trades and Manufacturing connects K-12 education with industry expertise, emerging technologies, and real-world learning opportunities across skilled trades and manufacturing. The Learning Specialist will engage industry experts to capture and translate current practices, technologies, and applications into virtual and experiential learning experiences that support curriculum outcomes, student achievement, and teacher professional learning. The role will strengthen connections between classrooms and the evolving world of skilled trades, manufacturing, and technology.

## What you will do:

Reporting to the Assistant Director of the Digital Learning and System Excellence Branch, the successful candidate will collaborate with the Anglophone sector, industry partners, and other agencies to connect teachers and students across the four Anglophone school districts with skilled trades and manufacturing careers, while supporting curriculum-connected learning and real-world applications.

The successful candidate's primary responsibilities will include:

• Work with the department, school districts, and industry to develop a connected network of experts to support virtual and experiential opportunities for students and teachers across the province.

• Contribute to the development of the Centre of Excellence model.

• Represent the Centre on committees and working groups.

• Liaise with businesses, community organizations, and other partners on related programs and opportunities.

• Develop and support programs and learning resources that provide opportunities for students in skilled trades and manufacturing, including in career education, co-op, and other placement opportunities.

• Develop and promote virtual and experiential learning activities that connect teachers and students with industry professionals.

• Coordinate meetings, events, and professional learning opportunities for teachers.

• Develop the centre's library of sharable resources, including technical documents, videos, and interactive materials to support teachers and students and highlight the variety of careers and learning options available in skilled trades and manufacturing.

• Collect data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to monitor progress towards achieving centre goals.

• Participate in process improvement projects and contribute to initiatives and activities of the branch and EECD.

## Who you are:

You are a changemaker who strives for excellence and innovation in all you do. You are a dynamic individual who is comfortable working independently and with different sized teams. The candidate should also possess intermediate or higher technology skills and be enthusiastic about the evolution and growth of skilled trades and manufacturing in New Brunswick. You are recognized as a leader and are comfortable leading initiatives, activities and events both in person and virtually.

Your attitude, skills and interests are just as important as your area of study. We are looking for diverse backgrounds that bring a combination of the following:

## Need to have:

• Master's degree in Education, or a related field and a minimum of six (6) years of public-school teaching experience. An equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered.

• A minimum of three (3) years of experience working in a skilled trades or manufacturing environment.

• Demonstrated effective relationship management with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

• Experience in the development and delivery of curricula and professional learning.

Written and spoken competence in English is required. Please state your language capability on your application.

## Nice to have:

• Written and spoken competence in French.

• Technology skills including areas such as:
• CAD, CAM, 3D printing, table-top manufacturing,

• Robotics and automation, industrial manufacturing processes

• Maker spaces and builder-style hands-on technology

• Additional skilled trades areas, e.g., culinary construction and transportation

• Successful completion of a Red Seal certification.

• Experience teaching skilled trades.

• Experience with safety protocols and other occupational health and safety standards.

Subject to the response to this competition, candidates may be required to demonstrate on their application one or more of the asset qualifications in addition to the essential qualifications in order to be given further consideration.

## Behavioural Competencies:

• Creative Thinking / Innovation

• Effective Interactive Communication

• Relationship / Network Building

• Results Orientation

• Teamwork and Cooperation

## Technical Competencies:

• Project Management

• Presentation Skills

• Planning and Organizing Skills

• Written Communication

Résumés should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

## Salary:

Pay Band 7: $94,146 - $113,906 annually.

## Work environment:

• Office location: 250 King Street, Fredericton.

• Some travel throughout province required.

• Remote work within New Brunswick can be considered.

• Standard hours of work: Monday - Friday, 8:15-4:30.

• We promote a scent-reduced environment.

## What can GNB offer you?

• Comprehensive benefits package which includes paid vacation, Health and Dental Plan, Life Insurance, and the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan.

• Opportunities for career growth, professional development and training.

• Free access to Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and services.

• 1 paid Volunteer Day per year to give back to your community.

• 1.25 days/month of paid sick leave.

Providing a safe workplace for all. Your health & safety are important to us. GNB has implemented preventative measures across the organization to ensure your health & safety.

## How to apply:

We encourage applicants to apply online at www.ere.gnb.ca by mail at the following address, or by email at HR.Competitions@gnb.ca by September 27, 2026, indicating competition number 26-2000-C21. This competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level.

Department of Education and Early Childhood Development
Human Resource Services
Place 2000, 250 King Street
Fredericton, N.B. E3B 5H1
Telephone: 1-506-444-4909

We thank all those who apply, however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted.

## Equal Opportunity Employer

Candidates registered with the Equal Employment Opportunity Program and veterans, who demonstrate they are among the most qualified, shall be given preference at the time of appointment. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

## Let's connect. You belong here.

2241259.description:
PROGRAM ADVISOR
OPEN COMPETITION
DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH
FREDERICTON
(An alternate work location in New Brunswick may be considered)

The Department of Health is seeking an individual to join the Public Health Branch as a Program Advisor.

As the Program Advisor you will:

• Research, develop, plan, monitor, and evaluate Public Health programs, policies, and legislative frameworks;

• Provide consultative expertise to support the team, leadership, and partners with health policy, promotion, prevention, and protection initiatives, using a population health framework;

• Engage in subject matter areas of population health, health promotion, and related topics, including food insecurity, the determinants of health, and health equity;

• Support the review and development of public health legislation, policies, and programs;

• Track, analyze, and compile national policy and legislative trends;

• Be accountable for stakeholder engagement and relationship management;

• Undertake knowledge translation initiatives;

• Develop and present briefing materials for senior leadership;

• Develop communications, key messages, and briefing notes;

• Represent Public Health on provincial and national committees.

Who you are:

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

2227060.description:
html
Competition number: 26-055

Salary: $77,166.00 - $91,408.00/Year

Job Type: Temporary Full Time

Closing Date: June 2, 2026

## Position Overview:

The City of Saint John is seeking qualified applications for the position of Temporary Community Safety Services Manager with Growth and Community Services for a term up to 2 years. The successful candidate's objective is to support community well-being in the City of Saint John by promoting, monitoring, and enforcing municipal by-laws to ensure properties, activities, and land use comply with applicable regulations.

The successful candidate will promote voluntary compliance of municipal by-laws to ensure regulatory requirements are met by all stakeholders. They will help administer, enforce and ensure the integrity and relevance of current municipal by-laws.

## Key Responsibilities:

• Ensure clear and correct communications of municipal regulatory information and promote voluntary compliance with by-law requirements by:
• Reviewing and responding to correspondence and inquiries from internal and external stakeholders.

• Providing assistance and information to various municipal departments regarding enforcement of city by-laws designated by Common Council.

• Making appropriate recommendations regarding measures to minimize and control violations in the community.

• Enforcing compliance through legal actions including the laying of charges for breach of by-laws under the department's jurisdiction.

• Conducting inspections as required, preparation of reports and notifying affected parties with respect to requirements.

• Formulating, implementing and periodically reviewing procedures, policies and regulations for by-law inspections and enforcement.

• Setting clear objectives, priorities and performance indicators for Community Safety Services (CSS) activities aligned with departmental and Council direction.

• Providing day-to-day guidance to CSS team members, including deployment, coordination of field activities, community outreach and risk mitigation.

• Establishing and maintaining standard operating procedures for CSS incident response, inspections and escalation protocols.

• Coaching and supporting CSS staff to ensure consistent, fair and effective enforcement and engagement.

• Ensure all requirements are met by all stakeholders by:
• Gathering evidence and recommending corrective actions or enforcement actions pursuant to by-laws and legislation.

• Preparing and prioritizing files recommended to legal department for action, providing information and support as required.

• Providing assistance and information to various departments and the public regarding by-law enforcement and consulting with staff of other city departments to minimize and resolve issues.

• Monitoring CSS results and preparing regular reports on activity, trends, compliance rates and outcomes for leadership and Council.

• Leading or supporting after-action reviews and continuous improvement initiatives following incidents, major files or targeted enforcement campaigns led by the CSS team.

• Represent the department to other departments, government organizations and the construction community in regard to by-law interpretation, enforcement and maintenance and enhance the department's reputation and relevance by:
• Responding to client and stakeholder concerns.

• Acting as the department's representative to other municipal governments, various provincial departments and other agencies.

• Participating in various municipal boards, committees, associations, and attending Council meetings and other meetings.

• Appearing on behalf of the City of Saint John in court, as required.

• Coordinating CSS responses with community partners to align approaches to safety, security and nuisance concerns.

• Presenting CSS performance, trends and recommendations to leadership and Council to inform direction and resourcing.

• Administer, enforce and ensure the integrity and relevance of current municipal by-laws and those that Common Council may enact by:
• Maintaining familiarity with various provincial legislative acts and other relevant legislation and information as well as researching relevant Provincial legislation, recommending repeal or amendment of by-laws.

• Conducting the necessary research required prior to the enactment of new by-laws and maintaining department policies and procedures manual based on this research as well as changing situations and priorities.

• Providing information, reports and support to Council and interested parties attending their meetings, as required.

• Providing by-law interpretation, supervision of by-law enforcement and maintenance of by-laws, codes and requirements.

• Preparation of quotes.

• Contractual obligations.

• Inspections and reports.

• Ensuring all CSS activities comply with applicable legislation, by-laws, privacy requirements and City policies.

• Managing CSS-related quotes, contracts and vendor performance where applicable, and contributing to resource planning and budgeting inputs for CSS operations.

## Essential Qualifications:

• Education: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university in a relevant field is required.

• Experience:
• 3-5 years of progressively responsible experience in regulatory compliance, municipal by-law/code enforcement, community safety, or a related public-sector compliance function.

• Minimum of 2 years in a supervisory or team-leadership position is required.

• Technical Skills:
• In-depth knowledge of relevant city by-laws, ordinances and provincial legislation.

• Proven managerial skill reflected in sound administrative abilities, attention to detail, sound conceptual thinking and an ability to work and achieve results in conjunction with others.

The successful applicant may be eligible to participate in a Flexible Time Options Program which includes the option of working a 4 or 5-day work week, subject to business requirements.

## Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a workforce that reflects the diversity of the communities in which we live and which we serve. We encourage and support applications from Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and members of visible minority groups. Candidates who belong to such groups, who are qualified, will be given preference at the time of selection.

Applications will be accepted through our online system only. Qualified applicants should submit their cover letters and resumes to:

City of Saint John
Attn: Hiring Committee
www.saintjohn.ca (careers)

Only those applicants being considered further will be contacted.

2241050.description:
## This is the life-changing opportunity you've been looking for.

Horizon Health Network in beautiful New Brunswick is looking for a Medical Affairs Coordinator to join our team!

Horizon Health Network (Horizon) is seeking an innovative, collaborative, and driven individual to join our team as a Medical Affairs Coordinator.

## Why you should work here

Working for Horizon gives you a career that provides an east coast lifestyle and the chance to make a big difference in the lives of New Brunswickers.

This position comes with competitive salary, paid time off, sick benefits, employer paid contributions into our government pension plan and a remote work policy.

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. An environment based on a commitment to diversity and inclusion supports our goal of safe and quality patient care.

## Who you are

The Medical Affairs Coordinator oversees administrative support services within the department and provides coordination and operational support to Medical Staff programs and initiatives. Reporting to the Director of Medical Affairs, this role will collaborate closely with department leadership, Physician Talent Acquisition, the Regional Chief of Staff and the Senior VP of Academic, Research and Medical Affairs.

## Qualifications

• You have a worked in healthcare operations/administration setting for a minimum of 2-4

• You hold a bachelor's degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration or a related field. A combination of education and experience may be considered.

• You have experience with healthcare operations, project management, process and quality improvement initiatives, information systems, and data analysis.

## Skills

• Excellent organizational and coordination skills with the ability to manage priorities

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities with ability to identify and lead quality/process improvement opportunities.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build collaborative relationships with executive leaders, physicians, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Digitally savvy with the ability to seek out innovative solutions, adopt new technologies, and adapt to new tools and systems.

• Ability to work independently or as part of a team with ability to maintain excellent standards of accountability and professionalism.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint).

## What you will do

• Coordinate delivery of Medical Affairs initiatives and physician support activities by organizing workgroups, tracking milestones and action items, preparing reports, and ensuring assigned deliverables are completed within established timelines.

• Provide administrative and operational support to physician governance and Medical Affairs leadership through preparation of committee materials, audit and benchmarking documentation, governance tracking, meeting coordination, and implementation of decisions and follow-up actions.

• Supervise assigned regional administrative staff including scheduling, workload distribution, onboarding, training, attendance monitoring, performance documentation, and cross-zone coverage within established policies and management direction.

• Coordinate Medical Affairs administrative processes, maintain standardized workflows, procedures, templates, tracking systems, and identifying operational issues requiring escalation to the Director.

• Support the department's continuous improvement by identify operational inefficiencies and quality issues, and leading administrative process/quality improvement initiatives.

## Horizon Competency

Core competencies for non-bargaining positions are based on the LEADS in a Caring Environment leadership capabilities framework: Lead Self, Engage Others, Achieve Results, Develop Coalitions, and System Transformation.

In addition to LEADS, all positions need to demonstrate compassion, patience, and professionalism in all interactions, consistently upholding a respectful and supportive environment for patients, clients, families, and colleagues. Proactively addresses concerns and responds to emerging needs with empathy and diligence, contributing to high-quality, patient/client centered care.

## Interested? Apply Today!

To learn more, visit MyHorizonCareer.ca/management-business-professionals/

Horizon Health Network (Horizon) only accepts on-line applications.

## About Horizon's Recruitment Process

We thank all applicant who apply; however, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted. All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Horizon's recruitment screening process may include language proficiency testing, clerical testing and/or behavioral assessment. If you are selected for testing, you will be contacted via the email address provided on your application. The official results will be shared with the candidate, Human Resources and the requesting manager electronically and language results will be placed on the personnel file for Horizon's hiring purposes.

## Diversity Statement

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. We believe in a healthcare system that equally supports all people regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, social background, religion, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or sexual orientation. 2226994.title: Aircraft Maintenance Engineer
2226994.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

The Aircraft Maintenance Engineer is responsible for supporting the safe and efficient operation of aircraft by assisting with inspections, maintenance, repairs, and modifications. This role ensures all assigned aircraft are maintained in compliance with company standards, customer requirements, and Transport Canada regulations.

## Responsibilities:

• Assist in carrying out maintenance, repairs and modifications on aircraft

• Complete work sheets for work accomplished

• Report on unserviceable maintenance equipment

• Ensure that assigned aircraft are maintained in accordance with Customer Standards

• Carry out the inspection, maintenance and repair of company aircraft and related aircraft systems

• Report to the Shift Supervisor on issues affecting the serviceability of aircraft

• Ensure aircraft are maintained in accordance with the company Maintenance Control Manual and Transport Canada Regulations

• Comply with all company safety practices and procedures

• Complete all required documentation and task cards for the work accomplished related to the aircraft maintenance performed

• Other duties as assigned

## Qualifications:

• Must have completed a Transport Canada approved Aircraft Maintenance Course and hold a valid Transport Canada M1 and/or M2 AME license

• Experience with King Airs and Falcons preferred, experience with Gulfstreams an asset

• Have a valid Canadian passport as some travel is required

• Must possess strong decision making, organizational and communication skills

• The ability to work both independently and in a team environment

• Knowledge of airframe and power plant systems

• Trouble shooting skills

• Knowledge of Transport Canada Regulations

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

NOTE: The recruiter is reviewing and interviewing eligible applicants for this position as they are received. If you are interested in this posting, you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

2240167.title: Benefits Services Specialist
2240167.description:
Vestcor has a full-time position available for a Benefits Services Specialist.

Located in Fredericton, Vestcor is the largest investment manager in Atlantic Canada, providing global investment management services to 11 different client groups representing approximately $24.4 billion in assets under management. We also provide administration services to 11 pension plans and five employee benefit plans.

The Benefits Services Specialist works as part of a team in performing a number of pension-related calculations for plan members. Calculations are performed using our pension administration system along with Excel spreadsheets. The work is performed within a fast-paced, high-volume environment with a focus on providing excellent service to plan members.

The ideal candidate requires a post-secondary diploma and five years of work experience. Experience working with Microsoft Office Suite is required.

The candidate must be a team player, be client focused, possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and have excellent attention to detail. Written and spoken competence in English is required.

In the cover letter, candidates must demonstrate why they believe they have the required qualifications and skills for this position. We offer a competitive salary, an excellent benefits package, and a challenging and rewarding team environment. The successful candidate will participate in the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan.

Vestcor supports a diverse and inclusive work environment and encourages applications from all qualified applicants. Interested applicants must forward their cover letter and resume by September 30, 2026 to:

Director Human Resources

Vestcor Inc.

100 - 140 Carleton St.

Fredericton, NB E3B 3T4

Or via e-mail to: careers@vestcor.org

2241263.description:
Senior Project ManagerDepartment of Education and Early Childhood DevelopmentPermanent Position (francophone)Open CompetitionFredericton

Interested in making a difference in our province? We encourage you to Choose GNB!

## Who we are:

The Educational Facilities and Pupil Transportation Branch provide school districts with support and expertise in the planning and management of educational facilities and pupil transportation. The objective is to create a healthy and secure learning and working environment and we are seeking an individual to join the Educational Facilities Unit as a Senior Project Manager in our central office in Fredericton.

## What you will do:

Reporting to the Infrastructure Program Manager, the successful candidate will be a member of the team responsible for the planning, development, and implementation of strategies for the effective management of the province`s school infrastructure which includes 294 schools.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the planning of educational facilities, which includes, recommending capital projects and completing the related consultations with Francophone School Districts, District Education Councils, and community groups. They are responsible for providing leadership to issues related to the operations of school physical plants and following up with School Districts and the Department of Transportation and Infrastructure (DTI) on appropriate identified issues. They will review plans and specifications, ensuring compliance with environmental and public safety laws and regulations, as well as managing approved budgetary allotments.

Key responsibilities include:

• Plan, develop and implement effective infrastructure management strategies

• Stakeholder engagement and consultation

• Capital Program project recommendations, planning and implementation

• Prepare documentation for annual capital budget submissions

• Educational facility specifications and construction plan review

• Ensure communication plans for all capital projects are implemented

• Compliance of Environmental and Public Safety laws, regulations and building codes

• Facilitate communication and coordination between DTI and School Districts

• Management of approved budget allocation

## Who you are:

You are client-centric and passionate about delivering exceptional service. You demonstrate initiative and are adaptable, organized and solution oriented. You are self-motivated with strong teamwork skills. You enjoy multi-tasking in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines. You are an effective communicator and collaborator, and you have strong problem solving and analytical skills.

## Need to have:

• A bachelor`s degree in engineering, architecture or a related field with a minimum of six (6) years of related progressive experience in facility planning, management of physical plant, building administration or relatable building operation field.

• Demonstrated experience in planning and organizing major projects.

• Superior level in French is required for this position. A language evaluation will be offered to those who screen in.

• An equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Written and spoken competence in French and English is required; the positions will mainly conduct business in French. Please state your language capability on your application.

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please ensure that preferred language, either English or French for assessment, is identified on your resume.

Behavioural Competencies:

• Analytical Thinking/Judgment

• Commitment to Learning

• Effective Interactive Communication

• Self-Confidence

• Concern for Order

## Technical Competencies:

• Knowledge of Applicable Legislation & the Department`s policies and procedures

• Project Management

Résumés should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

Salary:
Pay Band 5: $67,600 - $94,406 annually.

## Work Environment:

• Office location: Place 2000 (250 King Street, Fredericton)

• Standard hours of work: Monday - Friday, 8:15 am-4:30 pm

• We promote a scent-reduced environment

## What can GNB offer you?

• Comprehensive benefits package which includes paid vacation, Health and Dental Plan, Life Insurance, Long Term Disability, and the New Brunswick Public Service Pension Plan

Providing a safe workplace for all. Your health & safety are important to us. GNB has implemented preventative measures across the organization to ensure your health & Safety.

2216348.title: Disability and Wellness Coordinator (temporary position up to two (2) years)
2216348.description:
html
Competition number: PF 26-004

Salary: $68,309.00 - $68,309.00/Year

Job Type: Temporary Full Time

Closing Date: April 12, 2026

## Position Overview:

Under the direction of the Director of Human Resources, this position will proactively coordinate disability management files, assessing any barriers to ensure timely, effective, and successful return-to-work plans. The Disability and Wellness Coordinator will collaborate with internal and external partners to ensure compliance with applicable legislation while promoting a culture of health and wellness in coordinating Workplace Wellness programs.

The incumbent requires a high level of energy, organizational skills, initiative, and independent judgment in the performance of varied wellness and disability management duties that are highly confidential in nature.

As a member of the Saint John Police administration team, this member must understand the vision, mission, and leadership principles of the Saint John Police and promote our organizational values of leadership, accountability, professionalism, inclusiveness, integrity, and valour.

Successful completion of the security clearance and integrity interview are requirements of the Saint John Police.

## Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Disability Management:

• Administer and coordinate non-occupational and occupational claims, ensuring timely and accurate processing as part of a return-to-work or duty-to-accommodate program.

• Serve as a liaison between employees, managers, healthcare providers, and insurance partners to support return-to-work plans.

• Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, policies, standard operating procedures, and reporting requirements.

• Assist employees when they are off work or at risk of being off work for health reasons; provide direction in completion of required documentation.

• Ensure employees' disability management files are maintained, stored securely, and remain confidential.

• Educate employees and management on disability inclusion, reasonable accommodations, and best practices.

• Respond to numerous daily inquiries either by walk-in, telephone, and/or email.

• Conduct timely assessments, schedule, and attend return-to-work meetings with employees, managers, and external stakeholders to facilitate discussions, ensuring accommodations are effective.

• Prepare and maintain monthly and quarterly reports, tracking types of leaves and return-to-work programs.

• Attend and participate in discussions on various return-to-work committees.

Wellness:

• Foster a culture of health and well-being across the organization by coordinating wellness days, incentive challenges, and educational campaigns.

• Be an active member of committees (e.g., wellness and fit for duty).

• Deliver wellness educational sessions for new and current employees.

• Collaborate with the City of Saint John Human Resources department related to wellness initiatives.

• Coordinate and be present for all required ergonomic assessments in the workplace.

• Perform other related duties as required.

## Essential Qualifications:

• Excellent communication skills both orally and in writing, including the preparation of clear, concise, and thorough reports.

• Strong interpersonal and listening skills to assist employees facing difficulty and stressful circumstances in a professional and compassionate manner.

• Effective planning, organizational, and time management skills.

• Ability to work well both independently and as a member of a team.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).

• Strong knowledge of New Brunswick Workers' Compensation Act, Employment Standards Act, Occupational Health and Safety Act, and Human Rights Act.

• High level of discretion, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize, and work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

• Solid working knowledge of, and background in, mental health wellness promotion in individuals and organizations.

## Education/Experience:

• Post-secondary education with a concentration in Human Resources or related field.

• Three years' experience in health and wellness, disability management, or related field.

• Certified Disability Management Professional Certification is an asset and/or additional coursework in occupational health, rehabilitation, or legislation related to disability management.

• Must have or be able to attain Chartered Professional in Human Resources (CPHR) designation.

• A proficiency in French of Intermediate (2) as per the Province of New Brunswick Oral Proficiency Rating Scale would be an asset.

Not only is the department responsible for managing over 18,000 kilometers of provincial highways, it also manages the planning, design and construction of hospitals, schools and other government buildings.
