2238948.title: Jordan’s Principle Case Coordinator
2238948.description:
The Chapman Group is helping its client, Mawiw Council Inc., hire its next Jordan's Principle Case Coordinator. Mawiw Council Inc. is one of approximately 80 tribal councils in Canada. It is a non-profit corporation governed by a Board of Directors comprised of Chiefs of partnering First Nations: Neqotkuk, Elsipogtog, and Esgenoôpetitj. As a tribal council, Mawiw is mandated to provide capacity building services to its three partnering First Nations. Our organization receives core funding from Indigenous Services Canada (ISC) and project-based funding from a number of federal, provincial and other sources.

Closing Date: Friday, September 17th, 2026

Qualifications

## Desirable Qualifications and Experience

• Prior experience working with First Nations, preferably in social development or health

• Experience working with Jordan's Principle is considered an asset

• Prior experience establishing strong client relationships

• Knowledge and understanding of First Nation history, culture and the unique experiences and issues of First Nation communities

• Demonstrate leadership and communication skills

• Experience with database and/or computer skills

## Essential Qualifications and Experience

• Must possess a certificate or diploma/degree in either Social Work, Health, Education or Human Resources and/or Work Experience Equivalency

• Possess a positive attitude and be enthusiastic/passionate about delivering the best services to First Nation children and their families

• Highly motivated, energetic and creative

• Demonstrate professional, appropriate, effective and tactful communication skills including verbal and non-verbal

• Possess good writing and electronic data entry skills

• Criminal Record check/Vulnerable record check

• Must have a Valid driver's license and access to a car

## Application Submission

• We thank all applicants for their interest, but only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

• In the event there are two or more equally qualified applicants, preference will be given first to qualified First Nation applicants, followed by candidates with First Nation work experience.

• A complete application contains: A cover letter illustrating why you qualify for the position and a detailed resume.

Responsibilities

## Position overview:

The Jordan's Principle Case Coordinator works collaboratively with the Jordan's Principle Case Manager, families, First Nation communities, and service providers to support children and families in accessing timely and coordinated services. Based primarily in the Fredericton office, the Case Coordinator is responsible for intake, assessment, referral and service coordination, database management, follow-up, and community outreach. The Case Coordinator serves as a key point of contact for families and communities, providing ongoing support, advocacy, information, and navigation throughout the Jordan's Principle process. The position also supports awareness and understanding of Jordan's Principle, maintains accurate and timely documentation and reporting, and contributes to continuous improvement of coordinated service delivery.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Advanced Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Advanced Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Advanced Care Paramedic positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Advanced Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Advanced Care Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Must be willing to participate and contribute to future pilot projects, related research initiatives and focus groups

• Must be willing to participate in community Paramedicine duties

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your ACP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

To holistically coordinate the care of each patient, incorporating the nursing profession's values of knowledge, theory and practice. To assess, plan, implement and evaluate the needs of patients and significant others in the delivery of care and collaborate with all members of the interdisciplinary team in this approach.

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Diploma in Nursing or a Bachelor's Degree in Nursing;

• Currently registered and in good standing, or eligible for registration, with the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB);

• A minimum of two (2) years in the last five (5) years of specialized registered nursing experience with preference in the areas of family practice, surgical, palliative care or oncology in a patient unit that requires daily collaboration with various health disciplines and family members as part of reaching patient goals;

• A good driving record with a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License;

• Have a current CPR Level C certification or be prepared to obtain within 3 months;

• Ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and possess leadership and coaching skills, strong interpersonal skills, good judgment and decision making skills;

• Support student placement initiatives;

• Able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record;

• A high regard for confidentiality; and

2233037.description:
True North Salmon LP, a division of Cooke Aquaculture Inc., a dynamic and growing east coast family company, with Platinum Member status in the Canada's Best Managed Companies Program has an opportunity for a highly motivated individual to join the Company's Production Team based out of our Fundy Bay Drive facility located in St. George, NB.

Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, and South America. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly-skilled and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

As a result of our robust growth, we are adding a Production Supervisor to our team of professionals. This is a Monday to Friday Night Shift position. Reporting to the Senior Production Manager, the successful candidate will:

• Provide coaching, guidance, leadership and direction to the operational/production staff.

• Be able to exercise the necessary authority to assure policies and procedures are followed and time frames are met

• Have excellent people management and communication skills to build effective staff and organizational relationships

• Possess a high attention to detail and quality, time management and organizational skills, and the ability to meet cost and schedule requirements

The ideal candidate will have experience in a deadline driven, fast paced environment and should possess a minimum of 3-5 years supervisory experience completed by above average computer skills. Experience and/or training in production will be considered asset.

*As per company policy, a criminal background check is required.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Wellness: Wellness programs.

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

## The Opportunity

The role description is just one part of the story. This is an opportunity to grow, to stretch, to work within the parameters of the role but stretch to your fullest potential. We are a team that counts performance, we reward contribution, and we recognize talent. It is about being at the center of the fastest growing company in Atlantic Canada and knowing you are part of that growth. The ability to bring your passion for learning, desire for growth, and energy for moving your career forward is what we offer.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

We thank all candidates for their interest, however, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2239220.title: Account Executive
2239220.description:
Position Type:
Permanent

If you're looking for a fulfilling career that can make a real difference in your life, and the lives of others, you've come to the right place.

As a national health solutions partner, we put people first in everything we do - and that begins with our team of 8,000+ professionals who bring a cross-section of diverse life experiences and career expertise to Medavie. By collaborating and innovating together, our employees are creating industry-leading solutions in insurance, primary care and emergency medical services that impact millions of lives in Canada each year.

Our mission is to improve the wellbeing of Canadians so that every life can be lived to the fullest - and it's reflected in our award-winning culture. We celebrate individuality and value the diverse perspectives and skills our employees contribute. We go beyond providing competitive pay and comprehensive benefits to offer opportunities for personal and professional growth, flexible work options, meaningful experiences, and supportive leadership. Medavie is where employees can be their best selves, feel they belong, and achieve their full potential. Be part of it by applying for a position with us today.

## Opportunity

As an Account Executive, you'll be responsible for growing, retaining, and strengthening relationships within an assigned portfolio of business. Reporting to the Regional Manager, Atlantic Group Sales, you'll work closely with brokers, clients, and internal partners to deliver group benefits solutions that meet evolving business needs while supporting Medavie Blue Cross's growth objectives.

As a trusted relationship manager, you'll develop a deep understanding of your clients' goals and challenges, providing solutions that create long-term value and help them achieve their business objectives. Known for your expertise in group benefits and your ability to build strong partnerships, you'll bring forward insights and recommendations that help clients make informed decisions while contributing to the success of your portfolio.

This role offers the flexibility of working remotely or through a hybrid arrangement from one of our offices in Dartmouth, Moncton, or Charlottetown. Regular travel throughout the assigned territory is required to support relationship building, business development activities, and client engagement.

## What You'll Do

• Work collaboratively with your team to execute sales and business development strategies.

• Be responsible for the sales performance, retention, and financial management of your assigned block of business.

• Achieve annual targets related to new business growth, retention, profitability, and overall portfolio performance.

• Manage and retain an inforce block of business while identifying opportunities to expand client value and strengthen relationships.

• Establish, develop, and maintain relationships with brokers, clients, and prospective clients.

• Partner with underwriting, implementation, proposal, and service teams to deliver effective solutions and exceptional client experiences.

• Conduct presentations, client meetings, and educational seminars.

• Develop and execute action plans to identify business opportunities and support portfolio growth.

• Maintain professional and technical knowledge through ongoing learning, industry involvement, and networking opportunities.

## About You

• You have 5+ years of experience in sales, group benefits, insurance, or a related field.

• You excel at building meaningful partnerships with brokers, clients, and key stakeholders and take a consultative approach to understanding their needs.

• You have a proven track record of achieving business development and client management objectives.

• You have experience developing and managing broker relationships and understand the importance of growing and retaining a successful block of business.

• You enjoy collaborating with others and building strong partnerships across teams.

• You bring a customer-focused mindset and are committed to building trusted relationships that support long-term success.

• You have strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.

## Other Qualifications

• A current Life Licence would be considered an asset.

• A valid driver's licence is required.

• Bilingualism in English and French would be considered an asset.

## What We Offer

• A comprehensive Health and Dental Benefits Program paid 100% by us, including a Health Spending Account.

• A flexible and supportive work environment with a strong focus on work-life balance and employee well-being.

• Opportunities for learning, growth, and career development.

• A collaborative team environment built on respect, accountability, and a commitment to serving our clients and communities.

• Opportunities to give back through community involvement initiatives and volunteer programs.

• Free parking.

## Compensation

• $61,230 - $81,000 CAD.

• In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our sales incentive program.

2240102.description:
## Travel Consultant - Customer Service Representative

On Site Training | Work From Home Opportunities | Starting at $21/hour + bonus potential

## Helping People Through the Moments That Matter

Travel doesn't always go according to plan.

Flights get cancelled. Weather disrupts plans. Connections are missed. Things don't always go as expected.

When that happens, our customers need more than someone to answer the call. They need someone who can listen, understand what matters most, and confidently guide them towards a solution.

As a Travel Consultant, you'll help our customers book, manage and modify their travel arrangements while delivering the exceptional service they expect. Whether you're helping a customer rebook a flight, adjust hotel reservations, navigate a travel disruption, or maximize the benefits available to them, you'll play an important role in turning stressful situations into positive experiences.

This isn't just about booking travel. It's about building trust, solving problems, and making customers feel genuinely supported when they need it most.

If you're someone who loves helping people, communicates naturally, and can stay focused when things get busy, we'd love to meet you!

## Why You'll Love Working Here

At Cloud5, we believe great customer experiences start with great people.

We'll provide the training, coaching, and support you need to succeed, even if you've never worked in travel before. You'll develop valuable customer service, communication, consulting, and problem-solving skills while working alongside a team that genuinely supports one another.

No two days are exactly the same. You'll tackle new challenges, connect with different customers, and continuously build skills that will benefit you throughout your career.

## No travel experience? No problem!

If you have strong customer service skills, enjoy helping people, and are passionate about creating positive customer experiences, we'll provide the training to help you succeed.

## Why Join Us?

• $21/hour starting wage with quarterly bonus potential

• Shift premiums across various hours/days

• Work from home opportunities following successful completion of training

• Employee referral bonus of up to $500 per successful candidate

• Medical & Vision benefits after 3 months

• Dental coverage after 6 months

• RRSP and TFSA options

• Company RRSP match up to 3 percent after 1 year

• Paid training and ongoing coaching to help you succeed

• Career growth opportunities within a growing organization

• Access to various travel perks and discounts

## What You'll Do

• Help customers book, manage, modify and troubleshoot travel arrangements

• Resolve travel-related issues and provide solutions during disruptions and unexpected situations

• Communicate with customers by phone to understand their needs and provide personalized support

• Demonstrate the value and benefits available to the customer

• Consult with customers to identify the best available options based on their unique circumstances

• Coordinate with travel suppliers and partners to secure travel arrangements and resolve issues

• Research solutions, troubleshoot challenges, and think creatively when standard options aren't available

• Maintain a calm, professional, and empathetic approach during complex or high-pressure situations

• Deliver a consistently exceptional customer experience while meeting service expectations

## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

Success in this role isn't measured by how much you know about travel on day one. It's measured by how well you listen, solve problems, and create positive experiences for customers.

## You may be a great fit if you:

• Connect naturally with people and build rapport easily

• Are an active listener who takes the time to understand customer needs

• Lead conversations with empathy, professionalism, and confidence

• Enjoy troubleshooting and finding solutions to complex problems

• Can balance customer needs with program guidelines and available options

• Stay calm and resourceful when handling challenging situations

• Are highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks at once

• Communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing

• Are comfortable using technology and navigating multiple systems simultaneously

• Have a positive attitude, growth mindset and genuine desire to help others

Experience in customer service, hospitality, travel, contact center, or other service-focused environments is considered an asset, but we are equally interested in candidates who demonstrate strong communication skills, curiosity, and a customer first mindset.

Cloud5 Communications is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law. We will never request a fee or payment from candidates. Please do not provide any personal or financial information to anyone you suspect of recruitment fraud.

## How to Identify Recruitment Fraud:

• You receive a message on WhatsApp or another online messaging platform

• You are asked to provide a fee or payment (we will NEVER request payment from candidates)

• Our email communication will only ever come from a @Cloud5.com domain or @msg.paycomonline.com domain. We will never contact you through Gmail or any other free online mail service

• Cross reference the recruiter's name and contact information on LinkedIn or by contacting corphr@cloud5.com

• If you are still unsure call 1 (877) 241-2516

## COMPETITION NUMBER

## 2025869

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

OMISTA is looking for a Financial Service Representative to join our Main Street Team. At OMISTA Credit Union, we believe banking is about more than transactions. It's about building relationships, understanding what matters to our members, and finding solutions that help them move forward.

We're looking for a Financial Service Representative 1 (FSR1) to join our Main Street team in Moncton. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working directly with people, has an interest in financial services, and wants to continue developing their knowledge of personal banking and lending.

## What you'll do:

As an FSR 1, you'll be an important part of the member experience from the very first conversation. You'll:

• Welcome new and potential members and guide them through the account-opening and onboarding process.

• Get to know members' needs and goals and recommend products and services that are right for them.

• Strong communication, listening, and relationship-building skills.

• An interest in personal financial services and lending.

• The ability to understand financial information and apply sound judgement when assessing lending needs.

• Strong organizational and administrative skills, with attention to accuracy and detail.

• A willingness to learn and stay current in a changing financial services environment.

• A collaborative, team-oriented approach.

You don't need to know everything on day one. We'll support you in building your credit union and lending knowledge, including required credit union education courses in Credit Union Products & Services and Consumer & Residential Mortgage lending.

At OMISTA, you'll be part of a team that believes in Banking Local and putting our members and communities first. The Department of Justice and Public Safety is dedicated to the rule of law, the promotion of the public interest, and the impartial administration of justice and works to improve the safety, security and resiliency of communities and citizens.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Salary: As per collective agreement.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Emergency Medical Technicians are based on the current Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements for Emergency Medical Technician as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our emergency medical technicians provide transportation and patient care for non-urgent low acuity patients and are expected to maintain and operate ambulances and related equipment in accordance with patient needs and public safety.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in emergency medical technology or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• High school graduation plus an Emergency Medical Technician program/course

• Must meet all legislated requirements for Emergency Medical Technician in New Brunswick

• Must be registered, active Emergency Medical Technician with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Written & Spoken competency in one of the two official languages (English or French) is required and spoken competency in the other official language is preferred.

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your EMT certificate from a recognized institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as an Emergency Medical Technician within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR Level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

Please note: Related and allied duties may be assigned from time to time as may become necessary to the operation of Ambulance NB. Also other competencies related to changes in PANB Scope of Practice guidelines and approved by the Provincial Medical Director may also be added to the duties and responsibilities of this classification.

Horizon Health Network in beautiful New Brunswick is looking for a Maternal Fetal Medicine Specialist to join our team!

Horizon Health Network (Horizon) is seeking a dedicated, dependable, passionate, and qualified Maternal Fetal Medicine Specialist to join the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology. The ideal candidate will have experience working within a collaborative environment as a member of an interdisciplinary team to provide safe and quality patient care.

## Why you should work here

Working for Horizon gives you a career that provides an east coast lifestyle and the chance to make a big difference in the lives of New Brunswickers.

Horizon is committed to enhancing our diverse and inclusive environment for our employees and patients. Reporting to the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department Head and the Medical Director for the area, the Maternal Fetal Medicine Specialist collaborates with other Physicians, Nurse Practitioners, Registered, Nurses, and other Allied Medical Staff.

html
Job Title: Commercial Cleaner

Location: Quispamsis/Saint John, NB

Shift/Hours: Early mornings, must be flexible.

Pay Rate: $17.50 - $20.00/Hour

## Assignment Information:

As a Commercial Cleaner with Advantage Personnel, you will be an essential part of our customers' growing team, responsible for maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment in various commercial settings, including offices, retail spaces, and industrial facilities!

Your primary duties will involve performing routine cleaning tasks to ensure that facilities meet health and safety standards, enhancing the overall appearance and functionality of the workspace. In this role, you will work both independently and as part of a team, following established cleaning protocols and procedures.

Attention to detail is critical, as you will be responsible for cleaning floors, restrooms, windows, and communal areas, as well as managing waste disposal and replenishing supplies. You will also be expected to operate cleaning equipment and use cleaning chemicals safely and effectively. Your contributions will directly impact the satisfaction and comfort of employees and visitors alike.

A strong commitment to quality, punctuality, and professionalism will be essential as you represent our company and uphold our reputation for excellence in service. This position is ideal for individuals who take pride in their work, enjoy maintaining clean environments, and are committed to delivering outstanding results. Whether you are looking for a full-time career or part-time hours, this role offers the opportunity to work in diverse settings while developing your skills in the cleaning industry.

## Key Responsibilities:

• Cleaning all office areas, including lobby, hallways, washrooms, locker rooms, shower facilities, fingerprint and interview rooms.

• Ensuring cleanliness of bathrooms, toilets, urinals, showers, and locker rooms.

• Disinfecting kitchen areas, including appliances, tables, etc.

• Restocking and replacing paper towels, toilet paper, hand soap, and other supplies.

• Dusting and wiping down surfaces like tables, counters, desks, window ledges, and more.

• Sweeping, mopping, and vacuuming floors and carpets.

• Shampooing carpets and floor mats periodically.

• Cleaning window blinds and wiping down chairs in various rooms.

• Disinfecting door handles, light switches, and other high-touch surfaces.

• Spot cleaning walls, cabinets, desks, and doors.

• Emptying trash and replacing bags in all areas.

• Handling light toilet plunging and reporting major issues.

• Performing annual tasks such as floor stripping and regular floor buffing.

• Providing bio-hazard cleaning of vehicles and cells as required.

## Qualifications/Requirements:

• Physically fit, capable of lifting up to 45 pounds (e.g., vacuum cleaner or mop bucket).

• Comfortable walking up and down stairs, frequently requiring cleaning.

• Detail-oriented with a strong sense of pride in workmanship.

• Reliable and maintains a professional demeanor and appearance.

• Team-oriented and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

• Strong problem-solving skills and common sense.

• Demonstrates integrity, personal awareness, sensitivity, and accountability.

• Must have personal transportation.

• Criminal record check and additional security clearance required.

## Senior Accountant
Saint John, NB
Reference # HL-OCA-10025

Our client, Ocean Capital Holdings Limited, is a privately held company with its head office located in Saint John, NB with interests in a number of businesses, including broadcasting, construction, energy, and real estate. Their purpose is to grow winning businesses with great people, which contribute to better communities. They unlock the potential of their businesses through imagination and a passion for winning, and they celebrate the uniqueness in each person. Their focus is on excellence and accomplishment.

We are excited to partner with them to bring an experienced Senior Accountant to their finance team in Saint John, NB. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Accounting, this position provides a broad range of accounting and financial support to Ocean Capital Holdings Limited and related companies. As an integral member of the accounting team, the Senior Accountant will play a key role in financial reporting, consolidated reporting, daily accounting activities, cash management, and process improvement initiatives across a diverse group of businesses.

## Responsibilities will include:

• Prepare monthly consolidated and non-consolidated financial statements and schedules, including journal entries, reconciliations, and variance analysis for multiple companies and present to Senior Leadership

• Coordinate with operational finance teams to prepare consolidated financial reports and analysis

• Prepare annual budgets and schedules including management reporting

• Assist in creation of annual management and shareholder reporting

• Manage day-to-day transactional processing: billing, cash forecasting

• Be a key resource to support and engage with audit processes - internal and external

• Assist with the development and implementation of formalized accounting and reporting policies and standards

• Assist in identifying and implementing process improvement initiatives within our team and cross functional teams

## The ideal candidate will possess:

• Chartered Professional Accounting (CPA) designation

• 5-7 years of progressive accounting experience post CPA completion

• Degree in Business Administration

• Experience with consolidated financial statements and US GAAP would be considered strong assets

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

• Experience with mid-market to top tier ERP system

• Experience in applying foreign currency translation methods and managing exchange rate impacts in financial reporting and consolidations

• Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering complex financial information in an engaging and accessible manner

• Proven experience collaborating with and presenting to senior leadership

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability

• Industry experience considered an asset

• Managerial or supervisory experience considered an asset

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Reliable self-starter with the ability to work independently and manage priorities

• Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy

• Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality and professional integrity

Ocean Capital continues to grow! Don't miss this opportunity to contribute to our client's dedicated team. Connect with us to learn more or apply now.

2238847.title: Database Administrator
2238847.description:
Data is at the heart of our operations and decision-making. As a Database Administrator, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, security, and evolution of the platforms that support our critical systems and drive our growth ambitions.

Purpose of the Role
Ensure the availability, performance, security, and resilience of the organization's data platforms while serving as a technical expert in their management, optimization, and ongoing evolution.

Qualifications

## Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in database administration, including strong expertise in SQL Server and hands-on experience with Oracle.

## Technical Skills

• SQL Server (expert level) and Oracle (operational level).

• Experience with high availability (AlwaysOn, clustering), backup, advanced recovery, and disaster recovery testing.

• Solid understanding of performance tuning, indexing, and database architecture.

• Knowledge of Azure, hybrid cloud, and Windows Server environments.

• Automation (PowerShell, SQL scripting, CI/CD pipelines).

• Familiarity with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• Monitoring and observability of data environments.

• Management of multi-platform and multi-system environments.

• Data security (encryption, access management, auditing).

• Excellent skills in solving complex problems and troubleshooting.

• Clear communication and the ability to explain technical concepts in layman's terms to a variety of stakeholders.

• Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams (development, infrastructure, security, BI).

• Priority management and the ability to handle pressure and emergency situations in a 24/7 production environment.

Responsibilities

2234437.description:
Job Posting Information
Manager, Project Controls
Regular non-unionized position
Fredericton, New Brunswick, Canada
Salary range: $102,717 - $141,097 annually
Competition # E22522-2026

At NB Power we are a team, committed to offering the best customer experience, ensuring energy security, and accelerating a sustainable clean energy transition. Why? Because we're New Brunswickers too, we care about our customers and future generations, and today we are actively looking for a new member to join us.

The Mactaquac Generating Station began generating electricity in 1968. Since the 1980s, concrete portions of the hydro station have been affected by a chemical reaction called alkali-aggregate reaction. The reaction causes the concrete to swell and crack and has required substantial annual maintenance and repairs. NB Power is proposing a project to ensure the station can operate to its intended 100-year lifespan with a modified approach to maintenance and adjusting and replacing equipment and concrete overtime.

As part of the Mactaquac Life Achievement Project, the Manager, Project Controls is a key leadership role reporting to the Manager, Business Services. This position oversees planning, estimating, scheduling, and performance tracking to optimize project outcomes. Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering Manager, and Construction Manager, you will ensure efficient resource allocation, cost control, and compliance with project standards.

## Key functions include:

• Planning, Scheduling & Performance Management: Maintaining the master project schedule, ensuring alignment with execution strategies and contractual milestones. This includes overseeing critical path activities, producing resource-loaded schedules in Primavera P6, and monitoring performance metrics such as SPI and CPI. The role also involves leading schedule health reviews, initiating corrective actions, and supporting risk analysis to maintain schedule integrity.

• Cost Control & Compliance: Developing and maintaining cost control systems, ensuring continuity between estimates and baselines, and analyzing cost and schedule reports to keep the project on track. Enforce compliance with project control standards and implement change management processes to manage scope and cost variations effectively.

• Leadership & Team Development: Leading and developing a team of project control professionals, fostering a culture of high performance and collaboration. This includes providing coaching and career development, ensuring proactive communication across project functions, and building strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external contractors to achieve project objectives.

## Our ideal teammate will have:

• Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, with a preference for Civil Engineering

• Seven years of progressive experience in project controls, preferably in heavy infrastructure project, with proven experience in large construction projects.

• Three years of experience in a supervisory role managing multi-functional teams

• Proven expertise in strategic project management and planning for megaprojects

• Knowledge of accounting, financial analysis, risk management, and reporting principles

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Proficiency in project management and cost management systems (Primavera P6/ERP preferred)

• Registered Professional Engineer licensed in New Brunswick or eligible for immediate transfer considered as an asset.

An equivalent combination of training and experience may be considered. Subject to competition response, the minimum qualifications may be modified.

An Eligibility List generated from this competition may be used to fill future vacancies at the same level within a period of up to 12 months.

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm with offices across Atlantic Canada and Ontario. Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. 2236600.title: Associate Data Engineer
2236600.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

Cooke is continuing to mature its digital strategy through modern data platforms, integrated data pipelines, and enterprise data standards that support operations, processing, distribution, and corporate functions. As an Associate Data Engineer, you will support the development and operation of basic data pipelines that help ensure accurate, reliable data movement between systems.

## The Role

As an Associate Data Engineer, you will build and support basic data pipelines under guidance. You will help ensure data is extracted, transformed, and loaded accurately between systems using standard tools, established design patterns, and approved software development lifecycle practices.

## Key Responsibilities

• Build and test basic data pipelines under supervision using standard tools and SDLC frameworks.

• Extract, transform, and load data from source systems following established design patterns.

• Monitor daily data flows and troubleshoot errors or failed jobs.

• Maintain and document datasets, workflows, and integration processes.

• Escalate complex issues or data anomalies to senior engineers or architects.

## What Success Looks Like

• Basic data pipelines are built, tested, and supported accurately under guidance.

• Daily data flows are monitored consistently, with errors identified and escalated appropriately.

• Datasets, workflows, and integration processes are documented clearly and kept current.

• Work follows established design patterns, SDLC practices, and enterprise data standards.

• Learning progress is demonstrated through increased confidence with Cooke's data platforms, tools, and engineering best practices.

## Core Skills & Competencies

• Foundational data engineering skills, including basic SQL, scripting, data modelling, and understanding of data structures and relationships.

• Ability to support basic ETL and ELT processes, including data ingestion, transformation, integration, and pipeline monitoring under guidance.

• Exposure to modern data tools and platforms such as Snowflake, DBT, FiveTran, Boomi, and API-based integrations.

• Attention to data quality, including profiling datasets, identifying errors, applying validation checks, and following data security practices.

• Willingness to learn enterprise data standards, governance practices, metadata management, and engineering best practices while escalating complex issues appropriately.

## Behaviors That Drive Success

• Adaptability: Adapts to minor changes with support; remains calm in routine disruptions.

• Business Acumen: Understands basic business processes and terminology.

• Collaboration & Synergy: Works cooperatively with team members on shared tasks.

• Decisiveness: Makes informed decisions in familiar situations; seeks guidance when uncertain.

• Design Thinking: Applies basic design or process improvement techniques to specific problems.

• Digital Acumen: Uses digital tools confidently and adapts to new systems.

• Diversity Mindset: Demonstrates openness to other perspectives and working styles.

• Growth Mindset: Seeks development opportunities and applies new skills to work.

• Innovative: Experiments with new approaches and learns from results.

• Outcome Driven: Focuses on completing assigned tasks accurately.

• Political Savviness: Aware of reporting structures and workplace etiquette.

• Risk Taking: Follows established procedures and avoids mistakes.

## Experience & Qualifications

• Education: Currently enrolled in, or recently completed, a diploma or degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

• Experience: 0-2 years in data development, ETL support, or a related technical co-op or internship.

• Skills: Basic SQL and scripting, data modelling fundamentals, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn.

• Organization-specific: Exposure to Cooke's data pipelines, integration tools such as DBT, FiveTran, and Boomi, and an understanding of enterprise data standards and quality expectations.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

RJ Bartlett Engineering, a division of CBCL Limited, has decades of experience in fire protection engineering, code consulting, alternative compliance analyses and customer service. With a thorough knowledge of fire safety requirements in building codes, fire codes, and referenced standards, we work with clients to ensure safety within their buildings is front of mind. Our people working together with their talents and capabilities make the difference. Services are provided for clients in all Canadian Provinces, several US States, Bermuda, and the Caribbean.

Our team values collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Fire Protection Specialist to join our dynamic team in either Fredericton, NB or Halifax, NS.

As a Fire Protection Specialist, you will be responsible for applying fire protection codes and standards to a variety of commercial and industrial projects. You'll work closely with engineers, project managers, and clients to deliver effective and innovative fire protection solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Working both individually and as part of a team to provide support for our firm's fire protection engineering consulting services.

• Drafting and drawing management.

• Fire code consulting.

• Shop drawing reviews, construction reviews (occasional travel will be required), inspections, and integrated system testing.

• The application of various NFPA and CAN/ULC standards in the development of design drawings and specifications for fire protection and life safety systems such as sprinkler and standpipe, fire pumps and water supply infrastructure, fire alarm systems, etc.

Your Capabilities and Credentials:

• A technical post-secondary education with current eligibility for registration as either:
• A PTech/CET/CTech with Canadian Provincial professional technologist associations, or

• A P.Eng. with Canadian Provincial professional engineering associations.

• A minimum of 5 years experience in the construction or engineering consulting industries with experience with fire protection systems

• Strong verbal and written communication abilities to effectively convey technical information and collaborate with project stakeholders;

• Proven ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently, maintain attention to detail, with the ability to thrive in a deadline-oriented environment; and

• A collaborative mindset and a passion for contributing to a positive team environment.

You are welcome to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements.

In addition to the prerequisites outlined above, experience with or exposure to any of the following would be considered an asset:

• Previous project management experience;

• Formal drawing standards for quality control;

• BIM modelling platforms (REVIT or similar);

• Familiarity with or exposure any of the following codes and standards:
• National Building Code of Canada

• National Fire Code of Canada

• CAN/ULC-S524; CAN/ULC-S561; CAN/ULC-S1001

• NFPA 13, NFPA 14; NFPA 20

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• DBPlus Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Flexible hours and locations to support work/life balance;

• Ability to work paid overtime and bank time-in-lieu for future use;

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise;

• Exposure to a variety of projects;

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests;

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise;

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa;

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills;

About Us

As a recently established division of CBCL Limited, RJ Bartlett Engineering has brought their positive legacy into the broader CBCL environment. Our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and our planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

CBCL Limited strives to provide a diverse workplace that is inclusive, accessible and celebrates individuals and what makes us unique. We are proud to be an employer partner with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and Pride at Work.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Advanced Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Advanced Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Advanced Care Paramedic positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Advanced Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Advanced Care Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Must be willing to participate and contribute to future pilot projects, related research initiatives and focus groups

• Must be willing to participate in community Paramedicine duties

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your ACP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

At CBCL Limited, we are a successful, dynamic, and growing engineering and environmental consulting firm. We have an exciting opportunity for a Group Lead, Electrical Buildings – NB to join our team in New Brunswick. There is a possibility to operate out of Moncton, Saint John, or Fredericton.

Bring your technical expertise, people-focused leadership, and collaborative mindset to a team that delivers excellence in electrical design and consulting for buildings projects across New Brunswick and beyond. In this role, you will guide and support a talented group of engineers and technologists, contribute to project delivery and client relationships, and help shape the continued growth and success of our Electrical Buildings practice.

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Lead and Support the Team: Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and mentorship to electrical engineers and technologists, supporting workload planning, technical development, collaboration, and overall team performance.

• Oversee Electrical Buildings Design: Guide the design, analysis, and coordination of electrical building systems, including power distribution, lighting, lighting controls, life safety, communications, security, and access control systems for commercial, institutional, industrial, infrastructure, and residential projects.

• Support Business Development and Client Relationships: Contribute to business development efforts by maintaining strong client relationships, identifying opportunities, supporting proposals, and representing CBCL's Electrical Buildings group with professionalism and technical credibility.

• Manage and Coordinate Project Delivery: Work closely with project managers and multidisciplinary teams to support successful project planning and delivery, helping to ensure quality, budget, schedule, and client expectations are met.

• Foster Innovation and Collaboration: Promote innovative problem-solving, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement while supporting a collaborative and inclusive team environment.

• Ensure Quality and Technical Excellence: Apply sound engineering judgment, complete technical reviews, and support quality management practices to ensure design solutions comply with electrical codes, safety standards, building requirements, and industry best practices.

• Support Construction and Field Services: Lead or support site reviews, respond to RFIs, review shop drawings, resolve field issues, and ensure construction activities align with design intent and project requirements.

• Contribute to Group Planning and Growth: Support resource planning, staff development, technical standards, and strategic initiatives that strengthen the Electrical Buildings group and contribute to CBCL's continued growth in New Brunswick.

Your Capabilities and Credentials:

• A Degree in Electrical Engineering or diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology

• Registration or eligibility for registration with provincial Engineering or technical association;

• Minimum of 10 years of relevant electrical buildings design experience, including demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, mentoring, or team coordination;

• Strong experience in electrical building systems design, including power distribution, lighting, fire alarm, communications, security, and controls, with in-depth knowledge of applicable building, energy, and electrical codes and standards;

• Experience leading multidisciplinary project coordination, technical reviews, proposal support, and client-focused project delivery in a consulting environment;

• Proficiency with electrical design and coordination tools such as AutoCAD and Revit, with the ability to guide others in producing coordinated, high-quality deliverables;

• Strong communication, organization, and leadership skills, with the ability to support team members, build trusted client relationships, and deliver quality work on time and within budget.

You are encouraged to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements.

The following would be considered assets:

• Experience working in a consulting engineering environment, particularly within electrical buildings design, is preferred;

• Previous experience in a group lead, discipline lead, or formal people leadership role would be considered an asset;

• Experience using Agi32 lighting analysis software and SKM Power Tools; and

• The ability to communicate in both English and French would be an asset.

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• CAAT Defined Benefit Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Flexible hours to support work/life balance;

• Opportunity to earn paid overtime or bank time-in-lieu for future use;

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise;

• Exposure to a variety of projects;

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests;

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise;

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development;

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa; and

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills.

About Us

At CBCL our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and our planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

CBCL Limited strives to provide a diverse workplace that is inclusive, accessible and celebrates individuals and what makes us unique. We are proud to be an employer partner with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and Pride at Work.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment or interview process, or while working with us, please email hr@cbcl.ca. We will work with you to meet your needs in a respectful and timely manner.

Our goal is to ensure every candidate has a fair opportunity to demonstrate their abilities. We value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to removing barriers that may prevent individuals from thriving in their roles.
