2236599.title: Data Engineer
2236599.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

Cooke is continuing to mature its digital strategy through modern data platforms, integrated data pipelines, and enterprise data standards that support operations, processing, distribution, and corporate functions. As a Data Engineer, you will develop and optimize data integration solutions, implement automation, monitor data quality, and collaborate with architects and business teams to align data solutions with enterprise data models.

## The Role

As a Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and transformations that support analytics, operational reporting, and enterprise data integration. You will work independently on routine data engineering activities while partnering with business analysts, architects, application teams, and data stakeholders to deliver reliable, secure, and well-documented data solutions.

## Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and transformations to support analytics and operational reporting.

• Implement data validation, cleansing, and quality checks to ensure reliable datasets.

• Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and application teams to understand and deliver against data requirements.

• Automate data ingestion and integration processes to improve performance, reliability, and repeatability.

• Maintain data documentation, metadata, lineage, and technical specifications for ongoing support and reference.

## What Success Looks Like

• Reliable ETL and ELT pipelines are built, maintained, and improved with minimal supervision.

• Data quality checks, cleansing logic, and validation processes are embedded into data workflows.

• Data requirements are translated into practical solutions through effective collaboration with analysts, architects, and application teams.

• Ingestion, integration, and orchestration processes are automated where appropriate to improve reliability and performance.

• Technical documentation, metadata, and lineage remain current and aligned to Cooke's enterprise data standards.

## Core Skills & Competencies

• Proficient in building and maintaining ETL and ELT data pipelines using tools such as Snowflake, DBT, FiveTran, Boomi, and API-based integrations.

• Strong SQL, scripting, and data modelling skills, with the ability to map data flows, lineage, and relationships across source and target systems.

• Ability to implement ingestion, transformation, orchestration, validation, cleansing, and quality checks independently using standard Cooke tools and patterns.

• Working knowledge of data warehousing, APIs, integration patterns, data security, metadata management, and governance workflows.

• Strong troubleshooting and collaboration skills to resolve data quality or performance issues and work effectively with architects, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders.

## Behaviors That Drive Success

• Adaptability: Adjusts work methods for new tools, priorities, or directions with limited guidance.

• Business Acumen: Applies business insights to improve processes and make informed decisions.

• Collaboration & Synergy: Builds strong cross-functional relationships and encourages knowledge sharing.

• Decisiveness: Makes timely, data-informed decisions within scope.

• Design Thinking: Uses user-centered design and data insights to inform solutions.

• Digital Acumen: Applies digital insights to improve work quality or customer experience.

• Diversity Mindset: Values diversity in teams and ensures inclusivity in discussions and decisions.

• Growth Mindset: Demonstrates continuous learning and encourages it in others.

• Innovative: Applies innovative methods to solve functional or business challenges.

• Outcome Driven: Delivers measurable results tied to team or project outcomes.

• Political Savviness: Navigates relationships within the team and immediate area.

• Risk Taking: Raises issues and suggests improvements when risks are low.

## Experience & Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Experience: 2-4 years of experience in data engineering, integration development, analytics enablement, or related technical roles.

• Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python, ETL or ELT tools, data warehousing concepts, APIs, pipeline automation, and data quality troubleshooting.

• Organization-specific: Hands-on use of Cooke's cloud data platform, familiarity with data governance and MDM integrations, and alignment with Cooke's enterprise data model and security standards.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

2225218.description:
## Closing Date: October 5, 2026 at 4:00 PM

Capital Planning & Operations
Capital Planning & Operations is a team of approximately 130 employees that take tremendous pride in the campus and deliver exceptional service that supports the University of New Brunswick's mission, vision, and values. You will be a part of a motivated team of professionals who are always striving to make our campus a safe, sustainable, accessible, and welcoming environment for students, faculty, staff, and community.

## WHAT WE OFFER

## Full -time | Continuing | Fredericton | On campus

Standard Work Hours: Mon - Fri | 7:30 am - 4:00 pm or Four 10-hour shifts | 40 hours per week

Additional Working Conditions:
• This position requires the incumbent to occasionally work at heights and in confined spaces.
• Must be able to work under emergency conditions and to multi-task.

Salary Range: $34.05 per hour

## YOUR FOCUS

Reporting to the Director of Energy and Sustainability, this position is accountable for the continued safe and reliable operation, maintenance and modification of all instrumentation and controls equipment at the UNB Central Heating Plant (CHP) and steam distribution system.

• Maintain, troubleshoot and repair all boiler control system hardware including terminal units, UPS, network communications, multi-function processors and slaves, communication I/O modules and power supplies for both ABB DCS and Rockwell PLC systems. Maintain and administer servers, client computers and third party nodes on the LAN system.

• Maintain the computer system graphics, tag database, alarm management, log generation, control programming, configuration, loop and control tuning, and all other documentation pertinent to the boiler control software, interfaces, and methodology of control. Install process software and perform database backups using appropriate software tools.

• Assist with the maintenance of the environmental logging function by insuring that all environment monitoring equipment is calibrated on a scheduled basis and that the integrity of data transfer from the CHP control system to the data historian is functional at all times.

• Maintain, troubleshoot, calibrate, repair, replace, document and commission field instruments such as steam drum level, flue gas temperature, steam flow, oil flow, feedwater flow, opacity monitors, combustion analyzers, mass flow meters, variable frequency drives, boiler air flow, sonar devices, solid fuel detection, I/P and P/I converters, valve positioners, bubble tube oil level detection, and all other instruments found in an Industrial Boiler Plant.

• Develop, program, implement and commission boiler control strategies using appropriate and applicable engineering software tools. Configure and implement new control graphics and edit existing graphics on the operator interface using the ABB and Rockwell software packages. Perform on-line configurations as required.

• Perform combustion tests and make necessary adjustments to boilers for efficient operation and environment conformance.

• Participate in construction projects and/or repairs work involving the CHP control system, maintaining accurate notes, and interacting with consultants, sales companies, contractors, operating personnel, and other Facilities Management trades.

• Provide detailed estimates for repair and/or construction relating to instrumentation. Prepare job estimates for labour, equipment, and materials.

• Maintain and operate the data historian server. Participate in various assigned projects and studies.

• Responsible for the application of safety precautions as may be required to ensure minimum hazard to self and other while working at heights and in confined space areas.

• Responsible for the care and preservation of assigned tools and specialized equipment.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

## WHAT YOU BRING

• Possession of a current Journeyperson Industrial Instrument Mechanic (Instrumentation Control Technician) as recognized by the Province of New Brunswick is essential.

• Minimum of 6 years' experience in a high-pressure steam plant operation or similar industrial environment, combined with 3 years exposure to an Industrial Distributed Control System and/or PLC Boiler control systems.

## Additional Strengths

• Proficient with computers and computer-based applications with a willingness to acquire further knowledge of computer hardware, software and peripherals, and server technology.

• Ability to draw, edit, read and interpret blueprints and technical sketches.

• Ability to interact professionally with technical and professional persons including operating personnel, consultants, contractors, and Professional Engineers.

## WHY CHOOSE UNB?

UNB offers a large variety of benefits for employees, including a full pension, a minimum of three weeks of vacation annually, the Employee and Family Assistance Program (EFAP), and dental, life, and health insurance.

## GENERAL LABOUR AND TRADES AND ALLIED SERVICES AND AUDIO-VISUAL GROUP (GLTA)

This position is part of the UNIFOR, Local 4504 employee group and falls under the GLTA Collective Agreement.

## COMMITMENT TO EQUITY, DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

The University of New Brunswick is committed to employment equity and fostering diversity within our community and developing an inclusive workplace that reflects the richness of the broader community that we serve. The University welcomes and encourages applications from all qualified individuals who will help us achieve our goals, including women, visible minorities, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of any sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. Preference will be given to Canadian citizens and permanent residents of Canada.

We thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

As a national health solutions partner, we put people first in everything we do - and that begins with our team of 8,000+ professionals who bring a cross-section of diverse life experiences and career expertise to Medavie. ## Position Summary

Trauma New Brunswick (Trauma NB) is a provincial partnership of Horizon Health Network, Vitalité Health Network, Ambulance NB, and the New Brunswick Department of Health. Trauma NB coordinates trauma care, education, research, and injury prevention across New Brunswick.

The Physician Lead – Trauma Education provides provincial leadership for Trauma NB's trauma educational initiatives. Working closely with the Provincial Medical Director, Trauma NB staff, and provincial simulation faculty, the Physician Lead ensures delivery of a high?quality, evidence?informed, psychologically safe, and clinically relevant trauma simulation program that aligns with provincial trauma system priorities.

## Key Responsibilities

## Clinical and Educational Leadership

• Provide clinical leadership and oversight for provincial trauma simulation.

• Identify, develop, mentor, and evaluate trauma simulation faculty.

• Promote a culture of psychological safety, professional engagement, and continuous improvement.

• Be available as a clinical resource for ATLS coordinators regarding faculty development, quality delivery, and course structure/delivery decisions. Course director/instructor/eligibility would be an asset.

## Curriculum and Simulation Design

• Coordinate design, development, and implementation of interdisciplinary, in?situ trauma simulations in collaboration with available programs/resources within RHAs and Trauma NB

• Coordinate development and validation of all trauma simulation curricula and clinical content in programs delivered within each RHA relevant to trauma care.

• Design, develop, and implement a procedural skills curriculum relevant to emergency procedures for the trauma patient.

• Ensure alignment with Trauma NB priorities, policies, consensus statements, as well as the best available medical and educational evidence.

## Program Quality, Evaluation, and Accreditation

• Collaborate with Trauma NB education specialist on data collection, analysis, and reporting related to learner needs, outcomes, faculty development, and program performance.

• Coordinate development of pre?learning, post?learning, and simulation session packages

• Apply proven faculty development and retention strategies.

## Program Delivery

• In collaboration with Trauma NB staff and in collaboration with leaders within the RHAs, implement delivery high?quality, in?situ trauma simulation sessions across the province.

• Adapt simulation activities to rural, regional, and tertiary care contexts.

• Liaise with knowledge translation specialist to incorporate proven strategies for dissemination of Trauma NB, and established clinical aids.

• Implement physician skills curricula.

## Reporting and Accountability

• Prepare required reports:

• End?of?Year (April): Program performance against annual objectives.

• Mid?Year (October): Forward planning report linking priorities with resource needs.

• Sessional Reports: In conjunction with participating Trauma NB staff and/or simulation faculty, submit post?session summaries identifying strengths, vulnerabilities, and faculty development opportunities.

## Stakeholder Engagement

• Maintain effective communication with Trauma NB partners, including Horizon Health Network, Vitalité Health Network, Ambulance NB, and the NB Department of Health - as relevant, in conjunction with Trauma NB leadership where appropriate.

• Contribute to Trauma NB strategic and operational planning.

## Program Operations

• Maintain a work schedule defined at least six weeks in advance, when at all possible.

• Maintain regular communication with Trauma NB leadership.

• Maintain accurate records of activities and time spent in accordance with contractual requirements.

## Qualifications and Experience

• Eligibility for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick.

• Clinical experience in Emergency Medicine, Intensive Care, or a relevant surgical specialty.

• Experience developing, delivering, and evaluating clinical education for physicians and other healthcare professionals.

• Demonstrated experience designing curricula and teaching emergency procedural skills.

• Demonstrated experience designing and delivering interdisciplinary, in?situ healthcare simulations.

• Proven ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Strong communication, facilitation, and leadership skills.

• Experience with data analysis, reporting, and performance evaluation.

• Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, professionalism, and commitment to confidentiality.

## Leadership Competencies

• Ability to inspire trust, collaboration, fairness, and accountability.

• Integrity, self?awareness, resilience, and professional confidence.

• Ability to foster a shared vision and integrate evidence into decision?making.

The Geriatric Department of the Dr. Georges-L.-Dumont University Hospital Centre in Moncton, New Brunswick, is seeking to recruit one geriatrician. Reporting to the Head of the Geriatrics Department and the Medical Director for the area, the geriatrician diagnoses and treats a large number of disorders and conditions among seniors as inpatients or outpatients. Using a holistic approach, the geriatrician performs comprehensive geriatric assessments and provides preventive care, treatments, follow-up care, and end-of-life care tailored to patients' specific needs. The chosen candidate will work closely with the patient and their loved ones as well as with frontline health professionals, specialists, other health professionals and social support service providers. The chosen candidate will take an active part in the teaching activities in their department, in close collaboration with the Centre de formation médicale du Nouveau-Brunswick. The geriatrician may also take part in research activities in their field of practice.The successful candidate will participate in the implementation of the Geriatric Day Hospital and the Elderly Friendly Hospital concept throughout the network.

The position involves professional medical work performed by licensed specialists (holding specialist licensure recognized by the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick). At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

Our people are the heart of our organization. We have more than 14,000 dedicated employees working with over 1,000 physicians, and play a major role in research, education, innovation and health and wellness.

2130519.title: Primary Care Paramedic
2130519.description:
Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

Salary: As per collective agreement.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics, Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

• Written & Spoken competency in one of the two official languages (English or French) is required and spoken competency in the other official language is preferred.

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest xray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

As valuable member of the Extramural Program's interdisciplinary team, the Patient Care Attendant - 2 (PCA-2) reports to the Unit Manager and provides personal support and assistance with activities of daily living and other services to patients of all ages in the community.

Using a person-centered approach, the PCA-2 works in partnership with the patient and their health care team by holistically supporting the patient's physical, psychological, social, cognitive, cultural, and spiritual needs.

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provides holistic and individualized care across the lifespan.

• Provides food and meal assistance.

• Assists with mobilization.

• Assists with personal hygiene.

• Supports patient care activities by observing and reporting concerns, changes, or relevant information to the appropriate health care team members.

• Provides assistance with Activities of Daily Living (ADL) and Instrumental Activities of Daily Living (IADL).

• Provides palliative, end-of-life (EOL), and postmortem care.

• Recognize and report changes in the patient's status to the primary provider.

• Assists with restricted activities/controlled acts, as delegated by a Regulated Health Professional

• Participates as a member of the healthcare team.

• Documents patient information, care and progress as per EMP documentation standards.

• Maintains patient safety.

• Reports suspected situations of abuse and/or neglect.

• Maintains personal and team members' safety.

• Applies infection prevention and control practices.

• Maintain a clean and safe work area.

• Provides inclusive care.

•

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS

• High school graduation plus an additional patient care program/course of up to six months or equivalent.

• Experience working with adult patients would be an asset;

• A good driving record with a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License;

• Have a current CPR Level C certification that has been issued in the last 12 months;

• Ability to work efficiently as a member of the team, possess strong interpersonal and communication skill;

• Able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record;

• A high regard for confidentiality Good computer knowledge and skills (MS Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Submit a valid and clean criminal record check;

All interested applicants are encouraged to apply as an equivalent combination of education, training and experience may be considered.

Note: For any positions in the St. Stephen EMP unit, a valid Canadian passport or Nexus card will be required.

If you are interested in working with a dynamic team of professionals and possess the necessary qualifications, please click the 'Apply Now' button to submit your resume.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

We currently have an opening for a permanent full-time Senior Environmental Professional based in any of the following NB offices: Fredericton, Moncton or Saint John.

About Us

At GEMTEC, we offer something different. We're an employee-owned, 400-person multidisciplinary consulting firm with offices across Atlantic Canada and Ontario. We're large enough to compete head-to-head with publicly traded engineering giants, but still small enough to maintain the culture and flexibility of a close-knit team. Our size and hands-on management style let us move quickly, embrace new opportunities, and empower our people to shape their own careers, without getting lost in corporate bureaucracy.

About the Role

The position provides the opportunity to primarily support the growing team in New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Newfoundland and Labrador, and across Canada. You will work with a team of engineers, and environmental scientists on a variety of environmental projects in support of infrastructure and land development, renewable energy development and mine development. Some of the key responsibilities are:

• Planning, development and execution of environmental deliverables including Environmental Impact Assessments, Environmental Monitoring Reports, Permit Applications, etc. for proposed development projects in various industry sectors under provincial and/or federal processes.

• Planning, execution, and management of field programs/surveys relevant to the assessment of terrestrial and/or aquatic biology including avifauna, wildlife, vegetation (including rare plants), aquatics, wetlands, species at risk, etc.

• Involved in coordinating, preparing, and reviewing provincial and federal environmental permitting applications.

• Provide oversight of field and office staff including review of health and safety plans, survey methodology, QA/QC practices, etc.

• Preparation and review of proposals, work plans and budgets as well as contributing or leading the management of projects.

• Collaboration with other GEMTEC staff and offices on environmental permitting and related environmental projects of various sizes.

• Involved in coordinating and completing environmental and socioeconomic studies, Aboriginal, stakeholder, and public consultation programs.

Qualifications

• Completion of an undergraduate degree in related field such as Biology, Environmental Engineering or Environmental Science.

• Minimum of 8 years of experience in a related environmental professional role.

• A demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a fast paced, multidisciplinary environment.

• Knowledge and understanding of applicable municipal, provincial, and federal policies, guidelines and legislation for environmental assessments.

• Excellent project management skills with the ability to develop scope of works, execution strategies, and experience with overseeing management of environmental related work.

• Certified wetland delineator would be considered an asset

• Strong oral and written communication skills

• Prior work experience in environmental consulting will be considered an asset

• Must have a valid driver's license

• Travel may be required throughout Atlantic Canada

Benefits and Perks:

• Full time permanent salaried position

• Year end profit sharing bonus

• Health and dental benefits

• Employer matching RRSP up to 5%

• Paid time off (vacation and sick days)

• Office year-end closure (paid time off between Christmas and New Years)

• Future potential opportunity to become a shareholder

• Opportunities to be involved in a wide variety of technically challenging projects across multiple industries as our office grows

We are seeking an Intermediate to Senior Industrial Process Engineer to join our growing Industrial team in Fredericton, NB. This role is ideal for an experienced process engineer with deep expertise in pulp and paper manufacturing and process systems who is looking to play a key role in project delivery, client development, and the continued growth of our industrial practice.

As a Senior Industrial Process Engineer, you will provide technical leadership on complex industrial projects, working closely with clients to develop practical and innovative solutions. You will contribute to all phases of project delivery, from feasibility studies and conceptual design through detailed engineering, construction support, and commissioning.

Your key responsibilities:

• Lead process engineering assignments for pulp and paper, forestry, tissue manufacturing, and other industrial process facilities.

• Develop and review process engineering deliverables including process flow diagrams (PFDs), P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process calculations, and technical reports.

• Provide technical leadership and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, and automation specialists.

• Support feasibility studies, process optimization initiatives, facility expansions, modernization projects, and operational improvements.

• Conduct process assessments, troubleshooting investigations, equipment evaluations, and plant performance reviews.

• Build and maintain strong client relationships while supporting proposal development and business development activities within the industrial sector.

• Provide construction, commissioning, and startup support, ensuring successful project execution and operational performance.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the continued growth of CBCL's industrial process engineering capabilities

Your capabilities and credentials:

• Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation, or eligibility for registration with a provincial engineering association.

• 7+ years of experience in industrial process engineering, with demonstrated expertise in pulp and paper, tissue manufacturing, forestry products, or related industrial sectors.

• Strong understanding of process design, including process flow diagrams (PFDs), P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process modelling, and equipment selection.

• Experience leading feasibility studies, plant assessments, process optimization initiatives, and capital improvement projects.

• Proven ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and effectively communicate complex technical concepts to clients and project stakeholders.

• Strong client relationship management and business development skills, with experience supporting proposals and identifying new project opportunities.

What we can offer you:

• A competitive compensation package effective on your first day of employment:
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits

• CAAT Defined Benefit Pension Plan with employer contributions

• Generous vacation allowance commensurate with experience

• Maternity or Parental leave top-up

• Health spending account

• Wellness incentive

• Membership dues reimbursement

• Education and lifelong learning subsidization

• Community volunteering incentive

• Employee Family Assistance Program

• Public transit subsidy

In addition to the above benefits, we offer:

• Flexible work hours with occasional work-from-home opportunities, supporting both your professional and personal commitments.

• Diverse team with a wide range of experience and expertise.

• Exposure to a variety of projects.

• Support to develop skills and pursue projects related to your own interests.

• Collaboration between multiple disciplines and levels of expertise.

• Mentoring opportunities to foster your personal and professional development.

• Accessible and central offices in Atlantic Canada and Ottawa.

• Access to training opportunities in areas ranging from technical development to leadership skills.

• Competitive salary: $100,000-130,000 annually, depending on experience.

To meet pay transparency requirements, compensation ranges are included for roles in locations where required by law. The salary range listed for this position represents the expected hiring range; actual starting compensation will vary based on factors such as professional experience, technical expertise, credentials, and alignment with the role's requirements, as well as internal compensation structures and market data. Beyond base salary, CBCL provides a comprehensive total rewards package that includes health and dental benefits and a pension program from your first day of employment, along with eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus.

About Us

At CBCL our purpose is to create a positive and lasting impact on people and planet. As an employee-owned firm, at CBCL, our people are everything. We are committed to promoting inclusivity and diversity for a workplace where everyone can thrive, and we build long-term relationships with our clients while providing them with innovative solutions.

We have earned recognition as one of Canada's Top 100 Employers and one of Canada's Best Managed Companies. Our multitalented group of professionals offer consulting in the Infrastructure, Water and Wastewater, Buildings, Industrial, and Earth and Environment sectors. We value our people, our communities, and our history and look forward to continuing our steady growth.

Along with our commitment to reducing our carbon footprint corporately, CBCL develops and implements sustainable engineering solutions that respect the current social and environmental impacts, as well as future implications of our designs.

CBCL operates from its offices in Halifax and Sydney, NS; Charlottetown, PE; Saint John, Fredericton and Moncton, NB; St. John's, NL, and Ottawa, ON.

CBCL Limited strives to provide a diverse workplace that is inclusive, accessible and celebrates individuals and what makes us unique. We are proud to be an employer partner with the Canadian Centre for Diversity and Inclusion and Pride at Work.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace for all. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment or interview process, or while working with us, please email hr@cbcl.ca. We will work with you to meet your needs in a respectful and timely manner.

Our goal is to ensure every candidate has a fair opportunity to demonstrate their abilities. We value diverse perspectives and are dedicated to removing barriers that may prevent individuals from thriving in their roles.

The New Brunswick Extra-Mural Program (EMP), often known as the "hospital without walls," has operated under the simple philosophy of helping New Brunswickers receive the care they need in the places where they are healthiest and happiest - their homes and communities. EMP makes a difference in the lives of those it serves by drastically reducing hospital admissions and greatly increasing patient satisfaction with its level of health care.

As part of EMP, your role is vital in our province's overall health. Join an integrated, multi-disciplinary team of health care professionals, dedicated to providing New Brunswickers with outstanding, highly coordinated primary health care.

## JOB SUMMARY

To holistically coordinate the care of each patient, incorporating the nursing profession's values of knowledge, theory and practice. To assess, plan, implement and evaluate the needs of patients and significant others in the delivery of care and collaborate with all members of the interdisciplinary team in this approach.

## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND OTHER JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Diploma in Nursing or a Bachelor's Degree in Nursing;

• Currently registered and in good standing, or eligible for registration, with the College of Nursing of New Brunswick (CNNB);

• A minimum of two (2) years in the last five (5) years of specialized registered nursing experience with preference in the areas of family practice, surgical, palliative care or oncology in a patient unit that requires daily collaboration with various health disciplines and family members as part of reaching patient goals;

• A good driving record with a valid New Brunswick Class 5 Driver's License;

• Have a current CPR Level C certification or be prepared to obtain within 3 months;

• Ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and possess leadership and coaching skills, strong interpersonal skills, good judgment and decision making skills;

• Support student placement initiatives;

The Director of Cybersecurity is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing the organization's cybersecurity strategy, governance framework, and security operations. This role provides strategic leadership to protect company information, systems, networks, and digital assets from evolving cyber threats while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

## Key Responsibilities:

## Cybersecurity Strategy & Governance

• Develop and execute an enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives.

• Establish cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures based on recognized frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls).

• Advise executive leadership on cybersecurity risks, emerging threats, and strategic investments.

• Develop cybersecurity roadmaps and annual security objectives.

## Security Operations & Incident Response

• Lead the organization's cybersecurity operations, including threat monitoring, detection, investigation, and response.

• Oversee Security Operations Center (SOC) functions and managed security service providers.

• Direct incident response activities, including cybersecurity breaches, ransomware events, and forensic investigations.

• Ensure business continuity and disaster recovery plans are maintained, tested, and continually improved.

## Risk Management & Compliance

• Conduct enterprise cybersecurity risk assessments and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, privacy requirements, and industry standards.

• Lead cybersecurity audits, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing activities, and remediation programs.

• Manage third-party and vendor cybersecurity risk assessments.

## Infrastructure & Technology Security

• Work with IT and technical leadership to keep security architecture across cloud, on-premises, network, endpoint, and application environments aligned with the overall security strategy.

• Guide identity and access management programs, including privileged access management and multi-factor authentication.

• Evaluate and implement cybersecurity technologies and tools.

## Leadership & Team Development

• Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing cybersecurity team.

• Develop cybersecurity awareness and training programs across the organization.

• Manage cybersecurity budgets, resource planning, and vendor relationships.

• Foster a culture of security awareness throughout the business.

## Stakeholder Collaboration

• Partner with IT, technical and architecture leadership, Legal, HR, Risk Management, Operations, and business leaders to strengthen the organization's security posture.

• Present cybersecurity metrics, risks, and initiatives to executive leadership.

• Collaborate with external partners, auditors, regulators, and law enforcement agencies when required.

## Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field considered an asset.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in information security, cybersecurity, or IT leadership roles.

• 5+ years leading cybersecurity teams and enterprise security programs.

• Experience managing cybersecurity operations in complex, multi-site, or global organizations.

• Proven experience with incident response, risk management, cloud security, and regulatory compliance.

## Certifications

• CISSP or CISM preferred.

• CISA, CCSP, or GIAC considered an asset.

## Technical Knowledge

• Security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, and SOC 2.

• Cloud security platforms (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud).

• Identity and Access Management (IAM), SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence solutions.

• Data protection, privacy regulations, and cybersecurity compliance requirements.

## Leadership Competencies

• Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.

• Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills.

• Ability to manage complex security incidents and make decisions under pressure.

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.

• Proven ability to influence organizational change and drive security maturity.

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

Title: Lead Finance Specialist, Capital Projects & Fixed Assets

Employee Working Location: Partially Virtual / Hybrid (Canada)

Employment Status: Permanent Full-time

The Canadian Red Cross (Red Cross) - an inspirational not for profit organization, helps people and communities in Canada and around the world in times of need and supports them in strengthening their resilience. As a Canada's Best Employers 2026, we are committed to having an accessible, diverse, inclusive, and barrier-free work environment.

The Lead Finance Specialist (Capital Projects & Fixed Assets) provides specialized financial leadership and oversight for capital projects, project accounting, capital assets, and related financial controls across the organization. This role is responsible for ensuring that project expenditures, capital investments, and fixed assets are accurately recorded, appropriately governed, and compliant with accounting standards, organizational policies, and internal control requirements.
As the primary finance lead for project accounting and fixed asset management, the role serves as a key advisor to Finance leadership and works closely with project teams, FP&A, operational leaders, procurement, technology, and finance system stakeholders. The Lead Finance Specialist supports informed decision-making through technical accounting guidance, financial governance, capital reporting, compliance oversight, and continuous improvement of project and asset accounting processes.

## In this role, you will :

## Capital Project Accounting & Governance

• Act as the primary finance lead for project accounting and capital investment accounting.

• Establish and maintain project financial structures, cost tracking frameworks, and accounting requirements.

• Review project expenditures and assess capitalization eligibility in accordance with accounting standards and organizational policies.

• Monitor project costs and capital spending to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.

• Provide accounting guidance related to project costs, capitalization, amortization, disposals, and project close-out activities.

• Support development and maintenance of project accounting policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.

## Fixed Asset Management

• Maintain oversight of the full fixed asset lifecycle, including acquisitions, capitalization, transfers, disposals, impairments, and amortization.

• Ensure the completeness and accuracy of the fixed asset register.

• Review and reconcile capital asset and construction-in-progress balances.

• Support physical asset verification activities and asset reviews.

• Ensure asset records are supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.

## Compliance, Controls & Accounting Stewardship

• Ensure compliance with accounting standards, organizational policies, delegation authorities, and internal control requirements.

• Design, implement, and monitor controls related to project accounting and fixed assets.

• Maintain audit-ready documentation and accounting support.

• Coordinate responses to internal and external audit requests related to projects and capital assets.

• Identify control gaps, compliance risks, and opportunities for process improvement.

## D365 & Financial Process Ownership

• Act as Finance process owner for project accounting and fixed asset accounting within D365.

• Support system configurations, testing, enhancements, and process improvements affecting project and capital accounting.

• Partner with Finance Systems, IT, Procurement, and operational stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting, and process effectiveness.

• Develop and maintain accounting procedures, guidance materials, and training resources.

## Stakeholder Support & Continuous Improvement

• Provide technical accounting guidance to project managers, business leaders, and Finance partners.

• Support consistent application of capitalization policies and project accounting requirements across the organization.

• Develop reporting, reconciliations, and monitoring tools that strengthen financial governance.

• Recommend improvements to processes, controls, and reporting practices.

## What Success Looks Like in This Role

A successful Lead Finance Specialist (Capital Projects & Fixed Assets) will:

• Ensure capital projects and fixed assets are accurately accounted for and supported by appropriate documentation.

• Maintain a strong and effective control environment over project accounting and capital assets.

• Deliver timely, accurate, and reliable capital and fixed asset reporting.

• Be recognized as the organization's subject matter expert for project accounting and capital asset accounting.

• Support successful audits with minimal findings related to projects or fixed assets.

• Improve consistency, compliance, and governance across capital project processes.

• Partner effectively with FP&A, project sponsors, and operational leaders while maintaining accounting integrity.

## What we are looking for:

• 8-12 years of relevant experience in accounting, finance, capital project accounting, fixed assets, or financial management.

• CPA designation required.

• Strong knowledge of ASNPO and capital asset accounting requirements.

• Experience supporting large capital projects, technology implementations, ERP projects, or infrastructure investments.

• Experience with project accounting and fixed asset modules within ERP systems, preferably D365.

• Strong accounting, internal control, reconciliation, and audit support experience.

• Effective communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.

## Working Conditions :

• As we work with and support people (managers, colleagues, beneficiaries/customers, volunteers, donors and external partners) and communities in Canada and around the world, applicants whose first language is not English may be required to perform the responsibilities of the role in English.

• Eligibility to work in Canada: At this time, we welcome applications from candidates eligible to work in Canada. If you are not a citizen or permanent resident of Canada, we encourage you to carefully review your visa to find out whether you are eligible to work in the job you are considering applying for. Refer to our FAQ for more information.

• If you are selected for this role, you will be required to complete a successful pre-employment screening process which includes a satisfactory Enhanced Police Information Check (E-PIC).

With short commutes, the warmest ocean waters in Canada, and a rich and colourful cultural experience, New Brunswick is truly Canada's hidden gem. Situated on the Atlantic coast, the province boasts stunning landscapes ranging from pristine beaches to dense forests, providing endless opportunities for outdoor recreation such as hiking, camping, fishing, skiing and more.

2239612.description:
Horizon Health Network is seeking a full-time Anatomical Pathologist to join the Department of Laboratory Medicine at Saint John Regional Hospital, the principal tertiary-care referral centre for southern New Brunswick and Atlantic Canada's leading centre for advanced care.

The successful candidate will join a collegial group of pathologists providing comprehensive diagnostic services to Saint John and the surrounding region. Saint John Regional Hospital is a major teaching hospital affiliated with Dalhousie University Medical School and supports undergraduate and postgraduate medical education, research, and quality improvement initiatives.

The Department of Laboratory Medicine provides a full range of anatomical pathology services, processing a diverse and complex spectrum of surgical pathology, cytopathology, and autopsy specimens from a tertiary-care referral population across southern New Brunswick. The department is supported by a state-of-the-art Molecular Diagnostics and Cytogenetics Program that delivers comprehensive testing across solid tumor oncology, hematologic malignancies, and inherited (germline) disorders.

While all qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, preference will be given to candidates with fellowship training and/or significant experience in one or more of the following areas:

• Renal Pathology

• Neuropathology

• Molecular Pathology

Candidates with expertise that complements existing departmental strengths and supports future program development are particularly encouraged to apply.

## Why you should work here

New Brunswick offers a safe and welcoming community with a relaxed lifestyle and a true work-life balance, enriched by its diverse Indigenous, Anglophone, and Francophone heritage.

Horizon Health Network is the largest health authority in the region, employing dedicated professionals focused on delivering high-quality care. Our employees collaborate with community partners to provide accessible health programs and services to over half a million people through our 12 hospitals and more than 100 medical facilities and clinics.

Saint John is a vibrant coastal city located on the Bay of Fundy, offering an exceptional quality of life, affordable housing, excellent schools, outdoor recreation, and convenient access to Atlantic Canada's natural attractions. The city combines the amenities of an urban centre with the lifestyle advantages of a smaller community.

## Incentives & Remuneration

This position offers highly competitive remuneration for the position is based on New Brunswick Medicare's Alternate Funding Plan (AFP).

Successful applicants may be eligible to receive the following:

• Urban recruitment incentive of $50,000.00 with a 2-year return of service.

• Moving expense reimbursement is also available.

## What you will do

The physician will work collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team, adhere to evidence-based practices aligned with Horizon Health Network's mission.

• Provide diagnostic anatomical pathology services, including surgical pathology and intraoperative consultation

• Participate in subspecialty sign-out and multidisciplinary case conferences

• Contribute to quality assurance, accreditation, and laboratory improvement initiatives

• Participate in medical education for students, residents, and fellows

• Engage in clinical research and scholarly activities as desired

• Share in departmental on-call responsibilities

(Note: These responsibilities are the basic and prime duties associated with this position; other related and allied duties may be assigned from time to time as may be necessary to the operation of Horizon Health Network.)

## Who you are

Applicants must:

• Hold an MD degree (or equivalent)

• Be certified in Anatomical Pathology by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (or equivalent acceptable credentials)

• Be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of New Brunswick

• Demonstrate excellence in diagnostic surgical pathology

• Possess strong communication and teamwork skills

• Be committed to teaching, quality assurance, and continuous professional development

The physician must also meet continuing education requirements, adhere to departmental and health authority policies, comply with relevant legislation, and follow professional ethical standards set by regulatory bodies.

## Interested? Apply Today!

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

2240760.description:
## COMPETITION NUMBER

## 202600417

## POSITION TITLE

Primary Care Paramedic

## LOCATION

Fredericton, NB

## BARGAINING UNIT

NB Union – Specialized Health Care Professionals

## STATUS

Part time permanent

## HOURS OF WORK

Rotating days and nights, weekends, and statutory holidays. Subject to change due to operational requirements.

## ANTICIPATED START DATE

As soon as possible

## ANTICIPATED END DATE

Not applicable

## SALARY RANGE

As per collective agreement

## LANGUAGE REQUIREMENT

Written and spoken competency in one of the two official languages (English or French) is required and spoken competency in the other official language is preferred.

## CLOSING DATE

This competition will remain open until filled.

Imagine a career where, at the end of every day, you know you've made a positive difference in the lives of people who need your help.

At Ambulance New Brunswick, our team consists of talented emergency medical dispatchers, primary and advanced care paramedics, emergency medical technicians, and critical care flight nurses. Health care professionals who respond with their best in some of the most difficult situations imaginable.

As the provincial ambulance service provider, our dispatchers respond to calls from those in medical distress through the 911 system and send help within seconds. Our paramedics take over from there, responding to approximately 130,000 calls per year and transporting patients to hospital by ambulance. And, each year, our specialized air ambulance crew transfers hundreds of the most critically ill and injured patients to specialized medical centres around the Maritimes and beyond.

## Duties of Position:

Clinical expectations and responsibilities for Primary Care Paramedics are based on the current National Occupational Competency Profile (NOCP) for Primary Care Paramedics,Paramedic Association of New Brunswick registration requirements as well as Ambulance NB policies, procedures and protocols.

Our paramedics provide medical support to patients on scene and en route to hospitals. Given the unpredictability of clinical presentations in the field, they are skilled in emergency techniques and well-versed in various medical treatments. "First on scene" in times of crisis, they don't leave until the job's done.

If you're a new graduate from a post-secondary program in paramedicine or have working experience outside the province of New Brunswick, ANB has a standardized process for selecting top candidates to fill Primary Care Paramedic (PCP) positions. Conducted several times a year, the Selection Process consists of a comprehensive assessment to determine your level of qualification to work for our organization.

Required Qualifications:

• You are entitled to work in Canada (Canadian citizenship, permanent resident status or work permit)

• Must demonstrate the ability to work efficiently as a member of the team and be able to work all shifts as assigned, maintaining a good attendance record

• Must have a high regard for confidentiality and patient safety

• Primary Care Paramedic program/course of over six months; If you do not have one and are interested in this career, here is a list of paramedic programs in Atlantic Canada, click here

• Must be registered, active Paramedic with the Paramedic Association of New Brunswick; If you are not currently registered in New Brunswick, please visit PANB at www.panb.ca

• Must have a valid New Brunswick Class 4 Driver's Licence (or equivalent)

Additional requirements for your application:

• Current Resume and Cover Letter

• A copy of your PCP diploma from an accredited institution

• Proof of current registration with Paramedic Association of New Brunswick

• Proof of completion of a Physical Abilities Test (PAT) specific to working as a paramedic within the last 12 months

• Proof of valid CPR level C certification issued in the last 12 months

• Photocopy of front and back of valid Class 4 driver's license (or equivalent) with minimum one year driving experience

• Driver's abstract; issued within the last 30 days

• Copy of any valid Driver's course certificate i.e. CEVO, VFIS or NS VSP or equivalent issued within the last three years

• Criminal Record with Vulnerable Sector Check; issued within the last 30 days

• Immunization Record (Tetanus Tdap) within the last 10 years, 2 MMR vaccines (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) or lab evidenced immunity, 2 Varicella vaccines (Chicken Pox) or lab evidenced immunity, 3 Hepatitis B doses and Lab evidenced immunity, TB Skin Test (2 step) and a 1-step in the last 12 months; if reactive a follow up chest x-ray). Please note, a meeting with our Employee Health and Wellness Consultant can be scheduled, to ensure that all vaccinations are up to date by the time an offer is made

• Valid Official Language Assessments (oral assessment only) in both French and English from the Department of Post-secondary Education, Training and Labour. You can contact them at LS-SL@gnb.ca. Please take into account the additional time to receive your language assessment

• Additional training and/or education is highly valued.

For any questions for our HR team, please contact us at jobs-emplois@ambulancenb.ca

If you are looking for a career that will change lives and have a direct impact on the health of our community, submit your application.

Ambulance NB is committed to the principle of equal opportunity in its employment practices and to providing an environment free from discrimination and harassment for all employees.

We would like to thank all candidates for expressing interest. Please note only those selected for interviews will be contacted.

2226294.title: Water Quality Specialist
2226294.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

## The Role

The Water Quality Specialist is responsible for water quality, water system performance, biosecurity, and system cleanliness across land-based facilities in Maine and Canada. This role plays a critical part in maintaining system integrity, supporting fish health, and ensuring consistent operating standards across all sites.

## Key Responsibilities:

## Water Quality Monitoring & Testing

• Conduct routine and investigative water testing, including:
• Source water

• Transport water

• Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) water

• Analyze results, identify trends, and provide corrective recommendations

## System Performance Oversight

• Monitor and assess performance of:
• UV systems (performance and specifications)

• Ozone systems (performance and specifications)

• RAS system performance

• Effluent treatment systems

• Support optimization and troubleshooting of water treatment and filtration systems

## Biosecurity & Disinfection

• Lead and support system disinfection initiatives

• Develop, standardize, and maintain disinfection protocols and quality control processes

• Conduct biosecurity reviews and site audits to ensure compliance with internal standards

## Site Cleanliness & Controls

• Evaluate and support site cleanliness practices

• Identify risks and implement improvements to reduce contamination and disease transfer

## Fish Transport Disinfection

• Oversee and verify fish transport disinfection practices for:
• Shoreland transport operations

• Subcontractor-managed transport activities

## Travel & Site Engagement

• Perform frequent site visits across Maine and Canada

• Work directly with site teams to assess conditions, provide guidance, and support continuous improvement

## Qualifications & Experience:

• Education in Water Quality, Environmental Science, Biology, Aquaculture, or a related field

• Experience with water treatment systems, RAS operations, or industrial/biological systems preferred

• Strong understanding of biosecurity principles and system hygiene

• Comfortable working in field-based environments with extensive travel requirements

• Strong observational, analytical, and documentation skills

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

• Financial Planning: Opportunity for RRSP matching to support your retirement savings.

• Time Off: Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave for work-life balance.

• Wellness: Wellness programs and access to on-site gym facilities (available in some locations).

• Career Development: Professional growth opportunities and avenues for advancement.

• Perks: Employee discounts on company products or services.

• Convenience: On-site parking or parking allowance.

If you're looking to join a supportive team environment with opportunities for personal and professional development, apply now and become part of our dynamic team.

## The Why

Why Cooke? Simple - because we are a company that rewards initiative, resourcefulness, and work ethic. We will champion your growth and provide you with the platform to create your path, your career, and your future.

NOTE: The recruiter is reviewing and interviewing eligible applicants for this position as they are received. If you are interested in this posting, you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

2226846.description:
Cooke is a global seafood company with operations in North America, Europe, South America and Australia. Our company's success is driven by our dynamic, highly skilled, and innovative management team, supported by dedicated employees who live in coastal communities and contribute to the local area's economy and sense of community.

True North Salmon, part of Cooke, is a recognized leader in premium seafood production, known for quality, sustainability, and innovation. We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Director of Processing to lead our processing operations and play a key role in delivering world-class products to global markets.

## The Role

As Director of Processing, you will take full ownership of plant operations, leading teams, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest standards in safety, quality, and efficiency. This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on operational performance, cost management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

## What You'll Do:

## Lead Operations

• Oversee all processing activities including receiving, grading, filleting, portioning, freezing, packing, and shipping.

• Drive production planning and execution to meet demand while maximizing throughput.

• Monitor performance and implement improvements to increase efficiency and output.

## Drive Performance & Efficiency

• Champion Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Optimize yield, reduce waste, and improve labour productivity.

• Partner with Maintenance to ensure equipment reliability and uptime.

## Ensure Quality & Food Safety

• Maintain compliance with HACCP, CFIA, SQF, BRC, and other regulatory standards.

• Lead resolution of quality or food safety issues with strong corrective actions.

• Promote a culture of quality and food safety across all teams.

## Build and Lead High-Performing Teams

• Lead, coach, and develop managers, supervisors, and production teams.

• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Support recruitment, training, and succession planning.

## Manage Costs & Deliver Results

• Oversee budgets and control labour, materials, and overhead costs.

• Identify and execute cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality.

• Analyze operational data to improve profitability and performance.

## Champion Safety

• Lead safety programs and ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations.

• Promote a proactive, prevention-focused safety culture.

## What You Bring

• 10+ years of leadership experience in fish processing.

• Strong background in plant operations, yield optimization, and cost control.

• Proven ability to lead large teams and drive measurable results.

• Expertise in food safety systems (HACCP, CFIA, SQF, BRC).

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.

• Strong analytical, leadership, and communication skills.

## Working Environment

• Processing plant environment (cold, wet, fast-paced)

• Regular presence on the production floor required

• Use of PPE required at all times

Join our team and enjoy the benefits of full-time year-round employment with competitive rates and a comprehensive benefits package tailored to support your well-being and career growth.

## Benefits Package:

• Health Benefits: Includes coverage for dental, vision, and extended medical care.

• Insurance: Life and disability insurance provided for financial security.

• Support Services: Access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
